 606:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 607:     if (!file) return;
 608:     try {
 609:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 610:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 611:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 612:       const now = Date.now();
 613:       const created: BookRecord = {
 614:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 615:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 616:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 617:         byteLength: file.size,
 618:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 619:         addedAt: now,
 620:       };
 621:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 622:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 623:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 624:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 625:       setBook(created);
 626:       setSession(blank);
 627:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 628:       setError("");
 629:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 630:     } catch (cause) {
 631:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 632:     }
 633:   }
 634: 
 635:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 636:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 637: 
 638:     try {
 639:       await removeBook(item.id);
 640:       await removeSession(item.id);
 641: 
 642:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 643:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 644:         const next = { ...current };
 645:         delete next[item.id];
 646:         return next;
 647:       });
 648: 
 649:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 650:         setBook(null);
 651:         setSession(null);
 652:         setPdf(null);
 653:       }
 654: 
 655:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 656:       setError("");
 657:     } catch (cause) {
 658:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 659:     }
 660:   }
 661:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 662:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 663:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 664:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 665:     try {
 666:       await putBook(renamed);
 667:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 668:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 669:     } catch (cause) {
 670:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 671:     }
 672:   }

 684:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 685:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 686:     try {
 687:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 688:       setSession({
 689:         ...activeSession,
 690:         originalFen: fen,
 691:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 692:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 693:         moves: [],
 694:         moveIndex: 0,
 695:       });
 696:       setLastMove(null);
 697:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 698:       setUserArrows([]);
 699:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 700:       return true;
 701:     } catch (cause) {
 702:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 703:       return false;
 704:     }
 705:   }

 717:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 718:     return true;

 770:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 771:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 772:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 773:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 774:       return;
 775:     }
 776:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 777:     try {
 778:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 779:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 780:       preview.width = crop.width;
 781:       preview.height = crop.height;
 782:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 783:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 784:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 785:     } catch (cause) {
 786:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 787:       return;
 788:     }
 789:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 790:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 791:     setTransferFen("");
 792:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 793:         setRecognitionError("");
 794:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 795:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 796:     try {
 797:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 798:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 799:       });
 800:       const form = new FormData();
 801:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 802:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 803:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 804:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 805:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 806:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 807:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 808:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 809:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 810:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 811:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 812:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 813:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 814:       }
 815:     } catch (cause) {
 816:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 817:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 818:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 819:     }
 820:   }

 822:   function closeTransfer() {
 823:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 824:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 825:     setTransferPreview("");
 826:     setTransferFen("");
 827:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 828:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 829:     setRecognitionError("");
 830:       }

 833:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 834:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 835:       setGameEndOverlay({
 836:         title: "Checkmate",
 837:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 838:       });
 839:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 840:       setGameEndOverlay({
 841:         title: "Stalemate",
 842:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 843:       });
 844:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 845:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 846:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 847:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 848:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 849:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 850:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 851:     } else {
 852:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 853:     }
 854:   }

 856:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 857:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 858:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 859:     try {
 860:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 861:       const result = currentGame.move({
 862:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 863:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 864:         promotion: piece,
 865:       });
 866:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 867:       patchBoardSession({
 868:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 869:         moves: nextMoves,
 870:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 871:       });
 872:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 873:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 874:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 875:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 876:       setError("");
 877:     } catch {
 878:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 879:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 880:     }
 881:   }
 882: 
 883:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 884:     if (!boardSession) return;
 885:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 886:     try {
 887:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 888:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 889:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 890:       if (promote) {
 891:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 892:         return;
 893:       }
 894:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 895:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 896:       if (workspaceMode === "opening-explorer") {
 897:         const line = nextMoves
 898:           .map((move, index) => index % 2 === 0 ? `${Math.floor(index / 2) + 1}. ${move}` : move)
 899:           .join(" ");
 900:         setOpeningExplorerInput(line);
 901:         setOpeningExplorerPly(nextMoves.length);
 902:       } else {
 903:         patchBoardSession({
 904:           currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 905:           moves: nextMoves,
 906:           moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 907:         });
 908:       }
 909:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 910:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 911:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 912:       setError("");
 913:     } catch {
 914:       const piece = game.get(to);
 915:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 916:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 917:     }
 918:   }
 919: 
 920:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 921:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 922:     setRedSquares([]);
 923: 
 924:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 925:       setUserArrows([]);
 926:       setArrowStart(null);
 927:       setArrowHover(null);
 928:       return;
 929:     }
 930: if (!boardSession) return;
 931:     if (annotationMode) {
 932:       if (!arrowStart) {
 933:         setArrowStart(square);
 934:         return;
 935:       }
 936:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 937:       setArrowStart(null);
 938:       setArrowHover(null);
 939:       return;
 940:     }
 941:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 942:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 943:       return;
 944:     }
 945:     const piece = game.get(square);
 946:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 947:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 948:   }

 950:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 951:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 952: 
 953:   event.preventDefault();
 954: 
 955:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 956:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 957:     event.clientX,
 958:     event.clientY,
 959:     bounds,
 960:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 961:   );
 962: 
 963:   if (!square) return;
 964: 
 965:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 966:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 967:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 968:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 969:   setArrowStart(square);
 970:   setArrowHover(square);
 971: 
 972:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 973: }

 975:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 976:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 977:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 978:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
 979:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 980:     setArrowHover(square);
 981:   }

 983:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 984:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 985: 
 986:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 987: 
 988:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 989:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 990:     event.clientX,
 991:     event.clientY,
 992:     bounds,
 993:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 994:   );
 995: 
 996:   if (to && to !== from) {
 997:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 998:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 999:   } else {
1000:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
1001:   }
1002: 
1003:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
1004:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
1005:   setArrowStart(null);
1006:   setArrowHover(null);
1007: }

1015:   function loadPgnText(source: string) {
1016:     try {
1017:       const imported = parsePgn(source);
1018:       const replay = new Chess(imported.lineBaseFen);
1019: 
1020:       for (const san of imported.moves) {
1021:         replay.move(san);
1022:       }
1023: 
1024:       const last = replay.history({ verbose: true }).at(-1);
1025: 
1026:       setAnalysisBoard((current) => ({
1027:         ...current,
1028:         lineBaseFen: imported.lineBaseFen,
1029:         currentFen: imported.finalFen,
1030:         moves: imported.moves,
1031:         moveIndex: imported.moves.length,
1032:       }));
1033: 
1034:       setWorkspaceMode("analysis");
1035:       setStudyMode(false);
1036:       setLastMove(last ? { from: last.from, to: last.to } : null);
1037:       setSelectedSquare(null);
1038: 
1039:       const white = imported.headers.White || "White";
1040:       const black = imported.headers.Black || "Black";
1041:       setNotice(`PGN loaded: ${white} vs ${black} · ${imported.moves.length} plies.`);
1042:       setError("");
1043:     } catch (cause) {
1044:       setError(`PGN import failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1045:     }
1046:   }

1105:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
1106:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
1107: 
1108:     const controller = scanAbortControllerRef.current;
1109:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1110:     controller?.abort();

1115:     setCropEditingId(null);
1116:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1117:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1118:

1120:       ...current,
1121:       candidatesByPage: {
1122:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1123:         [String(current.page)]: [],
1124:       },
1125:       selectedDiagramId: null,
1126:     }));

1131:   async function detectBoards() {
1132:     if (detecting) {
1133:       stopBoardScan();
1134:       return;
1135:     }
1136: 
1137:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
1138:     if (!API_BASE) {
1139:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
1140:       return;
1141:     }
1142: 
1143:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
1144:     const abortController = new AbortController();
1145:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
1146:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
1147: 
1148:     setDetecting(true);
1149:     setError("");
1150:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
1151:     patchSession((current) => ({
1152:       ...current,
1153:       candidatesByPage: {
1154:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1155:         [String(current.page)]: [],
1156:       },
1157:       selectedDiagramId: null,
1158:     }));
1159: 
1160:     try {
1161:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
1162:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
1163:           (blob) => blob
1164:             ? resolve(blob)
1165:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
1166:           "image/png",
1167:         );
1168:       });
1169: 
1170:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1171: 
1172:       const form = new FormData();
1173:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
1174: 
1175:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
1176:         method: "POST",
1177:         body: form,
1178:         signal: abortController.signal,
1179:       });
1180: 
1181:       if (!response.ok) {
1182:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
1183:       }
1184: 
1185:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
1186:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
1187:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
1188:       );
1189: 
1190:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1191: 
1192:       patchSession((current) => ({
1193:         ...current,
1194:         candidatesByPage: {
1195:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
1196:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
1197:         },
1198:         selectedDiagramId: null,
1199:       }));
1200: 
1201:       setNotice(
1202:         candidates.length
1203:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
1204:           : "No board candidates found.",
1205:       );
1206:     } catch (cause) {
1207:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1208: 
1209:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
1210:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
1211:       } else {
1212:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1213:       }
1214:     } finally {
1215:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
1216:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1217:         setDetecting(false);
1218:       }
1219:     }
1220:   }
1221:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {
1222:     const box = canvasRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
1223:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;
1224:   }
1225: 
1226:   function startCropEdit(
1227:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
1228:     candidate: Candidate,
1229:     handle: CropHandle,
1230:   ) {
1231:     event.stopPropagation();
1232:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1233:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;
1234:     if (!point || !stage) return;
1235:     cropEditStartRef.current = { candidate, handle, point };
1236:     stage.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1237:   }
1238: 
1239:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1240:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1241:     if (!manualMode) return;
1242: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1243: if (!canvas) return;
1244: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1245: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1246: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1247: if (
1248:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1249:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1250:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1251:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1252: ) return;
1253:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1254:     if (!point) return;
1255:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1256:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1257:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1258:     setDragSelection(selection);
1259:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1260:   }
1261: 
1262:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1263:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1264:     if (edit) {
1265:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1266:       if (!point || !session) return;
1267:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1268:       patchSession((current) => {
1269:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1270:         return {
1271:           ...current,
1272:           candidatesByPage: {
1273:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1274:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1275:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1276:           },
1277:         };
1278:       });
1279:       return;
1280:     }
1281:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1282:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1283:     if (point) {
1284:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1285:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1286:       setDragSelection(selection);
1287:     }
1288:   }
1289: 
1290:   function finishRegion() {
1291:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1292:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1293:       return;
1294:     }
1295:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1296:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1297:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1298:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1299:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1300:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1301:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1302:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1303:     setDragSelection(null);
1304:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1305:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1306:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1307:       x, y, width, height,
1308:       relativeScore: 1,
1309:       source: "manual",
1310:     };
1311:     patchSession((current) => ({
1312:       ...current,
1313:       candidatesByPage: {
1314:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1315:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1316:       },
1317:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1318:     }));
1319:     setManualMode(false);
1320:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1321:   }
1322: 
1323:   function cancelRegion() {
1324:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1325:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1326:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1327:     setDragSelection(null);
1328:   }

1330:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1331:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1332:     try {
1333:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1334:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1335:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1336:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1337:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1338:       const scale = mode === "width"
1339:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1340:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1341:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1342:     } catch (cause) {
1343:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1344:     }
1345:   }

 473:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 474:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 475:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 476:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 477:     try {
 478:       await putBook(renamed);
 479:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 480:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 481:     } catch (cause) {
 482:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 483:     }
 484:   }

 486:   function changePage(delta: number) {
 487:     if (!session) return;
 488:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });
 489:   }

 491:   function goToPage(value: number) {
 492:     if (!session || !Number.isFinite(value)) return;
 493:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });
 494:   }

 496:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 497:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 498:     try {
 499:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 500:       setSession({
 501:         ...activeSession,
 502:         originalFen: fen,
 503:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 504:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 505:         moves: [],
 506:         moveIndex: 0,
 507:       });
 508:       setLastMove(null);
 509:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 510:       setUserArrows([]);
 511:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 512:       return true;
 513:     } catch (cause) {
 514:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 515:       return false;
 516:     }
 517:   }

 519:   function analyzeManualPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 520:     const loaded = moveToPosition(fen);
 521:     if (!loaded) return false;
 522:     setEngineScore(null);
 523:     setEngineMessage("");
 524:     if (!engineEnabled) {
 525:       toggleEngine();
 526:     } else {
 527:       engineRef.current?.analyze(fen, engineDepth);
 528:     }
 529:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 530:     return true;
 531:   }

 582:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 583:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 584:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 585:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 586:       return;
 587:     }
 588:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 589:     try {
 590:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 591:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 592:       preview.width = crop.width;
 593:       preview.height = crop.height;
 594:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 595:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 596:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 597:     } catch (cause) {
 598:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 599:       return;
 600:     }
 601:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 602:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 603:     setTransferFen("");
 604:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 605:         setRecognitionError("");
 606:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 607:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 608:     try {
 609:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 610:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 611:       });
 612:       const form = new FormData();
 613:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 614:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 615:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 616:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 617:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 618:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 619:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 620:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 621:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 622:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 623:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 624:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 625:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 626:       }
 627:     } catch (cause) {
 628:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 629:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 630:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 631:     }
 632:   }
 633: 
 634:   function closeTransfer() {
 635:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 636:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 637:     setTransferPreview("");
 638:     setTransferFen("");
 639:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 640:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 641:     setRecognitionError("");
 642:       }

 645:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 646:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 647:       setGameEndOverlay({
 648:         title: "Checkmate",
 649:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 650:       });
 651:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 652:       setGameEndOverlay({
 653:         title: "Stalemate",
 654:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 655:       });
 656:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 657:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 658:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 659:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 660:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 661:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 662:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 663:     } else {
 664:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 665:     }
 666:   }
 667: 
 668:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 669:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 670:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 671:     try {
 672:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 673:       const result = currentGame.move({
 674:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 675:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 676:         promotion: piece,
 677:       });
 678:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 679:       patchBoardSession({
 680:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 681:         moves: nextMoves,
 682:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 683:       });
 684:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 685:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 686:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 687:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 688:       setError("");
 689:     } catch {
 690:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 691:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 692:     }
 693:   }
 694: 
 695:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 696:     if (!boardSession) return;
 697:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 698:     try {
 699:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 700:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 701:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 702:       if (promote) {
 703:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 704:         return;
 705:       }
 706:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 707:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 708:       patchBoardSession({
 709:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 710:         moves: nextMoves,
 711:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 712:       });
 713:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 714:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 715:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 716:       setError("");
 717:     } catch {
 718:       const piece = game.get(to);
 719:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 720:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 721:     }
 722:   }
 723: 
 724:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 725:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 726:     setRedSquares([]);
 727: 
 728:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 729:       setUserArrows([]);
 730:       setArrowStart(null);
 731:       setArrowHover(null);
 732:       return;
 733:     }
 734: if (!session) return;
 735:     if (annotationMode) {
 736:       if (!arrowStart) {
 737:         setArrowStart(square);
 738:         return;
 739:       }
 740:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 741:       setArrowStart(null);
 742:       setArrowHover(null);
 743:       return;
 744:     }
 745:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 746:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 747:       return;
 748:     }
 749:     const piece = game.get(square);
 750:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 751:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 752:   }

 754:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 755:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 756: 
 757:   event.preventDefault();
 758: 
 759:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 760:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 761:     event.clientX,
 762:     event.clientY,
 763:     bounds,
 764:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 765:   );
 766: 
 767:   if (!square) return;
 768: 
 769:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 770:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 771:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 772:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 773:   setArrowStart(square);
 774:   setArrowHover(square);
 775: 
 776:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 777: }

 779:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 780:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 781:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 782:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
 783:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 784:     setArrowHover(square);

 787:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 788:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 789: 
 790:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 791: 
 792:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 793:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 794:     event.clientX,
 795:     event.clientY,
 796:     bounds,
 797:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 798:   );
 799: 
 800:   if (to && to !== from) {
 801:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 802:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 803:   } else {
 804:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 805:   }
 806: 
 807:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 808:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 809:   setArrowStart(null);
 810:   setArrowHover(null);
 811: }

 863:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
 864:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 865: 
 866:     const controller = scanAbortControllerRef.current;
 867:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 868:     controller?.abort();
 869:

 871:     setManualMode(false);
 872:     setDragSelection(null);
 873:     setCropEditingId(null);
 874:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 875:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 876: 
 877:     patchSession((current) => ({
 878:       ...current,
 879:       candidatesByPage: {
 880:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 881:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 882:       },
 883:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 884:     }));
 885: 
 886:     setError("");
 887:     setNotice("Board detection cleared.");

 889:   async function detectBoards() {
 890:     if (detecting) {
 891:       stopBoardScan();
 892:       return;
 893:     }
 894: 
 895:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 896:     if (!API_BASE) {
 897:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 898:       return;
 899:     }
 900: 
 901:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 902:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 903:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 904:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 905: 
 906:     setDetecting(true);
 907:     setError("");
 908:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 909:     patchSession((current) => ({
 910:       ...current,
 911:       candidatesByPage: {
 912:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 913:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 914:       },
 915:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 916:     }));
 917: 
 918:     try {
 919:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 920:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 921:           (blob) => blob
 922:             ? resolve(blob)
 923:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 924:           "image/png",
 925:         );
 926:       });
 927: 
 928:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 929: 
 930:       const form = new FormData();
 931:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 932: 
 933:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 934:         method: "POST",
 935:         body: form,
 936:         signal: abortController.signal,
 937:       });
 938: 
 939:       if (!response.ok) {
 940:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 941:       }
 942: 
 943:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 944:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 945:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 946:       );
 947: 
 948:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 949: 
 950:       patchSession((current) => ({
 951:         ...current,
 952:         candidatesByPage: {
 953:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 954:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 955:         },
 956:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 957:       }));
 958: 
 959:       setNotice(
 960:         candidates.length
 961:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 962:           : "No board candidates found.",
 963:       );
 964:     } catch (cause) {
 965:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 966: 
 967:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 968:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 969:       } else {
 970:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 971:       }
 972:     } finally {
 973:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 974:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 975:         setDetecting(false);
 976:       }
 977:     }
 978:   }

 981:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;

 984:   function startCropEdit(
 985:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
 986:     candidate: Candidate,

 988:   ) {
 989:     event.stopPropagation();
 990:     const point = pointerPosition(event);

 997:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 998:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 999:     if (!manualMode) return;
1000: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1001: if (!canvas) return;
1002: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1003: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1004: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1005: if (
1006:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1007:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1008:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1009:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1010: ) return;
1011:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1012:     if (!point) return;
1013:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1014:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1015:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1016:     setDragSelection(selection);
1017:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1018:   }

1020:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1021:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1022:     if (edit) {
1023:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1024:       if (!point || !session) return;
1025:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1026:       patchSession((current) => {
1027:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1028:         return {
1029:           ...current,
1030:           candidatesByPage: {
1031:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1032:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1033:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1034:           },
1035:         };
1036:       });
1037:       return;
1038:     }
1039:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1040:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1041:     if (point) {
1042:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1043:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1044:       setDragSelection(selection);
1045:     }
1046:   }
1047: 
1048:   function finishRegion() {
1049:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1050:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1051:       return;
1052:     }
1053:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1054:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1055:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1056:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1057:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1058:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1059:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1060:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1061:     setDragSelection(null);
1062:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1063:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1064:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1065:       x, y, width, height,
1066:       relativeScore: 1,
1067:       source: "manual",
1068:     };
1069:     patchSession((current) => ({
1070:       ...current,
1071:       candidatesByPage: {
1072:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1073:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1074:       },
1075:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1076:     }));
1077:     setManualMode(false);
1078:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1079:   }
1080: 
1081:   function cancelRegion() {
1082:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1083:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1084:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1085:     setDragSelection(null);

 249:         const step = event.shiftKey ? 0.01 : 0.002;
 250:         const x = event.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowRight" ? step : 0;
 251:         const y = event.key === "ArrowUp" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowDown" ? step : 0;
 252:         const next = editCrop(candidate, "move", x, y);
 253:         patchSession((current) => {
 254:           const pageKey = String(current.page);
 255:           return {
 256:             ...current,
 257:             candidatesByPage: {
 258:               ...current.candidatesByPage,
 259:               [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((item) =>
 260:                 item.id === candidate.id ? { ...item, ...next } : item),
 261:             },
 262:           };
 263:         });
 264:         event.preventDefault();
 265:         return;
 266:       }
 267:       if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") changePage(-1);
 268:       if (event.key === "ArrowRight") changePage(1);
 269:     }
 270:     window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 271:     return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 272:   });
 273: 
 274:   useEffect(() => () => {
 275:     engineRef.current?.dispose();
 276:     engineRef.current = null;
 277:   }, []);
 278: 
 279:   const sortedBooks = useMemo(() => [...books].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt), [books]);
 280:   const visibleBooks = useMemo(() => {
 281:     const needle = bookSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
 282:     return sortedBooks.filter((item) => {
 283:       const saved = sessionIndex[item.id];
 284:       const matchesTab =
 285:         libraryTab === "all" || libraryTab === "recent" || libraryTab === "local" ||
 286:         (libraryTab === "bookmarks" && (saved?.bookmarks.length ?? 0) > 0) ||
 287:         (libraryTab === "positions" && (saved?.positions.length ?? 0) > 0) ||
 288:         (libraryTab === "progress" && (saved?.page ?? 1) > 1);
 289:       return matchesTab && item.title.toLowerCase().includes(needle);
 290:     });
 291:   }, [bookSearch, libraryTab, sessionIndex, sortedBooks]);
 292: 
 293:   const game = useMemo(() => {
 294:     if (!session) return new Chess();
 295:     try {
 296:       return makePosition(session.lineBaseFen, session.moves, session.moveIndex);
 297:     } catch {
 298:       try { return new Chess(session.currentFen); } catch { return new Chess(); }
 299:     }
 300:   }, [session]);
 301:   const legalTargets = useMemo(() => {
 302:     if (!selectedSquare) return new Set<string>();
 303:     return new Set(game.moves({ square: selectedSquare, verbose: true }).map((move) => move.to));
 304:   }, [game, selectedSquare]);
 305:   const pieceSquares = game.board();
 306:   const moveHistory = useMemo(() => {
 307:     try { return makePosition(session?.lineBaseFen ?? START_FEN, session?.moves ?? [], session?.moveIndex ?? 0).history({ verbose: true }); }
 308:     catch { return []; }
 309:   }, [session]);
 310:   const highlightedMove = lastMove ?? (moveHistory.length
 311:     ? { from: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].from, to: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].to }
 312:     : null);
 313:   const engineArrow = useMemo(
 314:     () => engineEnabled ? parseBestMove(engineScore?.bestMove) : null,
 315:     [engineEnabled, engineScore?.bestMove],
 316:   );
 317: 
 318:   useEffect(() => {
 319:     setUserArrows([]);
 320:     setArrowStart(null);
 321:     setArrowHover(null);
 322:     setAnnotationMode(false);
 323:   }, [book?.id, session?.currentFen]);
 324: 
 325:   useEffect(() => {
 326:     if (engineEnabled) engineRef.current?.analyze(game.fen(), engineDepth);
 327:   }, [engineEnabled, session?.currentFen, session?.moveIndex, engineDepth]);

 329:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 330:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 331:   }

 333:   function toggleEngine() {
 334:     if (engineEnabled) {
 335:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 336:       engineRef.current = null;
 337:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 338:       setEngineStatus("off");
 339:       setEngineScore(null);
 340:       setEngineMessage("");
 341:       return;
 342:     }
 343:     try {
 344:       setEngineScore(null);
 345:       setEngineMessage("");
 346:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 347:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 348:         (status, message) => {
 349:           setEngineStatus(status);
 350:           if (status === "error") {
 351:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 352:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 353:             setEngineScore(null);
 354:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 355:             engineRef.current = null;
 356:           }
 357:         },
 358:         setEngineScore,
 359:       );
 360:       engineRef.current = client;
 361:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 362:     } catch (cause) {
 363:       setEngineStatus("error");
 364:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 365:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 366:     }
 367:   }

 369:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 370:     setSession((current) => {
 371:       if (!current) return current;
 372:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 373:     });
 374:   }

 376:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 377:     try {
 378:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 379:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 380:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 381:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 382:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 383:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 384:       setBook(opened);
 385:       setSession(nextSession);
 386:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 387:       setError("");
 388:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 389:     } catch (cause) {
 390:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 391:     }
 392:   }

 394:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 395:     if (!file) return;
 396:     try {
 397:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 398:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 399:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 400:       const now = Date.now();
 401:       const created: BookRecord = {
 402:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 403:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 404:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 405:         byteLength: file.size,
 406:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 407:         addedAt: now,
 408:       };
 409:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 410:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 411:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 412:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 413:       setBook(created);
 414:       setSession(blank);
 415:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 416:       setError("");
 417:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 418:     } catch (cause) {
 419:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 420:     }
 421:   }

 423:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 424:     if (!window.confirm(`Remove "${item.title}" from your library?`)) return;
 425: 
 426:     try {
 427:       await removeBook(item.id);
 428:       await removeSession(item.id);
 429: 
 430:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 431:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 432:         const next = { ...current };
 433:         delete next[item.id];
 434:         return next;
 435:       });
 436: 
 437:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 438:         setBook(null);
 439:         setSession(null);
 440:         setPdf(null);
 441:       }
 442: 
 443:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 444:       setError("");
 445:     } catch (cause) {
 446:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 447:     }
 448:   }
 449:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 450:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 451:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 452:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 453:     try {
 454:       await putBook(renamed);
 455:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 456:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 457:     } catch (cause) {
 458:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 459:     }
 460:   }

 542:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 543:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 544:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 545:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 546:       return;
 547:     }
 548:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 549:     try {
 550:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 551:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 552:       preview.width = crop.width;
 553:       preview.height = crop.height;
 554:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 555:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 556:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 557:     } catch (cause) {
 558:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 559:       return;
 560:     }
 561:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 562:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 563:     setTransferFen("");
 564:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 565:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 566:     setRecognitionError("");
 567:     setTransferPiece("P");
 568:     const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 569:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 570:     try {
 571:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 572:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 573:       });
 574:       const form = new FormData();
 575:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 576:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 577:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 578:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 579:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 580:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 581:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 582:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 583:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 584:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 585:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 586:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 587:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 588:       }
 589:     } catch (cause) {
 590:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 591:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 592:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 593:     }
 594:   }
 595: 
 596:   function closeTransfer() {
 597:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 598:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 599:     setTransferPreview("");
 600:     setTransferFen("");
 601:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 602:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 603:     setRecognitionError("");
 604:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 605:   }

 607:   function editTransferSquare(displayRow: number, displayCol: number) {
 608:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 609:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 610:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a six-field FEN before editing individual squares.");
 611:       return;
 612:     }
 613:     const board = parseFenPlacement(fields[0]);
 614:     if (!board) {
 615:       setRecognitionError("The FEN piece placement is invalid. Correct it before editing squares.");
 616:       return;
 617:     }
 618:     const row = displayRow;
 619:     const col = displayCol;
 620:     try {
 621:       const placement = setFenPiece(fields[0], row, col, transferPiece);
 622:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, placement));
 623:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 624:       setRecognitionError("");
 625:     } catch (cause) {
 626:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 627:     }
 628:   }
 629: 
 630:   function flipTransferPosition() {
 631:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 632:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 633:       setRecognitionError("Recognize a position or enter a complete FEN before flipping it.");
 634:       return;
 635:     }
 636:     try {
 637:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, flipFenPlacement(fields[0])));
 638:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 639:       setRecognitionError("");
 640:     } catch (cause) {
 641:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 642:     }
 643:   }

 645:   function confirmTransfer() {
 646:     if (!transferCandidate) return;
 647:     if (!transferFen.trim()) {
 648:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a FEN position first.");
 649:       return;
 650:     }
 651:     if (moveToPosition(transferFen.trim())) {
 652:       closeTransfer();
 653:     }
 654:   }
 655: 
 656:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 657:     if (!session) return;
 658:     try {
 659:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 660:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 661:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 662:       let promotion: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" = "q";
 663:       if (promote) {
 664:         const choice = window.prompt("Promote to queen, rook, bishop, or knight? (q/r/b/n)", "q")?.toLowerCase();
 665:         if (!choice) return;
 666:         switch (choice) {
 667:           case "q": promotion = "q"; break;
 668:           case "r": promotion = "r"; break;
 669:           case "b": promotion = "b"; break;
 670:           case "n": promotion = "n"; break;
 671:           default:
 672:             setError("Promotion must be q, r, b, or n.");
 673:             return;
 674:         }
 675:       }
 676:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to, promotion });
 677:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 678:       patchSession({
 679:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 680:         moves: nextMoves,
 681:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 682:       });
 683:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 684:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 685:       setError("");
 686:     } catch {
 687:       const piece = game.get(to);
 688:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 689:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 690:     }
 691:   }
 692: 
 693:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 694:     if (!session) return;
 695:     if (annotationMode) {
 696:       if (!arrowStart) {
 697:         setArrowStart(square);
 698:         return;
 699:       }
 700:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 701:       setArrowStart(null);
 702:       setArrowHover(null);
 703:       return;
 704:     }
 705:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 706:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 707:       return;
 708:     }
 709:     const piece = game.get(square);
 710:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 711:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 712:   }

 741:     setArrowHover(null);

 772:   async function detectBoards() {
 773:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 774:     if (!API_BASE) {
 775:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Start the optional CV service and set VITE_API_BASE_URL, or draw a board region manually.");
 776:       return;
 777:     }
 778:     // Abort any previous scan
 779:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 780:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 781:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 782:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 783:     setDetecting(true);
 784:     setError("");
 785:     try {
 786:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 787:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")), "image/png");
 788:       });
 789:       const form = new FormData();
 790:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 791:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, { method: "POST", body: form, signal: abortController.signal });
 792:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 793:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 794:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map((item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index));
 795:       // Only update state if this is the latest request
 796:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 797:       patchSession((current) => ({
 798:         ...current,
 799:         candidatesByPage: { ...current.candidatesByPage, [String(current.page)]: candidates },
 800:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 801:       }));
 802:       setNotice(candidates.length ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.` : "No board candidates found. You can draw a region manually.");
 803:     } catch (cause) {
 804:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 805:         // Scan cancelled â€“ silent handling
 806:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 807:       } else {
 808:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 809:       }
 810:     } finally {
 811:       // Ensure detecting flag cleared only for the latest request
 812:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 813:         setDetecting(false);
 814:       }
 815:     }
 816:   }
 817: 
 818:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {
 819:     const box = canvasRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
 820:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;
 821:   }
 822: 
 823:   function startCropEdit(
 824:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
 825:     candidate: Candidate,
 826:     handle: CropHandle,
 827:   ) {
 828:     event.stopPropagation();
 829:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 830:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;
 831:     if (!point || !stage) return;
 832:     cropEditStartRef.current = { candidate, handle, point };
 833:     stage.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 834:   }
 835: 
 836:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 837:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 838:     if (!manualMode) return;
 839: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 840: if (!canvas) return;
 841: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 842: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 843: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 844: if (
 845:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 846:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 847:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 848:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 849: ) return;
 850:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 851:     if (!point) return;
 852:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 853:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 854:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 855:     setDragSelection(selection);
 856:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 857:   }
 858: 
 859:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 860:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 861:     if (edit) {
 862:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 863:       if (!point || !session) return;
 864:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 865:       patchSession((current) => {
 866:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 867:         return {
 868:           ...current,
 869:           candidatesByPage: {
 870:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 871:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 872:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 873:           },
 874:         };
 875:       });
 876:       return;
 877:     }
 878:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
 879:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 880:     if (point) {
 881:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 882:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 883:       setDragSelection(selection);
 884:     }
 885:   }
 886: 
 887:   function finishRegion() {
 888:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
 889:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 890:       return;
 891:     }
 892:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
 893:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
 894:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
 895:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
 896:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
 897:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
 898:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 899:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 900:     setDragSelection(null);
 901:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
 902:     const candidate: Candidate = {
 903:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
 904:       x, y, width, height,
 905:       relativeScore: 1,
 906:       source: "manual",
 907:     };
 908:     patchSession((current) => ({
 909:       ...current,
 910:       candidatesByPage: {
 911:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 912:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
 913:       },
 914:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
 915:     }));
 916:     setManualMode(false);
 917:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
 918:   }
 919: 
 920:   function cancelRegion() {
 921:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 922:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 923:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 924:     setDragSelection(null);
 925:   }

 927:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
 928:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
 929:     try {
 930:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
 931:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
 932:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
 933:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
 934:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
 935:       const scale = mode === "width"
 936:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
 937:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
 938:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
 939:     } catch (cause) {
 940:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 941:     }
 942:   }

 944:   async function expandBoard() {

 947:     try {
 948:       if (document.fullscreenElement) await document.exitFullscreen();
 949:       else await target.requestFullscreen();
 950:     } catch (cause) {
 951:       setError(`Could not expand chessboard: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 952:     }
 953:   }

 172:   }, [ready, book, session]);
 173: 
 174:   useEffect(() => {
 175:     pdfRef.current?.cleanup();
 176:     void loadingTaskRef.current?.destroy();
 177:     setPdf(null);
 178:     if (!book) {
 179:       pdfRef.current = null;
 180:       loadingTaskRef.current = null;
 181:       return;
 182:     }
 183:     let cancelled = false;
 184:     let loadingTask: PDFDocumentLoadingTask | null = null;
 185:     setPdfLoading(true);
 186:     setError("");
 187:     book.file.slice(0).arrayBuffer().then((data) => {
 188:       if (cancelled) return;
 189:       loadingTask = getDocument({ data });
 190:       loadingTaskRef.current = loadingTask;
 191:       return loadingTask.promise;
 192:     }).then((document) => {
 193:       if (!document) return;
 194:       if (cancelled) {
 195:         void document.cleanup();
 196:         return;
 197:       }

 199:       setPdf(document);
 200:       setPdfLoading(false);
 201:       setSession((current) => current ? { ...current, pageCount: document.numPages } : current);
 202:     }).catch((cause: unknown) => {
 203:       if (!cancelled) {
 204:         setPdfLoading(false);
 205:         setError(`Could not open this PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 206:       }
 207:     });
 208:     return () => {
 209:       cancelled = true;
 210:       if (loadingTask) void loadingTask.destroy();
 211:     };

 220:       if (cancelled) return;

 222:       const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
 223:       if (!context) throw new Error("Canvas rendering is unavailable in this browser.");
 224:       canvas.width = Math.floor(viewport.width);
 225:       canvas.height = Math.floor(viewport.height);
 226:       const task = page.render({ canvas, canvasContext: context, viewport });
 227:       renderTaskRef.current = task;
 228:       return task.promise;
 229:     }).then(() => {
 230:       if (!cancelled) setRendering(false);
 231:     }).catch((cause: unknown) => {
 232:       if (!cancelled && !(cause instanceof Error && cause.name === "RenderingCancelledException")) {
 233:         setRendering(false);
 234:         setError(`Could not render page ${session.page}: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 235:       }
 236:     });
 237:     return () => {
 238:       cancelled = true;
 239:       renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();
 240:     };
 241:   }, [pdf, session?.page, session?.zoom]);
 242: 
 243:   useEffect(() => {
 244:     function onKey(event: KeyboardEvent) {
 245:       if (!session || !book || isTypingTarget(event.target)) return;
 246:       if (cropEditingId && ["ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", "ArrowUp", "ArrowDown"].includes(event.key)) {
 247:         const candidate = (session.candidatesByPage[String(session.page)] ?? []).find((item) => item.id === cropEditingId);
 248:         if (!candidate) return;
 249:         const step = event.shiftKey ? 0.01 : 0.002;
 250:         const x = event.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowRight" ? step : 0;
 251:         const y = event.key === "ArrowUp" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowDown" ? step : 0;
 252:         const next = editCrop(candidate, "move", x, y);
 253:         patchSession((current) => {
 254:           const pageKey = String(current.page);
 255:           return {
 256:             ...current,
 257:             candidatesByPage: {
 258:               ...current.candidatesByPage,
 259:               [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((item) =>
 260:                 item.id === candidate.id ? { ...item, ...next } : item),
 261:             },
 262:           };
 263:         });
 264:         event.preventDefault();
 265:         return;
 266:       }
 267:       if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") changePage(-1);
 268:       if (event.key === "ArrowRight") changePage(1);
 269:     }
 270:     window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 271:     return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 272:   });

 279:   const sortedBooks = useMemo(() => [...books].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt), [books]);
 280:   const visibleBooks = useMemo(() => {

 282:     return sortedBooks.filter((item) => {

 287:         (libraryTab === "positions" && (saved?.positions.length ?? 0) > 0) ||

 289:       return matchesTab && item.title.toLowerCase().includes(needle);

 293:   const game = useMemo(() => {
 294:     if (!session) return new Chess();

 296:       return makePosition(session.lineBaseFen, session.moves, session.moveIndex);

 329:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 330:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 331:   }

 333:   function toggleEngine() {
 334:     if (engineEnabled) {
 335:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 336:       engineRef.current = null;
 337:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 338:       setEngineStatus("off");
 339:       setEngineScore(null);
 340:       setEngineMessage("");
 341:       return;
 342:     }
 343:     try {
 344:       setEngineScore(null);
 345:       setEngineMessage("");
 346:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 347:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 348:         (status, message) => {
 349:           setEngineStatus(status);
 350:           if (status === "error") {
 351:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 352:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 353:             setEngineScore(null);
 354:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 355:             engineRef.current = null;
 356:           }
 357:         },
 358:         setEngineScore,
 359:       );
 360:       engineRef.current = client;
 361:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 362:     } catch (cause) {
 363:       setEngineStatus("error");
 364:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 365:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 366:     }
 367:   }

 369:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 370:     setSession((current) => {
 371:       if (!current) return current;
 372:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 373:     });
 374:   }

 376:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 377:     try {
 378:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 379:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 380:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 381:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 382:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 383:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 384:       setBook(opened);
 385:       setSession(nextSession);
 386:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 387:       setError("");
 388:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 389:     } catch (cause) {
 390:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 391:     }
 392:   }

 394:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 395:     if (!file) return;
 396:     try {
 397:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 398:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 399:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 400:       const now = Date.now();
 401:       const created: BookRecord = {
 402:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 403:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 404:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 405:         byteLength: file.size,
 406:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 407:         addedAt: now,
 408:       };
 409:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 410:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 411:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 412:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 413:       setBook(created);
 414:       setSession(blank);
 415:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 416:       setError("");
 417:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 418:     } catch (cause) {
 419:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 420:     }
 421:   }

 423:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 424:     if (!window.confirm(`Remove "${item.title}" from your library?`)) return;
 425: 
 426:     try {
 427:       await removeBook(item.id);
 428:       await removeSession(item.id);
 429: 
 430:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 431:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 432:         const next = { ...current };
 433:         delete next[item.id];
 434:         return next;
 435:       });
 436: 
 437:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 438:         setBook(null);
 439:         setSession(null);
 440:         setPdf(null);
 441:       }
 442: 
 443:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 444:       setError("");
 445:     } catch (cause) {
 446:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 447:     }
 448:   }
 449:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 450:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 451:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 452:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 453:     try {
 454:       await putBook(renamed);
 455:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 456:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 457:     } catch (cause) {
 458:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 459:     }
 460:   }

 465:   }

 481:         moveIndex: 0,

 483:       setLastMove(null);
 484:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 485:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 486:       return true;
 487:     } catch (cause) {
 488:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 489:       return false;
 490:     }
