 542:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 543:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 544:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 545:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 546:       return;
 547:     }
 548:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 549:     try {
 550:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 551:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 552:       preview.width = crop.width;
 553:       preview.height = crop.height;
 554:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 555:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 556:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 557:     } catch (cause) {
 558:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 559:       return;
 560:     }
 561:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 562:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 563:     setTransferFen("");
 564:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 565:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 566:     setRecognitionError("");
 567:     setTransferPiece("P");
 568:     const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 569:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 570:     try {
 571:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 572:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 573:       });
 574:       const form = new FormData();
 575:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 576:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 577:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 578:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 579:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 580:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 581:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 582:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 583:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 584:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 585:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 586:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 587:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 588:       }
 589:     } catch (cause) {
 590:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 591:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 592:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 593:     }
 594:   }
 595: 
 596:   function closeTransfer() {
 597:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 598:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 599:     setTransferPreview("");
 600:     setTransferFen("");
 601:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 602:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 603:     setRecognitionError("");
 604:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 605:   }
 606: 
 607:   function editTransferSquare(displayRow: number, displayCol: number) {
 608:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 609:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 610:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a six-field FEN before editing individual squares.");
 611:       return;
 612:     }
 613:     const board = parseFenPlacement(fields[0]);
 614:     if (!board) {
 615:       setRecognitionError("The FEN piece placement is invalid. Correct it before editing squares.");
 616:       return;
 617:     }
 618:     const row = displayRow;
 619:     const col = displayCol;
 620:     try {
 621:       const placement = setFenPiece(fields[0], row, col, transferPiece);
 622:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, placement));
 623:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 624:       setRecognitionError("");
 625:     } catch (cause) {
 626:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 627:     }
 628:   }
 629: 
 630:   function flipTransferPosition() {
 631:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 632:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 633:       setRecognitionError("Recognize a position or enter a complete FEN before flipping it.");
 634:       return;
 635:     }
 636:     try {
 637:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, flipFenPlacement(fields[0])));
 638:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 639:       setRecognitionError("");
 640:     } catch (cause) {
 641:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 642:     }
 643:   }
 644: 
 645:   function confirmTransfer() {
 646:     if (!transferCandidate) return;
 647:     if (!transferFen.trim()) {
 648:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a FEN position first.");
 649:       return;
 650:     }
 651:     if (moveToPosition(transferFen.trim())) {
 652:       closeTransfer();
 653:     }
 654:   }
 655: 
 656:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 657:     if (!session) return;
 658:     try {
 659:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 660:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 661:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 662:       let promotion: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" = "q";
 663:       if (promote) {
 664:         const choice = window.prompt("Promote to queen, rook, bishop, or knight? (q/r/b/n)", "q")?.toLowerCase();
 665:         if (!choice) return;
 666:         switch (choice) {
 667:           case "q": promotion = "q"; break;
 668:           case "r": promotion = "r"; break;
 669:           case "b": promotion = "b"; break;
 670:           case "n": promotion = "n"; break;
 671:           default:
 672:             setError("Promotion must be q, r, b, or n.");
 673:             return;
 674:         }
 675:       }
 676:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to, promotion });
 677:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 678:       patchSession({
 679:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 680:         moves: nextMoves,
 681:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 682:       });
 683:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 684:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 685:       setError("");
 686:     } catch {
 687:       const piece = game.get(to);
 688:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 689:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 690:     }
 691:   }
 692: 
 693:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 694:     if (!session) return;
 695:     if (annotationMode) {
 696:       if (!arrowStart) {
 697:         setArrowStart(square);
 698:         return;
 699:       }
 700:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 701:       setArrowStart(null);
 702:       setArrowHover(null);
 703:       return;
 704:     }
 705:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 706:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 707:       return;
 708:     }
 709:     const piece = game.get(square);
 710:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 711:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 712:   }

 715:     if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;

 719:     if (!square) return;

 722:     setArrowStart(square);
 723:     setArrowHover(square);
 724:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 725:   }

 739:     arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 740:     setArrowStart(null);
 741:     setArrowHover(null);

 750:   function jumpToMove(index: number) {
 751:     if (!session) return;

 755:       patchSession({ moveIndex: index, currentFen: next.fen() });
 756:       setLastMove(last ? { from: last.from, to: last.to } : null);
 757:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 758:     } catch (cause) {
 759:       setError(`Could not navigate to move: ${messageOf(cause)}`);

 772:   async function detectBoards() {
 773:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 774:     if (!API_BASE) {
 775:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Start the optional CV service and set VITE_API_BASE_URL, or draw a board region manually.");
 776:       return;
 777:     }
 778:     // Abort any previous scan
 779:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 780:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 781:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 782:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 783:     setDetecting(true);
 784:     setError("");
 785:     try {
 786:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 787:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")), "image/png");
 788:       });
 789:       const form = new FormData();
 790:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 791:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, { method: "POST", body: form, signal: abortController.signal });
 792:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 793:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 794:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map((item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index));
 795:       // Only update state if this is the latest request
 796:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 797:       patchSession((current) => ({
 798:         ...current,
 799:         candidatesByPage: { ...current.candidatesByPage, [String(current.page)]: candidates },
 800:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 801:       }));
 802:       setNotice(candidates.length ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.` : "No board candidates found. You can draw a region manually.");
 803:     } catch (cause) {
 804:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 805:         // Scan cancelled â€“ silent handling
 806:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 807:       } else {
 808:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 809:       }
 810:     } finally {
 811:       // Ensure detecting flag cleared only for the latest request
 812:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 813:         setDetecting(false);
 814:       }
 815:     }
 816:   }

 820:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;

 823:   function startCropEdit(
 824:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
 825:     candidate: Candidate,
 826:     handle: CropHandle,
 827:   ) {
 828:     event.stopPropagation();
 829:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 830:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;

 833:     stage.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);

 836:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 837:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 838:     if (!manualMode) return;
 839: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 840: if (!canvas) return;
 841: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 842: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 843: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 844: if (
 845:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 846:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 847:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 848:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 849: ) return;
 850:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 851:     if (!point) return;
 852:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 853:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 854:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 855:     setDragSelection(selection);
 856:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 857:   }
 858: 
 859:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 860:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 861:     if (edit) {
 862:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 863:       if (!point || !session) return;
 864:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 865:       patchSession((current) => {
 866:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 867:         return {
 868:           ...current,
 869:           candidatesByPage: {
 870:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 871:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 872:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 873:           },
 874:         };
 875:       });
 876:       return;
 877:     }
 878:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
 879:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 880:     if (point) {
 881:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 882:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 883:       setDragSelection(selection);
 884:     }
 885:   }
 886: 
 887:   function finishRegion() {
 888:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
 889:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 890:       return;
 891:     }
 892:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
 893:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
 894:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
 895:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
 896:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
 897:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
 898:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 899:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 900:     setDragSelection(null);
 901:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
 902:     const candidate: Candidate = {
 903:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
 904:       x, y, width, height,
 905:       relativeScore: 1,
 906:       source: "manual",
 907:     };
 908:     patchSession((current) => ({
 909:       ...current,
 910:       candidatesByPage: {
 911:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 912:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
 913:       },
 914:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
 915:     }));
 916:     setManualMode(false);
 917:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
 918:   }
 919: 
 920:   function cancelRegion() {
 921:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 922:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 923:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 924:     setDragSelection(null);
 925:   }

 927:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
 928:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
 929:     try {
 930:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
 931:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
 932:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
 933:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
 934:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
 935:       const scale = mode === "width"
 936:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
 937:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
 938:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
 939:     } catch (cause) {
 940:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 941:     }
 942:   }

 944:   async function expandBoard() {

 947:     try {
 948:       if (document.fullscreenElement) await document.exitFullscreen();
 949:       else await target.requestFullscreen();
 950:     } catch (cause) {
 951:       setError(`Could not expand chessboard: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 952:     }
 953:   }

 955:   function saveBookmark() {
 956:     if (!session) return;
 957:     patchSession((current) => ({
 958:       ...current,
 959:       bookmarks: current.bookmarks.includes(current.page)
 960:         ? current.bookmarks.filter((page) => page !== current.page)
 961:         : [...current.bookmarks, current.page].sort((a, b) => a - b),
 962:     }));
 963:   }

 965:   function savePosition() {
 966:     if (!session) return;
 967:     const position = {
 968:       id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 969:       title: `Page ${session.page} position`,
 970:       fen: session.currentFen,
 971:       page: session.page,
 972:       savedAt: Date.now(),
 973:     };
 974:     patchSession((current) => ({ ...current, positions: [...current.positions, position] }));

 260:                 item.id === candidate.id ? { ...item, ...next } : item),
 261:             },
 262:           };
 263:         });
 264:         event.preventDefault();
 265:         return;
 266:       }
 267:       if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") changePage(-1);
 268:       if (event.key === "ArrowRight") changePage(1);
 269:     }
 270:     window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 271:     return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 272:   });
 273: 
 274:   useEffect(() => () => {
 275:     engineRef.current?.dispose();
 276:     engineRef.current = null;
 277:   }, []);
 278: 
 279:   const sortedBooks = useMemo(() => [...books].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt), [books]);
 280:   const visibleBooks = useMemo(() => {
 281:     const needle = bookSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
 282:     return sortedBooks.filter((item) => {
 283:       const saved = sessionIndex[item.id];
 284:       const matchesTab =
 285:         libraryTab === "all" || libraryTab === "recent" || libraryTab === "local" ||
 286:         (libraryTab === "bookmarks" && (saved?.bookmarks.length ?? 0) > 0) ||
 287:         (libraryTab === "positions" && (saved?.positions.length ?? 0) > 0) ||
 288:         (libraryTab === "progress" && (saved?.page ?? 1) > 1);
 289:       return matchesTab && item.title.toLowerCase().includes(needle);
 290:     });
 291:   }, [bookSearch, libraryTab, sessionIndex, sortedBooks]);
 292: 
 293:   const game = useMemo(() => {
 294:     if (!session) return new Chess();
 295:     try {
 296:       return makePosition(session.lineBaseFen, session.moves, session.moveIndex);
 297:     } catch {
 298:       try { return new Chess(session.currentFen); } catch { return new Chess(); }
 299:     }
 300:   }, [session]);
 301:   const legalTargets = useMemo(() => {
 302:     if (!selectedSquare) return new Set<string>();
 303:     return new Set(game.moves({ square: selectedSquare, verbose: true }).map((move) => move.to));
 304:   }, [game, selectedSquare]);
 305:   const pieceSquares = game.board();
 306:   const moveHistory = useMemo(() => {
 307:     try { return makePosition(session?.lineBaseFen ?? START_FEN, session?.moves ?? [], session?.moveIndex ?? 0).history({ verbose: true }); }
 308:     catch { return []; }
 309:   }, [session]);
 310:   const highlightedMove = lastMove ?? (moveHistory.length
 311:     ? { from: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].from, to: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].to }
 312:     : null);
 313:   const engineArrow = useMemo(
 314:     () => engineEnabled ? parseBestMove(engineScore?.bestMove) : null,
 315:     [engineEnabled, engineScore?.bestMove],
 316:   );
 317: 
 318:   useEffect(() => {
 319:     setUserArrows([]);
 320:     setArrowStart(null);
 321:     setArrowHover(null);
 322:     setAnnotationMode(false);
 323:   }, [book?.id, session?.currentFen]);
 324: 
 325:   useEffect(() => {
 326:     if (engineEnabled) engineRef.current?.analyze(game.fen(), engineDepth);
 327:   }, [engineEnabled, session?.currentFen, session?.moveIndex, engineDepth]);
 328: 
 329:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 330:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 331:   }

 333:   function toggleEngine() {
 334:     if (engineEnabled) {
 335:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 336:       engineRef.current = null;
 337:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 338:       setEngineStatus("off");
 339:       setEngineScore(null);
 340:       setEngineMessage("");
 341:       return;
 342:     }
 343:     try {
 344:       setEngineScore(null);
 345:       setEngineMessage("");
 346:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 347:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 348:         (status, message) => {
 349:           setEngineStatus(status);
 350:           if (status === "error") {
 351:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 352:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 353:             setEngineScore(null);
 354:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 355:             engineRef.current = null;
 356:           }
 357:         },
 358:         setEngineScore,
 359:       );
 360:       engineRef.current = client;
 361:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 362:     } catch (cause) {
 363:       setEngineStatus("error");
 364:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 365:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 366:     }
 367:   }

 369:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 370:     setSession((current) => {
 371:       if (!current) return current;
 372:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 373:     });
 374:   }

 376:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 377:     try {
 378:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 379:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 380:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 381:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 382:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 383:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 384:       setBook(opened);
 385:       setSession(nextSession);
 386:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 387:       setError("");
 388:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 389:     } catch (cause) {
 390:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 391:     }
 392:   }

 394:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 395:     if (!file) return;
 396:     try {
 397:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 398:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 399:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 400:       const now = Date.now();
 401:       const created: BookRecord = {
 402:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 403:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 404:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 405:         byteLength: file.size,
 406:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 407:         addedAt: now,
 408:       };
 409:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 410:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 411:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 412:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 413:       setBook(created);
 414:       setSession(blank);
 415:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 416:       setError("");
 417:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 418:     } catch (cause) {
 419:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 420:     }
 421:   }

 423:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 424:     if (!window.confirm(`Remove "${item.title}" from your library?`)) return;
 425: 
 426:     try {
 427:       await removeBook(item.id);
 428:       await removeSession(item.id);
 429: 
 430:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 431:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 432:         const next = { ...current };
 433:         delete next[item.id];
 434:         return next;
 435:       });
 436: 
 437:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 438:         setBook(null);
 439:         setSession(null);
 440:         setPdf(null);
 441:       }
 442: 
 443:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 444:       setError("");
 445:     } catch (cause) {
 446:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 447:     }
 448:   }
 449:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 450:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 451:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 452:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 453:     try {
 454:       await putBook(renamed);
 455:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 456:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 457:     } catch (cause) {
 458:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 459:     }
 460:   }

 472:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 473:     if (!session) return false;

 478:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 479:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 480:         moves: [],
 481:         moveIndex: 0,
 482:       });
 483:       setLastMove(null);
 484:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 485:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 486:       return true;
 487:     } catch (cause) {
 488:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 489:       return false;
 490:     }

 542:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 543:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 544:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 545:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 546:       return;
 547:     }
 548:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 549:     try {
 550:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 551:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 552:       preview.width = crop.width;
 553:       preview.height = crop.height;
 554:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 555:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 556:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 557:     } catch (cause) {
 558:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 559:       return;
 560:     }
 561:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 562:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 563:     setTransferFen("");
 564:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 565:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 566:     setRecognitionError("");
 567:     setTransferPiece("P");
 568:     const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 569:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 570:     try {
 571:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 572:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 573:       });
 574:       const form = new FormData();
 575:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 576:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 577:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 578:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 579:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 580:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 581:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 582:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 583:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 584:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 585:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 586:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 587:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 588:       }
 589:     } catch (cause) {
 590:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 591:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 592:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 593:     }
 594:   }

 596:   function closeTransfer() {
 597:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 598:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 599:     setTransferPreview("");
 600:     setTransferFen("");
 601:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 602:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 603:     setRecognitionError("");
 604:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 605:   }

 607:   function editTransferSquare(displayRow: number, displayCol: number) {
 608:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 609:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 610:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a six-field FEN before editing individual squares.");
 611:       return;
 612:     }
 613:     const board = parseFenPlacement(fields[0]);
 614:     if (!board) {
 615:       setRecognitionError("The FEN piece placement is invalid. Correct it before editing squares.");
 616:       return;
 617:     }
 618:     const row = displayRow;
 619:     const col = displayCol;
 620:     try {
 621:       const placement = setFenPiece(fields[0], row, col, transferPiece);
 622:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, placement));
 623:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 624:       setRecognitionError("");
 625:     } catch (cause) {
 626:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 627:     }
 628:   }
 629: 
 630:   function flipTransferPosition() {
 631:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 632:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 633:       setRecognitionError("Recognize a position or enter a complete FEN before flipping it.");
 634:       return;
 635:     }
 636:     try {
 637:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, flipFenPlacement(fields[0])));
 638:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 639:       setRecognitionError("");
 640:     } catch (cause) {
 641:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 642:     }
 643:   }

 645:   function confirmTransfer() {
 646:     if (!transferCandidate) return;
 647:     if (!transferFen.trim()) {
 648:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a FEN position first.");
 649:       return;
 650:     }
 651:     if (moveToPosition(transferFen.trim())) {
 652:       closeTransfer();
 653:     }
 654:   }
 655: 
 656:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 657:     if (!session) return;
 658:     try {
 659:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 660:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 661:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 662:       let promotion: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" = "q";
 663:       if (promote) {
 664:         const choice = window.prompt("Promote to queen, rook, bishop, or knight? (q/r/b/n)", "q")?.toLowerCase();
 665:         if (!choice) return;
 666:         switch (choice) {
 667:           case "q": promotion = "q"; break;
 668:           case "r": promotion = "r"; break;
 669:           case "b": promotion = "b"; break;
 670:           case "n": promotion = "n"; break;
 671:           default:
 672:             setError("Promotion must be q, r, b, or n.");
 673:             return;
 674:         }
 675:       }
 676:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to, promotion });
 677:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 678:       patchSession({
 679:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 680:         moves: nextMoves,
 681:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 682:       });
 683:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 684:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 685:       setError("");
 686:     } catch {
 687:       const piece = game.get(to);
 688:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 689:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 690:     }
 691:   }
 692: 
 693:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 694:     if (!session) return;
 695:     if (annotationMode) {
 696:       if (!arrowStart) {
 697:         setArrowStart(square);
 698:         return;
 699:       }
 700:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 701:       setArrowStart(null);
 702:       setArrowHover(null);
 703:       return;
 704:     }
 705:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 706:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 707:       return;
 708:     }
 709:     const piece = game.get(square);
 710:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 711:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 712:   }

 772:   async function detectBoards() {
 773:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 774:     if (!API_BASE) {
 775:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Start the optional CV service and set VITE_API_BASE_URL, or draw a board region manually.");
 776:       return;
 777:     }
 778:     // Abort any previous scan
 779:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 780:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 781:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 782:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 783:     setDetecting(true);
 784:     setError("");
 785:     try {
 786:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 787:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")), "image/png");
 788:       });
 789:       const form = new FormData();
 790:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 791:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, { method: "POST", body: form, signal: abortController.signal });
 792:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 793:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 794:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map((item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index));
 795:       // Only update state if this is the latest request
 796:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 797:       patchSession((current) => ({
 798:         ...current,
 799:         candidatesByPage: { ...current.candidatesByPage, [String(current.page)]: candidates },
 800:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 801:       }));
 802:       setNotice(candidates.length ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.` : "No board candidates found. You can draw a region manually.");
 803:     } catch (cause) {
 804:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 805:         // Scan cancelled â€“ silent handling
 806:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 807:       } else {
 808:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 809:       }
 810:     } finally {
 811:       // Ensure detecting flag cleared only for the latest request
 812:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 813:         setDetecting(false);
 814:       }
 815:     }
 816:   }

 820:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;

 834:   }

 836:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 837:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 838:     if (!manualMode) return;
 839: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 840: if (!canvas) return;
 841: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 842: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 843: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 844: if (
 845:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 846:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 847:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 848:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 849: ) return;
 850:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 851:     if (!point) return;
 852:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 853:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 854:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 855:     setDragSelection(selection);
 856:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 857:   }
 858: 
 859:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 860:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 861:     if (edit) {
 862:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 863:       if (!point || !session) return;
 864:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 865:       patchSession((current) => {
 866:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 867:         return {
 868:           ...current,
 869:           candidatesByPage: {
 870:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 871:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 872:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 873:           },
 874:         };
 875:       });
 876:       return;
 877:     }
 878:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
 879:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 880:     if (point) {
 881:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 882:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 883:       setDragSelection(selection);
 884:     }
 885:   }
 886: 
 887:   function finishRegion() {
 888:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
 889:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 890:       return;
 891:     }
 892:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
 893:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
 894:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
 895:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
 896:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
 897:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
 898:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 899:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 900:     setDragSelection(null);
 901:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
 902:     const candidate: Candidate = {
 903:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
 904:       x, y, width, height,
 905:       relativeScore: 1,
 906:       source: "manual",
 907:     };
 908:     patchSession((current) => ({
 909:       ...current,
 910:       candidatesByPage: {
 911:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 912:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
 913:       },
 914:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
 915:     }));
 916:     setManualMode(false);
 917:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
 918:   }
 919: 
 920:   function cancelRegion() {
 921:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 922:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 923:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 924:     setDragSelection(null);
 925:   }

 927:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
 928:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
 929:     try {
 930:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
 931:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
 932:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
 933:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
 934:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
 935:       const scale = mode === "width"
 936:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
 937:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
 938:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
 939:     } catch (cause) {
 940:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 941:     }
 942:   }

 949:       else await target.requestFullscreen();
 950:     } catch (cause) {
 951:       setError(`Could not expand chessboard: ${messageOf(cause)}`);

  28: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  29:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  30:   if (!match) return uci;
  31:   try {
  32:     const position = new Chess(fen);
  33:     const move = position.move({
  34:       from: match[1] as Square,
  35:       to: match[2] as Square,
  36:       ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  37:     });
  38:     return move.san;
  39:   } catch {
  40:     return uci;
  41:   }
  42: }
  43: 
  44: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {
  45:   const position = new Chess(fen);
  46:   const san: string[] = [];
  47:   for (const uci of pv) {
  48:     const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  49:     if (!match) break;
  50:     try {
  51:       const move = position.move({
  52:         from: match[1] as Square,
  53:         to: match[2] as Square,
  54:         ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  55:       });
  56:       san.push(move.san);
  57:     } catch {
  58:       break;
  59:     }
  60:   }
  61:   return san.join(" ");
  62: }

 443:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 444:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);

 447:   function toggleEngine() {
 448:     if (engineEnabled) {
 449:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 450:       engineRef.current = null;
 451:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 452:       setEngineStatus("off");
 453:       setEngineScore(null);
 454:       setEngineMessage("");
 455:       return;
 456:     }
 457:     try {
 458:       setEngineScore(null);
 459:       setEngineMessage("");
 460:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 461:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 462:         (status, message) => {
 463:           setEngineStatus(status);
 464:           if (status === "error") {
 465:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 466:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 467:             setEngineScore(null);
 468:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 469:             engineRef.current = null;
 470:           }
 471:         },
 472:         setEngineScore,
 473:       );
 474:       engineRef.current = client;
 475:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 476:     } catch (cause) {
 477:       setEngineStatus("error");
 478:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 479:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 480:     }
 481:   }

 483:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 484:     setSession((current) => {
 485:       if (!current) return current;
 486:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 487:     });
 488:   }

 490:   function patchBoardSession(change: Partial<StudyBoardState>) {
 491:     if (workspaceMode === "opening-explorer") {
 492:       return;
 493:     }
 494: 
 495:     if (workspaceMode === "analysis") {
 496:       setAnalysisBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 497:     } else if (workspaceMode === "opening-prep") {
 498:       setOpeningPrepBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 499:     } else if (studyMode) {
 500:       setStudyBoard((current) => current ? { ...current, ...change } : current);
 501:     } else {
 502:       patchSession(change);
 503:     }
 504:   }
 505:   async function toggleStudyMode() {
 506:     if (!studyMode) {
 507:       if (!session) {
 508:         setError("Open a book before entering study mode.");
 509:         return;
 510:       }
 511:       setStudyBoard({
 512:         lineBaseFen: session.lineBaseFen,
 513:         currentFen: session.currentFen,
 514:         moves: [...session.moves],
 515:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 516:         flipped: session.flipped,
 517:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 518:       });
 519:       setStudyMode(true);
 520:     } else {
 521:       // Preserve the latest Focus Mode board when returning to normal mode.
 522:       if (studyBoard) {
 523:         patchSession({
 524:           lineBaseFen: studyBoard.lineBaseFen,
 525:           currentFen: studyBoard.currentFen,
 526:           moves: [...studyBoard.moves],
 527:           moveIndex: studyBoard.moveIndex,
 528:           flipped: studyBoard.flipped,
 529:           coordinates: studyBoard.coordinates,
 530:         });
 531:       }
 532:       setStudyMode(false);
 533:     }
 534:     setLastMove(null);
 535:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 536:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 537:   
 538:     try {
 539:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 540:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 541:       } else {
 542:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 543:       }
 544:     } catch {
 545:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 546:     }
 547: }

 549:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 550:     try {
 551:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 552:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 553:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 554:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 555:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 556:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 557:       setBook(opened);
 558:       setSession(nextSession);
 559:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 560:       setError("");
 561:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 562:     } catch (cause) {
 563:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 564:     }
 565:   }

 567:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 568:     if (!file) return;
 569:     try {
 570:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 571:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 572:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 573:       const now = Date.now();
 574:       const created: BookRecord = {
 575:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 576:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 577:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 578:         byteLength: file.size,
 579:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 580:         addedAt: now,
 581:       };
 582:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 583:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 584:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 585:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 586:       setBook(created);
 587:       setSession(blank);
 588:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 589:       setError("");
 590:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 591:     } catch (cause) {
 592:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 593:     }
 594:   }

 596:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 597:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 598: 
 599:     try {
 600:       await removeBook(item.id);
 601:       await removeSession(item.id);
 602: 
 603:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 604:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 605:         const next = { ...current };
 606:         delete next[item.id];
 607:         return next;
 608:       });
 609: 
 610:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 611:         setBook(null);
 612:         setSession(null);
 613:         setPdf(null);
 614:       }
 615: 
 616:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 617:       setError("");
 618:     } catch (cause) {
 619:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 620:     }
 621:   }
 622:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 623:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 624:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 625:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 626:     try {
 627:       await putBook(renamed);
 628:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 629:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 630:     } catch (cause) {
 631:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 632:     }
 633:   }

 645:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 646:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 647:     try {
 648:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 649:       setSession({
 650:         ...activeSession,
 651:         originalFen: fen,
 652:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 653:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 654:         moves: [],
 655:         moveIndex: 0,
 656:       });
 657:       setLastMove(null);
 658:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 659:       setUserArrows([]);
 660:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 661:       return true;
 662:     } catch (cause) {
 663:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 664:       return false;
 665:     }
 666:   }

 668:   function analyzeManualPosition(fen: string): boolean {

 672:     setEngineMessage("");

 674:       toggleEngine();

 676:       engineRef.current?.analyze(fen, engineDepth);
 677:     }
 678:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 679:     return true;
 680:   }

 721:               candidate.id === baseline.id ? baseline : candidate),
 722:           },
 723:         };
 724:       });
 725:     }
 726:     setCropEditingId(null);
 727:     cropBaselineRef.current = null;
 728:     patchSession({ selectedDiagramId: null });
 729:   }

 731:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 732:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 733:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 734:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 735:       return;
 736:     }
 737:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 738:     try {
 739:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 740:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 741:       preview.width = crop.width;
 742:       preview.height = crop.height;
 743:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 744:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 745:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 746:     } catch (cause) {
 747:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 748:       return;
 749:     }
 750:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 751:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 752:     setTransferFen("");
 753:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 754:         setRecognitionError("");
 755:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 756:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 757:     try {
 758:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 759:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 760:       });
 761:       const form = new FormData();
 762:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 763:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 764:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 765:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 766:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 767:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 768:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 769:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 770:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 771:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 772:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 773:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 774:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 775:       }
 776:     } catch (cause) {
 777:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 778:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 779:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 780:     }
 781:   }

 783:   function closeTransfer() {
 784:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 785:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 786:     setTransferPreview("");
 787:     setTransferFen("");
 788:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 789:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 790:     setRecognitionError("");
 791:       }

 794:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 795:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 796:       setGameEndOverlay({
 797:         title: "Checkmate",
 798:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 799:       });
 800:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 801:       setGameEndOverlay({
 802:         title: "Stalemate",
 803:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 804:       });
 805:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 806:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 807:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 808:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 809:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 810:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 811:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 812:     } else {
 813:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 814:     }
 815:   }

 817:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 818:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 819:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 820:     try {
 821:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 822:       const result = currentGame.move({
 823:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 824:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 825:         promotion: piece,
 826:       });
 827:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 828:       patchBoardSession({
 829:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 830:         moves: nextMoves,
 831:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 832:       });
 833:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 834:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 835:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 836:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 837:       setError("");
 838:     } catch {
 839:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 840:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 841:     }
 842:   }
 843: 
 844:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 845:     if (!boardSession) return;
 846:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 847:     try {
 848:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 849:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 850:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 851:       if (promote) {
 852:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 853:         return;
 854:       }
 855:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 856:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 857:       if (workspaceMode === "opening-explorer") {
 858:         const line = nextMoves
 859:           .map((move, index) => index % 2 === 0 ? `${Math.floor(index / 2) + 1}. ${move}` : move)
 860:           .join(" ");
 861:         setOpeningExplorerInput(line);
 862:         setOpeningExplorerPly(nextMoves.length);
 863:       } else {
 864:         patchBoardSession({
 865:           currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 866:           moves: nextMoves,
 867:           moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 868:         });
 869:       }
 870:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 871:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 872:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 873:       setError("");
 874:     } catch {
 875:       const piece = game.get(to);
 876:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 877:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 878:     }
 879:   }
 880: 
 881:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 882:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 883:     setRedSquares([]);
 884: 
 885:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 886:       setUserArrows([]);
 887:       setArrowStart(null);
 888:       setArrowHover(null);
 889:       return;
 890:     }
 891: if (!boardSession) return;
 892:     if (annotationMode) {
 893:       if (!arrowStart) {
 894:         setArrowStart(square);
 895:         return;
 896:       }
 897:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 898:       setArrowStart(null);
 899:       setArrowHover(null);
 900:       return;
 901:     }
 902:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 903:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 904:       return;
 905:     }
 906:     const piece = game.get(square);
 907:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 908:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 909:   }

 911:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 912:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 913: 
 914:   event.preventDefault();
 915: 
 916:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 917:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 918:     event.clientX,
 919:     event.clientY,
 920:     bounds,
 921:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 922:   );
 923: 
 924:   if (!square) return;
 925: 
 926:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 927:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 928:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 929:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 930:   setArrowStart(square);
 931:   setArrowHover(square);
 932: 
 933:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 934: }

 936:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 937:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 938:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 939:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
 940:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 941:     setArrowHover(square);

 944:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 945:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 946: 
 947:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 948: 
 949:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 950:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 951:     event.clientX,
 952:     event.clientY,
 953:     bounds,
 954:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 955:   );
 956: 
 957:   if (to && to !== from) {
 958:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 959:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 960:   } else {
 961:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 962:   }
 963: 
 964:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 965:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 966:   setArrowStart(null);
 967:   setArrowHover(null);
 968: }

 977:     if (!boardSession) return;
 978:     try {
 979:       const next = makePosition(boardSession.lineBaseFen, boardSession.moves, index);
 980:       const last = next.history({ verbose: true }).at(-1);

 982:       setLastMove(last ? { from: last.from, to: last.to } : null);
 983:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 984:     } catch (cause) {
 985:       setError(`Could not navigate to move: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 986:     }
 987:   }

1020:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
1021:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;

1024:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;

1030:     setCropEditingId(null);
1031:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1032:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1033: 
1034:     patchSession((current) => ({
1035:       ...current,
1036:       candidatesByPage: {
1037:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1038:         [String(current.page)]: [],
1039:       },

1046:   async function detectBoards() {
1047:     if (detecting) {
1048:       stopBoardScan();
1049:       return;
1050:     }
1051: 
1052:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
1053:     if (!API_BASE) {
1054:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
1055:       return;
1056:     }
1057: 
1058:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
1059:     const abortController = new AbortController();
1060:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
1061:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
1062: 
1063:     setDetecting(true);
1064:     setError("");
1065:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
1066:     patchSession((current) => ({
1067:       ...current,
1068:       candidatesByPage: {
1069:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1070:         [String(current.page)]: [],
1071:       },
1072:       selectedDiagramId: null,
1073:     }));
1074: 
1075:     try {
1076:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
1077:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
1078:           (blob) => blob
1079:             ? resolve(blob)
1080:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
1081:           "image/png",
1082:         );
1083:       });
1084: 
1085:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1086: 
1087:       const form = new FormData();
1088:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
1089: 
1090:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
1091:         method: "POST",
1092:         body: form,
1093:         signal: abortController.signal,
1094:       });
1095: 
1096:       if (!response.ok) {
1097:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
1098:       }
1099: 
1100:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
1101:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
1102:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
1103:       );
1104: 
1105:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1106: 
1107:       patchSession((current) => ({
1108:         ...current,
1109:         candidatesByPage: {
1110:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
1111:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
1112:         },
1113:         selectedDiagramId: null,
1114:       }));
1115: 
1116:       setNotice(
1117:         candidates.length
1118:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
1119:           : "No board candidates found.",
1120:       );
1121:     } catch (cause) {
1122:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1123: 
1124:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
1125:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
1126:       } else {
1127:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1128:       }
1129:     } finally {
1130:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
1131:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1132:         setDetecting(false);
1133:       }
1134:     }
1135:   }

1138:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;

1154:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1155:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1156:     if (!manualMode) return;
1157: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1158: if (!canvas) return;
1159: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1160: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1161: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1162: if (
1163:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1164:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1165:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1166:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1167: ) return;
1168:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1169:     if (!point) return;
1170:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1171:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1172:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1173:     setDragSelection(selection);
1174:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1175:   }

1177:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1178:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1179:     if (edit) {
1180:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1181:       if (!point || !session) return;
1182:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1183:       patchSession((current) => {
1184:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1185:         return {
1186:           ...current,
1187:           candidatesByPage: {
1188:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1189:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1190:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1191:           },
1192:         };
1193:       });
1194:       return;
1195:     }
1196:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1197:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1198:     if (point) {
1199:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1200:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1201:       setDragSelection(selection);
1202:     }
1203:   }

1205:   function finishRegion() {
1206:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1207:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1208:       return;
1209:     }
1210:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1211:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1212:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1213:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1214:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1215:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1216:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1217:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1218:     setDragSelection(null);
1219:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1220:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1221:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1222:       x, y, width, height,
1223:       relativeScore: 1,
1224:       source: "manual",
1225:     };
1226:     patchSession((current) => ({
1227:       ...current,
1228:       candidatesByPage: {
1229:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1230:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1231:       },
1232:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1233:     }));
1234:     setManualMode(false);
1235:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1236:   }

1239:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1240:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1241:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1242:     setDragSelection(null);
1243:   }

1245:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1246:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1247:     try {
1248:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1249:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1250:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1251:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1252:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1253:       const scale = mode === "width"
1254:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1255:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1256:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1257:     } catch (cause) {
1258:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1259:     }
1260:   }

1270:         : [...current.bookmarks, current.page].sort((a, b) => a - b),
1271:     }));

  26: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  27:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  28:   if (!match) return uci;
  29:   try {
  30:     const position = new Chess(fen);
  31:     const move = position.move({
  32:       from: match[1] as Square,
  33:       to: match[2] as Square,
  34:       ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  35:     });
  36:     return move.san;
  37:   } catch {
  38:     return uci;
  39:   }
  40: }

  42: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {
  43:   const position = new Chess(fen);
  44:   const san: string[] = [];
  45:   for (const uci of pv) {
  46:     const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  47:     if (!match) break;
  48:     try {
  49:       const move = position.move({
  50:         from: match[1] as Square,
  51:         to: match[2] as Square,
  52:         ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  53:       });
  54:       san.push(move.san);
  55:     } catch {
  56:       break;
  57:     }
  58:   }
  59:   return san.join(" ");

 367:   function toggleEngine() {
 368:     if (engineEnabled) {
 369:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 370:       engineRef.current = null;
 371:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 372:       setEngineStatus("off");
 373:       setEngineScore(null);
 374:       setEngineMessage("");
 375:       return;
 376:     }
 377:     try {
 378:       setEngineScore(null);
 379:       setEngineMessage("");
 380:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 381:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 382:         (status, message) => {
 383:           setEngineStatus(status);
 384:           if (status === "error") {
 385:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 386:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 387:             setEngineScore(null);
 388:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 389:             engineRef.current = null;
 390:           }
 391:         },
 392:         setEngineScore,
 393:       );
 394:       engineRef.current = client;
 395:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 396:     } catch (cause) {
 397:       setEngineStatus("error");
 398:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 399:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 400:     }
 401:   }

 404:     setSession((current) => {

 406:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 407:     });

 415:   async function toggleStudyMode() {
 416:     if (!studyMode) {
 417:       if (!session) {
 418:         setError("Open a book before entering study mode.");
 419:         return;
 420:       }
 421:       setStudyBoard({
 422:         lineBaseFen: session.lineBaseFen,
 423:         currentFen: session.currentFen,

 425:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 426:         flipped: session.flipped,
 427:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 428:       });
 429:       setStudyMode(true);
 430:     } else {
 431:       // Preserve the latest Focus Mode board when returning to normal mode.
 432:       if (studyBoard) {
 433:         patchSession({
 434:           lineBaseFen: studyBoard.lineBaseFen,
 435:           currentFen: studyBoard.currentFen,

 439:           coordinates: studyBoard.coordinates,
 440:         });
 441:       }

 443:     }
 444:     setLastMove(null);
 445:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 446:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 447:   
 448:     try {
 449:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 450:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 451:       } else {
 452:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 453:       }
 454:     } catch {
 455:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 456:     }

 459:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 460:     try {
 461:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 462:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 463:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 464:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 465:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 466:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 467:       setBook(opened);
 468:       setSession(nextSession);
 469:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 470:       setError("");
 471:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 472:     } catch (cause) {
 473:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 474:     }
 475:   }

 477:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 478:     if (!file) return;
 479:     try {
 480:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 481:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 482:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 483:       const now = Date.now();
 484:       const created: BookRecord = {
 485:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 486:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 487:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 488:         byteLength: file.size,
 489:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 490:         addedAt: now,
 491:       };
 492:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 493:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 494:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 495:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 496:       setBook(created);
 497:       setSession(blank);
 498:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 499:       setError("");
 500:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 501:     } catch (cause) {
 502:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 503:     }
 504:   }

 506:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 507:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 508: 
 509:     try {
 510:       await removeBook(item.id);
 511:       await removeSession(item.id);
 512: 
 513:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 514:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 515:         const next = { ...current };
 516:         delete next[item.id];
 517:         return next;
 518:       });
 519: 
 520:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 521:         setBook(null);
 522:         setSession(null);
 523:         setPdf(null);
 524:       }
 525: 
 526:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 527:       setError("");
 528:     } catch (cause) {
 529:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 530:     }
 531:   }
 532:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 533:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 534:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 535:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 536:     try {
 537:       await putBook(renamed);
 538:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 539:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 540:     } catch (cause) {
 541:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 542:     }
 543:   }

 555:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 556:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 557:     try {
 558:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 559:       setSession({
 560:         ...activeSession,
 561:         originalFen: fen,
 562:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 563:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 564:         moves: [],
 565:         moveIndex: 0,
 566:       });
 567:       setLastMove(null);
 568:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 569:       setUserArrows([]);
 570:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 571:       return true;
 572:     } catch (cause) {
 573:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 574:       return false;
 575:     }
 576:   }

 588:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
