 641:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 642:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 643:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 644:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 645:       return;
 646:     }
 647:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 648:     try {
 649:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 650:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 651:       preview.width = crop.width;
 652:       preview.height = crop.height;
 653:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 654:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 655:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 656:     } catch (cause) {
 657:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 658:       return;
 659:     }
 660:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 661:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 662:     setTransferFen("");
 663:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 664:         setRecognitionError("");
 665:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 666:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 667:     try {
 668:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 669:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 670:       });
 671:       const form = new FormData();
 672:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 673:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 674:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 675:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 676:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 677:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 678:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 679:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 680:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 681:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 682:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 683:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 684:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 685:       }
 686:     } catch (cause) {
 687:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 688:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 689:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 690:     }
 691:   }
 692: 
 693:   function closeTransfer() {
 694:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 695:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 696:     setTransferPreview("");
 697:     setTransferFen("");
 698:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 699:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 700:     setRecognitionError("");
 701:       }

 704:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 705:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 706:       setGameEndOverlay({
 707:         title: "Checkmate",
 708:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 709:       });
 710:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 711:       setGameEndOverlay({
 712:         title: "Stalemate",
 713:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 714:       });
 715:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 716:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 717:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 718:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 719:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 720:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 721:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 722:     } else {
 723:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 724:     }
 725:   }
 726: 
 727:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 728:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 729:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 730:     try {
 731:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 732:       const result = currentGame.move({
 733:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 734:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 735:         promotion: piece,
 736:       });
 737:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 738:       patchBoardSession({
 739:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 740:         moves: nextMoves,
 741:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 742:       });
 743:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 744:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 745:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 746:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 747:       setError("");
 748:     } catch {
 749:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 750:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 751:     }
 752:   }
 753: 
 754:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 755:     if (!boardSession) return;
 756:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 757:     try {
 758:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 759:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 760:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 761:       if (promote) {
 762:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 763:         return;
 764:       }
 765:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 766:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 767:       patchBoardSession({
 768:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 769:         moves: nextMoves,
 770:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 771:       });
 772:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 773:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 774:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 775:       setError("");
 776:     } catch {
 777:       const piece = game.get(to);
 778:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 779:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 780:     }
 781:   }
 782: 
 783:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 784:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 785:     setRedSquares([]);
 786: 
 787:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 788:       setUserArrows([]);
 789:       setArrowStart(null);
 790:       setArrowHover(null);
 791:       return;
 792:     }
 793: if (!boardSession) return;
 794:     if (annotationMode) {
 795:       if (!arrowStart) {
 796:         setArrowStart(square);
 797:         return;
 798:       }
 799:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 800:       setArrowStart(null);
 801:       setArrowHover(null);
 802:       return;
 803:     }
 804:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 805:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 806:       return;
 807:     }
 808:     const piece = game.get(square);
 809:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 810:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 811:   }

 948:   async function detectBoards() {
 949:     if (detecting) {
 950:       stopBoardScan();
 951:       return;
 952:     }
 953: 
 954:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 955:     if (!API_BASE) {
 956:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 957:       return;
 958:     }
 959: 
 960:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 961:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 962:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 963:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 964: 
 965:     setDetecting(true);
 966:     setError("");
 967:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 968:     patchSession((current) => ({
 969:       ...current,
 970:       candidatesByPage: {
 971:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 972:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 973:       },
 974:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 975:     }));
 976: 
 977:     try {
 978:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 979:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 980:           (blob) => blob
 981:             ? resolve(blob)
 982:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 983:           "image/png",
 984:         );
 985:       });
 986: 
 987:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 988: 
 989:       const form = new FormData();
 990:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 991: 
 992:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 993:         method: "POST",
 994:         body: form,
 995:         signal: abortController.signal,
 996:       });
 997: 
 998:       if (!response.ok) {
 999:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
1000:       }
1001: 
1002:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
1003:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
1004:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
1005:       );
1006: 
1007:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1008: 
1009:       patchSession((current) => ({
1010:         ...current,
1011:         candidatesByPage: {
1012:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
1013:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
1014:         },
1015:         selectedDiagramId: null,
1016:       }));
1017: 
1018:       setNotice(
1019:         candidates.length
1020:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
1021:           : "No board candidates found.",
1022:       );
1023:     } catch (cause) {
1024:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1025: 
1026:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
1027:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
1028:       } else {
1029:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1030:       }
1031:     } finally {
1032:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
1033:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1034:         setDetecting(false);
1035:       }
1036:     }
1037:   }
1038:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {

1056:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1057:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1058:     if (!manualMode) return;
1059: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1060: if (!canvas) return;
1061: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1062: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1063: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1064: if (
1065:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1066:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1067:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1068:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1069: ) return;
1070:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1071:     if (!point) return;
1072:     dragStartRef.current = point;

1079:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1080:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1081:     if (edit) {
1082:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1083:       if (!point || !session) return;
1084:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1085:       patchSession((current) => {
1086:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1087:         return {
1088:           ...current,
1089:           candidatesByPage: {
1090:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1091:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1092:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1093:           },
1094:         };
1095:       });
1096:       return;
1097:     }
1098:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1099:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1100:     if (point) {
1101:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1102:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1103:       setDragSelection(selection);
1104:     }
1105:   }

1107:   function finishRegion() {
1108:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1109:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1110:       return;
1111:     }
1112:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1113:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1114:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1115:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1116:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1117:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1118:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1119:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1120:     setDragSelection(null);
1121:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1122:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1123:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1124:       x, y, width, height,
1125:       relativeScore: 1,
1126:       source: "manual",
1127:     };
1128:     patchSession((current) => ({
1129:       ...current,
1130:       candidatesByPage: {
1131:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1132:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1133:       },
1134:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1135:     }));
1136:     setManualMode(false);
1137:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1138:   }

1147:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1148:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1149:     try {
1150:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1151:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1152:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1153:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1154:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1155:       const scale = mode === "width"
1156:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1157:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1158:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1159:     } catch (cause) {
1160:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1161:     }
1162:   }

  26: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  27:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  28:   if (!match) return uci;
  29:   try {
  30:     const position = new Chess(fen);
  31:     const move = position.move({
  32:       from: match[1] as Square,
  33:       to: match[2] as Square,
  34:       ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  35:     });
  36:     return move.san;
  37:   } catch {
  38:     return uci;
  39:   }
  40: }

  42: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {
  43:   const position = new Chess(fen);
  44:   const san: string[] = [];
  45:   for (const uci of pv) {

  53:       });
  54:       san.push(move.san);
  55:     } catch {

  57:     }

 426:         flipped: session.flipped,
 427:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 428:       });
 429:       setStudyMode(true);
 430:     } else {
 431:       // Preserve the latest Focus Mode board when returning to normal mode.
 432:       if (studyBoard) {
 433:         patchSession({
 434:           lineBaseFen: studyBoard.lineBaseFen,
 435:           currentFen: studyBoard.currentFen,
 436:           moves: [...studyBoard.moves],
 437:           moveIndex: studyBoard.moveIndex,
 438:           flipped: studyBoard.flipped,
 439:           coordinates: studyBoard.coordinates,
 440:         });
 441:       }
 442:       setStudyMode(false);
 443:     }
 444:     setLastMove(null);
 445:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 446:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 447:   
 448:     try {
 449:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 450:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 451:       } else {
 452:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 453:       }
 454:     } catch {
 455:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 456:     }
 457: }
 458: 
 459:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 460:     try {
 461:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 462:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 463:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 464:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 465:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 466:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 467:       setBook(opened);
 468:       setSession(nextSession);
 469:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 470:       setError("");
 471:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 472:     } catch (cause) {
 473:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 474:     }
 475:   }
 476: 
 477:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 478:     if (!file) return;
 479:     try {
 480:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 481:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 482:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 483:       const now = Date.now();
 484:       const created: BookRecord = {
 485:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 486:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 487:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 488:         byteLength: file.size,
 489:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 490:         addedAt: now,
 491:       };
 492:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 493:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 494:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 495:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 496:       setBook(created);
 497:       setSession(blank);
 498:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 499:       setError("");
 500:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 501:     } catch (cause) {
 502:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 503:     }
 504:   }
 505: 
 506:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 507:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 508: 
 509:     try {
 510:       await removeBook(item.id);
 511:       await removeSession(item.id);
 512: 
 513:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 514:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 515:         const next = { ...current };
 516:         delete next[item.id];
 517:         return next;
 518:       });
 519: 
 520:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 521:         setBook(null);
 522:         setSession(null);
 523:         setPdf(null);
 524:       }
 525: 
 526:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 527:       setError("");
 528:     } catch (cause) {
 529:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 530:     }
 531:   }
 532:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 533:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 534:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 535:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 536:     try {
 537:       await putBook(renamed);
 538:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 539:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 540:     } catch (cause) {
 541:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 542:     }
 543:   }

 555:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 556:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 557:     try {
 558:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 559:       setSession({
 560:         ...activeSession,
 561:         originalFen: fen,
 562:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 563:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 564:         moves: [],
 565:         moveIndex: 0,
 566:       });
 567:       setLastMove(null);
 568:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 569:       setUserArrows([]);
 570:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 571:       return true;
 572:     } catch (cause) {
 573:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 574:       return false;
 575:     }
 576:   }

 641:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 642:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 643:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 644:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 645:       return;
 646:     }
 647:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 648:     try {
 649:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 650:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 651:       preview.width = crop.width;
 652:       preview.height = crop.height;
 653:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 654:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 655:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 656:     } catch (cause) {
 657:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 658:       return;
 659:     }
 660:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 661:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 662:     setTransferFen("");
 663:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 664:         setRecognitionError("");
 665:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 666:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 667:     try {
 668:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 669:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 670:       });
 671:       const form = new FormData();
 672:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 673:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 674:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 675:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 676:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 677:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 678:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 679:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 680:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 681:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 682:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 683:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 684:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 685:       }
 686:     } catch (cause) {
 687:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 688:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 689:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 690:     }
 691:   }
 692: 
 693:   function closeTransfer() {
 694:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 695:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 696:     setTransferPreview("");
 697:     setTransferFen("");
 698:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 699:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 700:     setRecognitionError("");
 701:       }

 704:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 705:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 706:       setGameEndOverlay({
 707:         title: "Checkmate",
 708:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 709:       });
 710:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 711:       setGameEndOverlay({
 712:         title: "Stalemate",
 713:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 714:       });
 715:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 716:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 717:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 718:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 719:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 720:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 721:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 722:     } else {
 723:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 724:     }
 725:   }

 727:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 728:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 729:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 730:     try {
 731:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 732:       const result = currentGame.move({
 733:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 734:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 735:         promotion: piece,
 736:       });
 737:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 738:       patchBoardSession({
 739:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 740:         moves: nextMoves,
 741:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 742:       });
 743:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 744:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 745:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 746:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 747:       setError("");
 748:     } catch {
 749:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 750:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 751:     }
 752:   }
 753: 
 754:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 755:     if (!boardSession) return;
 756:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 757:     try {
 758:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 759:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 760:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 761:       if (promote) {
 762:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 763:         return;
 764:       }
 765:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 766:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 767:       patchBoardSession({
 768:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 769:         moves: nextMoves,
 770:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 771:       });
 772:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 773:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 774:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 775:       setError("");
 776:     } catch {
 777:       const piece = game.get(to);
 778:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 779:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 780:     }
 781:   }
 782: 
 783:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 784:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 785:     setRedSquares([]);
 786: 
 787:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 788:       setUserArrows([]);
 789:       setArrowStart(null);
 790:       setArrowHover(null);
 791:       return;
 792:     }
 793: if (!boardSession) return;
 794:     if (annotationMode) {
 795:       if (!arrowStart) {
 796:         setArrowStart(square);
 797:         return;
 798:       }
 799:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 800:       setArrowStart(null);
 801:       setArrowHover(null);
 802:       return;
 803:     }
 804:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 805:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 806:       return;
 807:     }
 808:     const piece = game.get(square);
 809:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 810:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 811:   }

 813:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 814:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 815: 
 816:   event.preventDefault();
 817: 
 818:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 819:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 820:     event.clientX,
 821:     event.clientY,
 822:     bounds,
 823:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 824:   );
 825: 
 826:   if (!square) return;
 827: 
 828:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 829:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 830:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 831:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 832:   setArrowStart(square);
 833:   setArrowHover(square);
 834: 
 835:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 836: }

 838:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 839:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 840:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 841:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
 842:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 843:     setArrowHover(square);
 844:   }
 845: 
 846:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 847:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 848: 
 849:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 850: 
 851:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 852:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 853:     event.clientX,
 854:     event.clientY,
 855:     bounds,
 856:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 857:   );
 858: 
 859:   if (to && to !== from) {
 860:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 861:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 862:   } else {
 863:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 864:   }
 865: 
 866:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 867:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 868:   setArrowStart(null);
 869:   setArrowHover(null);
 870: }

 911:       ...current,

 916:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 917:     }));

 921:   function clearBoardScan() {
 922:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
 923:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 924: 
 925:     const controller = scanAbortControllerRef.current;
 926:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 927:     controller?.abort();
 928: 
 929:     setDetecting(false);
 930:     setManualMode(false);
 931:     setDragSelection(null);
 932:     setCropEditingId(null);
 933:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 934:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 935: 
 936:     patchSession((current) => ({
 937:       ...current,
 938:       candidatesByPage: {
 939:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 940:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 941:       },
 942:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 943:     }));
 944: 
 945:     setError("");
 946:     setNotice("Board detection cleared.");
 947:   }
 948:   async function detectBoards() {
 949:     if (detecting) {
 950:       stopBoardScan();
 951:       return;
 952:     }
 953: 
 954:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 955:     if (!API_BASE) {
 956:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 957:       return;
 958:     }
 959: 
 960:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 961:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 962:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 963:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 964: 
 965:     setDetecting(true);
 966:     setError("");
 967:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 968:     patchSession((current) => ({
 969:       ...current,
 970:       candidatesByPage: {
 971:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 972:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 973:       },
 974:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 975:     }));
 976: 
 977:     try {
 978:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 979:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 980:           (blob) => blob
 981:             ? resolve(blob)
 982:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 983:           "image/png",
 984:         );
 985:       });
 986: 
 987:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 988: 
 989:       const form = new FormData();
 990:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 991: 
 992:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 993:         method: "POST",
 994:         body: form,
 995:         signal: abortController.signal,
 996:       });
 997: 
 998:       if (!response.ok) {
 999:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
1000:       }
1001: 
1002:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
1003:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
1004:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
1005:       );
1006: 
1007:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1008: 
1009:       patchSession((current) => ({
1010:         ...current,
1011:         candidatesByPage: {
1012:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
1013:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
1014:         },
1015:         selectedDiagramId: null,
1016:       }));
1017: 
1018:       setNotice(
1019:         candidates.length
1020:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
1021:           : "No board candidates found.",
1022:       );
1023:     } catch (cause) {
1024:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1025: 
1026:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
1027:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
1028:       } else {
1029:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1030:       }
1031:     } finally {
1032:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
1033:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1034:         setDetecting(false);
1035:       }
1036:     }
1037:   }
1038:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {
1039:     const box = canvasRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
1040:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;
1041:   }

1043:   function startCropEdit(
1044:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
1045:     candidate: Candidate,
1046:     handle: CropHandle,
1047:   ) {
1048:     event.stopPropagation();
1049:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1050:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;
1051:     if (!point || !stage) return;
1052:     cropEditStartRef.current = { candidate, handle, point };
1053:     stage.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1054:   }

1056:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1057:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1058:     if (!manualMode) return;
1059: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1060: if (!canvas) return;
1061: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1062: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1063: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1064: if (
1065:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1066:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1067:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1068:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1069: ) return;
1070:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1071:     if (!point) return;
1072:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1073:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1074:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1075:     setDragSelection(selection);
1076:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1077:   }
1078: 
1079:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1080:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1081:     if (edit) {
1082:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1083:       if (!point || !session) return;
1084:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1085:       patchSession((current) => {
1086:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1087:         return {
1088:           ...current,
1089:           candidatesByPage: {
1090:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1091:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1092:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1093:           },
1094:         };
1095:       });
1096:       return;
1097:     }
1098:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1099:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1100:     if (point) {
1101:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1102:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1103:       setDragSelection(selection);
1104:     }
1105:   }
1106: 
1107:   function finishRegion() {
1108:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1109:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1110:       return;
1111:     }
1112:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1113:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1114:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1115:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1116:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1117:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1118:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1119:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1120:     setDragSelection(null);
1121:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1122:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1123:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1124:       x, y, width, height,
1125:       relativeScore: 1,
1126:       source: "manual",
1127:     };
1128:     patchSession((current) => ({
1129:       ...current,
1130:       candidatesByPage: {
1131:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1132:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1133:       },
1134:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1135:     }));
1136:     setManualMode(false);
1137:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1138:   }
1139: 
1140:   function cancelRegion() {
1141:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1142:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1143:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1144:     setDragSelection(null);
1145:   }

1147:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1148:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1149:     try {
1150:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1151:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1152:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1153:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1154:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1155:       const scale = mode === "width"
1156:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1157:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1158:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1159:     } catch (cause) {
1160:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1161:     }
1162:   }

 137:         if (activeBook) {
 138:           const resumed = { ...activeBook, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 139:           await putBook(resumed);
 140:           setBooks([resumed, ...ordered.filter((item) => item.id !== resumed.id)]);
 141:           setBook(resumed);
 142:           setSession(storedSessions[activeBook.id] ?? newSession(activeBook.id));
 143:           if (activeBook.id !== activeId) await setActiveBookId(activeBook.id);
 144:         } else {
 145:           setBooks(ordered);
 146:         }
 147:       } catch (cause) {
 148:         if (!cancelled) setError(`Could not restore the local library: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 149:       } finally {
 150:         if (!cancelled) setReady(true);
 151:       }
 152:     }
 153:     void initialize();
 154:     return () => { cancelled = true; };
 155:   }, []);
 156: 
 157:   useEffect(() => {
 158:     if (!ready || !book || !session) return;
 159:     const snapshot = session;
 160:     void Promise.all([putSession(snapshot), setActiveBookId(book.id)])
 161:       .then(() => setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [snapshot.bookId]: snapshot })))
 162:       .catch((cause: unknown) => setError(`Could not save reading session: ${messageOf(cause)}`));
 163:   }, [ready, book, session]);

 213:       const context = canvas.getContext("2d");

 216:       canvas.height = Math.floor(viewport.height);
 217:       const task = page.render({ canvas, canvasContext: context, viewport });
 218:       renderTaskRef.current = task;
 219:       return task.promise;

 224:         setRendering(false);
 225:         setError(`Could not render page ${session.page}: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 226:       }
 227:     });

 230:       renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();
 231:     };

 233: 
 234:   useEffect(() => {
 235:     function onKey(event: KeyboardEvent) {
 236:       if (!session || !book || isTypingTarget(event.target)) return;
 237:       if (cropEditingId && ["ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", "ArrowUp", "ArrowDown"].includes(event.key)) {
 238:         const candidate = (session.candidatesByPage[String(session.page)] ?? []).find((item) => item.id === cropEditingId);
 239:         if (!candidate) return;
 240:         const step = event.shiftKey ? 0.01 : 0.002;
 241:         const x = event.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowRight" ? step : 0;
 242:         const y = event.key === "ArrowUp" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowDown" ? step : 0;
 243:         const next = editCrop(candidate, "move", x, y);
 244:         patchSession((current) => {
 245:           const pageKey = String(current.page);
 246:           return {
 247:             ...current,
 248:             candidatesByPage: {

 252:             },
 253:           };
 254:         });
 255:         event.preventDefault();
 256:         return;
 257:       }

 259:       if (event.key === "ArrowRight") changePage(1);
 260:     }
 261:     window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 262:     return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);

 270:   const sortedBooks = useMemo(() => [...books].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt), [books]);

 320:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 321:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 322:   }

 324:   function toggleEngine() {
 325:     if (engineEnabled) {
 326:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 327:       engineRef.current = null;
 328:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 329:       setEngineStatus("off");
 330:       setEngineScore(null);
 331:       setEngineMessage("");
 332:       return;
 333:     }
 334:     try {
 335:       setEngineScore(null);
 336:       setEngineMessage("");
 337:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 338:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 339:         (status, message) => {
 340:           setEngineStatus(status);
 341:           if (status === "error") {
 342:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 343:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 344:             setEngineScore(null);
 345:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 346:             engineRef.current = null;
 347:           }
 348:         },
 349:         setEngineScore,
 350:       );
 351:       engineRef.current = client;
 352:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 353:     } catch (cause) {
 354:       setEngineStatus("error");
 355:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 356:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 357:     }
 358:   }

 360:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 361:     setSession((current) => {
 362:       if (!current) return current;
 363:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 364:     });
 365:   }

 367:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 368:     try {
 369:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 370:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 371:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 372:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 373:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 374:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 375:       setBook(opened);
 376:       setSession(nextSession);
 377:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 378:       setError("");
 379:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 380:     } catch (cause) {
 381:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 382:     }
 383:   }

 385:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 386:     if (!file) return;
 387:     try {
 388:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 389:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 390:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 391:       const now = Date.now();
 392:       const created: BookRecord = {
 393:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 394:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 395:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 396:         byteLength: file.size,
 397:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 398:         addedAt: now,
 399:       };
 400:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 401:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 402:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 403:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 404:       setBook(created);
 405:       setSession(blank);
 406:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 407:       setError("");
 408:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 409:     } catch (cause) {
 410:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 411:     }
 412:   }

 414:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 415:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 416: 
 417:     try {
 418:       await removeBook(item.id);
 419:       await removeSession(item.id);
 420: 
 421:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 422:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 423:         const next = { ...current };
 424:         delete next[item.id];
 425:         return next;
 426:       });
 427: 
 428:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 429:         setBook(null);
 430:         setSession(null);
 431:         setPdf(null);
 432:       }
 433: 
 434:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 435:       setError("");
 436:     } catch (cause) {
 437:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 438:     }
 439:   }
 440:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 441:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 442:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 443:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 444:     try {
 445:       await putBook(renamed);
 446:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 447:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 448:     } catch (cause) {
 449:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 450:     }
 451:   }

 454:     if (!session) return;
 455:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });

 463:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 464:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 465:     try {
 466:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 467:       setSession({
 468:         ...activeSession,
 469:         originalFen: fen,
 470:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 471:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 472:         moves: [],
 473:         moveIndex: 0,
 474:       });
 475:       setLastMove(null);
 476:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 477:       setUserArrows([]);
 478:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 479:       return true;
 480:     } catch (cause) {
 481:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 482:       return false;
 483:     }
 484:   }

 496:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");

 549:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 550:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 551:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 552:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 553:       return;
 554:     }
 555:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 556:     try {
 557:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 558:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 559:       preview.width = crop.width;
 560:       preview.height = crop.height;
 561:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 562:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 563:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 564:     } catch (cause) {
 565:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 566:       return;
 567:     }
 568:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 569:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 570:     setTransferFen("");
 571:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 572:         setRecognitionError("");
 573:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 574:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 575:     try {
 576:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 577:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 578:       });
 579:       const form = new FormData();
 580:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 581:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 582:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 583:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 584:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 585:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 586:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 587:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 588:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 589:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 590:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 591:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 592:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 593:       }
 594:     } catch (cause) {
 595:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 596:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 597:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 598:     }
 599:   }

 602:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 603:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 604:     setTransferPreview("");
 605:     setTransferFen("");
 606:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 607:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 608:     setRecognitionError("");
 609:       }

 612:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 613:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 614:       setGameEndOverlay({
 615:         title: "Checkmate",
 616:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 617:       });
 618:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 619:       setGameEndOverlay({
 620:         title: "Stalemate",
 621:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 622:       });
 623:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 624:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 625:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 626:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 627:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 628:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 629:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 630:     } else {
 631:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 632:     }
 633:   }

 635:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 636:     if (!promotionRequest || !session) return;
 637:     try {
 638:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 639:       const result = currentGame.move({
 640:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 641:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 642:         promotion: piece,
 643:       });
 644:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 645:       patchSession({
 646:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 647:         moves: nextMoves,
 648:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 649:       });
 650:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 651:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 652:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 653:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 654:       setError("");
 655:     } catch {
 656:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 657:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 658:     }
 659:   }
 660: 
 661:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 662:     if (!session) return;
 663:     try {
 664:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 665:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 666:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 667:       if (promote) {
 668:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 669:         return;
 670:       }
 671:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 672:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 673:       patchSession({
 674:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 675:         moves: nextMoves,
 676:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 677:       });
 678:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 679:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 680:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 681:       setError("");
 682:     } catch {
 683:       const piece = game.get(to);
 684:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 685:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 686:     }
 687:   }
 688: 
 689:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 690:     
 691:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 692:       setUserArrows([]);
 693:       setArrowStart(null);
 694:       setArrowHover(null);
 695:       return;
 696:     }
 697: if (!session) return;
 698:     if (annotationMode) {
 699:       if (!arrowStart) {
 700:         setArrowStart(square);
 701:         return;
 702:       }
 703:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 704:       setArrowStart(null);
 705:       setArrowHover(null);
 706:       return;
 707:     }
 708:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 709:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 710:       return;
 711:     }
 712:     const piece = game.get(square);
 713:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 714:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 715:   }

 717:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 718:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 719: 
 720:   event.preventDefault();
 721: 
 722:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 723:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 724:     event.clientX,
 725:     event.clientY,
 726:     bounds,
 727:     Boolean(session?.flipped),

 747:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 748:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;

 750:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 751: 
 752:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();

 755:     event.clientY,
 756:     bounds,
 757:     Boolean(session?.flipped),
 758:   );

 761:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 762:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 763:   } else {
 764:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 765:   }
 766:

 768:   setArrowStart(null);
 769:   setArrowHover(null);

 848:   async function detectBoards() {
 849:     if (detecting) {
 850:       stopBoardScan();
 851:       return;
 852:     }
 853: 
 854:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 855:     if (!API_BASE) {
 856:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 857:       return;
 858:     }
 859: 
 860:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 861:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 862:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 863:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 864: 
 865:     setDetecting(true);
 866:     setError("");
 867:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 868:     patchSession((current) => ({
 869:       ...current,
 870:       candidatesByPage: {
 871:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 872:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 873:       },
 874:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 875:     }));
 876: 
 877:     try {
 878:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 879:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 880:           (blob) => blob
 881:             ? resolve(blob)
 882:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 883:           "image/png",
 884:         );
 885:       });
 886: 
 887:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 888: 
 889:       const form = new FormData();
 890:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 891: 
 892:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 893:         method: "POST",
 894:         body: form,
 895:         signal: abortController.signal,
 896:       });
 897: 
 898:       if (!response.ok) {
 899:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 900:       }
 901: 
 902:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 903:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 904:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 905:       );
 906: 
 907:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 908: 
 909:       patchSession((current) => ({
 910:         ...current,
 911:         candidatesByPage: {
 912:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 913:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 914:         },
 915:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 916:       }));
 917: 
 918:       setNotice(
 919:         candidates.length
 920:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 921:           : "No board candidates found.",
 922:       );
 923:     } catch (cause) {
 924:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 925: 
 926:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 927:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 928:       } else {
 929:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 930:       }
 931:     } finally {
 932:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 933:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 934:         setDetecting(false);
 935:       }
 936:     }
 937:   }

 956:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 957:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 958:     if (!manualMode) return;
 959: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 960: if (!canvas) return;
 961: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 962: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 963: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 964: if (
 965:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 966:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 967:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 968:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 969: ) return;
 970:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 971:     if (!point) return;
 972:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 973:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 974:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 975:     setDragSelection(selection);
 976:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 977:   }

 979:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 980:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 981:     if (edit) {
 982:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 983:       if (!point || !session) return;
 984:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 985:       patchSession((current) => {
 986:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 987:         return {
 988:           ...current,
 989:           candidatesByPage: {
 990:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 991:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 992:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 993:           },
 994:         };
 995:       });
 996:       return;
 997:     }
 998:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
 999:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1000:     if (point) {
1001:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1002:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1003:       setDragSelection(selection);
1004:     }
1005:   }

1007:   function finishRegion() {
1008:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1009:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1010:       return;
1011:     }
1012:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1013:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1014:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1015:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1016:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1017:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1018:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1019:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1020:     setDragSelection(null);
1021:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1022:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1023:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1024:       x, y, width, height,
1025:       relativeScore: 1,
1026:       source: "manual",
1027:     };
1028:     patchSession((current) => ({
1029:       ...current,
1030:       candidatesByPage: {
1031:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1032:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1033:       },
1034:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1035:     }));
1036:     setManualMode(false);
1037:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1038:   }

1043:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1044:     setDragSelection(null);

1047:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1048:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1049:     try {
1050:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1051:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1052:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1053:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1054:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1055:       const scale = mode === "width"
1056:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1057:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1058:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1059:     } catch (cause) {
1060:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1061:     }
1062:   }

  51: function squareName(fileIndex: number, rankIndex: number): Square {
  52:   return `${"abcdefgh"[fileIndex]}${rankIndex + 1}` as Square;
  53: }
  54: 
  55: function normalizedCandidate(value: CandidateInput, index: number): Candidate {
  56:   const { relative_score, confidence, ...candidate } = value;
  57:   return {
  58:     ...candidate,
  59:     id: candidate.id || `candidate-${index + 1}`,
  60:     source: candidate.source ?? "automatic",
  61:     relativeScore: candidate.relativeScore ?? relative_score ?? confidence ?? 0,
  62:   };
  63: }

 324:   function toggleEngine() {
 325:     if (engineEnabled) {
 326:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 327:       engineRef.current = null;
 328:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 329:       setEngineStatus("off");
 330:       setEngineScore(null);
 331:       setEngineMessage("");
 332:       return;
 333:     }
 334:     try {
 335:       setEngineScore(null);
 336:       setEngineMessage("");
 337:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 338:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 339:         (status, message) => {
 340:           setEngineStatus(status);
 341:           if (status === "error") {
 342:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 343:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 344:             setEngineScore(null);
 345:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 346:             engineRef.current = null;
 347:           }
 348:         },
 349:         setEngineScore,
 350:       );
 351:       engineRef.current = client;
 352:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 353:     } catch (cause) {
 354:       setEngineStatus("error");
 355:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 356:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 357:     }
 358:   }

 360:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 361:     setSession((current) => {
 362:       if (!current) return current;
 363:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 364:     });

 368:     try {
 369:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);

 373:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 374:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 375:       setBook(opened);
 376:       setSession(nextSession);
 377:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 378:       setError("");

 385:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 386:     if (!file) return;
 387:     try {
 388:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 389:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 390:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 391:       const now = Date.now();
 392:       const created: BookRecord = {
 393:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 394:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 395:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 396:         byteLength: file.size,
 397:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 398:         addedAt: now,
 399:       };
 400:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 401:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 402:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 403:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 404:       setBook(created);
 405:       setSession(blank);
 406:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 407:       setError("");
 408:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 409:     } catch (cause) {
 410:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 411:     }
 412:   }

 414:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {

 418:       await removeBook(item.id);

 422:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 423:         const next = { ...current };

 425:         return next;
 426:       });
 427:

 429:         setBook(null);
 430:         setSession(null);
 431:         setPdf(null);
 432:       }
 433: 
 434:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 435:       setError("");
 436:     } catch (cause) {
 437:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 438:     }
 439:   }
 440:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {

 445:       await putBook(renamed);

 447:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);

 449:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 450:     }

 549:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 550:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 551:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 552:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 553:       return;
 554:     }
 555:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 556:     try {
 557:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 558:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 559:       preview.width = crop.width;
 560:       preview.height = crop.height;
 561:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 562:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 563:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 564:     } catch (cause) {
 565:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 566:       return;
 567:     }
 568:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 569:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 570:     setTransferFen("");
 571:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 572:         setRecognitionError("");
 573:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 574:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 575:     try {
 576:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 577:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 578:       });
 579:       const form = new FormData();
 580:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 581:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 582:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 583:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 584:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 585:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 586:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 587:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 588:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 589:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 590:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 591:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 592:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 593:       }
 594:     } catch (cause) {
 595:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 596:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 597:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 598:     }
 599:   }

 603:     setTransferCandidate(null);

 612:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 613:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 614:       setGameEndOverlay({
 615:         title: "Checkmate",
 616:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 617:       });
 618:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 619:       setGameEndOverlay({
 620:         title: "Stalemate",
 621:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 622:       });
 623:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 624:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 625:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 626:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 627:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 628:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 629:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 630:     } else {
 631:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 632:     }
 633:   }
 634: 
 635:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 636:     if (!promotionRequest || !session) return;
 637:     try {
 638:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 639:       const result = currentGame.move({
 640:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 641:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 642:         promotion: piece,
 643:       });
 644:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 645:       patchSession({
 646:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 647:         moves: nextMoves,
 648:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 649:       });
 650:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 651:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 652:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 653:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 654:       setError("");
 655:     } catch {
 656:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 657:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 658:     }
 659:   }
 660: 
 661:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 662:     if (!session) return;
 663:     try {
 664:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 665:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 666:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 667:       if (promote) {
 668:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 669:         return;
 670:       }
 671:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 672:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 673:       patchSession({
 674:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 675:         moves: nextMoves,
 676:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 677:       });
 678:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 679:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 680:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 681:       setError("");
 682:     } catch {
 683:       const piece = game.get(to);
 684:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 685:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 686:     }
 687:   }

 689:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 690:     
 691:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 692:       setUserArrows([]);
 693:       setArrowStart(null);
 694:       setArrowHover(null);
 695:       return;
 696:     }
 697: if (!session) return;
 698:     if (annotationMode) {
 699:       if (!arrowStart) {
 700:         setArrowStart(square);
 701:         return;
 702:       }
 703:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 704:       setArrowStart(null);
 705:       setArrowHover(null);
 706:       return;
 707:     }
 708:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 709:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 710:       return;
 711:     }
 712:     const piece = game.get(square);
 713:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 714:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 715:   }
