 549:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 550:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 551:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 552:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 553:       return;
 554:     }
 555:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 556:     try {
 557:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 558:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 559:       preview.width = crop.width;
 560:       preview.height = crop.height;
 561:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 562:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 563:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 564:     } catch (cause) {
 565:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 566:       return;
 567:     }
 568:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 569:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 570:     setTransferFen("");
 571:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 572:         setRecognitionError("");
 573:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 574:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 575:     try {
 576:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 577:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 578:       });
 579:       const form = new FormData();
 580:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 581:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 582:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 583:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 584:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 585:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 586:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 587:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 588:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 589:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 590:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 591:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 592:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 593:       }
 594:     } catch (cause) {
 595:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 596:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 597:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 598:     }
 599:   }
 600: 
 601:   function closeTransfer() {
 602:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 603:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 604:     setTransferPreview("");
 605:     setTransferFen("");
 606:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 607:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 608:     setRecognitionError("");
 609:       }

 612:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 613:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 614:       setGameEndOverlay({
 615:         title: "Checkmate",
 616:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 617:       });
 618:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 619:       setGameEndOverlay({
 620:         title: "Stalemate",
 621:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 622:       });
 623:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 624:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 625:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 626:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 627:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 628:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 629:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 630:     } else {
 631:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 632:     }
 633:   }
 634: 
 635:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 636:     if (!promotionRequest || !session) return;
 637:     try {
 638:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 639:       const result = currentGame.move({
 640:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 641:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 642:         promotion: piece,
 643:       });
 644:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 645:       patchSession({
 646:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 647:         moves: nextMoves,
 648:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 649:       });
 650:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 651:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 652:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 653:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 654:       setError("");
 655:     } catch {
 656:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 657:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 658:     }
 659:   }
 660: 
 661:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 662:     if (!session) return;
 663:     try {
 664:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 665:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 666:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 667:       if (promote) {
 668:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 669:         return;
 670:       }
 671:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 672:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 673:       patchSession({
 674:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 675:         moves: nextMoves,
 676:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 677:       });
 678:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 679:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 680:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 681:       setError("");
 682:     } catch {
 683:       const piece = game.get(to);
 684:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 685:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 686:     }
 687:   }

 689:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 690:     
 691:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 692:       setUserArrows([]);
 693:       setArrowStart(null);
 694:       setArrowHover(null);
 695:       return;
 696:     }
 697: if (!session) return;
 698:     if (annotationMode) {
 699:       if (!arrowStart) {
 700:         setArrowStart(square);
 701:         return;
 702:       }
 703:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 704:       setArrowStart(null);
 705:       setArrowHover(null);
 706:       return;
 707:     }
 708:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 709:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 710:       return;
 711:     }
 712:     const piece = game.get(square);
 713:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 714:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 715:   }

 848:   async function detectBoards() {
 849:     if (detecting) {
 850:       stopBoardScan();
 851:       return;
 852:     }
 853: 
 854:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 855:     if (!API_BASE) {
 856:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 857:       return;
 858:     }
 859: 
 860:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 861:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 862:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 863:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 864: 
 865:     setDetecting(true);
 866:     setError("");
 867:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 868:     patchSession((current) => ({
 869:       ...current,
 870:       candidatesByPage: {
 871:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 872:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 873:       },
 874:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 875:     }));
 876: 
 877:     try {
 878:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 879:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 880:           (blob) => blob
 881:             ? resolve(blob)
 882:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 883:           "image/png",
 884:         );
 885:       });
 886: 
 887:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 888: 
 889:       const form = new FormData();
 890:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 891: 
 892:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 893:         method: "POST",
 894:         body: form,
 895:         signal: abortController.signal,
 896:       });
 897: 
 898:       if (!response.ok) {
 899:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 900:       }
 901: 
 902:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 903:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 904:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 905:       );
 906: 
 907:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 908: 
 909:       patchSession((current) => ({
 910:         ...current,
 911:         candidatesByPage: {
 912:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 913:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 914:         },
 915:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 916:       }));
 917: 
 918:       setNotice(
 919:         candidates.length
 920:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 921:           : "No board candidates found.",
 922:       );
 923:     } catch (cause) {
 924:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 925: 
 926:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 927:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 928:       } else {
 929:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 930:       }
 931:     } finally {
 932:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 933:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 934:         setDetecting(false);
 935:       }
 936:     }
 937:   }

 956:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 957:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 958:     if (!manualMode) return;
 959: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 960: if (!canvas) return;
 961: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 962: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 963: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 964: if (
 965:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 966:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 967:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 968:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 969: ) return;
 970:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 971:     if (!point) return;
 972:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 973:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };

 979:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 980:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 981:     if (edit) {
 982:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 983:       if (!point || !session) return;
 984:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 985:       patchSession((current) => {
 986:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 987:         return {
 988:           ...current,
 989:           candidatesByPage: {
 990:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 991:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 992:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 993:           },
 994:         };
 995:       });
 996:       return;
 997:     }
 998:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
 999:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1000:     if (point) {
1001:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1002:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1003:       setDragSelection(selection);
1004:     }

1007:   function finishRegion() {
1008:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1009:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1010:       return;
1011:     }
1012:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1013:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1014:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1015:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1016:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1017:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1018:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1019:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1020:     setDragSelection(null);
1021:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1022:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1023:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1024:       x, y, width, height,
1025:       relativeScore: 1,
1026:       source: "manual",
1027:     };
1028:     patchSession((current) => ({
1029:       ...current,
1030:       candidatesByPage: {
1031:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1032:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1033:       },
1034:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1035:     }));
1036:     setManualMode(false);
1037:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1038:   }

1047:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1048:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1049:     try {
1050:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1051:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1052:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1053:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1054:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1055:       const scale = mode === "width"
1056:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1057:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1058:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1059:     } catch (cause) {
1060:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1061:     }
1062:   }

  28: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  29:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  30:   if (!match) return uci;
  31:   try {
  32:     const position = new Chess(fen);
  33:     const move = position.move({
  34:       from: match[1] as Square,
  35:       to: match[2] as Square,
  36:       ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  37:     });
  38:     return move.san;
  39:   } catch {
  40:     return uci;
  41:   }
  42: }

  44: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {
  45:   const position = new Chess(fen);
  46:   const san: string[] = [];
  47:   for (const uci of pv) {
  48:     const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  49:     if (!match) break;
  50:     try {
  51:       const move = position.move({
  52:         from: match[1] as Square,
  53:         to: match[2] as Square,
  54:         ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  55:       });
  56:       san.push(move.san);
  57:     } catch {
  58:       break;
  59:     }
  60:   }
  61:   return san.join(" ");
  62: }

  84: function readableDate(timestamp: number): string {
  85:   if (!timestamp) return "Not opened";
  86:   const elapsed = Date.now() - timestamp;
  87:   if (elapsed < 60_000) return "Just now";
  88:   if (elapsed < 3_600_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 60_000)}m ago`;
  89:   if (elapsed < 86_400_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 3_600_000)}h ago`;

 485:     if (engineEnabled) {
 486:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 487:       engineRef.current = null;
 488:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 489:       setEngineStatus("off");
 490:       setEngineScore(null);
 491:       setEngineMessage("");
 492:       return;
 493:     }
 494:     try {
 495:       setEngineScore(null);
 496:       setEngineMessage("");
 497:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 498:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 499:         (status, message) => {
 500:           setEngineStatus(status);
 501:           if (status === "error") {
 502:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 503:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 504:             setEngineScore(null);
 505:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 506:             engineRef.current = null;
 507:           }
 508:         },
 509:         setEngineScore,
 510:       );
 511:       engineRef.current = client;
 512:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 513:     } catch (cause) {
 514:       setEngineStatus("error");
 515:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 516:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 517:     }
 518:   }
 519: 
 520:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 521:     setSession((current) => {
 522:       if (!current) return current;
 523:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 524:     });
 525:   }
 526: 
 527:   function patchBoardSession(change: Partial<StudyBoardState>) {
 528:     if (workspaceMode === "opening-explorer") {
 529:       return;
 530:     }
 531: 
 532:     if (workspaceMode === "analysis") {
 533:       setAnalysisBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 534:     } else if (workspaceMode === "opening-prep") {
 535:       setOpeningPrepBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 536:     } else if (studyMode) {
 537:       setStudyBoard((current) => current ? { ...current, ...change } : current);
 538:     } else {
 539:       patchSession(change);
 540:     }
 541:   }
 542:   async function toggleStudyMode() {
 543:     if (!studyMode) {
 544:       if (!session) {
 545:         setError("Open a book before entering study mode.");
 546:         return;
 547:       }
 548:       setStudyBoard({
 549:         lineBaseFen: session.lineBaseFen,
 550:         currentFen: session.currentFen,
 551:         moves: [...session.moves],
 552:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 553:         flipped: session.flipped,
 554:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 555:       });
 556:       setStudyMode(true);
 557:     } else {
 558:       // Preserve the latest Focus Mode board when returning to normal mode.
 559:       if (studyBoard) {
 560:         patchSession({
 561:           lineBaseFen: studyBoard.lineBaseFen,
 562:           currentFen: studyBoard.currentFen,
 563:           moves: [...studyBoard.moves],
 564:           moveIndex: studyBoard.moveIndex,
 565:           flipped: studyBoard.flipped,
 566:           coordinates: studyBoard.coordinates,
 567:         });
 568:       }
 569:       setStudyMode(false);
 570:     }
 571:     setLastMove(null);
 572:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 573:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 574: 
 575:     try {
 576:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 577:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 578:       } else {
 579:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 580:       }
 581:     } catch {
 582:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 583:     }
 584: }

 586:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 587:     try {
 588:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 589:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 590:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 591:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 592:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 593:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 594:       setBook(opened);
 595:       setSession(nextSession);
 596:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 597:       setError("");
 598:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 599:     } catch (cause) {
 600:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 601:     }
 602:   }
 603: 
 604:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 605:     if (!file) return;
 606:     try {
 607:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 608:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 609:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 610:       const now = Date.now();
 611:       const created: BookRecord = {
 612:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 613:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 614:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 615:         byteLength: file.size,
 616:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 617:         addedAt: now,
 618:       };
 619:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 620:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 621:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 622:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 623:       setBook(created);
 624:       setSession(blank);
 625:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 626:       setError("");
 627:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 628:     } catch (cause) {
 629:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 630:     }
 631:   }

 633:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 634:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 635: 
 636:     try {
 637:       await removeBook(item.id);
 638:       await removeSession(item.id);
 639: 
 640:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 641:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 642:         const next = { ...current };
 643:         delete next[item.id];
 644:         return next;
 645:       });
 646: 
 647:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 648:         setBook(null);
 649:         setSession(null);
 650:         setPdf(null);
 651:       }
 652: 
 653:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 654:       setError("");
 655:     } catch (cause) {
 656:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 657:     }
 658:   }
 659:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 660:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 661:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 662:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 663:     try {
 664:       await putBook(renamed);
 665:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 666:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 667:     } catch (cause) {
 668:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 669:     }
 670:   }

 682:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 683:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 684:     try {
 685:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 686:       setSession({
 687:         ...activeSession,
 688:         originalFen: fen,
 689:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 690:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 691:         moves: [],
 692:         moveIndex: 0,
 693:       });
 694:       setLastMove(null);
 695:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 696:       setUserArrows([]);
 697:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 698:       return true;
 699:     } catch (cause) {
 700:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 701:       return false;
 702:     }
 703:   }

 714:     }
 715:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 716:     return true;

 768:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 769:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 770:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 771:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 772:       return;
 773:     }
 774:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 775:     try {
 776:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 777:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 778:       preview.width = crop.width;
 779:       preview.height = crop.height;
 780:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 781:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 782:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 783:     } catch (cause) {
 784:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 785:       return;
 786:     }
 787:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 788:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 789:     setTransferFen("");
 790:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 791:         setRecognitionError("");
 792:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 793:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 794:     try {
 795:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 796:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 797:       });
 798:       const form = new FormData();
 799:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 800:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 801:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 802:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 803:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 804:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 805:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 806:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 807:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 808:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 809:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 810:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 811:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 812:       }
 813:     } catch (cause) {
 814:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 815:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 816:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 817:     }
 818:   }

 820:   function closeTransfer() {
 821:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 822:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 823:     setTransferPreview("");
 824:     setTransferFen("");
 825:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 826:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 827:     setRecognitionError("");
 828:       }

 831:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 832:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 833:       setGameEndOverlay({
 834:         title: "Checkmate",
 835:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 836:       });
 837:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 838:       setGameEndOverlay({
 839:         title: "Stalemate",
 840:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 841:       });
 842:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 843:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 844:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 845:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 846:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 847:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 848:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 849:     } else {
 850:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 851:     }
 852:   }

 854:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 855:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 856:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 857:     try {
 858:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 859:       const result = currentGame.move({
 860:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 861:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 862:         promotion: piece,
 863:       });
 864:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 865:       patchBoardSession({
 866:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 867:         moves: nextMoves,
 868:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 869:       });
 870:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 871:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 872:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 873:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 874:       setError("");
 875:     } catch {
 876:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 877:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 878:     }
 879:   }
 880: 
 881:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 882:     if (!boardSession) return;
 883:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 884:     try {
 885:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 886:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 887:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 888:       if (promote) {
 889:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 890:         return;
 891:       }
 892:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 893:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 894:       if (workspaceMode === "opening-explorer") {
 895:         const line = nextMoves
 896:           .map((move, index) => index % 2 === 0 ? `${Math.floor(index / 2) + 1}. ${move}` : move)
 897:           .join(" ");
 898:         setOpeningExplorerInput(line);
 899:         setOpeningExplorerPly(nextMoves.length);
 900:       } else {
 901:         patchBoardSession({
 902:           currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 903:           moves: nextMoves,
 904:           moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 905:         });
 906:       }
 907:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 908:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 909:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 910:       setError("");
 911:     } catch {
 912:       const piece = game.get(to);
 913:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 914:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 915:     }
 916:   }

 918:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 919:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 920:     setRedSquares([]);
 921: 
 922:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 923:       setUserArrows([]);
 924:       setArrowStart(null);
 925:       setArrowHover(null);
 926:       return;
 927:     }
 928: if (!boardSession) return;
 929:     if (annotationMode) {
 930:       if (!arrowStart) {
 931:         setArrowStart(square);
 932:         return;
 933:       }
 934:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 935:       setArrowStart(null);
 936:       setArrowHover(null);
 937:       return;
 938:     }
 939:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 940:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 941:       return;
 942:     }
 943:     const piece = game.get(square);
 944:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 945:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 946:   }

 948:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 949:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 950: 
 951:   event.preventDefault();
 952: 
 953:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 954:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 955:     event.clientX,
 956:     event.clientY,
 957:     bounds,
 958:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 959:   );
 960: 
 961:   if (!square) return;
 962: 
 963:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 964:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 965:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 966:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 967:   setArrowStart(square);
 968:   setArrowHover(square);
 969: 
 970:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 971: }

 973:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 974:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 975:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 976:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
 977:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 978:     setArrowHover(square);
 979:   }

 981:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 982:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 983: 
 984:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 985: 
 986:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 987:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 988:     event.clientX,
 989:     event.clientY,
 990:     bounds,
 991:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 992:   );
 993: 
 994:   if (to && to !== from) {
 995:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 996:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 997:   } else {
 998:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 999:   }
1000: 
1001:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
1002:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
1003:   setArrowStart(null);
1004:   setArrowHover(null);
1005: }

1083:   async function detectBoards() {
1084:     if (detecting) {
1085:       stopBoardScan();
1086:       return;
1087:     }
1088: 
1089:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
1090:     if (!API_BASE) {
1091:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
1092:       return;
1093:     }
1094: 
1095:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
1096:     const abortController = new AbortController();
1097:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
1098:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
1099: 
1100:     setDetecting(true);
1101:     setError("");
1102:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
1103:     patchSession((current) => ({
1104:       ...current,
1105:       candidatesByPage: {
1106:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1107:         [String(current.page)]: [],
1108:       },
1109:       selectedDiagramId: null,
1110:     }));
1111: 
1112:     try {
1113:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
1114:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
1115:           (blob) => blob
1116:             ? resolve(blob)
1117:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
1118:           "image/png",
1119:         );
1120:       });
1121: 
1122:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1123: 
1124:       const form = new FormData();
1125:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
1126: 
1127:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
1128:         method: "POST",
1129:         body: form,
1130:         signal: abortController.signal,
1131:       });
1132: 
1133:       if (!response.ok) {
1134:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
1135:       }
1136: 
1137:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
1138:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
1139:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
1140:       );
1141: 
1142:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1143: 
1144:       patchSession((current) => ({
1145:         ...current,
1146:         candidatesByPage: {
1147:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
1148:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
1149:         },
1150:         selectedDiagramId: null,
1151:       }));
1152: 
1153:       setNotice(
1154:         candidates.length
1155:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
1156:           : "No board candidates found.",
1157:       );
1158:     } catch (cause) {
1159:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1160: 
1161:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
1162:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
1163:       } else {
1164:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1165:       }
1166:     } finally {
1167:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
1168:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1169:         setDetecting(false);
1170:       }
1171:     }
1172:   }

1191:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1192:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1193:     if (!manualMode) return;
1194: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1195: if (!canvas) return;
1196: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1197: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1198: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1199: if (
1200:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1201:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1202:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1203:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1204: ) return;
1205:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1206:     if (!point) return;
1207:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1208:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1209:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1210:     setDragSelection(selection);
1211:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1212:   }

1214:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1215:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1216:     if (edit) {
1217:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1218:       if (!point || !session) return;
1219:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1220:       patchSession((current) => {
1221:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1222:         return {
1223:           ...current,
1224:           candidatesByPage: {
1225:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1226:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1227:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1228:           },
1229:         };
1230:       });
1231:       return;
1232:     }
1233:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1234:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1235:     if (point) {
1236:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1237:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1238:       setDragSelection(selection);
1239:     }
1240:   }

1242:   function finishRegion() {
1243:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1244:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1245:       return;
1246:     }
1247:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1248:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1249:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1250:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1251:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1252:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1253:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1254:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1255:     setDragSelection(null);
1256:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1257:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1258:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1259:       x, y, width, height,
1260:       relativeScore: 1,
1261:       source: "manual",
1262:     };
1263:     patchSession((current) => ({
1264:       ...current,
1265:       candidatesByPage: {
1266:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1267:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1268:       },
1269:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1270:     }));
1271:     setManualMode(false);
1272:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1273:   }

1275:   function cancelRegion() {
1276:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1277:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1278:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1279:     setDragSelection(null);
1280:   }

1282:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1283:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1284:     try {
1285:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1286:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1287:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1288:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1289:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1290:       const scale = mode === "width"
1291:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1292:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1293:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1294:     } catch (cause) {
1295:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1296:     }
1297:   }

  28: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  29:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  30:   if (!match) return uci;
  31:   try {
  32:     const position = new Chess(fen);
  33:     const move = position.move({
  34:       from: match[1] as Square,
  35:       to: match[2] as Square,
  36:       ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  37:     });
  38:     return move.san;
  39:   } catch {
  40:     return uci;
  41:   }
  42: }

  44: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {
  45:   const position = new Chess(fen);
  46:   const san: string[] = [];
  47:   for (const uci of pv) {
  48:     const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  49:     if (!match) break;
  50:     try {
  51:       const move = position.move({
  52:         from: match[1] as Square,
  53:         to: match[2] as Square,
  54:         ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  55:       });
  56:       san.push(move.san);
  57:     } catch {
  58:       break;
  59:     }
  60:   }
  61:   return san.join(" ");
  62: }

  84: function readableDate(timestamp: number): string {
  85:   if (!timestamp) return "Not opened";
  86:   const elapsed = Date.now() - timestamp;
  87:   if (elapsed < 60_000) return "Just now";
  88:   if (elapsed < 3_600_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 60_000)}m ago`;
  89:   if (elapsed < 86_400_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 3_600_000)}h ago`;

 435:               moveIndex: openingPosition.sanMoves.length,
 436:               flipped: false,
 437:               coordinates: true,
 438:             }
 439:           : studyMode
 440:             ? studyBoard
 441:             : session;
 442:   const game = useMemo(() => {
 443:     if (!boardSession) return new Chess();
 444:     try {
 445:       return makePosition(boardSession.lineBaseFen, boardSession.moves, boardSession.moveIndex);
 446:     } catch {
 447:       try { return new Chess(boardSession.currentFen); } catch { return new Chess(); }
 448:     }
 449:   }, [boardSession]);
 450:   const legalTargets = useMemo(() => {
 451:     if (!selectedSquare) return new Set<string>();
 452:     return new Set(game.moves({ square: selectedSquare, verbose: true }).map((move) => move.to));
 453:   }, [game, selectedSquare]);
 454:   const pieceSquares = game.board();
 455:   const moveHistory = useMemo(() => {
 456:     try { return makePosition(boardSession?.lineBaseFen ?? START_FEN, boardSession?.moves ?? [], boardSession?.moveIndex ?? 0).history({ verbose: true }); }
 457:     catch { return []; }
 458:   }, [boardSession]);
 459:   const highlightedMove = lastMove ?? (moveHistory.length
 460:     ? { from: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].from, to: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].to }
 461:     : null);
 462:   const engineArrow = useMemo(
 463:     () => engineEnabled ? parseBestMove(engineScore?.bestMove) : null,
 464:     [engineEnabled, engineScore?.bestMove],
 465:   );
 466: 
 467:   useEffect(() => {
 468:     setUserArrows([]);
 469:     setArrowStart(null);
 470:     setArrowHover(null);
 471:     setAnnotationMode(false);
 472:   }, [book?.id, session?.currentFen]);
 473: 
 474:   useEffect(() => {
 475:     if (engineEnabled && boardSession) {
 476:       engineRef.current?.analyze(game.fen(), engineDepth);
 477:     }
 478:   }, [engineEnabled, boardSession?.currentFen, boardSession?.moveIndex, game, engineDepth]);
 479: 
 480:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 481:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 482:   }
 483: 
 484:   function toggleEngine() {
 485:     if (engineEnabled) {
 486:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 487:       engineRef.current = null;
 488:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 489:       setEngineStatus("off");
 490:       setEngineScore(null);
 491:       setEngineMessage("");
 492:       return;
 493:     }
 494:     try {
 495:       setEngineScore(null);
 496:       setEngineMessage("");
 497:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 498:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 499:         (status, message) => {
 500:           setEngineStatus(status);
 501:           if (status === "error") {
 502:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 503:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 504:             setEngineScore(null);
 505:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 506:             engineRef.current = null;
 507:           }
 508:         },
 509:         setEngineScore,
 510:       );
 511:       engineRef.current = client;
 512:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 513:     } catch (cause) {
 514:       setEngineStatus("error");
 515:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 516:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 517:     }
 518:   }
 519: 
 520:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 521:     setSession((current) => {
 522:       if (!current) return current;
 523:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 524:     });
 525:   }
 526: 
 527:   function patchBoardSession(change: Partial<StudyBoardState>) {
 528:     if (workspaceMode === "opening-explorer") {
 529:       return;
 530:     }
 531: 
 532:     if (workspaceMode === "analysis") {
 533:       setAnalysisBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 534:     } else if (workspaceMode === "opening-prep") {
 535:       setOpeningPrepBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 536:     } else if (studyMode) {
 537:       setStudyBoard((current) => current ? { ...current, ...change } : current);
 538:     } else {
 539:       patchSession(change);
 540:     }
 541:   }
 542:   async function toggleStudyMode() {
 543:     if (!studyMode) {
 544:       if (!session) {
 545:         setError("Open a book before entering study mode.");
 546:         return;
 547:       }
 548:       setStudyBoard({
 549:         lineBaseFen: session.lineBaseFen,
 550:         currentFen: session.currentFen,
 551:         moves: [...session.moves],
 552:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 553:         flipped: session.flipped,
 554:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 555:       });
 556:       setStudyMode(true);
 557:     } else {
 558:       // Preserve the latest Focus Mode board when returning to normal mode.
 559:       if (studyBoard) {
 560:         patchSession({
 561:           lineBaseFen: studyBoard.lineBaseFen,
 562:           currentFen: studyBoard.currentFen,
 563:           moves: [...studyBoard.moves],
 564:           moveIndex: studyBoard.moveIndex,
 565:           flipped: studyBoard.flipped,
 566:           coordinates: studyBoard.coordinates,
 567:         });
 568:       }
 569:       setStudyMode(false);
 570:     }
 571:     setLastMove(null);
 572:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 573:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 574: 
 575:     try {
 576:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 577:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 578:       } else {
 579:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 580:       }
 581:     } catch {
 582:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 583:     }
 584: }

 586:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 587:     try {
 588:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 589:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 590:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 591:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 592:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 593:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 594:       setBook(opened);
 595:       setSession(nextSession);
 596:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 597:       setError("");
 598:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 599:     } catch (cause) {
 600:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 601:     }
 602:   }
 603: 
 604:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 605:     if (!file) return;
 606:     try {
 607:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 608:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 609:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 610:       const now = Date.now();
 611:       const created: BookRecord = {
 612:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 613:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 614:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 615:         byteLength: file.size,
 616:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 617:         addedAt: now,
 618:       };
 619:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 620:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 621:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 622:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 623:       setBook(created);
 624:       setSession(blank);
 625:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 626:       setError("");
 627:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 628:     } catch (cause) {
 629:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 630:     }
 631:   }
 632: 
 633:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 634:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 635: 
 636:     try {
 637:       await removeBook(item.id);
 638:       await removeSession(item.id);
 639: 
 640:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 641:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 642:         const next = { ...current };
 643:         delete next[item.id];
 644:         return next;
 645:       });
 646: 
 647:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 648:         setBook(null);
 649:         setSession(null);
 650:         setPdf(null);
 651:       }
 652: 
 653:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 654:       setError("");
 655:     } catch (cause) {
 656:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 657:     }
 658:   }
 659:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 660:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 661:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 662:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 663:     try {
 664:       await putBook(renamed);
 665:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 666:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 667:     } catch (cause) {
 668:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 669:     }
 670:   }

 673:     if (!session) return;
 674:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });
 675:   }

 677:   function goToPage(value: number) {
 678:     if (!session || !Number.isFinite(value)) return;
 679:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });
 680:   }

 682:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 683:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 684:     try {
 685:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 686:       setSession({
 687:         ...activeSession,
 688:         originalFen: fen,
 689:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 690:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 691:         moves: [],
 692:         moveIndex: 0,
 693:       });
 694:       setLastMove(null);
 695:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 696:       setUserArrows([]);
 697:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 698:       return true;
 699:     } catch (cause) {
 700:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 701:       return false;
 702:     }
 703:   }

 705:   function analyzeManualPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 706:     const loaded = moveToPosition(fen);
 707:     if (!loaded) return false;
 708:     setEngineScore(null);
 709:     setEngineMessage("");
 710:     if (!engineEnabled) {
 711:       toggleEngine();
 712:     } else {
 713:       engineRef.current?.analyze(fen, engineDepth);
 714:     }
 715:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 716:     return true;
 717:   }

 768:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 769:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 770:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 771:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 772:       return;
 773:     }
 774:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 775:     try {
 776:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 777:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 778:       preview.width = crop.width;
 779:       preview.height = crop.height;
 780:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 781:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 782:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 783:     } catch (cause) {
 784:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 785:       return;
 786:     }
 787:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 788:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 789:     setTransferFen("");
 790:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 791:         setRecognitionError("");
 792:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 793:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 794:     try {
 795:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 796:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 797:       });
 798:       const form = new FormData();
 799:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 800:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 801:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 802:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 803:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 804:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 805:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 806:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 807:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 808:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 809:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 810:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 811:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 812:       }
 813:     } catch (cause) {
 814:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 815:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 816:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 817:     }
 818:   }

 820:   function closeTransfer() {
 821:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 822:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 823:     setTransferPreview("");
 824:     setTransferFen("");
 825:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 826:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 827:     setRecognitionError("");
 828:       }

 831:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 832:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 833:       setGameEndOverlay({
 834:         title: "Checkmate",
 835:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 836:       });
 837:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 838:       setGameEndOverlay({
 839:         title: "Stalemate",
 840:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 841:       });
 842:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 843:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 844:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 845:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 846:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 847:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 848:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 849:     } else {
 850:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 851:     }
 852:   }

 854:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 855:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 856:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 857:     try {
 858:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 859:       const result = currentGame.move({
 860:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 861:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 862:         promotion: piece,
 863:       });
 864:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 865:       patchBoardSession({
 866:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 867:         moves: nextMoves,
 868:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 869:       });
 870:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 871:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 872:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 873:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 874:       setError("");
 875:     } catch {
 876:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 877:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 878:     }
 879:   }
 880: 
 881:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 882:     if (!boardSession) return;
 883:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 884:     try {
 885:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 886:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 887:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 888:       if (promote) {
 889:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 890:         return;
 891:       }
 892:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 893:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 894:       if (workspaceMode === "opening-explorer") {
 895:         const line = nextMoves
 896:           .map((move, index) => index % 2 === 0 ? `${Math.floor(index / 2) + 1}. ${move}` : move)
 897:           .join(" ");
 898:         setOpeningExplorerInput(line);
 899:         setOpeningExplorerPly(nextMoves.length);
 900:       } else {
 901:         patchBoardSession({
 902:           currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 903:           moves: nextMoves,
 904:           moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 905:         });
 906:       }
 907:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 908:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 909:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 910:       setError("");
 911:     } catch {
 912:       const piece = game.get(to);
 913:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 914:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 915:     }
 916:   }
 917: 
 918:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 919:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 920:     setRedSquares([]);
 921: 
 922:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 923:       setUserArrows([]);
 924:       setArrowStart(null);
 925:       setArrowHover(null);
 926:       return;
 927:     }
 928: if (!boardSession) return;
 929:     if (annotationMode) {
 930:       if (!arrowStart) {
 931:         setArrowStart(square);
 932:         return;
 933:       }
 934:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 935:       setArrowStart(null);
 936:       setArrowHover(null);
 937:       return;
 938:     }
 939:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 940:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 941:       return;
 942:     }
 943:     const piece = game.get(square);
 944:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 945:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 946:   }

 948:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 949:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 950: 
 951:   event.preventDefault();
 952: 
 953:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 954:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 955:     event.clientX,
 956:     event.clientY,
 957:     bounds,
 958:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 959:   );
 960: 
 961:   if (!square) return;
 962: 
 963:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 964:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 965:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 966:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 967:   setArrowStart(square);
 968:   setArrowHover(square);
 969: 
 970:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 971: }
 972: 
 973:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 974:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 975:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 976:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
 977:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 978:     setArrowHover(square);
 979:   }
 980: 
 981:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 982:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 983: 
 984:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 985: 
 986:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 987:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 988:     event.clientX,
 989:     event.clientY,
 990:     bounds,
 991:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 992:   );
 993: 
 994:   if (to && to !== from) {
 995:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 996:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 997:   } else {
 998:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 999:   }
1000: 
1001:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
1002:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
1003:   setArrowStart(null);
1004:   setArrowHover(null);
1005: }
1006: 
1007:   function cancelBoardArrowGesture() {
1008:     arrowGestureRef.current = null;
1009:     setArrowStart(null);
1010:     setArrowHover(null);
1011:   }

1013:   function jumpToMove(index: number) {
1014:     if (!boardSession) return;
1015:     try {
1016:       const next = makePosition(boardSession.lineBaseFen, boardSession.moves, index);
1017:       const last = next.history({ verbose: true }).at(-1);
1018:       patchBoardSession({ moveIndex: index, currentFen: next.fen() });
1019:       setLastMove(last ? { from: last.from, to: last.to } : null);
1020:       setSelectedSquare(null);
1021:     } catch (cause) {
1022:       setError(`Could not navigate to move: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1023:     }
1024:   }

1026:   async function copyText(value: string) {
1027:     try {
1028:       await navigator.clipboard.writeText(value);

1083:   async function detectBoards() {
1084:     if (detecting) {
1085:       stopBoardScan();
1086:       return;
1087:     }
1088: 
1089:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
1090:     if (!API_BASE) {
1091:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
1092:       return;
1093:     }
1094: 
1095:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
1096:     const abortController = new AbortController();
1097:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
1098:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
1099: 
1100:     setDetecting(true);
1101:     setError("");
1102:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
1103:     patchSession((current) => ({
1104:       ...current,
1105:       candidatesByPage: {
1106:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1107:         [String(current.page)]: [],
1108:       },
1109:       selectedDiagramId: null,
1110:     }));
1111: 
1112:     try {
1113:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
1114:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
1115:           (blob) => blob
1116:             ? resolve(blob)
1117:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
1118:           "image/png",
1119:         );
1120:       });
1121: 
1122:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1123: 
1124:       const form = new FormData();
1125:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
1126: 
1127:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
1128:         method: "POST",
1129:         body: form,
1130:         signal: abortController.signal,
1131:       });
1132: 
1133:       if (!response.ok) {
1134:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
1135:       }
1136: 
1137:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
1138:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
1139:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
1140:       );
1141: 
1142:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1143: 
1144:       patchSession((current) => ({
1145:         ...current,
1146:         candidatesByPage: {
1147:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
1148:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
1149:         },
1150:         selectedDiagramId: null,
1151:       }));
1152: 
1153:       setNotice(
1154:         candidates.length
1155:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
1156:           : "No board candidates found.",
1157:       );
1158:     } catch (cause) {
1159:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1160: 
1161:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
1162:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
1163:       } else {
1164:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1165:       }
1166:     } finally {
1167:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
1168:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1169:         setDetecting(false);
1170:       }
1171:     }
1172:   }
1173:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {

1179:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,

1191:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1192:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1193:     if (!manualMode) return;
1194: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1195: if (!canvas) return;
1196: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1197: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1198: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1199: if (
1200:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1201:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1202:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1203:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1204: ) return;
1205:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1206:     if (!point) return;
1207:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1208:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1209:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1210:     setDragSelection(selection);
1211:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1212:   }

1214:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1215:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1216:     if (edit) {
1217:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1218:       if (!point || !session) return;
1219:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1220:       patchSession((current) => {
1221:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1222:         return {
1223:           ...current,
1224:           candidatesByPage: {
1225:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1226:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1227:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1228:           },
1229:         };
1230:       });
1231:       return;
1232:     }
1233:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1234:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1235:     if (point) {
1236:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1237:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1238:       setDragSelection(selection);
1239:     }
1240:   }
1241: 
1242:   function finishRegion() {
1243:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1244:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1245:       return;
1246:     }
1247:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1248:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1249:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1250:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1251:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1252:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1253:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1254:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1255:     setDragSelection(null);
1256:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1257:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1258:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1259:       x, y, width, height,
1260:       relativeScore: 1,
1261:       source: "manual",
1262:     };
1263:     patchSession((current) => ({
1264:       ...current,
1265:       candidatesByPage: {
1266:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1267:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1268:       },
1269:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1270:     }));
1271:     setManualMode(false);
1272:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1273:   }

1276:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1277:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1278:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1279:     setDragSelection(null);
1280:   }

1282:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1283:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1284:     try {
1285:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1286:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1287:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1288:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1289:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1290:       const scale = mode === "width"
1291:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1292:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1293:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1294:     } catch (cause) {
1295:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1296:     }
1297:   }

1566:                       [baseX - px * headHalfWidth, baseY - py * headHalfWidth],

1578:                         opacity={opacity}

 380:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 381:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 382:       setBook(opened);
 383:       setSession(nextSession);
 384:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 385:       setError("");
 386:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 387:     } catch (cause) {
 388:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 389:     }
 390:   }
 391: 
 392:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 393:     if (!file) return;
 394:     try {
 395:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 396:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 397:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 398:       const now = Date.now();
 399:       const created: BookRecord = {
 400:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 401:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 402:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 403:         byteLength: file.size,
 404:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 405:         addedAt: now,
 406:       };
 407:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 408:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 409:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 410:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 411:       setBook(created);
 412:       setSession(blank);
 413:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 414:       setError("");
 415:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 416:     } catch (cause) {
 417:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 418:     }
 419:   }
 420: 
 421:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 422:     if (!window.confirm(`Remove "${item.title}" from your library?`)) return;
 423: 
 424:     try {
 425:       await removeBook(item.id);
 426:       await removeSession(item.id);
 427: 
 428:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 429:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 430:         const next = { ...current };
 431:         delete next[item.id];
 432:         return next;
 433:       });
 434: 
 435:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 436:         setBook(null);
 437:         setSession(null);
 438:         setPdf(null);
 439:       }
 440: 
 441:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 442:       setError("");
 443:     } catch (cause) {
 444:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 445:     }
 446:   }
 447:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 448:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 449:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 450:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 451:     try {
 452:       await putBook(renamed);
 453:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 454:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 455:     } catch (cause) {
 456:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 457:     }
 458:   }

 470:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 471:     if (!session) return false;
 472:     try {
 473:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 474:       patchSession({
 475:         originalFen: fen,
 476:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 477:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 478:         moves: [],
 479:         moveIndex: 0,
 480:       });
 481:       setLastMove(null);
 482:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 483:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 484:       return true;
 485:     } catch (cause) {
 486:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 487:       return false;
 488:     }
 489:   }
