 788:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 789:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 790:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 791:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
 792:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 793:     setArrowHover(square);

 796:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 797:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 798: 
 799:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 800: 
 801:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 802:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 803:     event.clientX,
 804:     event.clientY,
 805:     bounds,
 806:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 807:   );
 808: 
 809:   if (to && to !== from) {
 810:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 811:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 812:   } else {
 813:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 814:   }
 815: 
 816:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 817:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 818:   setArrowStart(null);
 819:   setArrowHover(null);
 820: }

 872:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
 873:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 874:

 876:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;

 882:     setCropEditingId(null);

 884:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 885:

 887:       ...current,
 888:       candidatesByPage: {
 889:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 890:         [String(current.page)]: [],

 898:   async function detectBoards() {
 899:     if (detecting) {
 900:       stopBoardScan();
 901:       return;
 902:     }
 903: 
 904:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 905:     if (!API_BASE) {
 906:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 907:       return;
 908:     }
 909: 
 910:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 911:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 912:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 913:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 914: 
 915:     setDetecting(true);
 916:     setError("");
 917:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 918:     patchSession((current) => ({
 919:       ...current,
 920:       candidatesByPage: {
 921:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 922:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 923:       },
 924:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 925:     }));
 926: 
 927:     try {
 928:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 929:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 930:           (blob) => blob
 931:             ? resolve(blob)
 932:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 933:           "image/png",
 934:         );
 935:       });
 936: 
 937:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 938: 
 939:       const form = new FormData();
 940:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 941: 
 942:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 943:         method: "POST",
 944:         body: form,
 945:         signal: abortController.signal,
 946:       });
 947: 
 948:       if (!response.ok) {
 949:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 950:       }
 951: 
 952:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 953:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 954:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 955:       );
 956: 
 957:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 958: 
 959:       patchSession((current) => ({
 960:         ...current,
 961:         candidatesByPage: {
 962:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 963:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 964:         },
 965:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 966:       }));
 967: 
 968:       setNotice(
 969:         candidates.length
 970:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 971:           : "No board candidates found.",
 972:       );
 973:     } catch (cause) {
 974:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 975: 
 976:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 977:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 978:       } else {
 979:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 980:       }
 981:     } finally {
 982:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 983:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 984:         setDetecting(false);
 985:       }
 986:     }
 987:   }
 988:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {

 990:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;

 993:   function startCropEdit(
 994:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
 995:     candidate: Candidate,
 996:     handle: CropHandle,
 997:   ) {
 998:     event.stopPropagation();
 999:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1000:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;
1001:     if (!point || !stage) return;
1002:     cropEditStartRef.current = { candidate, handle, point };
1003:     stage.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);

1006:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1007:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1008:     if (!manualMode) return;
1009: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1010: if (!canvas) return;
1011: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1012: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1013: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1014: if (
1015:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1016:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1017:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1018:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1019: ) return;
1020:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1021:     if (!point) return;
1022:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1023:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1024:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1025:     setDragSelection(selection);
1026:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1027:   }

1029:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1030:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1031:     if (edit) {
1032:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1033:       if (!point || !session) return;
1034:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1035:       patchSession((current) => {
1036:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1037:         return {
1038:           ...current,
1039:           candidatesByPage: {
1040:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1041:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1042:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1043:           },
1044:         };
1045:       });
1046:       return;
1047:     }
1048:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1049:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1050:     if (point) {
1051:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1052:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1053:       setDragSelection(selection);
1054:     }
1055:   }
1056: 
1057:   function finishRegion() {
1058:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1059:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1060:       return;
1061:     }
1062:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1063:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1064:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1065:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1066:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1067:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1068:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1069:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1070:     setDragSelection(null);
1071:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1072:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1073:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1074:       x, y, width, height,
1075:       relativeScore: 1,
1076:       source: "manual",
1077:     };
1078:     patchSession((current) => ({
1079:       ...current,
1080:       candidatesByPage: {
1081:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1082:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1083:       },
1084:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1085:     }));
1086:     setManualMode(false);
1087:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1088:   }
1089: 
1090:   function cancelRegion() {
1091:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1092:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1093:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1094:     setDragSelection(null);
1095:   }

1097:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1098:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1099:     try {
1100:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1101:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1102:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1103:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1104:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1105:       const scale = mode === "width"
1106:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1107:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;

  27: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  28:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  29:   if (!match) return uci;
  30:   try {
  31:     const position = new Chess(fen);
  32:     const move = position.move({
  33:       from: match[1] as Square,
  34:       to: match[2] as Square,
  35:       ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  36:     });
  37:     return move.san;
  38:   } catch {
  39:     return uci;
  40:   }
  41: }
  42: 
  43: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {
  44:   const position = new Chess(fen);
  45:   const san: string[] = [];
  46:   for (const uci of pv) {
  47:     const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  48:     if (!match) break;
  49:     try {
  50:       const move = position.move({
  51:         from: match[1] as Square,
  52:         to: match[2] as Square,
  53:         ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  54:       });
  55:       san.push(move.san);
  56:     } catch {
  57:       break;
  58:     }
  59:   }
  60:   return san.join(" ");

 251:     }).catch((cause: unknown) => {
 252:       if (!cancelled) {
 253:         setPdfLoading(false);
 254:         setError(`Could not open this PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 255:       }
 256:     });
 257:     return () => {
 258:       cancelled = true;
 259:       if (loadingTask) void loadingTask.destroy();
 260:     };
 261:   }, [book]);
 262: 
 263:   useEffect(() => {
 264:     if (!pdf || !session || !canvasRef.current) return;
 265:     let cancelled = false;
 266:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 267:     setRendering(true);
 268:     pdf.getPage(session.page).then((page) => {
 269:       if (cancelled) return;
 270:       const viewport = page.getViewport({ scale: session.zoom * Math.min(1.4, 1100 / page.getViewport({ scale: 1 }).width) });
 271:       const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
 272:       if (!context) throw new Error("Canvas rendering is unavailable in this browser.");
 273:       canvas.width = Math.floor(viewport.width);
 274:       canvas.height = Math.floor(viewport.height);
 275:       const task = page.render({ canvas, canvasContext: context, viewport });
 276:       renderTaskRef.current = task;
 277:       return task.promise;
 278:     }).then(() => {
 279:       if (!cancelled) setRendering(false);
 280:     }).catch((cause: unknown) => {
 281:       if (!cancelled && !(cause instanceof Error && cause.name === "RenderingCancelledException")) {
 282:         setRendering(false);
 283:         setError(`Could not render page ${session.page}: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 284:       }
 285:     });
 286:     return () => {
 287:       cancelled = true;
 288:       renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();
 289:     };
 290:   }, [pdf, session?.page, session?.zoom]);
 291: 
 292:   useEffect(() => {
 293:     function onKey(event: KeyboardEvent) {
 294:       if (!session || !book || isTypingTarget(event.target)) return;
 295:       if (cropEditingId && ["ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", "ArrowUp", "ArrowDown"].includes(event.key)) {
 296:         const candidate = (session.candidatesByPage[String(session.page)] ?? []).find((item) => item.id === cropEditingId);
 297:         if (!candidate) return;
 298:         const step = event.shiftKey ? 0.01 : 0.002;
 299:         const x = event.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowRight" ? step : 0;
 300:         const y = event.key === "ArrowUp" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowDown" ? step : 0;
 301:         const next = editCrop(candidate, "move", x, y);
 302:         patchSession((current) => {
 303:           const pageKey = String(current.page);
 304:           return {
 305:             ...current,
 306:             candidatesByPage: {
 307:               ...current.candidatesByPage,
 308:               [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((item) =>
 309:                 item.id === candidate.id ? { ...item, ...next } : item),
 310:             },
 311:           };
 312:         });
 313:         event.preventDefault();
 314:         return;
 315:       }
 316:       if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") changePage(-1);
 317:       if (event.key === "ArrowRight") changePage(1);
 318:     }
 319:     window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 320:     return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 321:   });

 324:     engineRef.current?.dispose();
 325:     engineRef.current = null;

 399:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 400:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 401:   }

 403:   function toggleEngine() {
 404:     if (engineEnabled) {
 405:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 406:       engineRef.current = null;
 407:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 408:       setEngineStatus("off");
 409:       setEngineScore(null);
 410:       setEngineMessage("");
 411:       return;
 412:     }
 413:     try {
 414:       setEngineScore(null);
 415:       setEngineMessage("");
 416:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 417:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 418:         (status, message) => {
 419:           setEngineStatus(status);
 420:           if (status === "error") {
 421:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 422:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 423:             setEngineScore(null);
 424:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 425:             engineRef.current = null;
 426:           }
 427:         },
 428:         setEngineScore,
 429:       );
 430:       engineRef.current = client;
 431:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 432:     } catch (cause) {
 433:       setEngineStatus("error");
 434:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 435:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 436:     }
 437:   }

 439:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 440:     setSession((current) => {
 441:       if (!current) return current;
 442:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 443:     });
 444:   }
 445: 
 446:   function patchBoardSession(change: Partial<StudyBoardState>) {
 447:     if (workspaceMode === "opening-explorer") {
 448:       return;
 449:     }
 450: 
 451:     if (workspaceMode === "analysis") {
 452:       setAnalysisBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 453:     } else if (studyMode) {
 454:       setStudyBoard((current) => current ? { ...current, ...change } : current);
 455:     } else {
 456:       patchSession(change);
 457:     }
 458:   }
 459:   async function toggleStudyMode() {
 460:     if (!studyMode) {
 461:       if (!session) {
 462:         setError("Open a book before entering study mode.");
 463:         return;
 464:       }
 465:       setStudyBoard({
 466:         lineBaseFen: session.lineBaseFen,
 467:         currentFen: session.currentFen,
 468:         moves: [...session.moves],
 469:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 470:         flipped: session.flipped,
 471:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 472:       });
 473:       setStudyMode(true);
 474:     } else {
 475:       // Preserve the latest Focus Mode board when returning to normal mode.
 476:       if (studyBoard) {
 477:         patchSession({
 478:           lineBaseFen: studyBoard.lineBaseFen,
 479:           currentFen: studyBoard.currentFen,
 480:           moves: [...studyBoard.moves],
 481:           moveIndex: studyBoard.moveIndex,
 482:           flipped: studyBoard.flipped,
 483:           coordinates: studyBoard.coordinates,
 484:         });
 485:       }
 486:       setStudyMode(false);
 487:     }
 488:     setLastMove(null);
 489:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 490:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 491:   
 492:     try {
 493:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 494:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 495:       } else {
 496:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 497:       }
 498:     } catch {
 499:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 500:     }
 501: }

 503:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 504:     try {
 505:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 506:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 507:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 508:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 509:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 510:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 511:       setBook(opened);
 512:       setSession(nextSession);
 513:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 514:       setError("");
 515:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 516:     } catch (cause) {
 517:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 518:     }
 519:   }

 521:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 522:     if (!file) return;
 523:     try {
 524:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 525:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 526:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 527:       const now = Date.now();
 528:       const created: BookRecord = {
 529:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 530:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 531:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 532:         byteLength: file.size,
 533:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 534:         addedAt: now,
 535:       };
 536:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 537:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 538:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 539:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 540:       setBook(created);
 541:       setSession(blank);
 542:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 543:       setError("");
 544:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 545:     } catch (cause) {
 546:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 547:     }
 548:   }

 550:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 551:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 552: 
 553:     try {
 554:       await removeBook(item.id);
 555:       await removeSession(item.id);
 556: 
 557:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 558:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 559:         const next = { ...current };
 560:         delete next[item.id];
 561:         return next;
 562:       });
 563: 
 564:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 565:         setBook(null);
 566:         setSession(null);
 567:         setPdf(null);
 568:       }
 569: 
 570:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 571:       setError("");
 572:     } catch (cause) {
 573:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 574:     }
 575:   }
 576:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 577:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 578:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 579:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 580:     try {
 581:       await putBook(renamed);
 582:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 583:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 584:     } catch (cause) {
 585:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 586:     }
 587:   }

 599:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 600:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 601:     try {
 602:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 603:       setSession({
 604:         ...activeSession,
 605:         originalFen: fen,
 606:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 607:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 608:         moves: [],
 609:         moveIndex: 0,
 610:       });
 611:       setLastMove(null);
 612:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 613:       setUserArrows([]);
 614:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 615:       return true;
 616:     } catch (cause) {
 617:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 618:       return false;
 619:     }
 620:   }

 685:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 686:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 687:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 688:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 689:       return;
 690:     }
 691:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 692:     try {
 693:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 694:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 695:       preview.width = crop.width;
 696:       preview.height = crop.height;
 697:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 698:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 699:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 700:     } catch (cause) {
 701:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 702:       return;
 703:     }
 704:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 705:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 706:     setTransferFen("");
 707:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 708:         setRecognitionError("");
 709:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 710:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 711:     try {
 712:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 713:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 714:       });
 715:       const form = new FormData();
 716:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 717:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 718:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 719:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 720:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 721:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 722:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 723:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 724:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 725:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 726:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 727:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 728:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 729:       }
 730:     } catch (cause) {
 731:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 732:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 733:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 734:     }
 735:   }
 736: 
 737:   function closeTransfer() {
 738:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 739:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 740:     setTransferPreview("");
 741:     setTransferFen("");
 742:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 743:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 744:     setRecognitionError("");
 745:       }

 748:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 749:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 750:       setGameEndOverlay({
 751:         title: "Checkmate",
 752:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 753:       });
 754:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 755:       setGameEndOverlay({
 756:         title: "Stalemate",
 757:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 758:       });
 759:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 760:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 761:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 762:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 763:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 764:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 765:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 766:     } else {
 767:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 768:     }
 769:   }
 770: 
 771:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 772:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 773:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 774:     try {
 775:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 776:       const result = currentGame.move({
 777:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 778:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 779:         promotion: piece,
 780:       });
 781:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 782:       patchBoardSession({
 783:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 784:         moves: nextMoves,
 785:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 786:       });
 787:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 788:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 789:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 790:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 791:       setError("");
 792:     } catch {
 793:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 794:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 795:     }
 796:   }
 797: 
 798:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 799:     if (!boardSession) return;
 800:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 801:     try {
 802:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 803:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 804:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 805:       if (promote) {
 806:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 807:         return;
 808:       }
 809:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 810:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 811:       patchBoardSession({
 812:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 813:         moves: nextMoves,
 814:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 815:       });
 816:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 817:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 818:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 819:       setError("");
 820:     } catch {
 821:       const piece = game.get(to);
 822:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 823:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 824:     }
 825:   }
 826: 
 827:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 828:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 829:     setRedSquares([]);
 830: 
 831:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 832:       setUserArrows([]);
 833:       setArrowStart(null);
 834:       setArrowHover(null);
 835:       return;
 836:     }
 837: if (!boardSession) return;
 838:     if (annotationMode) {
 839:       if (!arrowStart) {
 840:         setArrowStart(square);
 841:         return;
 842:       }
 843:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 844:       setArrowStart(null);
 845:       setArrowHover(null);
 846:       return;
 847:     }
 848:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 849:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 850:       return;
 851:     }
 852:     const piece = game.get(square);
 853:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 854:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 855:   }

 882:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {

 890:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 891:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 892: 
 893:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 894: 
 895:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 896:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 897:     event.clientX,
 898:     event.clientY,
 899:     bounds,
 900:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 901:   );
 902: 
 903:   if (to && to !== from) {
 904:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 905:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 906:   } else {
 907:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 908:   }
 909: 
 910:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 911:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 912:   setArrowStart(null);
 913:   setArrowHover(null);

 992:   async function detectBoards() {
 993:     if (detecting) {
 994:       stopBoardScan();
 995:       return;
 996:     }
 997: 
 998:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 999:     if (!API_BASE) {
1000:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
1001:       return;
1002:     }
1003: 
1004:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
1005:     const abortController = new AbortController();
1006:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
1007:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
1008: 
1009:     setDetecting(true);
1010:     setError("");
1011:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
1012:     patchSession((current) => ({
1013:       ...current,
1014:       candidatesByPage: {
1015:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1016:         [String(current.page)]: [],
1017:       },
1018:       selectedDiagramId: null,
1019:     }));
1020: 
1021:     try {
1022:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
1023:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
1024:           (blob) => blob
1025:             ? resolve(blob)
1026:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
1027:           "image/png",
1028:         );
1029:       });
1030: 
1031:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1032: 
1033:       const form = new FormData();
1034:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
1035: 
1036:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
1037:         method: "POST",
1038:         body: form,
1039:         signal: abortController.signal,
1040:       });
1041: 
1042:       if (!response.ok) {
1043:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
1044:       }
1045: 
1046:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
1047:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
1048:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
1049:       );
1050: 
1051:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1052: 
1053:       patchSession((current) => ({
1054:         ...current,
1055:         candidatesByPage: {
1056:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
1057:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
1058:         },
1059:         selectedDiagramId: null,
1060:       }));
1061: 
1062:       setNotice(
1063:         candidates.length
1064:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
1065:           : "No board candidates found.",
1066:       );
1067:     } catch (cause) {
1068:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1069: 
1070:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
1071:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
1072:       } else {
1073:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1074:       }
1075:     } finally {
1076:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
1077:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1078:         setDetecting(false);
1079:       }
1080:     }
1081:   }

1100:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1101:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1102:     if (!manualMode) return;
1103: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1104: if (!canvas) return;
1105: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1106: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1107: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1108: if (
1109:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1110:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1111:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1112:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1113: ) return;
1114:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1115:     if (!point) return;
1116:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1117:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1118:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1119:     setDragSelection(selection);
1120:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1121:   }

1123:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1124:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1125:     if (edit) {
1126:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1127:       if (!point || !session) return;
1128:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1129:       patchSession((current) => {
1130:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1131:         return {
1132:           ...current,
1133:           candidatesByPage: {
1134:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1135:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1136:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1137:           },
1138:         };
1139:       });
1140:       return;
1141:     }
1142:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1143:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1144:     if (point) {
1145:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1146:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1147:       setDragSelection(selection);
1148:     }
1149:   }

1151:   function finishRegion() {
1152:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1153:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1154:       return;
1155:     }
1156:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1157:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1158:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1159:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1160:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1161:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1162:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1163:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1164:     setDragSelection(null);
1165:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1166:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1167:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1168:       x, y, width, height,
1169:       relativeScore: 1,
1170:       source: "manual",
1171:     };
1172:     patchSession((current) => ({
1173:       ...current,
1174:       candidatesByPage: {
1175:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1176:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1177:       },
1178:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1179:     }));
1180:     setManualMode(false);
1181:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1182:   }

1185:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1186:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1187:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1188:     setDragSelection(null);
1189:   }

1191:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1192:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1193:     try {
1194:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1195:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1196:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1197:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1198:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1199:       const scale = mode === "width"
1200:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1201:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1202:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1203:     } catch (cause) {
1204:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1205:     }
1206:   }

  28: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  29:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  30:   if (!match) return uci;
  31:   try {
  32:     const position = new Chess(fen);
  33:     const move = position.move({
  34:       from: match[1] as Square,
  35:       to: match[2] as Square,
  36:       ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  37:     });
  38:     return move.san;
  39:   } catch {
  40:     return uci;
  41:   }
  42: }

  44: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {
  45:   const position = new Chess(fen);
  46:   const san: string[] = [];
  47:   for (const uci of pv) {
  48:     const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  49:     if (!match) break;
  50:     try {
  51:       const move = position.move({
  52:         from: match[1] as Square,
  53:         to: match[2] as Square,
  54:         ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  55:       });
  56:       san.push(move.san);
  57:     } catch {
  58:       break;
  59:     }
  60:   }
  61:   return san.join(" ");
  62: }

  84: function readableDate(timestamp: number): string {
  85:   if (!timestamp) return "Not opened";
  86:   const elapsed = Date.now() - timestamp;
  87:   if (elapsed < 60_000) return "Just now";
  88:   if (elapsed < 3_600_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 60_000)}m ago`;
  89:   if (elapsed < 86_400_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 3_600_000)}h ago`;
  90:   return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString();

 405:   const game = useMemo(() => {
 406:     if (!boardSession) return new Chess();
 407:     try {
 408:       return makePosition(boardSession.lineBaseFen, boardSession.moves, boardSession.moveIndex);
 409:     } catch {
 410:       try { return new Chess(boardSession.currentFen); } catch { return new Chess(); }
 411:     }
 412:   }, [boardSession]);
 413:   const legalTargets = useMemo(() => {
 414:     if (!selectedSquare) return new Set<string>();
 415:     return new Set(game.moves({ square: selectedSquare, verbose: true }).map((move) => move.to));
 416:   }, [game, selectedSquare]);
 417:   const pieceSquares = game.board();
 418:   const moveHistory = useMemo(() => {
 419:     try { return makePosition(boardSession?.lineBaseFen ?? START_FEN, boardSession?.moves ?? [], boardSession?.moveIndex ?? 0).history({ verbose: true }); }
 420:     catch { return []; }
 421:   }, [boardSession]);
 422:   const highlightedMove = lastMove ?? (moveHistory.length
 423:     ? { from: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].from, to: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].to }
 424:     : null);
 425:   const engineArrow = useMemo(
 426:     () => engineEnabled ? parseBestMove(engineScore?.bestMove) : null,
 427:     [engineEnabled, engineScore?.bestMove],
 428:   );
 429: 
 430:   useEffect(() => {
 431:     setUserArrows([]);
 432:     setArrowStart(null);
 433:     setArrowHover(null);
 434:     setAnnotationMode(false);
 435:   }, [book?.id, session?.currentFen]);
 436: 
 437:   useEffect(() => {
 438:     if (engineEnabled && boardSession) {
 439:       engineRef.current?.analyze(game.fen(), engineDepth);
 440:     }
 441:   }, [engineEnabled, boardSession?.currentFen, boardSession?.moveIndex, game, engineDepth]);
 442: 
 443:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 444:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 445:   }
 446: 
 447:   function toggleEngine() {
 448:     if (engineEnabled) {
 449:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 450:       engineRef.current = null;
 451:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 452:       setEngineStatus("off");
 453:       setEngineScore(null);
 454:       setEngineMessage("");
 455:       return;
 456:     }
 457:     try {
 458:       setEngineScore(null);
 459:       setEngineMessage("");
 460:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 461:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 462:         (status, message) => {
 463:           setEngineStatus(status);
 464:           if (status === "error") {
 465:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 466:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 467:             setEngineScore(null);
 468:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 469:             engineRef.current = null;
 470:           }
 471:         },
 472:         setEngineScore,
 473:       );
 474:       engineRef.current = client;
 475:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 476:     } catch (cause) {
 477:       setEngineStatus("error");
 478:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 479:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 480:     }
 481:   }
 482: 
 483:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 484:     setSession((current) => {
 485:       if (!current) return current;
 486:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 487:     });
 488:   }
 489: 
 490:   function patchBoardSession(change: Partial<StudyBoardState>) {
 491:     if (workspaceMode === "opening-explorer") {
 492:       return;
 493:     }
 494: 
 495:     if (workspaceMode === "analysis") {
 496:       setAnalysisBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 497:     } else if (workspaceMode === "opening-prep") {
 498:       setOpeningPrepBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 499:     } else if (studyMode) {
 500:       setStudyBoard((current) => current ? { ...current, ...change } : current);
 501:     } else {
 502:       patchSession(change);
 503:     }
 504:   }
 505:   async function toggleStudyMode() {
 506:     if (!studyMode) {
 507:       if (!session) {
 508:         setError("Open a book before entering study mode.");
 509:         return;
 510:       }
 511:       setStudyBoard({
 512:         lineBaseFen: session.lineBaseFen,
 513:         currentFen: session.currentFen,
 514:         moves: [...session.moves],
 515:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 516:         flipped: session.flipped,
 517:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 518:       });
 519:       setStudyMode(true);
 520:     } else {
 521:       // Preserve the latest Focus Mode board when returning to normal mode.
 522:       if (studyBoard) {
 523:         patchSession({
 524:           lineBaseFen: studyBoard.lineBaseFen,
 525:           currentFen: studyBoard.currentFen,
 526:           moves: [...studyBoard.moves],
 527:           moveIndex: studyBoard.moveIndex,
 528:           flipped: studyBoard.flipped,
 529:           coordinates: studyBoard.coordinates,
 530:         });
 531:       }
 532:       setStudyMode(false);
 533:     }
 534:     setLastMove(null);
 535:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 536:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 537:   
 538:     try {
 539:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 540:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 541:       } else {
 542:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 543:       }
 544:     } catch {
 545:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 546:     }
 547: }

 549:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 550:     try {
 551:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 552:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 553:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 554:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 555:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 556:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 557:       setBook(opened);
 558:       setSession(nextSession);
 559:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 560:       setError("");
 561:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 562:     } catch (cause) {
 563:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 564:     }
 565:   }

 567:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 568:     if (!file) return;
 569:     try {
 570:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 571:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 572:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 573:       const now = Date.now();
 574:       const created: BookRecord = {
 575:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 576:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 577:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 578:         byteLength: file.size,
 579:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 580:         addedAt: now,
 581:       };
 582:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 583:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 584:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 585:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 586:       setBook(created);
 587:       setSession(blank);
 588:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 589:       setError("");
 590:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 591:     } catch (cause) {
 592:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 593:     }
 594:   }
 595: 
 596:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 597:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 598: 
 599:     try {
 600:       await removeBook(item.id);
 601:       await removeSession(item.id);
 602: 
 603:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 604:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 605:         const next = { ...current };
 606:         delete next[item.id];
 607:         return next;
 608:       });
 609: 
 610:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 611:         setBook(null);
 612:         setSession(null);
 613:         setPdf(null);
 614:       }
 615: 
 616:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 617:       setError("");
 618:     } catch (cause) {
 619:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 620:     }
 621:   }
 622:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 623:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 624:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 625:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 626:     try {
 627:       await putBook(renamed);
 628:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 629:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 630:     } catch (cause) {
 631:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 632:     }
 633:   }

 645:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 646:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 647:     try {
 648:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 649:       setSession({
 650:         ...activeSession,
 651:         originalFen: fen,
 652:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 653:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 654:         moves: [],
 655:         moveIndex: 0,
 656:       });
 657:       setLastMove(null);
 658:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 659:       setUserArrows([]);
 660:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 661:       return true;
 662:     } catch (cause) {
 663:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 664:       return false;
 665:     }
 666:   }

 677:     }
 678:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 679:     return true;
 680:   }

 731:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 732:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 733:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 734:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 735:       return;
 736:     }
 737:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 738:     try {
 739:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 740:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 741:       preview.width = crop.width;
 742:       preview.height = crop.height;
 743:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 744:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 745:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 746:     } catch (cause) {
 747:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 748:       return;
 749:     }
 750:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 751:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 752:     setTransferFen("");
 753:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 754:         setRecognitionError("");
 755:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 756:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 757:     try {
 758:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 759:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 760:       });
 761:       const form = new FormData();
 762:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 763:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 764:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 765:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 766:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 767:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 768:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 769:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 770:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 771:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 772:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 773:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 774:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 775:       }
 776:     } catch (cause) {
 777:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 778:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 779:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 780:     }
 781:   }

 783:   function closeTransfer() {
 784:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 785:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 786:     setTransferPreview("");
 787:     setTransferFen("");
 788:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 789:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 790:     setRecognitionError("");
 791:       }

 794:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 795:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 796:       setGameEndOverlay({
 797:         title: "Checkmate",
 798:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 799:       });
 800:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 801:       setGameEndOverlay({
 802:         title: "Stalemate",
 803:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 804:       });
 805:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 806:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 807:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 808:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 809:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 810:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 811:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 812:     } else {
 813:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 814:     }
 815:   }

 817:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 818:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 819:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 820:     try {
 821:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 822:       const result = currentGame.move({
 823:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 824:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 825:         promotion: piece,
 826:       });
 827:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 828:       patchBoardSession({
 829:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 830:         moves: nextMoves,
 831:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 832:       });
 833:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 834:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 835:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 836:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 837:       setError("");
 838:     } catch {
 839:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 840:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 841:     }
 842:   }
 843: 
 844:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 845:     if (!boardSession) return;
 846:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 847:     try {
 848:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 849:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 850:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 851:       if (promote) {
 852:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 853:         return;
 854:       }
 855:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 856:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 857:       if (workspaceMode === "opening-explorer") {
 858:         const line = nextMoves
 859:           .map((move, index) => index % 2 === 0 ? `${Math.floor(index / 2) + 1}. ${move}` : move)
 860:           .join(" ");
 861:         setOpeningExplorerInput(line);
 862:         setOpeningExplorerPly(nextMoves.length);
 863:       } else {
 864:         patchBoardSession({
 865:           currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 866:           moves: nextMoves,
 867:           moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 868:         });
 869:       }
 870:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 871:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 872:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 873:       setError("");
 874:     } catch {
 875:       const piece = game.get(to);
 876:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 877:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 878:     }
 879:   }
 880: 
 881:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 882:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 883:     setRedSquares([]);
 884: 
 885:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 886:       setUserArrows([]);
 887:       setArrowStart(null);
 888:       setArrowHover(null);
 889:       return;
 890:     }
 891: if (!boardSession) return;
 892:     if (annotationMode) {
 893:       if (!arrowStart) {
 894:         setArrowStart(square);
 895:         return;
 896:       }
 897:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 898:       setArrowStart(null);
 899:       setArrowHover(null);
 900:       return;
 901:     }
 902:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 903:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 904:       return;
 905:     }
 906:     const piece = game.get(square);
 907:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 908:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 909:   }

 911:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 912:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 913: 
 914:   event.preventDefault();
 915: 
 916:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 917:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 918:     event.clientX,
 919:     event.clientY,
 920:     bounds,
 921:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 922:   );
 923: 
 924:   if (!square) return;
 925: 
 926:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 927:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 928:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 929:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 930:   setArrowStart(square);
 931:   setArrowHover(square);
 932: 
 933:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 934: }
 935: 
 936:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 937:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 938:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 939:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
 940:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 941:     setArrowHover(square);
 942:   }
 943: 
 944:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 945:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 946: 
 947:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 948: 
 949:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 950:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 951:     event.clientX,
 952:     event.clientY,
 953:     bounds,
 954:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 955:   );
 956: 
 957:   if (to && to !== from) {
 958:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 959:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 960:   } else {
 961:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 962:   }
 963: 
 964:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 965:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 966:   setArrowStart(null);
 967:   setArrowHover(null);
 968: }

 970:   function cancelBoardArrowGesture() {
 971:     arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 972:     setArrowStart(null);
 973:     setArrowHover(null);
 974:   }

 976:   function jumpToMove(index: number) {

 978:     try {
 979:       const next = makePosition(boardSession.lineBaseFen, boardSession.moves, index);
 980:       const last = next.history({ verbose: true }).at(-1);
 981:       patchBoardSession({ moveIndex: index, currentFen: next.fen() });
 982:       setLastMove(last ? { from: last.from, to: last.to } : null);
 983:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 984:     } catch (cause) {
 985:       setError(`Could not navigate to move: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 986:     }
 987:   }

 998:   function stopBoardScan() {
 999:     const controller = scanAbortControllerRef.current;
1000:     if (!controller) return;
1001: 
1002:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
1003:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;

1005:     setDetecting(false);
1006:     setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
1007:

1020:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
1021:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;

1046:   async function detectBoards() {
1047:     if (detecting) {
1048:       stopBoardScan();
1049:       return;
1050:     }
1051: 
1052:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
1053:     if (!API_BASE) {
1054:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
1055:       return;
1056:     }
1057: 
1058:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
1059:     const abortController = new AbortController();
1060:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
1061:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
1062: 
1063:     setDetecting(true);
1064:     setError("");
1065:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
1066:     patchSession((current) => ({
1067:       ...current,
1068:       candidatesByPage: {
1069:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1070:         [String(current.page)]: [],
1071:       },
1072:       selectedDiagramId: null,
1073:     }));
1074: 
1075:     try {
1076:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
1077:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
1078:           (blob) => blob
1079:             ? resolve(blob)
1080:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
1081:           "image/png",
1082:         );
1083:       });
1084: 
1085:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1086: 
1087:       const form = new FormData();
1088:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
1089: 
1090:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
1091:         method: "POST",
1092:         body: form,
1093:         signal: abortController.signal,
1094:       });
1095: 
1096:       if (!response.ok) {
1097:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
1098:       }
1099: 
1100:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
1101:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
1102:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
1103:       );
1104: 
1105:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1106: 
1107:       patchSession((current) => ({
1108:         ...current,
1109:         candidatesByPage: {
1110:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
1111:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
1112:         },
1113:         selectedDiagramId: null,
1114:       }));
1115: 
1116:       setNotice(
1117:         candidates.length
1118:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
1119:           : "No board candidates found.",
1120:       );
1121:     } catch (cause) {
1122:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1123: 
1124:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
1125:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
1126:       } else {
1127:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1128:       }
1129:     } finally {
1130:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
1131:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1132:         setDetecting(false);
1133:       }
1134:     }
1135:   }
1136:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {

1138:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;
1139:   }

1141:   function startCropEdit(
1142:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
1143:     candidate: Candidate,
1144:     handle: CropHandle,
1145:   ) {
1146:     event.stopPropagation();
1147:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1148:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;
1149:     if (!point || !stage) return;

1154:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1155:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1156:     if (!manualMode) return;
1157: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1158: if (!canvas) return;
1159: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1160: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1161: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1162: if (
1163:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1164:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1165:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1166:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1167: ) return;
1168:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1169:     if (!point) return;
1170:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1171:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1172:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1173:     setDragSelection(selection);
1174:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1175:   }

1177:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1178:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1179:     if (edit) {
1180:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1181:       if (!point || !session) return;
1182:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1183:       patchSession((current) => {
1184:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1185:         return {
1186:           ...current,
1187:           candidatesByPage: {
1188:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1189:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1190:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1191:           },
1192:         };
1193:       });
1194:       return;
1195:     }
1196:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1197:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1198:     if (point) {
1199:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1200:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1201:       setDragSelection(selection);
1202:     }
1203:   }
1204: 
1205:   function finishRegion() {
1206:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1207:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1208:       return;
1209:     }
1210:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1211:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1212:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1213:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1214:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1215:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1216:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1217:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1218:     setDragSelection(null);
1219:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1220:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1221:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1222:       x, y, width, height,
1223:       relativeScore: 1,
1224:       source: "manual",
1225:     };
1226:     patchSession((current) => ({
1227:       ...current,
1228:       candidatesByPage: {
1229:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1230:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1231:       },
1232:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1233:     }));
1234:     setManualMode(false);
1235:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1236:   }

1239:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1240:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1241:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1242:     setDragSelection(null);
1243:   }

1245:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1246:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1247:     try {
1248:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1249:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1250:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1251:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1252:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1253:       const scale = mode === "width"
1254:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1255:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1256:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1257:     } catch (cause) {
1258:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1259:     }
1260:   }

  28: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  29:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  30:   if (!match) return uci;
  31:   try {
  32:     const position = new Chess(fen);
  33:     const move = position.move({
  34:       from: match[1] as Square,
  35:       to: match[2] as Square,
  36:       ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  37:     });
  38:     return move.san;
  39:   } catch {
  40:     return uci;
  41:   }
  42: }

  44: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {
  45:   const position = new Chess(fen);
  46:   const san: string[] = [];
  47:   for (const uci of pv) {
  48:     const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  49:     if (!match) break;
  50:     try {
  51:       const move = position.move({
  52:         from: match[1] as Square,
  53:         to: match[2] as Square,
  54:         ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  55:       });
  56:       san.push(move.san);
  57:     } catch {
  58:       break;
  59:     }
  60:   }
  61:   return san.join(" ");
  62: }

  84: function readableDate(timestamp: number): string {
  85:   if (!timestamp) return "Not opened";
  86:   const elapsed = Date.now() - timestamp;
  87:   if (elapsed < 60_000) return "Just now";
  88:   if (elapsed < 3_600_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 60_000)}m ago`;
  89:   if (elapsed < 86_400_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 3_600_000)}h ago`;
  90:   return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString();

 415:     return new Set(game.moves({ square: selectedSquare, verbose: true }).map((move) => move.to));
 416:   }, [game, selectedSquare]);
 417:   const pieceSquares = game.board();
 418:   const moveHistory = useMemo(() => {
 419:     try { return makePosition(boardSession?.lineBaseFen ?? START_FEN, boardSession?.moves ?? [], boardSession?.moveIndex ?? 0).history({ verbose: true }); }
 420:     catch { return []; }
 421:   }, [boardSession]);
 422:   const highlightedMove = lastMove ?? (moveHistory.length
 423:     ? { from: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].from, to: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].to }
 424:     : null);
 425:   const engineArrow = useMemo(
 426:     () => engineEnabled ? parseBestMove(engineScore?.bestMove) : null,
 427:     [engineEnabled, engineScore?.bestMove],
 428:   );
 429: 
 430:   useEffect(() => {
 431:     setUserArrows([]);
 432:     setArrowStart(null);
 433:     setArrowHover(null);
 434:     setAnnotationMode(false);
 435:   }, [book?.id, session?.currentFen]);
 436: 
 437:   useEffect(() => {
 438:     if (engineEnabled && boardSession) {
 439:       engineRef.current?.analyze(game.fen(), engineDepth);
 440:     }
 441:   }, [engineEnabled, boardSession?.currentFen, boardSession?.moveIndex, game, engineDepth]);
 442: 
 443:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 444:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 445:   }
 446: 
 447:   function toggleEngine() {
 448:     if (engineEnabled) {
 449:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 450:       engineRef.current = null;
 451:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 452:       setEngineStatus("off");
 453:       setEngineScore(null);
 454:       setEngineMessage("");
 455:       return;
 456:     }
 457:     try {
 458:       setEngineScore(null);
 459:       setEngineMessage("");
 460:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 461:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 462:         (status, message) => {
 463:           setEngineStatus(status);
 464:           if (status === "error") {
 465:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 466:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 467:             setEngineScore(null);
 468:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 469:             engineRef.current = null;
 470:           }
 471:         },
 472:         setEngineScore,
 473:       );
 474:       engineRef.current = client;
 475:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 476:     } catch (cause) {
 477:       setEngineStatus("error");
 478:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 479:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 480:     }
 481:   }
 482: 
 483:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 484:     setSession((current) => {
 485:       if (!current) return current;
 486:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 487:     });
 488:   }
 489: 
 490:   function patchBoardSession(change: Partial<StudyBoardState>) {
 491:     if (workspaceMode === "opening-explorer") {
 492:       return;
 493:     }
 494: 
 495:     if (workspaceMode === "analysis") {
 496:       setAnalysisBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 497:     } else if (workspaceMode === "opening-prep") {
 498:       setOpeningPrepBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 499:     } else if (studyMode) {
 500:       setStudyBoard((current) => current ? { ...current, ...change } : current);
 501:     } else {
 502:       patchSession(change);
 503:     }
 504:   }
 505:   async function toggleStudyMode() {
 506:     if (!studyMode) {
 507:       if (!session) {
 508:         setError("Open a book before entering study mode.");
 509:         return;
 510:       }
 511:       setStudyBoard({
 512:         lineBaseFen: session.lineBaseFen,
 513:         currentFen: session.currentFen,
 514:         moves: [...session.moves],
 515:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 516:         flipped: session.flipped,
 517:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 518:       });
 519:       setStudyMode(true);
 520:     } else {
 521:       // Preserve the latest Focus Mode board when returning to normal mode.
 522:       if (studyBoard) {
 523:         patchSession({
 524:           lineBaseFen: studyBoard.lineBaseFen,
 525:           currentFen: studyBoard.currentFen,
 526:           moves: [...studyBoard.moves],
 527:           moveIndex: studyBoard.moveIndex,
 528:           flipped: studyBoard.flipped,
 529:           coordinates: studyBoard.coordinates,
 530:         });
 531:       }
 532:       setStudyMode(false);
 533:     }
 534:     setLastMove(null);
 535:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 536:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 537:   
 538:     try {
 539:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 540:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 541:       } else {
 542:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 543:       }
 544:     } catch {
 545:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 546:     }
 547: }
