 911:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 912:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 913: 
 914:   event.preventDefault();
 915: 
 916:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 917:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 918:     event.clientX,
 919:     event.clientY,
 920:     bounds,
 921:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 922:   );
 923: 
 924:   if (!square) return;
 925: 
 926:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 927:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 928:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 929:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 930:   setArrowStart(square);
 931:   setArrowHover(square);
 932: 
 933:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 934: }
 935: 
 936:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 937:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 938:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 939:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
 940:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 941:     setArrowHover(square);
 942:   }
 943: 
 944:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 945:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 946: 
 947:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 948: 
 949:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 950:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 951:     event.clientX,
 952:     event.clientY,
 953:     bounds,
 954:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 955:   );
 956: 
 957:   if (to && to !== from) {
 958:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 959:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 960:   } else {
 961:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 962:   }
 963: 
 964:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 965:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 966:   setArrowStart(null);
 967:   setArrowHover(null);
 968: }
 969: 
 970:   function cancelBoardArrowGesture() {
 971:     arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 972:     setArrowStart(null);
 973:     setArrowHover(null);
 974:   }

 976:   function jumpToMove(index: number) {
 977:     if (!boardSession) return;
 978:     try {
 979:       const next = makePosition(boardSession.lineBaseFen, boardSession.moves, index);
 980:       const last = next.history({ verbose: true }).at(-1);
 981:       patchBoardSession({ moveIndex: index, currentFen: next.fen() });
 982:       setLastMove(last ? { from: last.from, to: last.to } : null);
 983:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 984:     } catch (cause) {
 985:       setError(`Could not navigate to move: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 986:     }
 987:   }

 989:   async function copyText(value: string) {

1046:   async function detectBoards() {
1047:     if (detecting) {
1048:       stopBoardScan();
1049:       return;
1050:     }
1051: 
1052:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
1053:     if (!API_BASE) {
1054:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
1055:       return;
1056:     }
1057: 
1058:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
1059:     const abortController = new AbortController();
1060:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
1061:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
1062: 
1063:     setDetecting(true);
1064:     setError("");
1065:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
1066:     patchSession((current) => ({
1067:       ...current,
1068:       candidatesByPage: {
1069:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1070:         [String(current.page)]: [],
1071:       },
1072:       selectedDiagramId: null,
1073:     }));
1074: 
1075:     try {
1076:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
1077:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
1078:           (blob) => blob
1079:             ? resolve(blob)
1080:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
1081:           "image/png",
1082:         );
1083:       });
1084: 
1085:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1086: 
1087:       const form = new FormData();
1088:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
1089: 
1090:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
1091:         method: "POST",
1092:         body: form,
1093:         signal: abortController.signal,
1094:       });
1095: 
1096:       if (!response.ok) {
1097:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
1098:       }
1099: 
1100:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
1101:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
1102:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
1103:       );
1104: 
1105:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1106: 
1107:       patchSession((current) => ({
1108:         ...current,
1109:         candidatesByPage: {
1110:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
1111:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
1112:         },
1113:         selectedDiagramId: null,
1114:       }));
1115: 
1116:       setNotice(
1117:         candidates.length
1118:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
1119:           : "No board candidates found.",
1120:       );
1121:     } catch (cause) {
1122:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1123: 
1124:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
1125:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
1126:       } else {
1127:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1128:       }
1129:     } finally {
1130:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
1131:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1132:         setDetecting(false);
1133:       }
1134:     }
1135:   }

1154:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1155:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1156:     if (!manualMode) return;
1157: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1158: if (!canvas) return;
1159: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1160: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1161: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1162: if (
1163:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1164:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1165:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1166:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1167: ) return;
1168:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1169:     if (!point) return;
1170:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1171:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1172:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1173:     setDragSelection(selection);
1174:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1175:   }

1177:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1178:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1179:     if (edit) {
1180:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1181:       if (!point || !session) return;
1182:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1183:       patchSession((current) => {
1184:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1185:         return {
1186:           ...current,
1187:           candidatesByPage: {
1188:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1189:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1190:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1191:           },
1192:         };
1193:       });
1194:       return;
1195:     }
1196:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1197:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1198:     if (point) {
1199:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1200:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1201:       setDragSelection(selection);
1202:     }
1203:   }

1205:   function finishRegion() {
1206:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1207:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1208:       return;
1209:     }
1210:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1211:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1212:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1213:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1214:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1215:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1216:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1217:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1218:     setDragSelection(null);
1219:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1220:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1221:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1222:       x, y, width, height,
1223:       relativeScore: 1,
1224:       source: "manual",
1225:     };
1226:     patchSession((current) => ({
1227:       ...current,
1228:       candidatesByPage: {
1229:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1230:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1231:       },
1232:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1233:     }));
1234:     setManualMode(false);
1235:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1236:   }

1240:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1241:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1242:     setDragSelection(null);

1245:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1246:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1247:     try {
1248:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1249:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1250:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1251:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1252:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1253:       const scale = mode === "width"
1254:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1255:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1256:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1257:     } catch (cause) {
1258:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1259:     }
1260:   }

  26: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  27:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  28:   if (!match) return uci;
  29:   try {
  30:     const position = new Chess(fen);
  31:     const move = position.move({
  32:       from: match[1] as Square,
  33:       to: match[2] as Square,
  34:       ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  35:     });
  36:     return move.san;
  37:   } catch {
  38:     return uci;
  39:   }
  40: }

  42: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {
  43:   const position = new Chess(fen);
  44:   const san: string[] = [];
  45:   for (const uci of pv) {
  46:     const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  47:     if (!match) break;
  48:     try {
  49:       const move = position.move({
  50:         from: match[1] as Square,
  51:         to: match[2] as Square,
  52:         ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  53:       });
  54:       san.push(move.san);
  55:     } catch {
  56:       break;
  57:     }
  58:   }
  59:   return san.join(" ");
  60: }

  82: function readableDate(timestamp: number): string {
  83:   if (!timestamp) return "Not opened";
  84:   const elapsed = Date.now() - timestamp;
  85:   if (elapsed < 60_000) return "Just now";
  86:   if (elapsed < 3_600_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 60_000)}m ago`;

 397:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 398:     } catch (cause) {
 399:       setEngineStatus("error");
 400:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 401:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 402:     }
 403:   }

 405:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 406:     setSession((current) => {
 407:       if (!current) return current;
 408:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 409:     });
 410:   }
 411: 
 412:   function patchBoardSession(change: Partial<StudyBoardState>) {
 413:     if (studyMode) setStudyBoard((current) => current ? { ...current, ...change } : current);
 414:     else patchSession(change);
 415:   }

 417:   async function toggleStudyMode() {
 418:     if (!studyMode) {
 419:       if (!session) {
 420:         setError("Open a book before entering study mode.");
 421:         return;
 422:       }
 423:       setStudyBoard({
 424:         lineBaseFen: session.lineBaseFen,
 425:         currentFen: session.currentFen,
 426:         moves: [...session.moves],
 427:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 428:         flipped: session.flipped,
 429:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 430:       });
 431:       setStudyMode(true);
 432:     } else {
 433:       // Preserve the latest Focus Mode board when returning to normal mode.
 434:       if (studyBoard) {
 435:         patchSession({
 436:           lineBaseFen: studyBoard.lineBaseFen,
 437:           currentFen: studyBoard.currentFen,
 438:           moves: [...studyBoard.moves],
 439:           moveIndex: studyBoard.moveIndex,
 440:           flipped: studyBoard.flipped,
 441:           coordinates: studyBoard.coordinates,
 442:         });
 443:       }
 444:       setStudyMode(false);
 445:     }
 446:     setLastMove(null);
 447:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 448:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 449:   
 450:     try {
 451:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 452:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 453:       } else {
 454:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 455:       }
 456:     } catch {
 457:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 458:     }
 459: }

 461:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 462:     try {
 463:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 464:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 465:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 466:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 467:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 468:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 469:       setBook(opened);
 470:       setSession(nextSession);
 471:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 472:       setError("");
 473:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 474:     } catch (cause) {
 475:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 476:     }
 477:   }
 478: 
 479:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 480:     if (!file) return;
 481:     try {
 482:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 483:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 484:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 485:       const now = Date.now();
 486:       const created: BookRecord = {
 487:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 488:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 489:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 490:         byteLength: file.size,
 491:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 492:         addedAt: now,
 493:       };
 494:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 495:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 496:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 497:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 498:       setBook(created);
 499:       setSession(blank);
 500:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 501:       setError("");
 502:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 503:     } catch (cause) {
 504:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 505:     }
 506:   }
 507: 
 508:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 509:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 510: 
 511:     try {
 512:       await removeBook(item.id);
 513:       await removeSession(item.id);
 514: 
 515:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 516:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 517:         const next = { ...current };
 518:         delete next[item.id];
 519:         return next;
 520:       });
 521: 
 522:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 523:         setBook(null);
 524:         setSession(null);
 525:         setPdf(null);
 526:       }
 527: 
 528:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 529:       setError("");
 530:     } catch (cause) {
 531:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 532:     }
 533:   }
 534:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 535:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 536:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 537:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 538:     try {
 539:       await putBook(renamed);
 540:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 541:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 542:     } catch (cause) {
 543:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 544:     }
 545:   }

 549:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });
 550:   }

 554:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });

 557:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 558:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 559:     try {
 560:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 561:       setSession({
 562:         ...activeSession,
 563:         originalFen: fen,
 564:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 565:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 566:         moves: [],
 567:         moveIndex: 0,
 568:       });
 569:       setLastMove(null);
 570:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 571:       setUserArrows([]);
 572:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 573:       return true;
 574:     } catch (cause) {
 575:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 576:       return false;
 577:     }
 578:   }

 584:     setEngineMessage("");
 585:     if (!engineEnabled) {
 586:       toggleEngine();
 587:     } else {
 588:       engineRef.current?.analyze(fen, engineDepth);
 589:     }
 590:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 591:     return true;
 592:   }

 643:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 644:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 645:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 646:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 647:       return;
 648:     }
 649:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 650:     try {
 651:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 652:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 653:       preview.width = crop.width;
 654:       preview.height = crop.height;
 655:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 656:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 657:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 658:     } catch (cause) {
 659:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 660:       return;
 661:     }
 662:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 663:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 664:     setTransferFen("");
 665:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 666:         setRecognitionError("");
 667:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 668:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 669:     try {
 670:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 671:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 672:       });
 673:       const form = new FormData();
 674:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 675:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 676:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 677:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 678:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 679:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 680:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 681:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 682:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 683:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 684:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 685:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 686:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 687:       }
 688:     } catch (cause) {
 689:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 690:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 691:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 692:     }
 693:   }
 694: 
 695:   function closeTransfer() {
 696:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 697:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 698:     setTransferPreview("");
 699:     setTransferFen("");
 700:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 701:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 702:     setRecognitionError("");
 703:       }

 706:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 707:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 708:       setGameEndOverlay({
 709:         title: "Checkmate",
 710:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 711:       });
 712:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 713:       setGameEndOverlay({
 714:         title: "Stalemate",
 715:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 716:       });
 717:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 718:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 719:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 720:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 721:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 722:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 723:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 724:     } else {
 725:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 726:     }
 727:   }

 729:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 730:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 731:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 732:     try {
 733:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 734:       const result = currentGame.move({
 735:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 736:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 737:         promotion: piece,
 738:       });
 739:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 740:       patchBoardSession({
 741:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 742:         moves: nextMoves,
 743:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 744:       });
 745:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 746:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 747:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 748:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 749:       setError("");
 750:     } catch {
 751:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 752:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 753:     }
 754:   }
 755: 
 756:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 757:     if (!boardSession) return;
 758:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 759:     try {
 760:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 761:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 762:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 763:       if (promote) {
 764:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 765:         return;
 766:       }
 767:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 768:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 769:       patchBoardSession({
 770:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 771:         moves: nextMoves,
 772:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 773:       });
 774:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 775:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 776:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 777:       setError("");
 778:     } catch {
 779:       const piece = game.get(to);
 780:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 781:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 782:     }
 783:   }
 784: 
 785:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 786:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 787:     setRedSquares([]);
 788: 
 789:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 790:       setUserArrows([]);
 791:       setArrowStart(null);
 792:       setArrowHover(null);
 793:       return;
 794:     }
 795: if (!boardSession) return;
 796:     if (annotationMode) {
 797:       if (!arrowStart) {
 798:         setArrowStart(square);
 799:         return;
 800:       }
 801:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 802:       setArrowStart(null);
 803:       setArrowHover(null);
 804:       return;
 805:     }
 806:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 807:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 808:       return;
 809:     }
 810:     const piece = game.get(square);
 811:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 812:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 813:   }

 815:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 816:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 817: 
 818:   event.preventDefault();
 819: 
 820:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 821:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 822:     event.clientX,
 823:     event.clientY,
 824:     bounds,
 825:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 826:   );
 827: 
 828:   if (!square) return;
 829: 
 830:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 831:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 832:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 833:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 834:   setArrowStart(square);
 835:   setArrowHover(square);
 836: 
 837:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 838: }

 840:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 841:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 842:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 843:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
 844:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 845:     setArrowHover(square);
 846:   }

 848:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 849:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 850: 
 851:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 852: 
 853:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 854:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 855:     event.clientX,
 856:     event.clientY,
 857:     bounds,
 858:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 859:   );
 860: 
 861:   if (to && to !== from) {
 862:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 863:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 864:   } else {
 865:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 866:   }
 867: 
 868:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 869:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 870:   setArrowStart(null);
 871:   setArrowHover(null);
 872: }

 924:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
 925:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 926:

 928:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;

 933:     setDragSelection(null);
 934:     setCropEditingId(null);
 935:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 936:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 937: 
 938:     patchSession((current) => ({
 939:       ...current,
 940:       candidatesByPage: {
 941:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 942:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 943:       },
 944:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 945:     }));
 946: 
 947:     setError("");
 948:     setNotice("Board detection cleared.");
 949:   }
 950:   async function detectBoards() {
 951:     if (detecting) {
 952:       stopBoardScan();
 953:       return;
 954:     }
 955: 
 956:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 957:     if (!API_BASE) {
 958:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 959:       return;
 960:     }
 961: 
 962:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 963:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 964:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 965:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 966: 
 967:     setDetecting(true);
 968:     setError("");
 969:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 970:     patchSession((current) => ({
 971:       ...current,
 972:       candidatesByPage: {
 973:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 974:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 975:       },
 976:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 977:     }));
 978: 
 979:     try {
 980:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 981:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 982:           (blob) => blob
 983:             ? resolve(blob)
 984:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 985:           "image/png",
 986:         );
 987:       });
 988: 
 989:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 990: 
 991:       const form = new FormData();
 992:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 993: 
 994:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 995:         method: "POST",
 996:         body: form,
 997:         signal: abortController.signal,
 998:       });
 999: 
1000:       if (!response.ok) {
1001:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
1002:       }
1003: 
1004:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
1005:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
1006:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
1007:       );
1008: 
1009:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1010: 
1011:       patchSession((current) => ({
1012:         ...current,
1013:         candidatesByPage: {
1014:           ...current.candidatesByPage,

1023:           : "No board candidates found.",
1024:       );

1026:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1027:

1033:     } finally {

1035:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1036:         setDetecting(false);
1037:       }
1038:     }

1040:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {

1045:   function startCropEdit(
1046:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
1047:     candidate: Candidate,
1048:     handle: CropHandle,
1049:   ) {
1050:     event.stopPropagation();
1051:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1052:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;
1053:     if (!point || !stage) return;
1054:     cropEditStartRef.current = { candidate, handle, point };

1058:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1059:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1060:     if (!manualMode) return;
1061: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1062: if (!canvas) return;
1063: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1064: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1065: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1066: if (
1067:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1068:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1069:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1070:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1071: ) return;
1072:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1073:     if (!point) return;
1074:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1075:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1076:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1077:     setDragSelection(selection);
1078:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1079:   }

1081:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1082:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1083:     if (edit) {
1084:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1085:       if (!point || !session) return;
1086:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1087:       patchSession((current) => {
1088:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1089:         return {
1090:           ...current,
1091:           candidatesByPage: {
1092:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1093:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1094:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1095:           },
1096:         };
1097:       });
1098:       return;
1099:     }
1100:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1101:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1102:     if (point) {
1103:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1104:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1105:       setDragSelection(selection);
1106:     }
1107:   }

1109:   function finishRegion() {
1110:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1111:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1112:       return;
1113:     }
1114:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1115:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1116:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1117:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1118:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1119:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1120:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1121:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1122:     setDragSelection(null);
1123:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1124:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1125:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1126:       x, y, width, height,
1127:       relativeScore: 1,
1128:       source: "manual",
1129:     };
1130:     patchSession((current) => ({
1131:       ...current,
1132:       candidatesByPage: {
1133:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1134:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1135:       },
1136:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1137:     }));
1138:     setManualMode(false);
1139:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1140:   }

1142:   function cancelRegion() {
1143:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1144:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1145:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1146:     setDragSelection(null);
1147:   }

1149:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1150:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1151:     try {
1152:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1153:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1154:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1155:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1156:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1157:       const scale = mode === "width"
1158:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1159:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1160:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1161:     } catch (cause) {
1162:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1163:     }
1164:   }

1425:                       [tipX, tipY],
1426:                       [baseX - px * headHalfWidth, baseY - py * headHalfWidth],
1427:                       [baseX - px * shaftHalfWidth, baseY - py * shaftHalfWidth],

  26: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  27:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  28:   if (!match) return uci;
  29:   try {
  30:     const position = new Chess(fen);
  31:     const move = position.move({
  32:       from: match[1] as Square,
  33:       to: match[2] as Square,
  34:       ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  35:     });
  36:     return move.san;
  37:   } catch {
  38:     return uci;
  39:   }
  40: }
  41: 
  42: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {
  43:   const position = new Chess(fen);
  44:   const san: string[] = [];
  45:   for (const uci of pv) {
  46:     const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  47:     if (!match) break;
  48:     try {
  49:       const move = position.move({
  50:         from: match[1] as Square,
  51:         to: match[2] as Square,
  52:         ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  53:       });
  54:       san.push(move.san);
  55:     } catch {
  56:       break;
  57:     }
  58:   }
  59:   return san.join(" ");
  60: }

 367:   function toggleEngine() {
 368:     if (engineEnabled) {
 369:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 370:       engineRef.current = null;
 371:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 372:       setEngineStatus("off");
 373:       setEngineScore(null);
 374:       setEngineMessage("");
 375:       return;
 376:     }
 377:     try {
 378:       setEngineScore(null);
 379:       setEngineMessage("");
 380:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 381:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 382:         (status, message) => {
 383:           setEngineStatus(status);
 384:           if (status === "error") {
 385:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 386:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 387:             setEngineScore(null);
 388:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 389:             engineRef.current = null;
 390:           }
 391:         },
 392:         setEngineScore,
 393:       );
 394:       engineRef.current = client;
 395:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 396:     } catch (cause) {
 397:       setEngineStatus("error");
 398:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 399:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 400:     }
 401:   }

 415:   async function toggleStudyMode() {
 416:     if (!studyMode) {
 417:       if (!session) {
 418:         setError("Open a book before entering study mode.");
 419:         return;
 420:       }

 426:         flipped: session.flipped,
 427:         coordinates: session.coordinates,

 432:       if (studyBoard) {
 433:         patchSession({

 439:           coordinates: studyBoard.coordinates,
 440:         });
 441:       }

 444:     setLastMove(null);
 445:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 446:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 447:   
 448:     try {
 449:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 450:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 451:       } else {
 452:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 453:       }
 454:     } catch {
 455:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 456:     }

 459:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 460:     try {
 461:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 462:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 463:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 464:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 465:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 466:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 467:       setBook(opened);
 468:       setSession(nextSession);
 469:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 470:       setError("");
 471:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 472:     } catch (cause) {
 473:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 474:     }
 475:   }

 477:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 478:     if (!file) return;
 479:     try {
 480:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 481:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 482:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 483:       const now = Date.now();
 484:       const created: BookRecord = {
 485:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 486:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 487:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 488:         byteLength: file.size,
 489:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 490:         addedAt: now,
 491:       };
 492:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 493:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 494:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 495:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 496:       setBook(created);
 497:       setSession(blank);
 498:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 499:       setError("");
 500:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 501:     } catch (cause) {
 502:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 503:     }
 504:   }

 506:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 507:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 508: 
 509:     try {
 510:       await removeBook(item.id);
 511:       await removeSession(item.id);
 512: 
 513:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 514:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 515:         const next = { ...current };
 516:         delete next[item.id];
 517:         return next;
 518:       });
 519: 
 520:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 521:         setBook(null);
 522:         setSession(null);
 523:         setPdf(null);
 524:       }
 525: 
 526:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 527:       setError("");
 528:     } catch (cause) {
 529:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 530:     }
 531:   }
 532:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 533:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 534:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 535:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 536:     try {
 537:       await putBook(renamed);
 538:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 539:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 540:     } catch (cause) {
 541:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 542:     }
 543:   }

 555:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 556:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 557:     try {
 558:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 559:       setSession({
 560:         ...activeSession,
 561:         originalFen: fen,
 562:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 563:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 564:         moves: [],
 565:         moveIndex: 0,
 566:       });
 567:       setLastMove(null);
 568:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 569:       setUserArrows([]);
 570:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 571:       return true;
 572:     } catch (cause) {
 573:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 574:       return false;
 575:     }
 576:   }

 641:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 642:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 643:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 644:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 645:       return;
 646:     }
 647:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 648:     try {
 649:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 650:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 651:       preview.width = crop.width;
 652:       preview.height = crop.height;
 653:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 654:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 655:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 656:     } catch (cause) {
 657:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 658:       return;
 659:     }
 660:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 661:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 662:     setTransferFen("");
 663:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 664:         setRecognitionError("");
 665:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 666:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 667:     try {
 668:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 669:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 670:       });
 671:       const form = new FormData();
 672:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 673:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 674:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 675:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 676:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 677:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 678:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 679:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 680:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 681:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 682:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 683:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 684:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 685:       }
 686:     } catch (cause) {
 687:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 688:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 689:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 690:     }
 691:   }

 693:   function closeTransfer() {
 694:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 695:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 696:     setTransferPreview("");
 697:     setTransferFen("");
 698:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 699:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 700:     setRecognitionError("");
 701:       }

 704:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 705:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 706:       setGameEndOverlay({
 707:         title: "Checkmate",
 708:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 709:       });
 710:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 711:       setGameEndOverlay({
 712:         title: "Stalemate",
 713:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 714:       });
 715:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 716:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 717:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 718:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 719:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 720:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 721:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 722:     } else {
 723:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 724:     }
 725:   }

 727:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 728:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 729:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 730:     try {
 731:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 732:       const result = currentGame.move({
 733:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 734:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 735:         promotion: piece,
 736:       });
 737:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 738:       patchBoardSession({
 739:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 740:         moves: nextMoves,
 741:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 742:       });
 743:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 744:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 745:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 746:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 747:       setError("");
 748:     } catch {
 749:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 750:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 751:     }
 752:   }
 753: 
 754:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 755:     if (!boardSession) return;
 756:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 757:     try {
 758:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 759:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 760:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 761:       if (promote) {
 762:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 763:         return;
 764:       }
 765:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 766:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 767:       patchBoardSession({
 768:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 769:         moves: nextMoves,
 770:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 771:       });
 772:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 773:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 774:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 775:       setError("");
 776:     } catch {
 777:       const piece = game.get(to);
 778:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 779:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 780:     }
 781:   }

 783:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 784:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 785:     setRedSquares([]);
 786: 
 787:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 788:       setUserArrows([]);
 789:       setArrowStart(null);
 790:       setArrowHover(null);
 791:       return;
 792:     }
 793: if (!boardSession) return;
 794:     if (annotationMode) {
 795:       if (!arrowStart) {
 796:         setArrowStart(square);
 797:         return;
 798:       }
 799:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 800:       setArrowStart(null);
 801:       setArrowHover(null);
 802:       return;
 803:     }
 804:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 805:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 806:       return;
 807:     }
 808:     const piece = game.get(square);
 809:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 810:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 811:   }

 846:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 847:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 848: 
 849:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 850: 
 851:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 852:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 853:     event.clientX,
 854:     event.clientY,
 855:     bounds,
 856:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 857:   );
 858:

 860:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 861:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 862:   } else {
 863:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 864:   }
 865: 
 866:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 867:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;

 869:   setArrowHover(null);

 948:   async function detectBoards() {
 949:     if (detecting) {
 950:       stopBoardScan();
 951:       return;
 952:     }
 953: 
 954:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 955:     if (!API_BASE) {
 956:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 957:       return;
 958:     }
 959: 
 960:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 961:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 962:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 963:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 964: 
 965:     setDetecting(true);
 966:     setError("");
 967:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 968:     patchSession((current) => ({
 969:       ...current,
 970:       candidatesByPage: {
 971:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 972:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 973:       },
 974:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 975:     }));
 976: 
 977:     try {
 978:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 979:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 980:           (blob) => blob
 981:             ? resolve(blob)
 982:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 983:           "image/png",
 984:         );
 985:       });
 986: 
 987:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 988: 
 989:       const form = new FormData();
 990:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 991: 
 992:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 993:         method: "POST",
 994:         body: form,
 995:         signal: abortController.signal,
 996:       });
 997: 
 998:       if (!response.ok) {
 999:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
1000:       }
1001: 
1002:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
1003:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
1004:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
1005:       );
1006: 
1007:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1008: 
1009:       patchSession((current) => ({
1010:         ...current,
1011:         candidatesByPage: {
1012:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
1013:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
1014:         },
1015:         selectedDiagramId: null,
1016:       }));
1017: 
1018:       setNotice(
1019:         candidates.length
1020:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
1021:           : "No board candidates found.",
1022:       );
1023:     } catch (cause) {
1024:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1025: 
1026:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
1027:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
1028:       } else {
1029:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1030:       }
1031:     } finally {
1032:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
1033:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1034:         setDetecting(false);
1035:       }
1036:     }
1037:   }

1056:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1057:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1058:     if (!manualMode) return;
1059: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1060: if (!canvas) return;
1061: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1062: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1063: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1064: if (
1065:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1066:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1067:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1068:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1069: ) return;
1070:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1071:     if (!point) return;
1072:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1073:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1074:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1075:     setDragSelection(selection);
1076:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1077:   }

1079:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1080:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1081:     if (edit) {
1082:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1083:       if (!point || !session) return;
1084:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1085:       patchSession((current) => {
1086:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1087:         return {
1088:           ...current,
1089:           candidatesByPage: {
1090:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1091:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1092:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1093:           },
1094:         };
1095:       });
1096:       return;
1097:     }
1098:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1099:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1100:     if (point) {
1101:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1102:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1103:       setDragSelection(selection);
1104:     }
1105:   }

1107:   function finishRegion() {
1108:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1109:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1110:       return;
1111:     }
1112:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1113:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1114:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1115:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1116:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1117:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1118:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1119:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1120:     setDragSelection(null);
1121:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1122:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1123:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1124:       x, y, width, height,
1125:       relativeScore: 1,
1126:       source: "manual",
1127:     };
1128:     patchSession((current) => ({
1129:       ...current,
1130:       candidatesByPage: {
1131:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1132:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1133:       },
1134:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1135:     }));
1136:     setManualMode(false);
1137:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1138:   }

1147:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1148:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1149:     try {
1150:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1151:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1152:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1153:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1154:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1155:       const scale = mode === "width"
1156:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1157:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1158:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1159:     } catch (cause) {
1160:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1161:     }
1162:   }

  26: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  27:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  28:   if (!match) return uci;
  29:   try {
  30:     const position = new Chess(fen);
  31:     const move = position.move({
  32:       from: match[1] as Square,
  33:       to: match[2] as Square,
  34:       ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  35:     });
  36:     return move.san;
  37:   } catch {
  38:     return uci;
  39:   }
  40: }
  41: 
  42: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {
  43:   const position = new Chess(fen);
  44:   const san: string[] = [];
  45:   for (const uci of pv) {
  46:     const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  47:     if (!match) break;
  48:     try {
  49:       const move = position.move({
  50:         from: match[1] as Square,
  51:         to: match[2] as Square,
  52:         ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  53:       });
  54:       san.push(move.san);
  55:     } catch {
  56:       break;
  57:     }
  58:   }
  59:   return san.join(" ");
  60: }

 372:       setEngineStatus("off");
 373:       setEngineScore(null);
 374:       setEngineMessage("");
 375:       return;
 376:     }
 377:     try {
 378:       setEngineScore(null);
 379:       setEngineMessage("");
 380:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 381:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 382:         (status, message) => {
 383:           setEngineStatus(status);
 384:           if (status === "error") {
 385:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 386:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 387:             setEngineScore(null);
 388:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 389:             engineRef.current = null;
 390:           }
 391:         },
 392:         setEngineScore,
 393:       );
 394:       engineRef.current = client;
 395:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 396:     } catch (cause) {
 397:       setEngineStatus("error");
 398:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 399:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 400:     }
 401:   }
 402: 
 403:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 404:     setSession((current) => {
 405:       if (!current) return current;
 406:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 407:     });
 408:   }

 410:   function patchBoardSession(change: Partial<StudyBoardState>) {
 411:     if (studyMode) setStudyBoard((current) => current ? { ...current, ...change } : current);
 412:     else patchSession(change);
 413:   }

 415:   async function toggleStudyMode() {
 416:     if (!studyMode) {
 417:       if (!session) {
 418:         setError("Open a book before entering study mode.");
 419:         return;
 420:       }
 421:       setStudyBoard({
 422:         lineBaseFen: session.lineBaseFen,
 423:         currentFen: session.currentFen,
 424:         moves: [...session.moves],
 425:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 426:         flipped: session.flipped,
 427:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 428:       });
 429:       setStudyMode(true);
 430:     } else {
 431:       // Preserve the latest Focus Mode board when returning to normal mode.
 432:       if (studyBoard) {
 433:         patchSession({
 434:           lineBaseFen: studyBoard.lineBaseFen,
 435:           currentFen: studyBoard.currentFen,
 436:           moves: [...studyBoard.moves],
 437:           moveIndex: studyBoard.moveIndex,
 438:           flipped: studyBoard.flipped,
 439:           coordinates: studyBoard.coordinates,
 440:         });
 441:       }
 442:       setStudyMode(false);
 443:     }
 444:     setLastMove(null);
 445:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 446:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 447:   
 448:     try {
 449:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 450:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 451:       } else {
 452:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 453:       }
 454:     } catch {
 455:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 456:     }
 457: }

 459:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 460:     try {
 461:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 462:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 463:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 464:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 465:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 466:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 467:       setBook(opened);
 468:       setSession(nextSession);
 469:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 470:       setError("");
 471:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 472:     } catch (cause) {
 473:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 474:     }
 475:   }
 476: 
 477:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 478:     if (!file) return;
 479:     try {
 480:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 481:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 482:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 483:       const now = Date.now();
 484:       const created: BookRecord = {
 485:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 486:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 487:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 488:         byteLength: file.size,
 489:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 490:         addedAt: now,
 491:       };
 492:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 493:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 494:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 495:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 496:       setBook(created);
 497:       setSession(blank);
 498:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 499:       setError("");
 500:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 501:     } catch (cause) {
 502:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 503:     }
 504:   }
 505: 
 506:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 507:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 508: 
 509:     try {
 510:       await removeBook(item.id);
 511:       await removeSession(item.id);
 512: 
 513:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 514:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 515:         const next = { ...current };
 516:         delete next[item.id];
 517:         return next;
 518:       });
 519: 
 520:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 521:         setBook(null);
 522:         setSession(null);
 523:         setPdf(null);
 524:       }
 525: 
 526:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 527:       setError("");
 528:     } catch (cause) {
 529:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 530:     }
 531:   }
 532:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 533:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 534:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 535:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 536:     try {
 537:       await putBook(renamed);
 538:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 539:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 540:     } catch (cause) {
 541:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 542:     }
 543:   }

 552:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });

 555:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 556:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 557:     try {
 558:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 559:       setSession({
 560:         ...activeSession,
 561:         originalFen: fen,
 562:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 563:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 564:         moves: [],
 565:         moveIndex: 0,
 566:       });
 567:       setLastMove(null);
 568:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 569:       setUserArrows([]);
 570:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 571:       return true;
 572:     } catch (cause) {
 573:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 574:       return false;
 575:     }
 576:   }

 579:     const loaded = moveToPosition(fen);

 582:     setEngineMessage("");

 584:       toggleEngine();

 587:     }
 588:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 589:     return true;

 641:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 642:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 643:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 644:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 645:       return;
 646:     }
 647:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 648:     try {
 649:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 650:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 651:       preview.width = crop.width;
 652:       preview.height = crop.height;
 653:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 654:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 655:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 656:     } catch (cause) {
 657:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 658:       return;
 659:     }
 660:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 661:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 662:     setTransferFen("");
 663:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 664:         setRecognitionError("");
 665:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 666:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 667:     try {
 668:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 669:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 670:       });
 671:       const form = new FormData();
 672:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 673:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 674:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 675:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 676:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 677:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 678:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 679:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 680:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 681:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 682:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 683:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 684:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 685:       }
 686:     } catch (cause) {
 687:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 688:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 689:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 690:     }
 691:   }
 692: 
 693:   function closeTransfer() {
 694:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 695:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 696:     setTransferPreview("");
 697:     setTransferFen("");
 698:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 699:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 700:     setRecognitionError("");
 701:       }

 704:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 705:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 706:       setGameEndOverlay({
 707:         title: "Checkmate",
 708:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 709:       });
 710:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 711:       setGameEndOverlay({
 712:         title: "Stalemate",
 713:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 714:       });
 715:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 716:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 717:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 718:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 719:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 720:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 721:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 722:     } else {
 723:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 724:     }
 725:   }

 727:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 728:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 729:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 730:     try {
 731:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 732:       const result = currentGame.move({
 733:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 734:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 735:         promotion: piece,
 736:       });
 737:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 738:       patchBoardSession({
 739:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 740:         moves: nextMoves,
 741:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 742:       });
 743:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 744:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 745:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 746:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 747:       setError("");
 748:     } catch {
 749:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 750:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 751:     }
 752:   }
 753: 
 754:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 755:     if (!boardSession) return;
 756:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 757:     try {
 758:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 759:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 760:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 761:       if (promote) {
 762:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 763:         return;
 764:       }
 765:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 766:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 767:       patchBoardSession({
 768:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 769:         moves: nextMoves,
 770:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 771:       });
 772:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 773:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 774:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 775:       setError("");
 776:     } catch {
 777:       const piece = game.get(to);
 778:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 779:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 780:     }
 781:   }
 782: 
 783:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 784:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 785:     setRedSquares([]);
 786: 
 787:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 788:       setUserArrows([]);
 789:       setArrowStart(null);
 790:       setArrowHover(null);
 791:       return;
 792:     }
 793: if (!boardSession) return;
 794:     if (annotationMode) {
 795:       if (!arrowStart) {
 796:         setArrowStart(square);
 797:         return;
 798:       }
 799:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 800:       setArrowStart(null);
 801:       setArrowHover(null);
 802:       return;
 803:     }
 804:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 805:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 806:       return;
 807:     }
 808:     const piece = game.get(square);
 809:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 810:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 811:   }

 813:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 814:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 815: 
 816:   event.preventDefault();
 817: 
 818:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 819:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 820:     event.clientX,
 821:     event.clientY,
 822:     bounds,
 823:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 824:   );
 825: 
 826:   if (!square) return;
 827: 
 828:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 829:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 830:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 831:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 832:   setArrowStart(square);
 833:   setArrowHover(square);
 834: 
 835:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 836: }
