 232:         setRendering(false);
 233:         setError(`Could not render page ${session.page}: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 234:       }
 235:     });
 236:     return () => {
 237:       cancelled = true;
 238:       renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();
 239:     };
 240:   }, [pdf, session?.page, session?.zoom]);
 241: 
 242:   useEffect(() => {
 243:     function onKey(event: KeyboardEvent) {
 244:       if (!session || !book || isTypingTarget(event.target)) return;
 245:       if (cropEditingId && ["ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", "ArrowUp", "ArrowDown"].includes(event.key)) {
 246:         const candidate = (session.candidatesByPage[String(session.page)] ?? []).find((item) => item.id === cropEditingId);
 247:         if (!candidate) return;
 248:         const step = event.shiftKey ? 0.01 : 0.002;
 249:         const x = event.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowRight" ? step : 0;
 250:         const y = event.key === "ArrowUp" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowDown" ? step : 0;
 251:         const next = editCrop(candidate, "move", x, y);
 252:         patchSession((current) => {
 253:           const pageKey = String(current.page);
 254:           return {
 255:             ...current,
 256:             candidatesByPage: {
 257:               ...current.candidatesByPage,
 258:               [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((item) =>
 259:                 item.id === candidate.id ? { ...item, ...next } : item),
 260:             },
 261:           };
 262:         });
 263:         event.preventDefault();
 264:         return;
 265:       }
 266:       if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") changePage(-1);
 267:       if (event.key === "ArrowRight") changePage(1);
 268:     }
 269:     window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 270:     return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 271:   });
 272: 
 273:   useEffect(() => () => {
 274:     engineRef.current?.dispose();
 275:     engineRef.current = null;
 276:   }, []);
 277: 
 278:   const sortedBooks = useMemo(() => [...books].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt), [books]);
 279:   const visibleBooks = useMemo(() => {
 280:     const needle = bookSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
 281:     return sortedBooks.filter((item) => {
 282:       const matchesTab = libraryTab === "all" || libraryTab === "recent";
 283:       return matchesTab && item.title.toLowerCase().includes(needle);
 284:     });
 285:   }, [bookSearch, libraryTab, sessionIndex, sortedBooks]);
 286: 
 287:   const boardSession: StudyBoardState | null = studyMode ? studyBoard : session;
 288:   const game = useMemo(() => {
 289:     if (!boardSession) return new Chess();
 290:     try {
 291:       return makePosition(boardSession.lineBaseFen, boardSession.moves, boardSession.moveIndex);
 292:     } catch {
 293:       try { return new Chess(boardSession.currentFen); } catch { return new Chess(); }
 294:     }
 295:   }, [boardSession]);
 296:   const legalTargets = useMemo(() => {
 297:     if (!selectedSquare) return new Set<string>();
 298:     return new Set(game.moves({ square: selectedSquare, verbose: true }).map((move) => move.to));
 299:   }, [game, selectedSquare]);
 300:   const pieceSquares = game.board();
 301:   const moveHistory = useMemo(() => {
 302:     try { return makePosition(boardSession?.lineBaseFen ?? START_FEN, boardSession?.moves ?? [], boardSession?.moveIndex ?? 0).history({ verbose: true }); }
 303:     catch { return []; }
 304:   }, [boardSession]);
 305:   const highlightedMove = lastMove ?? (moveHistory.length
 306:     ? { from: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].from, to: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].to }
 307:     : null);
 308:   const engineArrow = useMemo(
 309:     () => engineEnabled ? parseBestMove(engineScore?.bestMove) : null,
 310:     [engineEnabled, engineScore?.bestMove],
 311:   );
 312: 
 313:   useEffect(() => {
 314:     setUserArrows([]);
 315:     setArrowStart(null);
 316:     setArrowHover(null);
 317:     setAnnotationMode(false);
 318:   }, [book?.id, session?.currentFen]);
 319: 
 320:   useEffect(() => {
 321:     if (engineEnabled) engineRef.current?.analyze(game.fen(), engineDepth);
 322:   }, [engineEnabled, session?.currentFen, session?.moveIndex, engineDepth]);

 324:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 325:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 326:   }

 328:   function toggleEngine() {
 329:     if (engineEnabled) {
 330:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 331:       engineRef.current = null;
 332:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 333:       setEngineStatus("off");
 334:       setEngineScore(null);
 335:       setEngineMessage("");
 336:       return;
 337:     }
 338:     try {
 339:       setEngineScore(null);
 340:       setEngineMessage("");
 341:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 342:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 343:         (status, message) => {
 344:           setEngineStatus(status);
 345:           if (status === "error") {
 346:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 347:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 348:             setEngineScore(null);
 349:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 350:             engineRef.current = null;
 351:           }
 352:         },
 353:         setEngineScore,
 354:       );
 355:       engineRef.current = client;
 356:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 357:     } catch (cause) {
 358:       setEngineStatus("error");
 359:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 360:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 361:     }
 362:   }

 364:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 365:     setSession((current) => {
 366:       if (!current) return current;
 367:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 368:     });
 369:   }

 372:     if (studyMode) setStudyBoard((current) => current ? { ...current, ...change } : current);
 373:     else patchSession(change);

 386:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 387:         flipped: session.flipped,
 388:         coordinates: session.coordinates,

 390:       setStudyMode(true);

 392:       setStudyMode(false);

 396:     setPromotionRequest(null);

 399:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 400:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 401:       } else {
 402:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 403:       }
 404:     } catch {
 405:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 406:     }

 409:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 410:     try {
 411:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 412:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 413:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 414:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 415:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 416:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 417:       setBook(opened);
 418:       setSession(nextSession);
 419:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 420:       setError("");
 421:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 422:     } catch (cause) {
 423:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 424:     }
 425:   }

 427:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 428:     if (!file) return;
 429:     try {
 430:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 431:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 432:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 433:       const now = Date.now();
 434:       const created: BookRecord = {
 435:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 436:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 437:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 438:         byteLength: file.size,
 439:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 440:         addedAt: now,
 441:       };
 442:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 443:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 444:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 445:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 446:       setBook(created);
 447:       setSession(blank);
 448:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 449:       setError("");
 450:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 451:     } catch (cause) {
 452:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 453:     }
 454:   }

 456:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 457:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 458: 
 459:     try {
 460:       await removeBook(item.id);
 461:       await removeSession(item.id);
 462: 
 463:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 464:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 465:         const next = { ...current };
 466:         delete next[item.id];
 467:         return next;
 468:       });
 469: 
 470:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 471:         setBook(null);
 472:         setSession(null);
 473:         setPdf(null);
 474:       }
 475: 
 476:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 477:       setError("");
 478:     } catch (cause) {
 479:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 480:     }
 481:   }
 482:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 483:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 484:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 485:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 486:     try {
 487:       await putBook(renamed);
 488:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 489:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 490:     } catch (cause) {
 491:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 492:     }
 493:   }

 496:     if (!session) return;
 497:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });
 498:   }

 500:   function goToPage(value: number) {

 502:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });
 503:   }

 505:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 506:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 507:     try {
 508:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 509:       setSession({
 510:         ...activeSession,
 511:         originalFen: fen,
 512:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 513:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 514:         moves: [],
 515:         moveIndex: 0,
 516:       });
 517:       setLastMove(null);
 518:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 519:       setUserArrows([]);
 520:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 521:       return true;
 522:     } catch (cause) {
 523:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 524:       return false;
 525:     }
 526:   }

 538:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");

 591:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 592:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 593:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 594:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 595:       return;
 596:     }
 597:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 598:     try {
 599:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 600:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 601:       preview.width = crop.width;
 602:       preview.height = crop.height;
 603:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 604:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 605:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 606:     } catch (cause) {
 607:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 608:       return;
 609:     }
 610:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 611:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 612:     setTransferFen("");
 613:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 614:         setRecognitionError("");
 615:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 616:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 617:     try {
 618:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 619:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 620:       });
 621:       const form = new FormData();
 622:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 623:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 624:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 625:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 626:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 627:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 628:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 629:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 630:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 631:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 632:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 633:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 634:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 635:       }
 636:     } catch (cause) {
 637:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 638:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 639:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 640:     }
 641:   }

 643:   function closeTransfer() {
 644:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 645:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 646:     setTransferPreview("");
 647:     setTransferFen("");
 648:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 649:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 650:     setRecognitionError("");
 651:       }

 654:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 655:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 656:       setGameEndOverlay({
 657:         title: "Checkmate",
 658:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 659:       });
 660:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 661:       setGameEndOverlay({
 662:         title: "Stalemate",
 663:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 664:       });
 665:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 666:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 667:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 668:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 669:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 670:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 671:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 672:     } else {
 673:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 674:     }
 675:   }

 677:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 678:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 679:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 680:     try {
 681:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 682:       const result = currentGame.move({
 683:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 684:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 685:         promotion: piece,
 686:       });
 687:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 688:       patchBoardSession({
 689:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 690:         moves: nextMoves,
 691:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 692:       });
 693:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 694:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 695:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 696:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 697:       setError("");
 698:     } catch {
 699:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 700:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 701:     }
 702:   }
 703: 
 704:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 705:     if (!boardSession) return;
 706:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 707:     try {
 708:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 709:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 710:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 711:       if (promote) {
 712:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 713:         return;
 714:       }
 715:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 716:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 717:       patchBoardSession({
 718:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 719:         moves: nextMoves,
 720:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 721:       });
 722:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 723:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 724:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 725:       setError("");
 726:     } catch {
 727:       const piece = game.get(to);
 728:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 729:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 730:     }
 731:   }
 732: 
 733:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 734:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 735:     setRedSquares([]);
 736: 
 737:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 738:       setUserArrows([]);
 739:       setArrowStart(null);
 740:       setArrowHover(null);
 741:       return;
 742:     }
 743: if (!boardSession) return;
 744:     if (annotationMode) {
 745:       if (!arrowStart) {
 746:         setArrowStart(square);
 747:         return;
 748:       }
 749:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 750:       setArrowStart(null);
 751:       setArrowHover(null);
 752:       return;
 753:     }
 754:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 755:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 756:       return;
 757:     }
 758:     const piece = game.get(square);
 759:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 760:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 761:   }

 763:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 764:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 765: 
 766:   event.preventDefault();
 767: 
 768:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 769:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 770:     event.clientX,
 771:     event.clientY,
 772:     bounds,
 773:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 774:   );
 775: 
 776:   if (!square) return;
 777: 
 778:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 779:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 780:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 781:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 782:   setArrowStart(square);
 783:   setArrowHover(square);
 784: 
 785:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 786: }
 787: 
 788:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 789:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 790:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 791:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
 792:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 793:     setArrowHover(square);
 794:   }
 795: 
 796:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 797:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 798: 
 799:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 800: 
 801:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 802:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 803:     event.clientX,
 804:     event.clientY,
 805:     bounds,
 806:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 807:   );
 808: 
 809:   if (to && to !== from) {
 810:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 811:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 812:   } else {
 813:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 814:   }
 815: 
 816:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 817:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 818:   setArrowStart(null);
 819:   setArrowHover(null);
 820: }

 822:   function cancelBoardArrowGesture() {
 823:     arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 824:     setArrowStart(null);
 825:     setArrowHover(null);
 826:   }
 827: 
 828:   function jumpToMove(index: number) {
 829:     if (!boardSession) return;
 830:     try {
 831:       const next = makePosition(boardSession.lineBaseFen, boardSession.moves, index);
 832:       const last = next.history({ verbose: true }).at(-1);
 833:       patchBoardSession({ moveIndex: index, currentFen: next.fen() });
 834:       setLastMove(last ? { from: last.from, to: last.to } : null);
 835:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 836:     } catch (cause) {
 837:       setError(`Could not navigate to move: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 838:     }
 839:   }

 887:       ...current,
 888:       candidatesByPage: {
 889:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 890:         [String(current.page)]: [],

 898:   async function detectBoards() {
 899:     if (detecting) {
 900:       stopBoardScan();
 901:       return;
 902:     }
 903: 
 904:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 905:     if (!API_BASE) {
 906:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 907:       return;
 908:     }
 909: 
 910:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 911:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 912:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 913:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 914: 
 915:     setDetecting(true);
 916:     setError("");
 917:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 918:     patchSession((current) => ({
 919:       ...current,
 920:       candidatesByPage: {
 921:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 922:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 923:       },
 924:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 925:     }));
 926: 
 927:     try {
 928:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 929:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 930:           (blob) => blob
 931:             ? resolve(blob)
 932:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 933:           "image/png",
 934:         );
 935:       });
 936: 
 937:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 938: 
 939:       const form = new FormData();
 940:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 941: 
 942:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 943:         method: "POST",
 944:         body: form,
 945:         signal: abortController.signal,
 946:       });
 947: 
 948:       if (!response.ok) {
 949:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 950:       }
 951: 
 952:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 953:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 954:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 955:       );
 956: 
 957:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 958: 
 959:       patchSession((current) => ({
 960:         ...current,
 961:         candidatesByPage: {
 962:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 963:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 964:         },
 965:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 966:       }));
 967: 
 968:       setNotice(
 969:         candidates.length
 970:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 971:           : "No board candidates found.",
 972:       );
 973:     } catch (cause) {
 974:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 975: 
 976:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 977:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 978:       } else {
 979:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 980:       }
 981:     } finally {
 982:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 983:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 984:         setDetecting(false);
 985:       }
 986:     }
 987:   }
 988:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {
 989:     const box = canvasRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
 990:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;
 991:   }

 993:   function startCropEdit(
 994:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
 995:     candidate: Candidate,
 996:     handle: CropHandle,
 997:   ) {
 998:     event.stopPropagation();
 999:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1000:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;
1001:     if (!point || !stage) return;
1002:     cropEditStartRef.current = { candidate, handle, point };
1003:     stage.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1004:   }

1006:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1007:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1008:     if (!manualMode) return;
1009: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1010: if (!canvas) return;
1011: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1012: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1013: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1014: if (
1015:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1016:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1017:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1018:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1019: ) return;
1020:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1021:     if (!point) return;
1022:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1023:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1024:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1025:     setDragSelection(selection);
1026:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1027:   }

1029:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1030:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1031:     if (edit) {
1032:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1033:       if (!point || !session) return;
1034:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1035:       patchSession((current) => {
1036:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1037:         return {
1038:           ...current,
1039:           candidatesByPage: {
1040:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1041:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1042:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1043:           },
1044:         };
1045:       });
1046:       return;
1047:     }
1048:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1049:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1050:     if (point) {
1051:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1052:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1053:       setDragSelection(selection);
1054:     }
1055:   }
1056: 
1057:   function finishRegion() {
1058:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1059:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1060:       return;
1061:     }
1062:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1063:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1064:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1065:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1066:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1067:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1068:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1069:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1070:     setDragSelection(null);
1071:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1072:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1073:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1074:       x, y, width, height,
1075:       relativeScore: 1,
1076:       source: "manual",
1077:     };
1078:     patchSession((current) => ({
1079:       ...current,
1080:       candidatesByPage: {
1081:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1082:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1083:       },
1084:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1085:     }));
1086:     setManualMode(false);
1087:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1088:   }
1089: 
1090:   function cancelRegion() {
1091:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1092:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1093:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1094:     setDragSelection(null);
1095:   }

1097:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1098:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1099:     try {
1100:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1101:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1102:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1103:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1104:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1105:       const scale = mode === "width"
1106:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1107:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1108:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1109:     } catch (cause) {
1110:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1111:     }
1112:   }

  41: 
  42: const PIECE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  43:   "": "Empty square", P: "White pawn", N: "White knight", B: "White bishop",
  44:   R: "White rook", Q: "White queen", K: "White king", p: "Black pawn",
  45:   n: "Black knight", b: "Black bishop", r: "Black rook", q: "Black queen", k: "Black king",
  46: };
  47: const PIECE_ASSETS: Record<string, string> = {
  48:   P: "wp", N: "wn", B: "wb", R: "wr", Q: "wq", K: "wk",
  49:   p: "bp", n: "bn", b: "bb", r: "br", q: "bq", k: "bk",
  50: };
  51: 
  52: function readableDate(timestamp: number): string {
  53:   if (!timestamp) return "Not opened";
  54:   const elapsed = Date.now() - timestamp;
  55:   if (elapsed < 60_000) return "Just now";
  56:   if (elapsed < 3_600_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 60_000)}m ago`;
  57:   if (elapsed < 86_400_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 3_600_000)}h ago`;
  58:   return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString();
  59: }
  60: 
  61: function squareName(fileIndex: number, rankIndex: number): Square {
  62:   return `${"abcdefgh"[fileIndex]}${rankIndex + 1}` as Square;
  63: }
  64: 
  65: function normalizedCandidate(value: CandidateInput, index: number): Candidate {
  66:   const { relative_score, confidence, ...candidate } = value;
  67:   return {
  68:     ...candidate,
  69:     id: candidate.id || `candidate-${index + 1}`,
  70:     source: candidate.source ?? "automatic",
  71:     relativeScore: candidate.relativeScore ?? relative_score ?? confidence ?? 0,
  72:   };
  73: }

 392:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 393:     if (!file) return;
 394:     try {
 395:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 396:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 397:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 398:       const now = Date.now();
 399:       const created: BookRecord = {
 400:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 401:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 402:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 403:         byteLength: file.size,
 404:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 405:         addedAt: now,
 406:       };
 407:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 408:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 409:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 410:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 411:       setBook(created);
 412:       setSession(blank);
 413:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 414:       setError("");
 415:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 416:     } catch (cause) {
 417:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 418:     }
 419:   }

 540:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 541:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 542:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 543:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 544:       return;
 545:     }
 546:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 547:     try {
 548:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 549:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 550:       preview.width = crop.width;
 551:       preview.height = crop.height;
 552:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 553:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 554:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 555:     } catch (cause) {
 556:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 557:       return;
 558:     }
 559:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 560:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 561:     setTransferFen("");
 562:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 563:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 564:     setRecognitionError("");
 565:     setTransferPiece("P");
 566:     const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 567:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 568:     try {
 569:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 570:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 571:       });
 572:       const form = new FormData();
 573:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 574:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 575:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 576:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 577:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 578:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 579:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 580:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 581:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 582:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 583:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 584:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 585:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 586:       }
 587:     } catch (cause) {
 588:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 589:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 590:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 591:     }
 592:   }
 593: 
 594:   function closeTransfer() {
 595:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 596:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 597:     setTransferPreview("");
 598:     setTransferFen("");
 599:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 600:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 601:     setRecognitionError("");
 602:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 603:   }

 605:   function editTransferSquare(displayRow: number, displayCol: number) {
 606:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 607:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 608:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a six-field FEN before editing individual squares.");
 609:       return;
 610:     }
 611:     const board = parseFenPlacement(fields[0]);
 612:     if (!board) {
 613:       setRecognitionError("The FEN piece placement is invalid. Correct it before editing squares.");
 614:       return;
 615:     }
 616:     const row = displayRow;
 617:     const col = displayCol;
 618:     try {
 619:       const placement = setFenPiece(fields[0], row, col, transferPiece);
 620:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, placement));
 621:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 622:       setRecognitionError("");
 623:     } catch (cause) {
 624:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 625:     }
 626:   }
 627: 
 628:   function flipTransferPosition() {
 629:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 630:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 631:       setRecognitionError("Recognize a position or enter a complete FEN before flipping it.");
 632:       return;
 633:     }
 634:     try {
 635:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, flipFenPlacement(fields[0])));
 636:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 637:       setRecognitionError("");
 638:     } catch (cause) {
 639:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 640:     }
 641:   }
 642: 
 643:   function confirmTransfer() {
 644:     if (!transferCandidate) return;
 645:     if (!transferFen.trim()) {
 646:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a FEN position first.");
 647:       return;
 648:     }
 649:     if (moveToPosition(transferFen.trim())) {
 650:       closeTransfer();
 651:     }
 652:   }
 653: 
 654:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 655:     if (!session) return;
 656:     try {
 657:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 658:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 659:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 660:       let promotion: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" = "q";
 661:       if (promote) {
 662:         const choice = window.prompt("Promote to queen, rook, bishop, or knight? (q/r/b/n)", "q")?.toLowerCase();
 663:         if (!choice) return;
 664:         switch (choice) {
 665:           case "q": promotion = "q"; break;
 666:           case "r": promotion = "r"; break;
 667:           case "b": promotion = "b"; break;
 668:           case "n": promotion = "n"; break;
 669:           default:
 670:             setError("Promotion must be q, r, b, or n.");
 671:             return;
 672:         }
 673:       }
 674:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to, promotion });
 675:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 676:       patchSession({
 677:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 678:         moves: nextMoves,
 679:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 680:       });
 681:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 682:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 683:       setError("");
 684:     } catch {
 685:       const piece = game.get(to);
 686:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 687:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 688:     }
 689:   }
 690: 
 691:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 692:     if (!session) return;
 693:     if (annotationMode) {
 694:       if (!arrowStart) {
 695:         setArrowStart(square);
 696:         return;
 697:       }
 698:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 699:       setArrowStart(null);
 700:       setArrowHover(null);
 701:       return;
 702:     }
 703:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 704:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 705:       return;
 706:     }
 707:     const piece = game.get(square);
 708:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 709:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 710:   }

 739:     setArrowHover(null);

 749:     if (!session) return;

 770:   async function detectBoards() {
 771:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 772:     if (!API_BASE) {
 773:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Start the optional CV service and set VITE_API_BASE_URL, or draw a board region manually.");
 774:       return;
 775:     }
 776:     setDetecting(true);
 777:     setError("");
 778:     try {
 779:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 780:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")), "image/png");
 781:       });
 782:       const form = new FormData();
 783:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 784:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 785:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 786:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 787:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map((item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index));
 788:       patchSession((current) => ({
 789:         ...current,
 790:         candidatesByPage: { ...current.candidatesByPage, [String(current.page)]: candidates },
 791:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 792:       }));
 793:       setNotice(candidates.length ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.` : "No board candidates found. You can draw a region manually.");
 794:     } catch (cause) {
 795:       setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 796:     } finally {
 797:       setDetecting(false);
 798:     }
 799:   }

 819:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 820:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 821:     if (!manualMode) return;
 822: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 823: if (!canvas) return;
 824: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 825: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 826: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 827: if (
 828:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 829:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 830:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 831:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 832: ) return;
 833:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 834:     if (!point) return;
 835:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 836:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 837:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 838:     setDragSelection(selection);
 839:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 840:   }

 842:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 843:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 844:     if (edit) {
 845:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 846:       if (!point || !session) return;
 847:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 848:       patchSession((current) => {
 849:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 850:         return {
 851:           ...current,
 852:           candidatesByPage: {
 853:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 854:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 855:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 856:           },
 857:         };
 858:       });
 859:       return;
 860:     }
 861:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
 862:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 863:     if (point) {
 864:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 865:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 866:       setDragSelection(selection);
 867:     }
 868:   }
 869: 
 870:   function finishRegion() {
 871:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
 872:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 873:       return;
 874:     }
 875:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
 876:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
 877:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
 878:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
 879:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
 880:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
 881:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 882:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 883:     setDragSelection(null);
 884:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
 885:     const candidate: Candidate = {
 886:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
 887:       x, y, width, height,
 888:       relativeScore: 1,
 889:       source: "manual",
 890:     };
 891:     patchSession((current) => ({
 892:       ...current,
 893:       candidatesByPage: {
 894:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 895:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
 896:       },
 897:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
 898:     }));
 899:     setManualMode(false);
 900:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
 901:   }

 904:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 905:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 906:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 907:     setDragSelection(null);
 908:   }

 910:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
 911:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
 912:     try {
 913:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
 914:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
 915:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
 916:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
 917:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
 918:       const scale = mode === "width"
 919:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
 920:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
 921:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
 922:     } catch (cause) {
 923:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 924:     }
 925:   }

 435:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 436:         setBook(null);
 437:         setSession(null);
 438:         setPdf(null);
 439:       }
 440: 
 441:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 442:       setError("");
 443:     } catch (cause) {
 444:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 445:     }
 446:   }
 447:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 448:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 449:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 450:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 451:     try {
 452:       await putBook(renamed);
 453:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 454:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 455:     } catch (cause) {
 456:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 457:     }
 458:   }

 540:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 541:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 542:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 543:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 544:       return;
 545:     }
 546:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 547:     try {
 548:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 549:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 550:       preview.width = crop.width;
 551:       preview.height = crop.height;
 552:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 553:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 554:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 555:     } catch (cause) {
 556:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 557:       return;
 558:     }
 559:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 560:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 561:     setTransferFen("");
 562:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 563:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 564:     setRecognitionError("");
 565:     setTransferPiece("P");
 566:     const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 567:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 568:     try {
 569:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 570:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 571:       });
 572:       const form = new FormData();
 573:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 574:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 575:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 576:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 577:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 578:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 579:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 580:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 581:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 582:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 583:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 584:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 585:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 586:       }
 587:     } catch (cause) {
 588:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 589:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 590:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 591:     }
 592:   }
 593: 
 594:   function closeTransfer() {
 595:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 596:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 597:     setTransferPreview("");
 598:     setTransferFen("");
 599:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 600:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 601:     setRecognitionError("");
 602:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 603:   }

 605:   function editTransferSquare(displayRow: number, displayCol: number) {
 606:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 607:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 608:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a six-field FEN before editing individual squares.");
 609:       return;
 610:     }
 611:     const board = parseFenPlacement(fields[0]);
 612:     if (!board) {
 613:       setRecognitionError("The FEN piece placement is invalid. Correct it before editing squares.");
 614:       return;
 615:     }
 616:     const row = displayRow;
 617:     const col = displayCol;
 618:     try {
 619:       const placement = setFenPiece(fields[0], row, col, transferPiece);
 620:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, placement));
 621:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 622:       setRecognitionError("");
 623:     } catch (cause) {
 624:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 625:     }
 626:   }
 627: 
 628:   function flipTransferPosition() {
 629:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 630:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 631:       setRecognitionError("Recognize a position or enter a complete FEN before flipping it.");
 632:       return;
 633:     }
 634:     try {
 635:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, flipFenPlacement(fields[0])));
 636:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 637:       setRecognitionError("");
 638:     } catch (cause) {
 639:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 640:     }
 641:   }

 643:   function confirmTransfer() {
 644:     if (!transferCandidate) return;
 645:     if (!transferFen.trim()) {
 646:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a FEN position first.");
 647:       return;
 648:     }
 649:     if (moveToPosition(transferFen.trim())) {
 650:       closeTransfer();
 651:     }
 652:   }
 653: 
 654:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 655:     if (!session) return;
 656:     try {
 657:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 658:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 659:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 660:       let promotion: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" = "q";
 661:       if (promote) {
 662:         const choice = window.prompt("Promote to queen, rook, bishop, or knight? (q/r/b/n)", "q")?.toLowerCase();
 663:         if (!choice) return;
 664:         switch (choice) {
 665:           case "q": promotion = "q"; break;
 666:           case "r": promotion = "r"; break;
 667:           case "b": promotion = "b"; break;
 668:           case "n": promotion = "n"; break;
 669:           default:
 670:             setError("Promotion must be q, r, b, or n.");
 671:             return;
 672:         }
 673:       }
 674:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to, promotion });
 675:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 676:       patchSession({
 677:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 678:         moves: nextMoves,
 679:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 680:       });
 681:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 682:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 683:       setError("");
 684:     } catch {
 685:       const piece = game.get(to);
 686:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 687:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 688:     }
 689:   }
 690: 
 691:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 692:     if (!session) return;
 693:     if (annotationMode) {
 694:       if (!arrowStart) {
 695:         setArrowStart(square);
 696:         return;
 697:       }
 698:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 699:       setArrowStart(null);
 700:       setArrowHover(null);
 701:       return;
 702:     }
 703:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 704:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 705:       return;
 706:     }
 707:     const piece = game.get(square);
 708:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 709:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 710:   }

 770:   async function detectBoards() {
 771:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 772:     if (!API_BASE) {
 773:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Start the optional CV service and set VITE_API_BASE_URL, or draw a board region manually.");
 774:       return;
 775:     }
 776:     setDetecting(true);
 777:     setError("");
 778:     try {
 779:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 780:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")), "image/png");
 781:       });
 782:       const form = new FormData();
 783:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 784:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 785:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 786:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 787:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map((item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index));
 788:       patchSession((current) => ({
 789:         ...current,
 790:         candidatesByPage: { ...current.candidatesByPage, [String(current.page)]: candidates },
 791:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 792:       }));
 793:       setNotice(candidates.length ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.` : "No board candidates found. You can draw a region manually.");
 794:     } catch (cause) {
 795:       setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 796:     } finally {
 797:       setDetecting(false);
 798:     }
 799:   }

 819:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 820:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 821:     if (!manualMode) return;
 822: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 823: if (!canvas) return;
 824: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 825: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 826: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 827: if (
 828:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 829:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 830:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 831:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 832: ) return;
 833:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 834:     if (!point) return;
 835:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 836:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };

 842:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 843:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 844:     if (edit) {
 845:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 846:       if (!point || !session) return;
 847:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 848:       patchSession((current) => {
 849:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 850:         return {
 851:           ...current,
 852:           candidatesByPage: {
 853:             ...current.candidatesByPage,

 855:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 856:           },
 857:         };
 858:       });
 859:       return;
 860:     }
 861:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
 862:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 863:     if (point) {
 864:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };

 870:   function finishRegion() {
 871:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
 872:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 873:       return;
 874:     }
 875:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
 876:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
 877:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
 878:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
 879:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
 880:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
 881:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 882:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 883:     setDragSelection(null);
 884:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
 885:     const candidate: Candidate = {
 886:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
 887:       x, y, width, height,
 888:       relativeScore: 1,
 889:       source: "manual",
 890:     };
 891:     patchSession((current) => ({
 892:       ...current,
 893:       candidatesByPage: {
 894:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 895:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
 896:       },
 897:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
 898:     }));
 899:     setManualMode(false);
 900:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
 901:   }

 910:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
 911:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
 912:     try {
 913:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
 914:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
 915:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
 916:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
 917:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
 918:       const scale = mode === "width"
 919:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
 920:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
 921:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
 922:     } catch (cause) {
 923:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 924:     }
 925:   }

 302:     try { return makePosition(session?.lineBaseFen ?? START_FEN, session?.moves ?? [], session?.moveIndex ?? 0).history({ verbose: true }); }
 303:     catch { return []; }
 304:   }, [session]);
 305:   const highlightedMove = lastMove ?? (moveHistory.length
 306:     ? { from: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].from, to: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].to }
 307:     : null);
 308:   const engineArrow = useMemo(
 309:     () => engineEnabled ? parseBestMove(engineScore?.bestMove) : null,
 310:     [engineEnabled, engineScore?.bestMove],
 311:   );
 312: 
 313:   useEffect(() => {
 314:     setUserArrows([]);
 315:     setArrowStart(null);
 316:     setArrowHover(null);
 317:     setAnnotationMode(false);
 318:   }, [book?.id, session?.currentFen]);
 319: 
 320:   useEffect(() => {
 321:     if (engineEnabled) engineRef.current?.analyze(game.fen(), engineDepth);
 322:   }, [engineEnabled, session?.currentFen, session?.moveIndex, engineDepth]);
 323: 
 324:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 325:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 326:   }
 327: 
 328:   function toggleEngine() {
 329:     if (engineEnabled) {
 330:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 331:       engineRef.current = null;
 332:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 333:       setEngineStatus("off");
 334:       setEngineScore(null);
 335:       setEngineMessage("");
 336:       return;
 337:     }
 338:     try {
 339:       setEngineScore(null);
 340:       setEngineMessage("");
 341:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 342:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 343:         (status, message) => {
 344:           setEngineStatus(status);
 345:           if (status === "error") {
 346:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 347:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 348:             setEngineScore(null);
 349:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 350:             engineRef.current = null;
 351:           }
 352:         },
 353:         setEngineScore,
 354:       );
 355:       engineRef.current = client;
 356:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 357:     } catch (cause) {
 358:       setEngineStatus("error");
 359:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 360:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 361:     }
 362:   }
 363: 
 364:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 365:     setSession((current) => {
 366:       if (!current) return current;
 367:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 368:     });
 369:   }

 371:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 372:     try {
 373:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 374:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 375:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 376:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 377:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 378:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 379:       setBook(opened);
 380:       setSession(nextSession);
 381:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 382:       setError("");
 383:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 384:     } catch (cause) {
 385:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 386:     }
 387:   }
 388: 
 389:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 390:     if (!file) return;
 391:     try {
 392:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 393:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 394:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 395:       const now = Date.now();
 396:       const created: BookRecord = {
 397:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 398:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 399:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 400:         byteLength: file.size,
 401:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 402:         addedAt: now,
 403:       };
 404:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 405:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 406:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 407:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 408:       setBook(created);
 409:       setSession(blank);
 410:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 411:       setError("");
 412:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 413:     } catch (cause) {
 414:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 415:     }
 416:   }
 417: 
 418:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 419:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 420: 
 421:     try {
 422:       await removeBook(item.id);
 423:       await removeSession(item.id);
 424: 
 425:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 426:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 427:         const next = { ...current };
 428:         delete next[item.id];
 429:         return next;
 430:       });
 431: 
 432:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 433:         setBook(null);
 434:         setSession(null);
 435:         setPdf(null);
 436:       }
 437: 
 438:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 439:       setError("");
 440:     } catch (cause) {
 441:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 442:     }
 443:   }
 444:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 445:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 446:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 447:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 448:     try {
 449:       await putBook(renamed);
 450:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 451:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 452:     } catch (cause) {
 453:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 454:     }
 455:   }

 458:     if (!session) return;
 459:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });
 460:   }

 462:   function goToPage(value: number) {
 463:     if (!session || !Number.isFinite(value)) return;
 464:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });
 465:   }

 467:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 468:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 469:     try {
 470:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 471:       setSession({
 472:         ...activeSession,
 473:         originalFen: fen,
 474:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 475:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 476:         moves: [],
 477:         moveIndex: 0,
 478:       });
 479:       setLastMove(null);
 480:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 481:       setUserArrows([]);
 482:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 483:       return true;
 484:     } catch (cause) {
 485:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 486:       return false;
 487:     }
 488:   }

 491:     const loaded = moveToPosition(fen);
 492:     if (!loaded) return false;
 493:     setEngineScore(null);
 494:     setEngineMessage("");
 495:     if (!engineEnabled) {
 496:       toggleEngine();
 497:     } else {
 498:       engineRef.current?.analyze(fen, engineDepth);
 499:     }
 500:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 501:     return true;
 502:   }

 553:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 554:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 555:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 556:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 557:       return;
 558:     }
 559:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 560:     try {
 561:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 562:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 563:       preview.width = crop.width;
 564:       preview.height = crop.height;
 565:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 566:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 567:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 568:     } catch (cause) {
 569:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 570:       return;
 571:     }
 572:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 573:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 574:     setTransferFen("");
 575:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 576:         setRecognitionError("");
 577:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 578:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 579:     try {
 580:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 581:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 582:       });
 583:       const form = new FormData();
 584:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 585:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 586:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 587:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 588:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 589:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 590:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 591:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 592:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 593:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 594:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 595:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 596:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 597:       }
 598:     } catch (cause) {
 599:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 600:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 601:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 602:     }
 603:   }
 604: 
 605:   function closeTransfer() {
 606:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 607:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 608:     setTransferPreview("");
 609:     setTransferFen("");
 610:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 611:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 612:     setRecognitionError("");
 613:       }

 616:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 617:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 618:       setGameEndOverlay({
 619:         title: "Checkmate",
 620:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 621:       });
 622:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 623:       setGameEndOverlay({
 624:         title: "Stalemate",
 625:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 626:       });
 627:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 628:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 629:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 630:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 631:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 632:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 633:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 634:     } else {
 635:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 636:     }
 637:   }

 639:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 640:     if (!promotionRequest || !session) return;
 641:     try {
 642:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 643:       const result = currentGame.move({
 644:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 645:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 646:         promotion: piece,
 647:       });
 648:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 649:       patchSession({
 650:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 651:         moves: nextMoves,
 652:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 653:       });
 654:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 655:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 656:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 657:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 658:       setError("");
 659:     } catch {
 660:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 661:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 662:     }
 663:   }
 664: 
 665:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 666:     if (!session) return;
 667:     try {
 668:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 669:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 670:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 671:       if (promote) {
 672:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 673:         return;
 674:       }
 675:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 676:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 677:       patchSession({
 678:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 679:         moves: nextMoves,
 680:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 681:       });
 682:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 683:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 684:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 685:       setError("");
 686:     } catch {
 687:       const piece = game.get(to);
 688:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 689:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 690:     }
 691:   }
 692: 
 693:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 694:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 695:     setRedSquares([]);
 696:     
 697:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 698:       setUserArrows([]);
 699:       setArrowStart(null);
 700:       setArrowHover(null);
 701:       return;
 702:     }
 703: if (!session) return;
 704:     if (annotationMode) {
 705:       if (!arrowStart) {
 706:         setArrowStart(square);
 707:         return;
 708:       }
 709:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 710:       setArrowStart(null);
 711:       setArrowHover(null);
 712:       return;
 713:     }
 714:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 715:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 716:       return;
 717:     }
 718:     const piece = game.get(square);
 719:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 720:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 721:   }

 723:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 724:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 725: 
 726:   event.preventDefault();
 727: 
 728:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 729:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 730:     event.clientX,
 731:     event.clientY,
 732:     bounds,
 733:     Boolean(session?.flipped),
 734:   );
 735: 
 736:   if (!square) return;
 737: 
 738:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 739:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 740:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 741:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 742:   setArrowStart(square);
 743:   setArrowHover(square);
 744: 
 745:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 746: }
 747: 
 748:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 749:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 750:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 751:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(session?.flipped));
 752:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 753:     setArrowHover(square);
 754:   }
 755: 
 756:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 757:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 758: 
 759:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 760: 
 761:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 762:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 763:     event.clientX,
 764:     event.clientY,
 765:     bounds,
 766:     Boolean(session?.flipped),
 767:   );
 768: 
 769:   if (to && to !== from) {
 770:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 771:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 772:   } else {
 773:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 774:   }
 775: 
 776:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 777:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 778:   setArrowStart(null);
 779:   setArrowHover(null);
 780: }
