 936:   function clearBoardScan() {
 937:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
 938:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 939: 
 940:     const controller = scanAbortControllerRef.current;
 941:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 942:     controller?.abort();
 943: 
 944:     setDetecting(false);
 945:     setManualMode(false);
 946:     setDragSelection(null);
 947:     setCropEditingId(null);
 948:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 949:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 950: 
 951:     patchSession((current) => ({
 952:       ...current,
 953:       candidatesByPage: {
 954:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 955:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 956:       },
 957:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 958:     }));
 959: 
 960:     setError("");
 961:     setNotice("Board detection cleared.");
 962:   }
 963:   async function detectBoards() {
 964:     if (detecting) {
 965:       stopBoardScan();
 966:       return;
 967:     }
 968: 
 969:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 970:     if (!API_BASE) {
 971:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 972:       return;
 973:     }
 974: 
 975:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 976:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 977:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 978:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 979: 
 980:     setDetecting(true);
 981:     setError("");
 982:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 983:     patchSession((current) => ({
 984:       ...current,
 985:       candidatesByPage: {
 986:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 987:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 988:       },
 989:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 990:     }));
 991: 
 992:     try {
 993:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 994:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 995:           (blob) => blob
 996:             ? resolve(blob)
 997:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 998:           "image/png",
 999:         );
1000:       });
1001: 
1002:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1003: 
1004:       const form = new FormData();
1005:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
1006: 
1007:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
1008:         method: "POST",
1009:         body: form,
1010:         signal: abortController.signal,
1011:       });
1012: 
1013:       if (!response.ok) {
1014:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
1015:       }
1016: 
1017:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
1018:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
1019:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
1020:       );
1021: 
1022:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1023: 
1024:       patchSession((current) => ({
1025:         ...current,
1026:         candidatesByPage: {
1027:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
1028:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
1029:         },
1030:         selectedDiagramId: null,
1031:       }));
1032: 
1033:       setNotice(
1034:         candidates.length
1035:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
1036:           : "No board candidates found.",
1037:       );
1038:     } catch (cause) {
1039:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1040: 
1041:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
1042:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
1043:       } else {
1044:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1045:       }
1046:     } finally {
1047:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
1048:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1049:         setDetecting(false);
1050:       }
1051:     }
1052:   }
1053:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {
1054:     const box = canvasRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
1055:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;
1056:   }

1058:   function startCropEdit(
1059:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
1060:     candidate: Candidate,
1061:     handle: CropHandle,
1062:   ) {
1063:     event.stopPropagation();
1064:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1065:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;
1066:     if (!point || !stage) return;
1067:     cropEditStartRef.current = { candidate, handle, point };
1068:     stage.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1069:   }

1071:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1072:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1073:     if (!manualMode) return;
1074: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1075: if (!canvas) return;
1076: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1077: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1078: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1079: if (
1080:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1081:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1082:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1083:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1084: ) return;
1085:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1086:     if (!point) return;
1087:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1088:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1089:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1090:     setDragSelection(selection);
1091:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1092:   }

1094:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1095:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1096:     if (edit) {
1097:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1098:       if (!point || !session) return;
1099:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1100:       patchSession((current) => {
1101:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1102:         return {
1103:           ...current,
1104:           candidatesByPage: {
1105:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1106:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1107:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1108:           },
1109:         };
1110:       });
1111:       return;
1112:     }
1113:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1114:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1115:     if (point) {
1116:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1117:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1118:       setDragSelection(selection);
1119:     }
1120:   }
1121: 
1122:   function finishRegion() {
1123:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1124:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1125:       return;
1126:     }
1127:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1128:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1129:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1130:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1131:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1132:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1133:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1134:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1135:     setDragSelection(null);
1136:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1137:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1138:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1139:       x, y, width, height,
1140:       relativeScore: 1,
1141:       source: "manual",
1142:     };
1143:     patchSession((current) => ({
1144:       ...current,
1145:       candidatesByPage: {
1146:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1147:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1148:       },
1149:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1150:     }));
1151:     setManualMode(false);
1152:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1153:   }
1154: 
1155:   function cancelRegion() {
1156:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1157:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1158:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1159:     setDragSelection(null);
1160:   }

1162:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1163:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1164:     try {
1165:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1166:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1167:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1168:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1169:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1170:       const scale = mode === "width"
1171:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1172:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1173:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1174:     } catch (cause) {
1175:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1176:     }
1177:   }

  26: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  27:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  28:   if (!match) return uci;
  29:   try {
  30:     const position = new Chess(fen);
  31:     const move = position.move({
  32:       from: match[1] as Square,
  33:       to: match[2] as Square,
  34:       ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  35:     });
  36:     return move.san;
  37:   } catch {
  38:     return uci;
  39:   }
  40: }
  41: 
  42: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {
  43:   const position = new Chess(fen);
  44:   const san: string[] = [];
  45:   for (const uci of pv) {
  46:     const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  47:     if (!match) break;
  48:     try {
  49:       const move = position.move({
  50:         from: match[1] as Square,
  51:         to: match[2] as Square,
  52:         ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  53:       });
  54:       san.push(move.san);
  55:     } catch {
  56:       break;
  57:     }
  58:   }
  59:   return san.join(" ");
  60: }

 377:   function toggleEngine() {
 378:     if (engineEnabled) {
 379:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 380:       engineRef.current = null;
 381:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 382:       setEngineStatus("off");
 383:       setEngineScore(null);
 384:       setEngineMessage("");
 385:       return;
 386:     }
 387:     try {
 388:       setEngineScore(null);
 389:       setEngineMessage("");
 390:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 391:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 392:         (status, message) => {
 393:           setEngineStatus(status);
 394:           if (status === "error") {
 395:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 396:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 397:             setEngineScore(null);
 398:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 399:             engineRef.current = null;
 400:           }
 401:         },
 402:         setEngineScore,
 403:       );
 404:       engineRef.current = client;
 405:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 406:     } catch (cause) {
 407:       setEngineStatus("error");
 408:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 409:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 410:     }
 411:   }

 413:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 414:     setSession((current) => {
 415:       if (!current) return current;
 416:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 417:     });
 418:   }

 422:       setAnalysisBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 423:     } else if (studyMode) {
 424:       setStudyBoard((current) => current ? { ...current, ...change } : current);
 425:     } else {
 426:       patchSession(change);

 464:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {

 467:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 468:       }
 469:     } catch {
 470:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.

 474:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 475:     try {
 476:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 477:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 478:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 479:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 480:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 481:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 482:       setBook(opened);
 483:       setSession(nextSession);
 484:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 485:       setError("");
 486:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 487:     } catch (cause) {
 488:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 489:     }
 490:   }

 492:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 493:     if (!file) return;
 494:     try {
 495:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 496:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 497:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 498:       const now = Date.now();
 499:       const created: BookRecord = {
 500:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 501:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 502:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 503:         byteLength: file.size,
 504:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 505:         addedAt: now,
 506:       };
 507:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 508:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 509:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 510:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 511:       setBook(created);
 512:       setSession(blank);
 513:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 514:       setError("");
 515:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 516:     } catch (cause) {
 517:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 518:     }
 519:   }

 521:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 522:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 523: 
 524:     try {
 525:       await removeBook(item.id);
 526:       await removeSession(item.id);
 527: 
 528:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 529:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 530:         const next = { ...current };
 531:         delete next[item.id];
 532:         return next;
 533:       });
 534: 
 535:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 536:         setBook(null);
 537:         setSession(null);
 538:         setPdf(null);
 539:       }
 540: 
 541:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 542:       setError("");
 543:     } catch (cause) {
 544:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 545:     }
 546:   }
 547:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 548:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 549:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 550:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 551:     try {
 552:       await putBook(renamed);
 553:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 554:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 555:     } catch (cause) {
 556:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 557:     }
 558:   }

 568:   }

 570:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 571:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 572:     try {
 573:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 574:       setSession({
 575:         ...activeSession,
 576:         originalFen: fen,
 577:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 578:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 579:         moves: [],
 580:         moveIndex: 0,
 581:       });
 582:       setLastMove(null);
 583:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 584:       setUserArrows([]);
 585:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 586:       return true;
 587:     } catch (cause) {
 588:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 589:       return false;
 590:     }
 591:   }

 593:   function analyzeManualPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 594:     const loaded = moveToPosition(fen);

 597:     setEngineMessage("");

 599:       toggleEngine();
 600:     } else {
 601:       engineRef.current?.analyze(fen, engineDepth);
 602:     }
 603:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 604:     return true;
 605:   }

 656:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 657:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 658:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 659:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 660:       return;
 661:     }
 662:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 663:     try {
 664:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 665:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 666:       preview.width = crop.width;
 667:       preview.height = crop.height;
 668:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 669:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 670:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 671:     } catch (cause) {
 672:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 673:       return;
 674:     }
 675:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 676:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 677:     setTransferFen("");
 678:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 679:         setRecognitionError("");
 680:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 681:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 682:     try {
 683:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 684:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 685:       });
 686:       const form = new FormData();
 687:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 688:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 689:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 690:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 691:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 692:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 693:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 694:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 695:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 696:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 697:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 698:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 699:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 700:       }
 701:     } catch (cause) {
 702:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 703:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 704:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 705:     }
 706:   }
 707: 
 708:   function closeTransfer() {
 709:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;

 719:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 720:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 721:       setGameEndOverlay({
 722:         title: "Checkmate",
 723:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 724:       });
 725:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 726:       setGameEndOverlay({
 727:         title: "Stalemate",
 728:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 729:       });
 730:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 731:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 732:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 733:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 734:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 735:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 736:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 737:     } else {
 738:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 739:     }
 740:   }
 741: 
 742:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 743:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 744:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 745:     try {
 746:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 747:       const result = currentGame.move({
 748:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 749:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 750:         promotion: piece,
 751:       });
 752:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 753:       patchBoardSession({
 754:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 755:         moves: nextMoves,
 756:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 757:       });
 758:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 759:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 760:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 761:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 762:       setError("");
 763:     } catch {
 764:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 765:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 766:     }
 767:   }
 768: 
 769:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 770:     if (!boardSession) return;
 771:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 772:     try {
 773:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 774:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 775:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 776:       if (promote) {
 777:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 778:         return;
 779:       }
 780:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 781:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 782:       patchBoardSession({
 783:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 784:         moves: nextMoves,
 785:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 786:       });
 787:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 788:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 789:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 790:       setError("");
 791:     } catch {
 792:       const piece = game.get(to);
 793:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 794:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 795:     }
 796:   }

 798:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 799:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 800:     setRedSquares([]);
 801: 
 802:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 803:       setUserArrows([]);
 804:       setArrowStart(null);
 805:       setArrowHover(null);
 806:       return;
 807:     }
 808: if (!boardSession) return;
 809:     if (annotationMode) {
 810:       if (!arrowStart) {
 811:         setArrowStart(square);
 812:         return;
 813:       }
 814:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 815:       setArrowStart(null);
 816:       setArrowHover(null);
 817:       return;
 818:     }
 819:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 820:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 821:       return;
 822:     }
 823:     const piece = game.get(square);
 824:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 825:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 826:   }

 950:

 963:   async function detectBoards() {
 964:     if (detecting) {
 965:       stopBoardScan();
 966:       return;
 967:     }
 968: 
 969:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 970:     if (!API_BASE) {
 971:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 972:       return;
 973:     }
 974: 
 975:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 976:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 977:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 978:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 979: 
 980:     setDetecting(true);
 981:     setError("");
 982:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 983:     patchSession((current) => ({
 984:       ...current,
 985:       candidatesByPage: {
 986:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 987:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 988:       },
 989:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 990:     }));
 991: 
 992:     try {
 993:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 994:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 995:           (blob) => blob
 996:             ? resolve(blob)
 997:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 998:           "image/png",
 999:         );
1000:       });
1001: 
1002:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1003: 
1004:       const form = new FormData();
1005:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
1006: 
1007:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
1008:         method: "POST",
1009:         body: form,
1010:         signal: abortController.signal,
1011:       });
1012: 
1013:       if (!response.ok) {
1014:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
1015:       }
1016: 
1017:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
1018:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
1019:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
1020:       );
1021: 
1022:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1023: 
1024:       patchSession((current) => ({
1025:         ...current,
1026:         candidatesByPage: {
1027:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
1028:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
1029:         },
1030:         selectedDiagramId: null,
1031:       }));
1032: 
1033:       setNotice(
1034:         candidates.length
1035:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
1036:           : "No board candidates found.",
1037:       );
1038:     } catch (cause) {
1039:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1040: 
1041:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
1042:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
1043:       } else {
1044:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1045:       }
1046:     } finally {
1047:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
1048:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1049:         setDetecting(false);
1050:       }
1051:     }
1052:   }

1071:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1072:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1073:     if (!manualMode) return;
1074: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1075: if (!canvas) return;
1076: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1077: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1078: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1079: if (
1080:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1081:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1082:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1083:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1084: ) return;
1085:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1086:     if (!point) return;
1087:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1088:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1089:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1090:     setDragSelection(selection);
1091:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1092:   }

1094:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1095:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1096:     if (edit) {
1097:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1098:       if (!point || !session) return;
1099:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1100:       patchSession((current) => {
1101:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1102:         return {
1103:           ...current,
1104:           candidatesByPage: {
1105:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1106:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1107:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1108:           },
1109:         };
1110:       });
1111:       return;
1112:     }
1113:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1114:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1115:     if (point) {
1116:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1117:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1118:       setDragSelection(selection);
1119:     }
1120:   }

1122:   function finishRegion() {
1123:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1124:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1125:       return;
1126:     }
1127:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1128:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1129:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1130:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1131:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1132:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1133:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1134:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1135:     setDragSelection(null);
1136:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1137:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1138:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1139:       x, y, width, height,
1140:       relativeScore: 1,
1141:       source: "manual",
1142:     };
1143:     patchSession((current) => ({
1144:       ...current,
1145:       candidatesByPage: {
1146:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1147:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1148:       },
1149:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1150:     }));
1151:     setManualMode(false);
1152:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1153:   }

1162:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1163:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1164:     try {
1165:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1166:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1167:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1168:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1169:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1170:       const scale = mode === "width"
1171:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1172:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1173:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1174:     } catch (cause) {
1175:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1176:     }
1177:   }

  27: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  28:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  29:   if (!match) return uci;
  30:   try {
  31:     const position = new Chess(fen);
  32:     const move = position.move({
  33:       from: match[1] as Square,
  34:       to: match[2] as Square,
  35:       ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  36:     });
  37:     return move.san;
  38:   } catch {
  39:     return uci;
  40:   }
  41: }
  42: 
  43: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {
  44:   const position = new Chess(fen);
  45:   const san: string[] = [];
  46:   for (const uci of pv) {
  47:     const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  48:     if (!match) break;
  49:     try {
  50:       const move = position.move({
  51:         from: match[1] as Square,
  52:         to: match[2] as Square,
  53:         ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  54:       });
  55:       san.push(move.san);
  56:     } catch {
  57:       break;
  58:     }
  59:   }
  60:   return san.join(" ");
  61: }

 372:   }, [game, selectedSquare]);
 373:   const pieceSquares = game.board();
 374:   const moveHistory = useMemo(() => {
 375:     try { return makePosition(boardSession?.lineBaseFen ?? START_FEN, boardSession?.moves ?? [], boardSession?.moveIndex ?? 0).history({ verbose: true }); }
 376:     catch { return []; }
 377:   }, [boardSession]);
 378:   const highlightedMove = lastMove ?? (moveHistory.length
 379:     ? { from: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].from, to: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].to }
 380:     : null);
 381:   const engineArrow = useMemo(
 382:     () => engineEnabled ? parseBestMove(engineScore?.bestMove) : null,
 383:     [engineEnabled, engineScore?.bestMove],
 384:   );
 385: 
 386:   useEffect(() => {
 387:     setUserArrows([]);
 388:     setArrowStart(null);
 389:     setArrowHover(null);
 390:     setAnnotationMode(false);
 391:   }, [book?.id, session?.currentFen]);
 392: 
 393:   useEffect(() => {
 394:     if (engineEnabled && boardSession) {
 395:       engineRef.current?.analyze(game.fen(), engineDepth);
 396:     }
 397:   }, [engineEnabled, boardSession?.currentFen, boardSession?.moveIndex, game, engineDepth]);
 398: 
 399:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 400:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 401:   }
 402: 
 403:   function toggleEngine() {
 404:     if (engineEnabled) {
 405:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 406:       engineRef.current = null;
 407:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 408:       setEngineStatus("off");
 409:       setEngineScore(null);
 410:       setEngineMessage("");
 411:       return;
 412:     }
 413:     try {
 414:       setEngineScore(null);
 415:       setEngineMessage("");
 416:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 417:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 418:         (status, message) => {
 419:           setEngineStatus(status);
 420:           if (status === "error") {
 421:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 422:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 423:             setEngineScore(null);
 424:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 425:             engineRef.current = null;
 426:           }
 427:         },
 428:         setEngineScore,
 429:       );
 430:       engineRef.current = client;
 431:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 432:     } catch (cause) {
 433:       setEngineStatus("error");
 434:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 435:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 436:     }
 437:   }
 438: 
 439:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 440:     setSession((current) => {
 441:       if (!current) return current;
 442:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 443:     });
 444:   }
 445: 
 446:   function patchBoardSession(change: Partial<StudyBoardState>) {
 447:     if (workspaceMode === "opening-explorer") {
 448:       return;
 449:     }
 450: 
 451:     if (workspaceMode === "analysis") {
 452:       setAnalysisBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 453:     } else if (studyMode) {
 454:       setStudyBoard((current) => current ? { ...current, ...change } : current);
 455:     } else {
 456:       patchSession(change);
 457:     }
 458:   }
 459:   async function toggleStudyMode() {
 460:     if (!studyMode) {
 461:       if (!session) {
 462:         setError("Open a book before entering study mode.");
 463:         return;
 464:       }
 465:       setStudyBoard({
 466:         lineBaseFen: session.lineBaseFen,
 467:         currentFen: session.currentFen,
 468:         moves: [...session.moves],
 469:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 470:         flipped: session.flipped,
 471:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 472:       });
 473:       setStudyMode(true);
 474:     } else {
 475:       // Preserve the latest Focus Mode board when returning to normal mode.
 476:       if (studyBoard) {
 477:         patchSession({
 478:           lineBaseFen: studyBoard.lineBaseFen,
 479:           currentFen: studyBoard.currentFen,
 480:           moves: [...studyBoard.moves],
 481:           moveIndex: studyBoard.moveIndex,
 482:           flipped: studyBoard.flipped,
 483:           coordinates: studyBoard.coordinates,
 484:         });
 485:       }
 486:       setStudyMode(false);
 487:     }
 488:     setLastMove(null);
 489:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 490:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 491:   
 492:     try {
 493:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 494:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 495:       } else {
 496:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 497:       }
 498:     } catch {
 499:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 500:     }
 501: }

 503:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 504:     try {
 505:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 506:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 507:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 508:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 509:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 510:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 511:       setBook(opened);
 512:       setSession(nextSession);
 513:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 514:       setError("");
 515:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 516:     } catch (cause) {
 517:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 518:     }
 519:   }
 520: 
 521:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 522:     if (!file) return;
 523:     try {
 524:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 525:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 526:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 527:       const now = Date.now();
 528:       const created: BookRecord = {
 529:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 530:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 531:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 532:         byteLength: file.size,
 533:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 534:         addedAt: now,
 535:       };
 536:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 537:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 538:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 539:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 540:       setBook(created);
 541:       setSession(blank);
 542:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 543:       setError("");
 544:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 545:     } catch (cause) {
 546:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 547:     }
 548:   }
 549: 
 550:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 551:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 552: 
 553:     try {
 554:       await removeBook(item.id);
 555:       await removeSession(item.id);
 556: 
 557:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 558:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 559:         const next = { ...current };
 560:         delete next[item.id];
 561:         return next;
 562:       });
 563: 
 564:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 565:         setBook(null);
 566:         setSession(null);
 567:         setPdf(null);
 568:       }
 569: 
 570:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 571:       setError("");
 572:     } catch (cause) {
 573:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 574:     }
 575:   }
 576:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 577:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 578:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 579:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 580:     try {
 581:       await putBook(renamed);
 582:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 583:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 584:     } catch (cause) {
 585:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 586:     }
 587:   }

 590:     if (!session) return;
 591:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });
 592:   }

 594:   function goToPage(value: number) {
 595:     if (!session || !Number.isFinite(value)) return;
 596:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });
 597:   }

 599:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 600:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 601:     try {
 602:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 603:       setSession({
 604:         ...activeSession,
 605:         originalFen: fen,
 606:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 607:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 608:         moves: [],
 609:         moveIndex: 0,
 610:       });
 611:       setLastMove(null);
 612:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 613:       setUserArrows([]);
 614:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 615:       return true;
 616:     } catch (cause) {
 617:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 618:       return false;
 619:     }
 620:   }

 622:   function analyzeManualPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 623:     const loaded = moveToPosition(fen);
 624:     if (!loaded) return false;
 625:     setEngineScore(null);
 626:     setEngineMessage("");
 627:     if (!engineEnabled) {
 628:       toggleEngine();
 629:     } else {
 630:       engineRef.current?.analyze(fen, engineDepth);
 631:     }
 632:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 633:     return true;
 634:   }

 685:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 686:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 687:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 688:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 689:       return;
 690:     }
 691:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 692:     try {
 693:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 694:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 695:       preview.width = crop.width;
 696:       preview.height = crop.height;
 697:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 698:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 699:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 700:     } catch (cause) {
 701:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 702:       return;
 703:     }
 704:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 705:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 706:     setTransferFen("");
 707:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 708:         setRecognitionError("");
 709:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 710:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 711:     try {
 712:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 713:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 714:       });
 715:       const form = new FormData();
 716:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 717:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 718:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 719:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 720:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 721:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 722:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 723:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 724:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 725:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 726:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 727:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 728:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 729:       }
 730:     } catch (cause) {
 731:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 732:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 733:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 734:     }
 735:   }
 736: 
 737:   function closeTransfer() {
 738:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 739:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 740:     setTransferPreview("");
 741:     setTransferFen("");
 742:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 743:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 744:     setRecognitionError("");
 745:       }

 748:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 749:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 750:       setGameEndOverlay({
 751:         title: "Checkmate",
 752:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 753:       });
 754:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 755:       setGameEndOverlay({
 756:         title: "Stalemate",
 757:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 758:       });
 759:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 760:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 761:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 762:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 763:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 764:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 765:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 766:     } else {
 767:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 768:     }
 769:   }

 771:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 772:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 773:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 774:     try {
 775:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 776:       const result = currentGame.move({
 777:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 778:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 779:         promotion: piece,
 780:       });
 781:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 782:       patchBoardSession({
 783:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 784:         moves: nextMoves,
 785:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 786:       });
 787:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 788:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 789:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 790:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 791:       setError("");
 792:     } catch {
 793:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 794:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 795:     }
 796:   }
 797: 
 798:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 799:     if (!boardSession) return;
 800:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 801:     try {
 802:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 803:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 804:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 805:       if (promote) {
 806:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 807:         return;
 808:       }
 809:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 810:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 811:       patchBoardSession({
 812:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 813:         moves: nextMoves,
 814:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 815:       });
 816:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 817:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 818:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 819:       setError("");
 820:     } catch {
 821:       const piece = game.get(to);
 822:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 823:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 824:     }
 825:   }
 826: 
 827:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 828:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 829:     setRedSquares([]);
 830: 
 831:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 832:       setUserArrows([]);
 833:       setArrowStart(null);
 834:       setArrowHover(null);
 835:       return;
 836:     }
 837: if (!boardSession) return;
 838:     if (annotationMode) {
 839:       if (!arrowStart) {
 840:         setArrowStart(square);
 841:         return;
 842:       }
 843:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 844:       setArrowStart(null);
 845:       setArrowHover(null);
 846:       return;
 847:     }
 848:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 849:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 850:       return;
 851:     }
 852:     const piece = game.get(square);
 853:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 854:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 855:   }

 857:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 858:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 859: 
 860:   event.preventDefault();
 861: 
 862:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 863:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 864:     event.clientX,
 865:     event.clientY,
 866:     bounds,
 867:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 868:   );
 869: 
 870:   if (!square) return;
 871: 
 872:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 873:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 874:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 875:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 876:   setArrowStart(square);
 877:   setArrowHover(square);
 878: 
 879:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 880: }
 881: 
 882:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 883:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 884:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 885:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
 886:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 887:     setArrowHover(square);
 888:   }
 889: 
 890:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 891:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 892: 
 893:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 894: 
 895:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 896:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 897:     event.clientX,
 898:     event.clientY,
 899:     bounds,
 900:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 901:   );
 902: 
 903:   if (to && to !== from) {
 904:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 905:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 906:   } else {
 907:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 908:   }
 909: 
 910:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 911:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 912:   setArrowStart(null);
 913:   setArrowHover(null);
 914: }

 916:   function cancelBoardArrowGesture() {
 917:     arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 918:     setArrowStart(null);
 919:     setArrowHover(null);
 920:   }

 928:       setLastMove(last ? { from: last.from, to: last.to } : null);
 929:       setSelectedSquare(null);

 931:       setError(`Could not navigate to move: ${messageOf(cause)}`);

 933:   }

 966:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
 967:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 968: 
 969:     const controller = scanAbortControllerRef.current;
 970:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 971:     controller?.abort();

 974:     setManualMode(false);

 976:     setCropEditingId(null);
 977:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 978:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 979: 
 980:     patchSession((current) => ({
 981:       ...current,
 982:       candidatesByPage: {
 983:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 984:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 985:       },

 992:   async function detectBoards() {
 993:     if (detecting) {
 994:       stopBoardScan();
 995:       return;
 996:     }
 997: 
 998:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 999:     if (!API_BASE) {
1000:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
1001:       return;
1002:     }
1003: 
1004:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
1005:     const abortController = new AbortController();
1006:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
1007:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
1008: 
1009:     setDetecting(true);
1010:     setError("");
1011:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
1012:     patchSession((current) => ({
1013:       ...current,
1014:       candidatesByPage: {
1015:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1016:         [String(current.page)]: [],
1017:       },
1018:       selectedDiagramId: null,
1019:     }));
1020: 
1021:     try {
1022:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
1023:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
1024:           (blob) => blob
1025:             ? resolve(blob)
1026:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
1027:           "image/png",
1028:         );
1029:       });
1030: 
1031:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1032: 
1033:       const form = new FormData();
1034:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
1035: 
1036:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
1037:         method: "POST",
1038:         body: form,
1039:         signal: abortController.signal,
1040:       });
1041: 
1042:       if (!response.ok) {
1043:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
1044:       }
1045: 
1046:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
1047:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
1048:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
1049:       );
1050: 
1051:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1052: 
1053:       patchSession((current) => ({
1054:         ...current,
1055:         candidatesByPage: {
1056:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
1057:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
1058:         },
1059:         selectedDiagramId: null,
1060:       }));
1061: 
1062:       setNotice(
1063:         candidates.length
1064:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
1065:           : "No board candidates found.",
1066:       );
1067:     } catch (cause) {
1068:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1069: 
1070:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
1071:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
1072:       } else {
1073:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1074:       }
1075:     } finally {
1076:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
1077:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1078:         setDetecting(false);
1079:       }
1080:     }
1081:   }
1082:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {
1083:     const box = canvasRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
1084:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;
1085:   }

1087:   function startCropEdit(
1088:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
1089:     candidate: Candidate,
1090:     handle: CropHandle,
1091:   ) {
1092:     event.stopPropagation();
1093:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1094:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;
1095:     if (!point || !stage) return;
1096:     cropEditStartRef.current = { candidate, handle, point };
1097:     stage.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);

1100:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1101:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1102:     if (!manualMode) return;
1103: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1104: if (!canvas) return;
1105: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1106: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1107: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1108: if (
1109:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1110:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1111:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1112:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1113: ) return;
1114:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1115:     if (!point) return;
1116:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1117:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1118:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1119:     setDragSelection(selection);
1120:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1121:   }

1123:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1124:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1125:     if (edit) {
1126:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1127:       if (!point || !session) return;
1128:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1129:       patchSession((current) => {
1130:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1131:         return {
1132:           ...current,
1133:           candidatesByPage: {
1134:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1135:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1136:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1137:           },
1138:         };
1139:       });
1140:       return;
1141:     }
1142:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1143:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1144:     if (point) {
1145:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1146:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1147:       setDragSelection(selection);
1148:     }
1149:   }
1150: 
1151:   function finishRegion() {
1152:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1153:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1154:       return;
1155:     }
1156:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1157:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1158:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1159:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1160:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1161:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1162:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1163:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1164:     setDragSelection(null);
1165:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1166:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1167:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1168:       x, y, width, height,
1169:       relativeScore: 1,
1170:       source: "manual",
1171:     };
1172:     patchSession((current) => ({
1173:       ...current,
1174:       candidatesByPage: {
1175:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1176:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1177:       },
1178:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1179:     }));
1180:     setManualMode(false);
1181:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1182:   }
1183: 
1184:   function cancelRegion() {
1185:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1186:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1187:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1188:     setDragSelection(null);
1189:   }

1191:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1192:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1193:     try {
1194:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1195:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1196:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1197:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1198:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1199:       const scale = mode === "width"
1200:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1201:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1202:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1203:     } catch (cause) {
1204:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1205:     }
1206:   }

1441:                     const from = squareCenter(arrow.from, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
1442:                     const to = squareCenter(arrow.to, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
1443:                     const dx = to.x - from.x;
1444:                     const dy = to.y - from.y;
1445:                     const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
1446:                     if (length < 0.001) return null;
1447: 
1448:                     const ux = dx / length;
1449:                     const uy = dy / length;
1450:                     const px = -uy;
1451:                     const py = ux;
1452: 
1453:                     const headLength = Math.min(0.34, length * 0.30);
1454:                     const headHalfWidth = 0.19;
1455:                     const shaftHalfWidth = kind === "preview" ? 0.045 : 0.055;
1456:                     const tipX = to.x - ux * 0.04;
1457:                     const tipY = to.y - uy * 0.04;
1458:                     const baseX = tipX - ux * headLength;
1459:                     const baseY = tipY - uy * headLength;
1460:                     const startX = from.x + ux * 0.12;
1461:                     const startY = from.y + uy * 0.12;
1462: 
1463:                     const points = [
1464:                       [startX + px * shaftHalfWidth, startY + py * shaftHalfWidth],
1465:                       [baseX + px * shaftHalfWidth, baseY + py * shaftHalfWidth],
1466:                       [baseX + px * headHalfWidth, baseY + py * headHalfWidth],
1467:                       [tipX, tipY],
1468:                       [baseX - px * headHalfWidth, baseY - py * headHalfWidth],
1469:                       [baseX - px * shaftHalfWidth, baseY - py * shaftHalfWidth],
1470:                       [startX - px * shaftHalfWidth, startY - py * shaftHalfWidth],
1471:                     ];
1472:                     const color = kind === "engine" ? "#f0a23b" : "#81b64c";
1473:                     const opacity = kind === "preview" ? 0.52 : kind === "engine" ? 0.78 : 0.80;
1474: 
1475:                     return (
1476:                       <polygon
1477:                         key={`${kind}-${arrow.from}-${arrow.to}-${index}`}
1478:                         points={points.map(([x, y]) => `${x},${y}`).join(" ")}
1479:                         fill={color}
1480:                         opacity={opacity}
1481:                         className={`board-arrow board-arrow-${kind}`}
1482:                       />
1483:                     );
1484:                   })}
1485:                 </svg>
1486:               </div>
1487:             </div>
1488:           </div>

1804: function formatSize(bytes: number): string {
1805:   if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${Math.max(1, Math.round(bytes / 1024))} KB`;
1806:   return `${(bytes / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)} MB`;
1807: }

1809: function isTypingTarget(target: EventTarget | null): boolean {
1810:   return target instanceof HTMLElement && (target.isContentEditable || ["INPUT", "TEXTAREA", "SELECT"].includes(target.tagName));

  27: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  28:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  29:   if (!match) return uci;
  30:   try {
  31:     const position = new Chess(fen);
  32:     const move = position.move({
  33:       from: match[1] as Square,
  34:       to: match[2] as Square,
  35:       ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  36:     });
  37:     return move.san;
  38:   } catch {
  39:     return uci;
  40:   }
  41: }
  42: 
  43: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {
  44:   const position = new Chess(fen);
  45:   const san: string[] = [];
  46:   for (const uci of pv) {
  47:     const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  48:     if (!match) break;
  49:     try {
  50:       const move = position.move({
  51:         from: match[1] as Square,
  52:         to: match[2] as Square,
  53:         ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  54:       });
  55:       san.push(move.san);
  56:     } catch {
  57:       break;
  58:     }
  59:   }
  60:   return san.join(" ");
  61: }

  73: type RecognitionResult = {

  83: function readableDate(timestamp: number): string {
  84:   if (!timestamp) return "Not opened";
  85:   const elapsed = Date.now() - timestamp;
  86:   if (elapsed < 60_000) return "Just now";
  87:   if (elapsed < 3_600_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 60_000)}m ago`;
  88:   if (elapsed < 86_400_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 3_600_000)}h ago`;
  89:   return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString();
  90: }
  91: 
  92: function squareName(fileIndex: number, rankIndex: number): Square {
  93:   return `${"abcdefgh"[fileIndex]}${rankIndex + 1}` as Square;
  94: }
  95: 
  96: function normalizedCandidate(value: CandidateInput, index: number): Candidate {
  97:   const { relative_score, confidence, ...candidate } = value;
  98:   return {
  99:     ...candidate,
 100:     id: candidate.id || `candidate-${index + 1}`,
 101:     source: candidate.source ?? "automatic",
 102:     relativeScore: candidate.relativeScore ?? relative_score ?? confidence ?? 0,
 103:   };
 104: }

 403:   function toggleEngine() {
 404:     if (engineEnabled) {
 405:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 406:       engineRef.current = null;
 407:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 408:       setEngineStatus("off");
 409:       setEngineScore(null);
 410:       setEngineMessage("");
 411:       return;
 412:     }
 413:     try {
 414:       setEngineScore(null);
 415:       setEngineMessage("");
 416:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 417:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 418:         (status, message) => {
 419:           setEngineStatus(status);
 420:           if (status === "error") {
 421:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 422:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 423:             setEngineScore(null);
 424:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 425:             engineRef.current = null;
 426:           }
 427:         },
 428:         setEngineScore,
 429:       );
 430:       engineRef.current = client;
 431:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 432:     } catch (cause) {
 433:       setEngineStatus("error");
 434:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 435:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 436:     }
 437:   }

 443:     });

 459:   async function toggleStudyMode() {
 460:     if (!studyMode) {

 470:         flipped: session.flipped,
 471:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 472:       });
 473:       setStudyMode(true);
 474:     } else {

 476:       if (studyBoard) {
 477:         patchSession({
 478:           lineBaseFen: studyBoard.lineBaseFen,
 479:           currentFen: studyBoard.currentFen,
 480:           moves: [...studyBoard.moves],
 481:           moveIndex: studyBoard.moveIndex,
 482:           flipped: studyBoard.flipped,
 483:           coordinates: studyBoard.coordinates,
 484:         });
 485:       }
 486:       setStudyMode(false);

 493:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {

 503:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 504:     try {
 505:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 506:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 507:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 508:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 509:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 510:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 511:       setBook(opened);
 512:       setSession(nextSession);
 513:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 514:       setError("");
 515:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 516:     } catch (cause) {
 517:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 518:     }
 519:   }

 521:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 522:     if (!file) return;
 523:     try {
 524:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 525:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 526:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 527:       const now = Date.now();
 528:       const created: BookRecord = {
 529:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 530:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 531:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 532:         byteLength: file.size,
 533:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 534:         addedAt: now,
 535:       };
 536:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 537:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 538:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 539:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 540:       setBook(created);
 541:       setSession(blank);
 542:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 543:       setError("");
 544:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 545:     } catch (cause) {
 546:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 547:     }
 548:   }
 549: 
 550:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 551:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 552: 
 553:     try {
 554:       await removeBook(item.id);
 555:       await removeSession(item.id);
 556: 
 557:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 558:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 559:         const next = { ...current };
 560:         delete next[item.id];
 561:         return next;
 562:       });
 563: 
 564:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 565:         setBook(null);
 566:         setSession(null);
 567:         setPdf(null);
 568:       }
 569: 
 570:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 571:       setError("");
 572:     } catch (cause) {
 573:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 574:     }
 575:   }
 576:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 577:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 578:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 579:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 580:     try {
 581:       await putBook(renamed);
 582:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 583:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 584:     } catch (cause) {
 585:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 586:     }
 587:   }

 592:   }

 596:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });
 597:   }

 599:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 600:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 601:     try {
 602:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 603:       setSession({
 604:         ...activeSession,
 605:         originalFen: fen,
 606:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 607:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 608:         moves: [],
 609:         moveIndex: 0,
 610:       });
 611:       setLastMove(null);
 612:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 613:       setUserArrows([]);
 614:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 615:       return true;
 616:     } catch (cause) {
 617:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 618:       return false;
 619:     }
 620:   }

 632:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 633:     return true;

 685:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 686:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 687:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 688:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 689:       return;
 690:     }
 691:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 692:     try {
 693:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 694:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 695:       preview.width = crop.width;
 696:       preview.height = crop.height;
 697:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 698:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 699:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 700:     } catch (cause) {
 701:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 702:       return;
 703:     }
 704:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 705:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 706:     setTransferFen("");
 707:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 708:         setRecognitionError("");
 709:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 710:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 711:     try {
 712:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 713:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 714:       });
 715:       const form = new FormData();
 716:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 717:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 718:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 719:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 720:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 721:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 722:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 723:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 724:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 725:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 726:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 727:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 728:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 729:       }
 730:     } catch (cause) {
 731:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 732:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 733:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 734:     }
 735:   }
 736: 
 737:   function closeTransfer() {
 738:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 739:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 740:     setTransferPreview("");
 741:     setTransferFen("");
 742:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 743:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 744:     setRecognitionError("");
 745:       }

 748:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 749:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 750:       setGameEndOverlay({
 751:         title: "Checkmate",
 752:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 753:       });
 754:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 755:       setGameEndOverlay({
 756:         title: "Stalemate",
 757:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 758:       });
 759:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 760:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 761:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 762:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 763:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 764:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 765:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 766:     } else {
 767:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 768:     }
 769:   }
