 771:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 772:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 773:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 774:     try {
 775:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 776:       const result = currentGame.move({
 777:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 778:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 779:         promotion: piece,
 780:       });
 781:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 782:       patchBoardSession({
 783:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 784:         moves: nextMoves,
 785:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 786:       });
 787:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 788:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 789:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 790:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 791:       setError("");
 792:     } catch {
 793:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 794:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 795:     }
 796:   }
 797: 
 798:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 799:     if (!boardSession) return;
 800:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 801:     try {
 802:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 803:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 804:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 805:       if (promote) {
 806:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 807:         return;
 808:       }
 809:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 810:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 811:       patchBoardSession({
 812:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 813:         moves: nextMoves,
 814:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 815:       });
 816:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 817:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 818:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 819:       setError("");
 820:     } catch {
 821:       const piece = game.get(to);
 822:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 823:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 824:     }
 825:   }
 826: 
 827:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 828:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 829:     setRedSquares([]);
 830: 
 831:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 832:       setUserArrows([]);
 833:       setArrowStart(null);
 834:       setArrowHover(null);
 835:       return;
 836:     }
 837: if (!boardSession) return;
 838:     if (annotationMode) {
 839:       if (!arrowStart) {
 840:         setArrowStart(square);
 841:         return;
 842:       }
 843:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 844:       setArrowStart(null);
 845:       setArrowHover(null);
 846:       return;
 847:     }
 848:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 849:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 850:       return;
 851:     }
 852:     const piece = game.get(square);
 853:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 854:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 855:   }

 857:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 858:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 859:

 861: 
 862:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 863:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 864:     event.clientX,
 865:     event.clientY,
 866:     bounds,
 867:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 868:   );

 871: 
 872:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 873:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 874:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 875:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 876:   setArrowStart(square);
 877:   setArrowHover(square);
 878: 
 879:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 880: }

 890:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 891:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 892: 
 893:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 894: 
 895:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 896:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 897:     event.clientX,
 898:     event.clientY,
 899:     bounds,
 900:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 901:   );
 902: 
 903:   if (to && to !== from) {
 904:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 905:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 906:   } else {
 907:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 908:   }
 909: 
 910:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 911:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 912:   setArrowStart(null);
 913:   setArrowHover(null);
 914: }

 967:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;

 978:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 979:

 981:       ...current,
 982:       candidatesByPage: {
 983:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 984:         [String(current.page)]: [],

 992:   async function detectBoards() {
 993:     if (detecting) {
 994:       stopBoardScan();
 995:       return;
 996:     }
 997: 
 998:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 999:     if (!API_BASE) {
1000:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
1001:       return;
1002:     }
1003: 
1004:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
1005:     const abortController = new AbortController();
1006:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
1007:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
1008: 
1009:     setDetecting(true);
1010:     setError("");
1011:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
1012:     patchSession((current) => ({
1013:       ...current,
1014:       candidatesByPage: {
1015:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1016:         [String(current.page)]: [],
1017:       },
1018:       selectedDiagramId: null,
1019:     }));
1020: 
1021:     try {
1022:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
1023:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
1024:           (blob) => blob
1025:             ? resolve(blob)
1026:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
1027:           "image/png",
1028:         );
1029:       });
1030: 
1031:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1032: 
1033:       const form = new FormData();
1034:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
1035: 
1036:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
1037:         method: "POST",
1038:         body: form,
1039:         signal: abortController.signal,
1040:       });
1041: 
1042:       if (!response.ok) {
1043:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
1044:       }
1045: 
1046:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
1047:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
1048:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
1049:       );
1050: 
1051:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1052: 
1053:       patchSession((current) => ({
1054:         ...current,
1055:         candidatesByPage: {
1056:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
1057:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
1058:         },
1059:         selectedDiagramId: null,
1060:       }));
1061: 
1062:       setNotice(
1063:         candidates.length
1064:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
1065:           : "No board candidates found.",
1066:       );
1067:     } catch (cause) {
1068:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1069: 
1070:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
1071:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
1072:       } else {
1073:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1074:       }
1075:     } finally {
1076:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
1077:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1078:         setDetecting(false);
1079:       }
1080:     }
1081:   }

1100:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1101:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1102:     if (!manualMode) return;
1103: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1104: if (!canvas) return;
1105: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1106: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1107: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1108: if (
1109:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1110:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1111:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1112:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1113: ) return;
1114:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1115:     if (!point) return;
1116:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1117:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1118:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1119:     setDragSelection(selection);
1120:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1121:   }

1123:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1124:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1125:     if (edit) {
1126:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1127:       if (!point || !session) return;
1128:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1129:       patchSession((current) => {
1130:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1131:         return {
1132:           ...current,
1133:           candidatesByPage: {
1134:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1135:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1136:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1137:           },
1138:         };
1139:       });
1140:       return;
1141:     }
1142:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1143:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1144:     if (point) {
1145:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1146:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1147:       setDragSelection(selection);
1148:     }

1151:   function finishRegion() {
1152:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1153:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1154:       return;
1155:     }
1156:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1157:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1158:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1159:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1160:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1161:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1162:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1163:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1164:     setDragSelection(null);
1165:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1166:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1167:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1168:       x, y, width, height,
1169:       relativeScore: 1,
1170:       source: "manual",
1171:     };
1172:     patchSession((current) => ({
1173:       ...current,
1174:       candidatesByPage: {
1175:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1176:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1177:       },
1178:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1179:     }));
1180:     setManualMode(false);
1181:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1182:   }

1187:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1188:     setDragSelection(null);
1189:   }

1191:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1192:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1193:     try {
1194:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1195:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1196:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1197:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1198:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1199:       const scale = mode === "width"
1200:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1201:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1202:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1203:     } catch (cause) {
1204:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1205:     }
1206:   }

  27: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  28:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  29:   if (!match) return uci;
  30:   try {
  31:     const position = new Chess(fen);
  32:     const move = position.move({
  33:       from: match[1] as Square,
  34:       to: match[2] as Square,
  35:       ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  36:     });
  37:     return move.san;
  38:   } catch {
  39:     return uci;
  40:   }
  41: }
  42: 
  43: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {
  44:   const position = new Chess(fen);
  45:   const san: string[] = [];
  46:   for (const uci of pv) {
  47:     const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  48:     if (!match) break;
  49:     try {
  50:       const move = position.move({
  51:         from: match[1] as Square,
  52:         to: match[2] as Square,
  53:         ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  54:       });
  55:       san.push(move.san);
  56:     } catch {
  57:       break;
  58:     }
  59:   }
  60:   return san.join(" ");
  61: }

 399:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {

 403:   function toggleEngine() {
 404:     if (engineEnabled) {
 405:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 406:       engineRef.current = null;
 407:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 408:       setEngineStatus("off");
 409:       setEngineScore(null);
 410:       setEngineMessage("");
 411:       return;
 412:     }
 413:     try {
 414:       setEngineScore(null);
 415:       setEngineMessage("");
 416:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 417:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 418:         (status, message) => {
 419:           setEngineStatus(status);
 420:           if (status === "error") {
 421:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 422:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 423:             setEngineScore(null);
 424:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 425:             engineRef.current = null;
 426:           }
 427:         },
 428:         setEngineScore,
 429:       );
 430:       engineRef.current = client;
 431:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 432:     } catch (cause) {
 433:       setEngineStatus("error");
 434:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 435:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 436:     }
 437:   }

 439:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 440:     setSession((current) => {
 441:       if (!current) return current;
 442:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 443:     });
 444:   }

 446:   function patchBoardSession(change: Partial<StudyBoardState>) {
 447:     if (workspaceMode === "opening-explorer") {
 448:       return;
 449:     }
 450: 
 451:     if (workspaceMode === "analysis") {
 452:       setAnalysisBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 453:     } else if (studyMode) {
 454:       setStudyBoard((current) => current ? { ...current, ...change } : current);
 455:     } else {
 456:       patchSession(change);
 457:     }
 458:   }
 459:   async function toggleStudyMode() {
 460:     if (!studyMode) {
 461:       if (!session) {
 462:         setError("Open a book before entering study mode.");
 463:         return;
 464:       }
 465:       setStudyBoard({
 466:         lineBaseFen: session.lineBaseFen,
 467:         currentFen: session.currentFen,
 468:         moves: [...session.moves],
 469:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 470:         flipped: session.flipped,
 471:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 472:       });
 473:       setStudyMode(true);
 474:     } else {
 475:       // Preserve the latest Focus Mode board when returning to normal mode.
 476:       if (studyBoard) {
 477:         patchSession({
 478:           lineBaseFen: studyBoard.lineBaseFen,
 479:           currentFen: studyBoard.currentFen,
 480:           moves: [...studyBoard.moves],
 481:           moveIndex: studyBoard.moveIndex,
 482:           flipped: studyBoard.flipped,
 483:           coordinates: studyBoard.coordinates,
 484:         });
 485:       }
 486:       setStudyMode(false);
 487:     }
 488:     setLastMove(null);
 489:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 490:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 491:   
 492:     try {
 493:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 494:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 495:       } else {
 496:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 497:       }
 498:     } catch {
 499:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 500:     }
 501: }

 503:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 504:     try {
 505:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 506:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 507:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 508:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 509:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 510:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 511:       setBook(opened);
 512:       setSession(nextSession);
 513:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 514:       setError("");
 515:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 516:     } catch (cause) {
 517:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 518:     }
 519:   }

 521:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 522:     if (!file) return;
 523:     try {
 524:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 525:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 526:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 527:       const now = Date.now();
 528:       const created: BookRecord = {
 529:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 530:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 531:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 532:         byteLength: file.size,
 533:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 534:         addedAt: now,
 535:       };
 536:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 537:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 538:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 539:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 540:       setBook(created);
 541:       setSession(blank);
 542:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 543:       setError("");
 544:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 545:     } catch (cause) {
 546:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 547:     }
 548:   }

 550:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 551:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 552: 
 553:     try {
 554:       await removeBook(item.id);
 555:       await removeSession(item.id);
 556: 
 557:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 558:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 559:         const next = { ...current };
 560:         delete next[item.id];
 561:         return next;
 562:       });
 563: 
 564:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 565:         setBook(null);
 566:         setSession(null);
 567:         setPdf(null);
 568:       }
 569: 
 570:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 571:       setError("");
 572:     } catch (cause) {
 573:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 574:     }
 575:   }
 576:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 577:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 578:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 579:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 580:     try {
 581:       await putBook(renamed);
 582:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 583:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 584:     } catch (cause) {
 585:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 586:     }
 587:   }

 599:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 600:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 601:     try {
 602:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 603:       setSession({
 604:         ...activeSession,
 605:         originalFen: fen,
 606:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 607:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 608:         moves: [],
 609:         moveIndex: 0,
 610:       });
 611:       setLastMove(null);
 612:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 613:       setUserArrows([]);
 614:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 615:       return true;
 616:     } catch (cause) {
 617:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 618:       return false;
 619:     }
 620:   }

 631:     }
 632:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 633:     return true;

 685:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 686:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 687:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 688:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 689:       return;
 690:     }
 691:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 692:     try {
 693:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 694:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 695:       preview.width = crop.width;
 696:       preview.height = crop.height;
 697:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 698:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 699:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 700:     } catch (cause) {
 701:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 702:       return;
 703:     }
 704:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 705:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 706:     setTransferFen("");
 707:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 708:         setRecognitionError("");
 709:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 710:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 711:     try {
 712:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 713:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 714:       });
 715:       const form = new FormData();
 716:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 717:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 718:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 719:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 720:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 721:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 722:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 723:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 724:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 725:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 726:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 727:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 728:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 729:       }
 730:     } catch (cause) {
 731:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 732:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 733:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 734:     }
 735:   }

 738:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 739:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 740:     setTransferPreview("");
 741:     setTransferFen("");
 742:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 743:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 744:     setRecognitionError("");
 745:       }

 748:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 749:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 750:       setGameEndOverlay({
 751:         title: "Checkmate",
 752:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 753:       });
 754:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 755:       setGameEndOverlay({
 756:         title: "Stalemate",
 757:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 758:       });
 759:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 760:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 761:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 762:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 763:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 764:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 765:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 766:     } else {
 767:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 768:     }
 769:   }

 771:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 772:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 773:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 774:     try {
 775:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 776:       const result = currentGame.move({
 777:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 778:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 779:         promotion: piece,
 780:       });
 781:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 782:       patchBoardSession({
 783:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 784:         moves: nextMoves,
 785:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 786:       });
 787:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 788:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 789:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 790:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 791:       setError("");
 792:     } catch {
 793:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 794:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 795:     }
 796:   }
 797: 
 798:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 799:     if (!boardSession) return;
 800:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 801:     try {
 802:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 803:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 804:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 805:       if (promote) {
 806:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 807:         return;
 808:       }
 809:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 810:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 811:       patchBoardSession({
 812:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 813:         moves: nextMoves,
 814:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 815:       });
 816:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 817:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 818:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 819:       setError("");
 820:     } catch {
 821:       const piece = game.get(to);
 822:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 823:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 824:     }
 825:   }

 827:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 828:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 829:     setRedSquares([]);
 830: 
 831:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 832:       setUserArrows([]);
 833:       setArrowStart(null);
 834:       setArrowHover(null);
 835:       return;
 836:     }
 837: if (!boardSession) return;
 838:     if (annotationMode) {
 839:       if (!arrowStart) {
 840:         setArrowStart(square);
 841:         return;
 842:       }
 843:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 844:       setArrowStart(null);
 845:       setArrowHover(null);
 846:       return;
 847:     }
 848:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 849:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 850:       return;
 851:     }
 852:     const piece = game.get(square);
 853:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 854:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 855:   }

 894:

 898:     event.clientY,

 900:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),

 907:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 908:   }

 992:   async function detectBoards() {
 993:     if (detecting) {
 994:       stopBoardScan();
 995:       return;
 996:     }
 997: 
 998:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 999:     if (!API_BASE) {
1000:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
1001:       return;
1002:     }
1003: 
1004:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
1005:     const abortController = new AbortController();
1006:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
1007:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
1008: 
1009:     setDetecting(true);
1010:     setError("");
1011:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
1012:     patchSession((current) => ({
1013:       ...current,
1014:       candidatesByPage: {
1015:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1016:         [String(current.page)]: [],
1017:       },
1018:       selectedDiagramId: null,
1019:     }));
1020: 
1021:     try {
1022:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
1023:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
1024:           (blob) => blob
1025:             ? resolve(blob)
1026:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
1027:           "image/png",
1028:         );
1029:       });
1030: 
1031:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1032: 
1033:       const form = new FormData();
1034:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
1035: 
1036:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
1037:         method: "POST",
1038:         body: form,
1039:         signal: abortController.signal,
1040:       });
1041: 
1042:       if (!response.ok) {
1043:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
1044:       }
1045: 
1046:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
1047:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
1048:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
1049:       );
1050: 
1051:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1052: 
1053:       patchSession((current) => ({
1054:         ...current,
1055:         candidatesByPage: {
1056:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
1057:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
1058:         },
1059:         selectedDiagramId: null,
1060:       }));
1061: 
1062:       setNotice(
1063:         candidates.length
1064:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
1065:           : "No board candidates found.",
1066:       );
1067:     } catch (cause) {
1068:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1069: 
1070:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
1071:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
1072:       } else {
1073:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1074:       }
1075:     } finally {
1076:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
1077:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1078:         setDetecting(false);
1079:       }
1080:     }
1081:   }

1100:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1101:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1102:     if (!manualMode) return;
1103: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1104: if (!canvas) return;
1105: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1106: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1107: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1108: if (
1109:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1110:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1111:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1112:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1113: ) return;
1114:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1115:     if (!point) return;
1116:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1117:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1118:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1119:     setDragSelection(selection);
1120:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1121:   }

1123:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1124:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1125:     if (edit) {
1126:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1127:       if (!point || !session) return;
1128:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1129:       patchSession((current) => {
1130:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1131:         return {
1132:           ...current,
1133:           candidatesByPage: {
1134:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1135:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1136:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1137:           },
1138:         };
1139:       });
1140:       return;
1141:     }
1142:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1143:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1144:     if (point) {
1145:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1146:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1147:       setDragSelection(selection);
1148:     }
1149:   }

1151:   function finishRegion() {
1152:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1153:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1154:       return;
1155:     }
1156:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1157:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1158:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1159:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1160:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1161:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1162:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1163:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1164:     setDragSelection(null);
1165:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1166:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1167:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1168:       x, y, width, height,
1169:       relativeScore: 1,
1170:       source: "manual",
1171:     };
1172:     patchSession((current) => ({
1173:       ...current,
1174:       candidatesByPage: {
1175:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1176:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1177:       },
1178:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1179:     }));
1180:     setManualMode(false);
1181:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1182:   }

1191:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1192:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1193:     try {
1194:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1195:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1196:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1197:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1198:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1199:       const scale = mode === "width"
1200:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1201:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1202:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1203:     } catch (cause) {
1204:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1205:     }
1206:   }

  27: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  28:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  29:   if (!match) return uci;
  30:   try {
  31:     const position = new Chess(fen);
  32:     const move = position.move({
  33:       from: match[1] as Square,
  34:       to: match[2] as Square,
  35:       ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  36:     });
  37:     return move.san;
  38:   } catch {
  39:     return uci;
  40:   }
  41: }
  42: 
  43: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {
  44:   const position = new Chess(fen);
  45:   const san: string[] = [];
  46:   for (const uci of pv) {
  47:     const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  48:     if (!match) break;
  49:     try {
  50:       const move = position.move({
  51:         from: match[1] as Square,
  52:         to: match[2] as Square,
  53:         ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  54:       });
  55:       san.push(move.san);
  56:     } catch {
  57:       break;
  58:     }
  59:   }
  60:   return san.join(" ");
  61: }

  83: function readableDate(timestamp: number): string {
  84:   if (!timestamp) return "Not opened";
  85:   const elapsed = Date.now() - timestamp;
  86:   if (elapsed < 60_000) return "Just now";
  87:   if (elapsed < 3_600_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 60_000)}m ago`;

 235:     if (!book) {
 236:       pdfRef.current = null;
 237:       loadingTaskRef.current = null;
 238:       return;
 239:     }

 241:     let loadingTask: PDFDocumentLoadingTask | null = null;

 245:       if (cancelled) return;

 259:     }).catch((cause: unknown) => {
 260:       if (!cancelled) {
 261:         setPdfLoading(false);
 262:         setError(`Could not open this PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 263:       }
 264:     });

 266:       cancelled = true;
 267:       if (loadingTask) void loadingTask.destroy();
 268:     };

 281:       canvas.width = Math.floor(viewport.width);
 282:       canvas.height = Math.floor(viewport.height);
 283:       const task = page.render({ canvas, canvasContext: context, viewport });
 284:       renderTaskRef.current = task;

 287:       if (!cancelled) setRendering(false);

 290:         setRendering(false);
 291:         setError(`Could not render page ${session.page}: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 292:       }
 293:     });
 294:     return () => {
 295:       cancelled = true;
 296:       renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();
 297:     };
 298:   }, [pdf, session?.page, session?.zoom]);

 300:   useEffect(() => {
 301:     function onKey(event: KeyboardEvent) {
 302:       if (!session || !book || isTypingTarget(event.target)) return;
 303:       if (cropEditingId && ["ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", "ArrowUp", "ArrowDown"].includes(event.key)) {
 304:         const candidate = (session.candidatesByPage[String(session.page)] ?? []).find((item) => item.id === cropEditingId);
 305:         if (!candidate) return;
 306:         const step = event.shiftKey ? 0.01 : 0.002;
 307:         const x = event.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowRight" ? step : 0;
 308:         const y = event.key === "ArrowUp" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowDown" ? step : 0;
 309:         const next = editCrop(candidate, "move", x, y);
 310:         patchSession((current) => {
 311:           const pageKey = String(current.page);
 312:           return {
 313:             ...current,
 314:             candidatesByPage: {
 315:               ...current.candidatesByPage,
 316:               [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((item) =>
 317:                 item.id === candidate.id ? { ...item, ...next } : item),
 318:             },
 319:           };
 320:         });
 321:         event.preventDefault();
 322:         return;
 323:       }
 324:       if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") changePage(-1);
 325:       if (event.key === "ArrowRight") changePage(1);
 326:     }
 327:     window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 328:     return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 329:   });

 409:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 410:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 411:   }

 413:   function toggleEngine() {
 414:     if (engineEnabled) {
 415:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 416:       engineRef.current = null;
 417:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 418:       setEngineStatus("off");
 419:       setEngineScore(null);
 420:       setEngineMessage("");
 421:       return;
 422:     }
 423:     try {
 424:       setEngineScore(null);
 425:       setEngineMessage("");
 426:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 427:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 428:         (status, message) => {
 429:           setEngineStatus(status);
 430:           if (status === "error") {
 431:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 432:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 433:             setEngineScore(null);
 434:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 435:             engineRef.current = null;
 436:           }
 437:         },
 438:         setEngineScore,
 439:       );
 440:       engineRef.current = client;
 441:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 442:     } catch (cause) {
 443:       setEngineStatus("error");
 444:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 445:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 446:     }
 447:   }

 449:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 450:     setSession((current) => {
 451:       if (!current) return current;
 452:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 453:     });
 454:   }
 455: 
 456:   function patchBoardSession(change: Partial<StudyBoardState>) {
 457:     if (workspaceMode === "opening-explorer") {
 458:       return;
 459:     }
 460: 
 461:     if (workspaceMode === "analysis") {
 462:       setAnalysisBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 463:     } else if (workspaceMode === "opening-prep") {
 464:       setOpeningPrepBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 465:     } else if (studyMode) {
 466:       setStudyBoard((current) => current ? { ...current, ...change } : current);
 467:     } else {
 468:       patchSession(change);
 469:     }
 470:   }
 471:   async function toggleStudyMode() {
 472:     if (!studyMode) {
 473:       if (!session) {
 474:         setError("Open a book before entering study mode.");
 475:         return;
 476:       }
 477:       setStudyBoard({
 478:         lineBaseFen: session.lineBaseFen,
 479:         currentFen: session.currentFen,
 480:         moves: [...session.moves],
 481:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 482:         flipped: session.flipped,
 483:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 484:       });
 485:       setStudyMode(true);
 486:     } else {
 487:       // Preserve the latest Focus Mode board when returning to normal mode.
 488:       if (studyBoard) {
 489:         patchSession({
 490:           lineBaseFen: studyBoard.lineBaseFen,
 491:           currentFen: studyBoard.currentFen,
 492:           moves: [...studyBoard.moves],
 493:           moveIndex: studyBoard.moveIndex,
 494:           flipped: studyBoard.flipped,
 495:           coordinates: studyBoard.coordinates,
 496:         });
 497:       }
 498:       setStudyMode(false);
 499:     }
 500:     setLastMove(null);
 501:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 502:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 503:   
 504:     try {
 505:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 506:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 507:       } else {
 508:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 509:       }
 510:     } catch {
 511:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 512:     }
 513: }

 515:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 516:     try {
 517:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 518:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 519:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 520:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 521:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 522:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 523:       setBook(opened);
 524:       setSession(nextSession);
 525:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 526:       setError("");
 527:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 528:     } catch (cause) {
 529:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 530:     }
 531:   }

 533:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 534:     if (!file) return;
 535:     try {
 536:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 537:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 538:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 539:       const now = Date.now();
 540:       const created: BookRecord = {
 541:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 542:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 543:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 544:         byteLength: file.size,
 545:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 546:         addedAt: now,
 547:       };
 548:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 549:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 550:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 551:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 552:       setBook(created);
 553:       setSession(blank);
 554:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 555:       setError("");
 556:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 557:     } catch (cause) {
 558:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 559:     }
 560:   }
 561: 
 562:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 563:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 564: 
 565:     try {
 566:       await removeBook(item.id);
 567:       await removeSession(item.id);
 568: 
 569:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 570:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 571:         const next = { ...current };
 572:         delete next[item.id];
 573:         return next;
 574:       });
 575: 
 576:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 577:         setBook(null);
 578:         setSession(null);
 579:         setPdf(null);
 580:       }
 581: 
 582:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 583:       setError("");
 584:     } catch (cause) {
 585:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 586:     }
 587:   }
 588:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 589:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 590:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 591:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 592:     try {
 593:       await putBook(renamed);
 594:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 595:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 596:     } catch (cause) {
 597:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 598:     }
 599:   }

 611:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 612:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 613:     try {
 614:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 615:       setSession({
 616:         ...activeSession,
 617:         originalFen: fen,
 618:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 619:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 620:         moves: [],
 621:         moveIndex: 0,
 622:       });
 623:       setLastMove(null);
 624:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 625:       setUserArrows([]);
 626:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 627:       return true;
 628:     } catch (cause) {
 629:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 630:       return false;
 631:     }
 632:   }

 643:     }
 644:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 645:     return true;
 646:   }

 697:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 698:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 699:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 700:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 701:       return;
 702:     }
 703:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 704:     try {
 705:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 706:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 707:       preview.width = crop.width;
 708:       preview.height = crop.height;
 709:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 710:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 711:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 712:     } catch (cause) {
 713:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 714:       return;
 715:     }
 716:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 717:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 718:     setTransferFen("");
 719:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 720:         setRecognitionError("");
 721:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 722:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 723:     try {
 724:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 725:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 726:       });
 727:       const form = new FormData();
 728:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 729:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 730:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 731:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 732:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 733:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 734:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 735:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 736:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 737:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 738:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 739:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 740:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 741:       }
 742:     } catch (cause) {
 743:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 744:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 745:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 746:     }
 747:   }
 748: 
 749:   function closeTransfer() {
 750:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 751:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 752:     setTransferPreview("");
 753:     setTransferFen("");
 754:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 755:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 756:     setRecognitionError("");
 757:       }

 760:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 761:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 762:       setGameEndOverlay({
 763:         title: "Checkmate",
 764:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 765:       });
 766:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 767:       setGameEndOverlay({
 768:         title: "Stalemate",
 769:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 770:       });
 771:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 772:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 773:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 774:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 775:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 776:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 777:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 778:     } else {
 779:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 780:     }
 781:   }
 782: 
 783:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 784:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 785:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 786:     try {
 787:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 788:       const result = currentGame.move({
 789:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 790:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 791:         promotion: piece,
 792:       });
 793:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 794:       patchBoardSession({
 795:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 796:         moves: nextMoves,
 797:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 798:       });
 799:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 800:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 801:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 802:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 803:       setError("");
 804:     } catch {
 805:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 806:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 807:     }
 808:   }
 809: 
 810:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 811:     if (!boardSession) return;
 812:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 813:     try {
 814:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 815:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 816:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 817:       if (promote) {
 818:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 819:         return;
 820:       }
 821:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 822:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 823:       patchBoardSession({
 824:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 825:         moves: nextMoves,
 826:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 827:       });
 828:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 829:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 830:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 831:       setError("");
 832:     } catch {
 833:       const piece = game.get(to);
 834:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 835:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 836:     }
 837:   }

 839:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 840:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 841:     setRedSquares([]);
 842: 
 843:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 844:       setUserArrows([]);
 845:       setArrowStart(null);
 846:       setArrowHover(null);
 847:       return;
 848:     }
 849: if (!boardSession) return;
 850:     if (annotationMode) {
 851:       if (!arrowStart) {
 852:         setArrowStart(square);
 853:         return;
 854:       }
 855:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 856:       setArrowStart(null);
 857:       setArrowHover(null);
 858:       return;
 859:     }
 860:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 861:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 862:       return;
 863:     }
 864:     const piece = game.get(square);
 865:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 866:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 867:   }

 894:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {

 896:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();

 902:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 903:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 904: 
 905:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 906: 
 907:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 908:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 909:     event.clientX,
 910:     event.clientY,
 911:     bounds,
 912:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 913:   );
 914: 
 915:   if (to && to !== from) {
 916:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 917:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 918:   } else {
 919:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 920:   }
 921: 
 922:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 923:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 924:   setArrowStart(null);
 925:   setArrowHover(null);
 926: }

1004:   async function detectBoards() {
1005:     if (detecting) {
1006:       stopBoardScan();
1007:       return;
1008:     }
1009: 
1010:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
1011:     if (!API_BASE) {
1012:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
1013:       return;
1014:     }
1015: 
1016:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
1017:     const abortController = new AbortController();
1018:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
1019:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
1020: 
1021:     setDetecting(true);
1022:     setError("");
1023:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
1024:     patchSession((current) => ({
1025:       ...current,
1026:       candidatesByPage: {
1027:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1028:         [String(current.page)]: [],
1029:       },
1030:       selectedDiagramId: null,
1031:     }));
1032: 
1033:     try {
1034:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
1035:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
1036:           (blob) => blob
1037:             ? resolve(blob)
1038:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
1039:           "image/png",
1040:         );
1041:       });
1042: 
1043:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1044: 
1045:       const form = new FormData();
1046:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
1047: 
1048:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
1049:         method: "POST",
1050:         body: form,
1051:         signal: abortController.signal,
1052:       });
1053: 
1054:       if (!response.ok) {
1055:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
1056:       }
1057: 
1058:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
1059:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
1060:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
1061:       );
1062: 
1063:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1064: 
1065:       patchSession((current) => ({
1066:         ...current,
1067:         candidatesByPage: {
1068:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
1069:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
1070:         },
1071:         selectedDiagramId: null,
1072:       }));
1073: 
1074:       setNotice(
1075:         candidates.length
1076:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
1077:           : "No board candidates found.",
1078:       );
1079:     } catch (cause) {
1080:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1081: 
1082:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
1083:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
1084:       } else {
1085:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1086:       }
1087:     } finally {
1088:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
1089:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1090:         setDetecting(false);
1091:       }
1092:     }
1093:   }

1112:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1113:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1114:     if (!manualMode) return;
1115: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1116: if (!canvas) return;
1117: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1118: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1119: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1120: if (
1121:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1122:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1123:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1124:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1125: ) return;
1126:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1127:     if (!point) return;
1128:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1129:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1130:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1131:     setDragSelection(selection);
1132:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);

1135:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1136:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1137:     if (edit) {
1138:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1139:       if (!point || !session) return;
1140:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1141:       patchSession((current) => {
1142:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1143:         return {
1144:           ...current,
1145:           candidatesByPage: {
1146:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1147:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1148:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1149:           },
1150:         };
1151:       });
1152:       return;
1153:     }
1154:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1155:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1156:     if (point) {
1157:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1158:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1159:       setDragSelection(selection);
1160:     }
1161:   }

1163:   function finishRegion() {
1164:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1165:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1166:       return;
1167:     }
1168:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1169:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1170:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1171:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1172:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1173:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1174:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1175:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1176:     setDragSelection(null);
1177:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1178:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1179:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1180:       x, y, width, height,
1181:       relativeScore: 1,
1182:       source: "manual",
1183:     };
1184:     patchSession((current) => ({
1185:       ...current,
1186:       candidatesByPage: {
1187:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1188:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1189:       },
1190:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1191:     }));
1192:     setManualMode(false);
1193:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1194:   }

1197:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1198:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1199:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1200:     setDragSelection(null);
1201:   }

1203:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1204:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1205:     try {
1206:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1207:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1208:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1209:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1210:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1211:       const scale = mode === "width"
1212:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1213:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1214:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1215:     } catch (cause) {
1216:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1217:     }
1218:   }

  28: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  29:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  30:   if (!match) return uci;
  31:   try {
  32:     const position = new Chess(fen);
  33:     const move = position.move({
  34:       from: match[1] as Square,
  35:       to: match[2] as Square,
  36:       ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  37:     });
  38:     return move.san;
  39:   } catch {
  40:     return uci;
  41:   }
  42: }
  43: 
  44: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {
  45:   const position = new Chess(fen);
  46:   const san: string[] = [];
  47:   for (const uci of pv) {
  48:     const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  49:     if (!match) break;
  50:     try {
  51:       const move = position.move({
  52:         from: match[1] as Square,
  53:         to: match[2] as Square,
  54:         ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  55:       });
  56:       san.push(move.san);
  57:     } catch {
  58:       break;
  59:     }
  60:   }
  61:   return san.join(" ");
  62: }

  84: function readableDate(timestamp: number): string {
  85:   if (!timestamp) return "Not opened";
  86:   const elapsed = Date.now() - timestamp;
  87:   if (elapsed < 60_000) return "Just now";
  88:   if (elapsed < 3_600_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 60_000)}m ago`;
  89:   if (elapsed < 86_400_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 3_600_000)}h ago`;

 342:     return sortedBooks.filter((item) => {
 343:       const matchesTab = libraryTab === "all" || libraryTab === "recent";
 344:       return matchesTab && item.title.toLowerCase().includes(needle);
 345:     });
 346:   }, [bookSearch, libraryTab, sessionIndex, sortedBooks]);

 349:     () => parseOpeningLine(openingExplorerInput),

 351:   );
 352:   const openingPosition = useMemo(

 354:     [openingExplorerInput, openingExplorerPly],
 355:   );
 356: 
 357:   useEffect(() => {
 358:     if (workspaceMode !== "opening-explorer") return;
 359:

 361:       setOpeningStats(null);
 362:       setOpeningStatsStatus("idle");

 370:         .then((result) => {
 371:           setOpeningStats(result);

 375:           if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
 376:             setOpeningStats(null);
 377:             setOpeningStatsStatus("error");

 383:       window.clearTimeout(timer);

 388:   const boardSession: StudyBoardState | null =
 389:     workspaceMode === "analysis"
 390:       ? analysisBoard
 391:       : workspaceMode === "opening-prep"
 392:         ? openingPrepBoard
 393:         : workspaceMode === "opening-explorer"
 394:           ? {
 395:               lineBaseFen: START_FEN,
 396:               currentFen: openingPosition.fen,
 397:               moves: openingPosition.sanMoves,
 398:               moveIndex: openingPosition.sanMoves.length,
 399:               flipped: false,
 400:               coordinates: true,
 401:             }

 403:             ? studyBoard

 405:   const game = useMemo(() => {
 406:     if (!boardSession) return new Chess();
 407:     try {
 408:       return makePosition(boardSession.lineBaseFen, boardSession.moves, boardSession.moveIndex);
 409:     } catch {
 410:       try { return new Chess(boardSession.currentFen); } catch { return new Chess(); }
 411:     }
 412:   }, [boardSession]);
 413:   const legalTargets = useMemo(() => {
 414:     if (!selectedSquare) return new Set<string>();

 416:   }, [game, selectedSquare]);
 417:   const pieceSquares = game.board();
 418:   const moveHistory = useMemo(() => {
 419:     try { return makePosition(boardSession?.lineBaseFen ?? START_FEN, boardSession?.moves ?? [], boardSession?.moveIndex ?? 0).history({ verbose: true }); }
 420:     catch { return []; }
 421:   }, [boardSession]);
 422:   const highlightedMove = lastMove ?? (moveHistory.length
 423:     ? { from: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].from, to: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].to }
 424:     : null);
 425:   const engineArrow = useMemo(

 427:     [engineEnabled, engineScore?.bestMove],
 428:   );

 433:     setArrowHover(null);
 434:     setAnnotationMode(false);

 437:   useEffect(() => {

 440:     }
 441:   }, [engineEnabled, boardSession?.currentFen, boardSession?.moveIndex, game, engineDepth]);

 443:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 444:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 445:   }
 446: 
 447:   function toggleEngine() {
 448:     if (engineEnabled) {
 449:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 450:       engineRef.current = null;
 451:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 452:       setEngineStatus("off");
 453:       setEngineScore(null);
 454:       setEngineMessage("");
 455:       return;
 456:     }
 457:     try {
 458:       setEngineScore(null);
 459:       setEngineMessage("");
 460:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 461:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 462:         (status, message) => {
 463:           setEngineStatus(status);
 464:           if (status === "error") {
 465:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 466:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 467:             setEngineScore(null);
 468:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 469:             engineRef.current = null;
 470:           }
 471:         },
 472:         setEngineScore,
 473:       );
 474:       engineRef.current = client;
 475:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 476:     } catch (cause) {
 477:       setEngineStatus("error");
 478:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 479:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 480:     }
 481:   }

 483:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 484:     setSession((current) => {
 485:       if (!current) return current;
 486:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 487:     });
 488:   }
 489: 
 490:   function patchBoardSession(change: Partial<StudyBoardState>) {
 491:     if (workspaceMode === "opening-explorer") {
 492:       return;
 493:     }
 494: 
 495:     if (workspaceMode === "analysis") {
 496:       setAnalysisBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 497:     } else if (workspaceMode === "opening-prep") {
 498:       setOpeningPrepBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 499:     } else if (studyMode) {
 500:       setStudyBoard((current) => current ? { ...current, ...change } : current);
 501:     } else {
 502:       patchSession(change);
 503:     }
 504:   }
 505:   async function toggleStudyMode() {
 506:     if (!studyMode) {
 507:       if (!session) {
 508:         setError("Open a book before entering study mode.");
 509:         return;
 510:       }
 511:       setStudyBoard({
 512:         lineBaseFen: session.lineBaseFen,
 513:         currentFen: session.currentFen,
 514:         moves: [...session.moves],
 515:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 516:         flipped: session.flipped,
 517:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 518:       });
 519:       setStudyMode(true);
 520:     } else {
 521:       // Preserve the latest Focus Mode board when returning to normal mode.
 522:       if (studyBoard) {
 523:         patchSession({
 524:           lineBaseFen: studyBoard.lineBaseFen,
 525:           currentFen: studyBoard.currentFen,
 526:           moves: [...studyBoard.moves],
 527:           moveIndex: studyBoard.moveIndex,
 528:           flipped: studyBoard.flipped,
 529:           coordinates: studyBoard.coordinates,
 530:         });
 531:       }
 532:       setStudyMode(false);
 533:     }
 534:     setLastMove(null);
 535:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 536:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 537:   
 538:     try {
 539:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 540:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 541:       } else {
 542:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 543:       }
 544:     } catch {
 545:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 546:     }
 547: }

 549:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 550:     try {
 551:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 552:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 553:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 554:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 555:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 556:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 557:       setBook(opened);
 558:       setSession(nextSession);
 559:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 560:       setError("");
 561:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 562:     } catch (cause) {
 563:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 564:     }
 565:   }

 567:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 568:     if (!file) return;
 569:     try {
 570:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 571:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 572:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 573:       const now = Date.now();
 574:       const created: BookRecord = {
 575:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 576:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 577:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 578:         byteLength: file.size,
 579:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 580:         addedAt: now,
 581:       };
 582:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 583:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 584:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 585:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 586:       setBook(created);
 587:       setSession(blank);
 588:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 589:       setError("");
 590:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 591:     } catch (cause) {
 592:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 593:     }
 594:   }
 595: 
 596:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 597:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 598: 
 599:     try {
 600:       await removeBook(item.id);
 601:       await removeSession(item.id);
 602: 
 603:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 604:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 605:         const next = { ...current };
 606:         delete next[item.id];
 607:         return next;
 608:       });
 609: 
 610:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 611:         setBook(null);
 612:         setSession(null);
 613:         setPdf(null);
 614:       }
 615: 
 616:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 617:       setError("");
 618:     } catch (cause) {
 619:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 620:     }
 621:   }
 622:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 623:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 624:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 625:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 626:     try {
 627:       await putBook(renamed);
 628:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 629:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 630:     } catch (cause) {
 631:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 632:     }
 633:   }

 640:   function goToPage(value: number) {

 642:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });

 645:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 646:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 647:     try {
 648:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 649:       setSession({
 650:         ...activeSession,
 651:         originalFen: fen,
 652:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 653:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 654:         moves: [],
 655:         moveIndex: 0,
 656:       });
 657:       setLastMove(null);
 658:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 659:       setUserArrows([]);
 660:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 661:       return true;
 662:     } catch (cause) {
 663:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 664:       return false;
 665:     }
 666:   }

 678:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 679:     return true;
