 654:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 655:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 656:       setGameEndOverlay({
 657:         title: "Checkmate",
 658:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 659:       });
 660:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 661:       setGameEndOverlay({
 662:         title: "Stalemate",
 663:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 664:       });
 665:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 666:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 667:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 668:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 669:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 670:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 671:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 672:     } else {
 673:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 674:     }
 675:   }

 677:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 678:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 679:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 680:     try {
 681:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 682:       const result = currentGame.move({
 683:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 684:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 685:         promotion: piece,
 686:       });
 687:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 688:       patchBoardSession({
 689:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 690:         moves: nextMoves,
 691:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 692:       });
 693:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 694:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 695:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 696:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 697:       setError("");
 698:     } catch {
 699:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 700:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 701:     }
 702:   }
 703: 
 704:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 705:     if (!boardSession) return;
 706:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 707:     try {
 708:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 709:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 710:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 711:       if (promote) {
 712:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 713:         return;
 714:       }
 715:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 716:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 717:       patchBoardSession({
 718:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 719:         moves: nextMoves,
 720:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 721:       });
 722:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 723:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 724:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 725:       setError("");
 726:     } catch {
 727:       const piece = game.get(to);
 728:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 729:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 730:     }
 731:   }

 733:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 734:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 735:     setRedSquares([]);
 736: 
 737:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 738:       setUserArrows([]);
 739:       setArrowStart(null);
 740:       setArrowHover(null);
 741:       return;
 742:     }
 743: if (!boardSession) return;
 744:     if (annotationMode) {
 745:       if (!arrowStart) {
 746:         setArrowStart(square);
 747:         return;
 748:       }
 749:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 750:       setArrowStart(null);
 751:       setArrowHover(null);
 752:       return;
 753:     }
 754:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 755:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 756:       return;
 757:     }
 758:     const piece = game.get(square);
 759:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 760:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 761:   }

 763:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 764:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 765:

 768:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();

 772:     bounds,
 773:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 774:   );

 777:

 780:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 781:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 782:   setArrowStart(square);
 783:   setArrowHover(square);
 784: 
 785:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 786: }

 788:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 789:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 790:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();

 796:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 797:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 798: 
 799:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 800: 
 801:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 802:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 803:     event.clientX,
 804:     event.clientY,
 805:     bounds,
 806:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 807:   );
 808: 
 809:   if (to && to !== from) {
 810:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 811:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 812:   } else {
 813:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 814:   }
 815: 
 816:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 817:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 818:   setArrowStart(null);
 819:   setArrowHover(null);
 820: }

 873:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;

 898:   async function detectBoards() {
 899:     if (detecting) {
 900:       stopBoardScan();
 901:       return;
 902:     }
 903: 
 904:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 905:     if (!API_BASE) {
 906:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 907:       return;
 908:     }
 909: 
 910:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 911:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 912:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 913:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 914: 
 915:     setDetecting(true);
 916:     setError("");
 917:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 918:     patchSession((current) => ({
 919:       ...current,
 920:       candidatesByPage: {
 921:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 922:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 923:       },
 924:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 925:     }));
 926: 
 927:     try {
 928:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 929:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 930:           (blob) => blob
 931:             ? resolve(blob)
 932:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 933:           "image/png",
 934:         );
 935:       });
 936: 
 937:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 938: 
 939:       const form = new FormData();
 940:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 941: 
 942:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 943:         method: "POST",
 944:         body: form,
 945:         signal: abortController.signal,
 946:       });
 947: 
 948:       if (!response.ok) {
 949:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 950:       }
 951: 
 952:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 953:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 954:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 955:       );
 956: 
 957:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 958: 
 959:       patchSession((current) => ({
 960:         ...current,
 961:         candidatesByPage: {
 962:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 963:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 964:         },
 965:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 966:       }));
 967: 
 968:       setNotice(
 969:         candidates.length
 970:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 971:           : "No board candidates found.",
 972:       );
 973:     } catch (cause) {
 974:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 975: 
 976:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 977:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 978:       } else {
 979:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 980:       }
 981:     } finally {
 982:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 983:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 984:         setDetecting(false);
 985:       }
 986:     }
 987:   }

 990:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;
 991:   }

1006:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1007:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1008:     if (!manualMode) return;
1009: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1010: if (!canvas) return;
1011: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1012: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1013: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1014: if (
1015:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1016:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1017:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1018:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1019: ) return;
1020:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1021:     if (!point) return;
1022:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1023:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1024:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1025:     setDragSelection(selection);
1026:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1027:   }

1029:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1030:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1031:     if (edit) {
1032:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1033:       if (!point || !session) return;
1034:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1035:       patchSession((current) => {
1036:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1037:         return {
1038:           ...current,
1039:           candidatesByPage: {
1040:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1041:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1042:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1043:           },
1044:         };
1045:       });
1046:       return;
1047:     }
1048:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1049:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1050:     if (point) {
1051:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1052:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1053:       setDragSelection(selection);
1054:     }
1055:   }
1056: 
1057:   function finishRegion() {
1058:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1059:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1060:       return;
1061:     }
1062:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1063:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1064:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1065:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1066:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1067:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1068:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1069:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1070:     setDragSelection(null);
1071:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1072:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1073:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1074:       x, y, width, height,
1075:       relativeScore: 1,
1076:       source: "manual",
1077:     };
1078:     patchSession((current) => ({
1079:       ...current,
1080:       candidatesByPage: {
1081:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1082:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1083:       },
1084:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1085:     }));
1086:     setManualMode(false);
1087:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1088:   }
1089: 
1090:   function cancelRegion() {
1091:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1092:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1093:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1094:     setDragSelection(null);
1095:   }

1097:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1098:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1099:     try {
1100:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1101:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1102:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1103:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1104:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1105:       const scale = mode === "width"
1106:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1107:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1108:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1109:     } catch (cause) {
1110:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1111:     }
1112:   }

1121:         ? current.bookmarks.filter((page) => page !== current.page)

 157:         if (!cancelled) setReady(true);
 158:       }
 159:     }
 160:     void initialize();
 161:     return () => { cancelled = true; };
 162:   }, []);
 163: 
 164:   useEffect(() => {
 165:     if (!ready || !book || !session) return;
 166:     const snapshot = session;
 167:     void Promise.all([putSession(snapshot), setActiveBookId(book.id)])
 168:       .then(() => setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [snapshot.bookId]: snapshot })))
 169:       .catch((cause: unknown) => setError(`Could not save reading session: ${messageOf(cause)}`));
 170:   }, [ready, book, session]);
 171: 
 172:   useEffect(() => {
 173:     pdfRef.current?.cleanup();
 174:     void loadingTaskRef.current?.destroy();
 175:     setPdf(null);
 176:     if (!book) {
 177:       pdfRef.current = null;
 178:       loadingTaskRef.current = null;
 179:       return;
 180:     }
 181:     let cancelled = false;
 182:     let loadingTask: PDFDocumentLoadingTask | null = null;
 183:     setPdfLoading(true);
 184:     setError("");
 185:     book.file.slice(0).arrayBuffer().then((data) => {
 186:       if (cancelled) return;
 187:       loadingTask = getDocument({ data });
 188:       loadingTaskRef.current = loadingTask;
 189:       return loadingTask.promise;
 190:     }).then((document) => {
 191:       if (!document) return;
 192:       if (cancelled) {
 193:         void document.cleanup();
 194:         return;
 195:       }
 196:       pdfRef.current = document;
 197:       setPdf(document);
 198:       setPdfLoading(false);
 199:       setSession((current) => current ? { ...current, pageCount: document.numPages } : current);
 200:     }).catch((cause: unknown) => {
 201:       if (!cancelled) {
 202:         setPdfLoading(false);
 203:         setError(`Could not open this PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 204:       }
 205:     });
 206:     return () => {
 207:       cancelled = true;
 208:       if (loadingTask) void loadingTask.destroy();
 209:     };
 210:   }, [book]);
 211: 
 212:   useEffect(() => {
 213:     if (!pdf || !session || !canvasRef.current) return;
 214:     let cancelled = false;
 215:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 216:     setRendering(true);
 217:     pdf.getPage(session.page).then((page) => {
 218:       if (cancelled) return;
 219:       const viewport = page.getViewport({ scale: session.zoom * Math.min(1.4, 1100 / page.getViewport({ scale: 1 }).width) });
 220:       const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
 221:       if (!context) throw new Error("Canvas rendering is unavailable in this browser.");
 222:       canvas.width = Math.floor(viewport.width);
 223:       canvas.height = Math.floor(viewport.height);
 224:       const task = page.render({ canvas, canvasContext: context, viewport });
 225:       renderTaskRef.current = task;
 226:       return task.promise;
 227:     }).then(() => {
 228:       if (!cancelled) setRendering(false);
 229:     }).catch((cause: unknown) => {
 230:       if (!cancelled && !(cause instanceof Error && cause.name === "RenderingCancelledException")) {
 231:         setRendering(false);
 232:         setError(`Could not render page ${session.page}: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 233:       }
 234:     });
 235:     return () => {
 236:       cancelled = true;
 237:       renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();
 238:     };
 239:   }, [pdf, session?.page, session?.zoom]);
 240: 
 241:   useEffect(() => {
 242:     function onKey(event: KeyboardEvent) {
 243:       if (!session || !book || isTypingTarget(event.target)) return;
 244:       if (cropEditingId && ["ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", "ArrowUp", "ArrowDown"].includes(event.key)) {
 245:         const candidate = (session.candidatesByPage[String(session.page)] ?? []).find((item) => item.id === cropEditingId);
 246:         if (!candidate) return;
 247:         const step = event.shiftKey ? 0.01 : 0.002;
 248:         const x = event.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowRight" ? step : 0;
 249:         const y = event.key === "ArrowUp" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowDown" ? step : 0;
 250:         const next = editCrop(candidate, "move", x, y);
 251:         patchSession((current) => {
 252:           const pageKey = String(current.page);
 253:           return {
 254:             ...current,
 255:             candidatesByPage: {
 256:               ...current.candidatesByPage,
 257:               [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((item) =>
 258:                 item.id === candidate.id ? { ...item, ...next } : item),
 259:             },
 260:           };
 261:         });
 262:         event.preventDefault();
 263:         return;
 264:       }
 265:       if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") changePage(-1);
 266:       if (event.key === "ArrowRight") changePage(1);
 267:     }
 268:     window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 269:     return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 270:   });

 272:   useEffect(() => () => {
 273:     engineRef.current?.dispose();
 274:     engineRef.current = null;

 277:   const sortedBooks = useMemo(() => [...books].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt), [books]);
 278:   const visibleBooks = useMemo(() => {
 279:     const needle = bookSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
 280:     return sortedBooks.filter((item) => {
 281:       const saved = sessionIndex[item.id];
 282:       const matchesTab =
 283:         libraryTab === "all" || libraryTab === "recent" || libraryTab === "local" ||
 284:         (libraryTab === "bookmarks" && (saved?.bookmarks.length ?? 0) > 0) ||
 285:         (libraryTab === "positions" && (saved?.positions.length ?? 0) > 0) ||
 286:         (libraryTab === "progress" && (saved?.page ?? 1) > 1);
 287:       return matchesTab && item.title.toLowerCase().includes(needle);
 288:     });

 291:   const game = useMemo(() => {
 292:     if (!session) return new Chess();
 293:     try {
 294:       return makePosition(session.lineBaseFen, session.moves, session.moveIndex);
 295:     } catch {
 296:       try { return new Chess(session.currentFen); } catch { return new Chess(); }
 297:     }

 302:   }, [game, selectedSquare]);

 304:   const moveHistory = useMemo(() => {
 305:     try { return makePosition(session?.lineBaseFen ?? START_FEN, session?.moves ?? [], session?.moveIndex ?? 0).history({ verbose: true }); }
 306:     catch { return []; }
 307:   }, [session]);
 308:   const highlightedMove = lastMove ?? (moveHistory.length
 309:     ? { from: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].from, to: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].to }
 310:     : null);
 311:   const engineArrow = useMemo(
 312:     () => engineEnabled ? parseBestMove(engineScore?.bestMove) : null,
 313:     [engineEnabled, engineScore?.bestMove],

 325:   }, [engineEnabled, session?.currentFen, session?.moveIndex, engineDepth]);

 327:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 328:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 329:   }

 331:   function toggleEngine() {
 332:     if (engineEnabled) {
 333:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 334:       engineRef.current = null;
 335:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 336:       setEngineStatus("off");
 337:       setEngineScore(null);
 338:       setEngineMessage("");
 339:       return;
 340:     }
 341:     try {
 342:       setEngineScore(null);
 343:       setEngineMessage("");
 344:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 345:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 346:         (status, message) => {
 347:           setEngineStatus(status);
 348:           if (status === "error") {
 349:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 350:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 351:             setEngineScore(null);
 352:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 353:             engineRef.current = null;
 354:           }
 355:         },
 356:         setEngineScore,
 357:       );
 358:       engineRef.current = client;
 359:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 360:     } catch (cause) {
 361:       setEngineStatus("error");
 362:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 363:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 364:     }
 365:   }

 367:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 368:     setSession((current) => {
 369:       if (!current) return current;
 370:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 371:     });
 372:   }

 374:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 375:     try {
 376:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 377:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 378:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 379:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 380:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 381:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 382:       setBook(opened);
 383:       setSession(nextSession);
 384:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 385:       setError("");
 386:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 387:     } catch (cause) {
 388:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 389:     }
 390:   }

 392:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 393:     if (!file) return;
 394:     try {
 395:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 396:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 397:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 398:       const now = Date.now();
 399:       const created: BookRecord = {
 400:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 401:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 402:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 403:         byteLength: file.size,
 404:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 405:         addedAt: now,
 406:       };
 407:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 408:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 409:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 410:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 411:       setBook(created);
 412:       setSession(blank);
 413:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 414:       setError("");
 415:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 416:     } catch (cause) {
 417:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 418:     }
 419:   }

 421:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 422:     if (!window.confirm(`Remove "${item.title}" from your library?`)) return;
 423: 
 424:     try {
 425:       await removeBook(item.id);
 426:       await removeSession(item.id);
 427: 
 428:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 429:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 430:         const next = { ...current };
 431:         delete next[item.id];
 432:         return next;
 433:       });
 434: 
 435:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 436:         setBook(null);
 437:         setSession(null);
 438:         setPdf(null);
 439:       }
 440: 
 441:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 442:       setError("");
 443:     } catch (cause) {
 444:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 445:     }
 446:   }
 447:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 448:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 449:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 450:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 451:     try {
 452:       await putBook(renamed);
 453:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 454:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 455:     } catch (cause) {
 456:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 457:     }
 458:   }

 461:     if (!session) return;
 462:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });
 463:   }

 467:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });
 468:   }

 470:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 471:     if (!session) return false;

 475:         originalFen: fen,
 476:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 477:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 478:         moves: [],
 479:         moveIndex: 0,
 480:       });
 481:       setLastMove(null);
 482:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 483:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 484:       return true;
 485:     } catch (cause) {
 486:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 487:       return false;
 488:     }
 489:   }

 540:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 541:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 542:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 543:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 544:       return;
 545:     }
 546:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 547:     try {
 548:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 549:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 550:       preview.width = crop.width;
 551:       preview.height = crop.height;
 552:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 553:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 554:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 555:     } catch (cause) {
 556:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 557:       return;
 558:     }
 559:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 560:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 561:     setTransferFen("");
 562:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 563:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 564:     setRecognitionError("");
 565:     setTransferPiece("P");
 566:     const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 567:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 568:     try {
 569:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 570:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 571:       });
 572:       const form = new FormData();
 573:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 574:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 575:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 576:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 577:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 578:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 579:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 580:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 581:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 582:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 583:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 584:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 585:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 586:       }
 587:     } catch (cause) {
 588:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 589:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 590:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 591:     }
 592:   }
 593: 
 594:   function closeTransfer() {
 595:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 596:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 597:     setTransferPreview("");
 598:     setTransferFen("");
 599:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 600:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 601:     setRecognitionError("");
 602:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 603:   }

 605:   function editTransferSquare(displayRow: number, displayCol: number) {
 606:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 607:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 608:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a six-field FEN before editing individual squares.");
 609:       return;
 610:     }
 611:     const board = parseFenPlacement(fields[0]);
 612:     if (!board) {
 613:       setRecognitionError("The FEN piece placement is invalid. Correct it before editing squares.");
 614:       return;
 615:     }
 616:     const row = displayRow;
 617:     const col = displayCol;
 618:     try {
 619:       const placement = setFenPiece(fields[0], row, col, transferPiece);
 620:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, placement));
 621:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 622:       setRecognitionError("");
 623:     } catch (cause) {
 624:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 625:     }
 626:   }
 627: 
 628:   function flipTransferPosition() {
 629:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 630:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 631:       setRecognitionError("Recognize a position or enter a complete FEN before flipping it.");
 632:       return;
 633:     }
 634:     try {
 635:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, flipFenPlacement(fields[0])));
 636:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 637:       setRecognitionError("");
 638:     } catch (cause) {
 639:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 640:     }
 641:   }
 642: 
 643:   function confirmTransfer() {
 644:     if (!transferCandidate) return;
 645:     if (!transferFen.trim()) {
 646:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a FEN position first.");
 647:       return;
 648:     }
 649:     if (moveToPosition(transferFen.trim())) {
 650:       closeTransfer();
 651:     }
 652:   }
 653: 
 654:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 655:     if (!session) return;
 656:     try {
 657:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 658:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 659:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 660:       let promotion: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" = "q";
 661:       if (promote) {
 662:         const choice = window.prompt("Promote to queen, rook, bishop, or knight? (q/r/b/n)", "q")?.toLowerCase();
 663:         if (!choice) return;
 664:         switch (choice) {
 665:           case "q": promotion = "q"; break;
 666:           case "r": promotion = "r"; break;
 667:           case "b": promotion = "b"; break;
 668:           case "n": promotion = "n"; break;
 669:           default:
 670:             setError("Promotion must be q, r, b, or n.");
 671:             return;
 672:         }
 673:       }
 674:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to, promotion });
 675:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 676:       patchSession({
 677:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 678:         moves: nextMoves,
 679:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 680:       });
 681:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 682:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 683:       setError("");
 684:     } catch {
 685:       const piece = game.get(to);
 686:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 687:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 688:     }
 689:   }
 690: 
 691:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 692:     if (!session) return;
 693:     if (annotationMode) {
 694:       if (!arrowStart) {
 695:         setArrowStart(square);
 696:         return;
 697:       }
 698:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 699:       setArrowStart(null);
 700:       setArrowHover(null);
 701:       return;
 702:     }
 703:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 704:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 705:       return;
 706:     }
 707:     const piece = game.get(square);
 708:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 709:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 710:   }

 712:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 713:     if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 714:     event.preventDefault();
 715:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 716:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(session?.flipped));
 717:     if (!square) return;
 718:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 719:     arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 720:     setArrowStart(square);
 721:     setArrowHover(square);
 722:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 723:   }
 724: 
 725:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 726:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 727:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 728:     setArrowHover(boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(session?.flipped)));
 729:   }
 730: 
 731:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 732:     const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 733:     if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 734:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 735:     const to = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(session?.flipped));
 736:     if (to && to !== from) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 737:     arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 738:     setArrowStart(null);
 739:     setArrowHover(null);
 740:   }

 748:   function jumpToMove(index: number) {
 749:     if (!session) return;
 750:     try {
 751:       const next = makePosition(session.lineBaseFen, session.moves, index);
 752:       const last = next.history({ verbose: true }).at(-1);
 753:       patchSession({ moveIndex: index, currentFen: next.fen() });
 754:       setLastMove(last ? { from: last.from, to: last.to } : null);
 755:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 756:     } catch (cause) {
 757:       setError(`Could not navigate to move: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 758:     }
 759:   }

 761:   async function copyText(value: string) {
 762:     try {
 763:       await navigator.clipboard.writeText(value);
 764:       setNotice("Copied to clipboard.");
 765:     } catch (cause) {
 766:       setError(`Clipboard access failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 767:     }
 768:   }

 770:   async function detectBoards() {
 771:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 772:     if (!API_BASE) {
 773:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Start the optional CV service and set VITE_API_BASE_URL, or draw a board region manually.");
 774:       return;
 775:     }
 776:     setDetecting(true);
 777:     setError("");
 778:     try {
 779:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 780:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")), "image/png");
 781:       });
 782:       const form = new FormData();
 783:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 784:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 785:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 786:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 787:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map((item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index));
 788:       patchSession((current) => ({
 789:         ...current,
 790:         candidatesByPage: { ...current.candidatesByPage, [String(current.page)]: candidates },
 791:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 792:       }));
 793:       setNotice(candidates.length ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.` : "No board candidates found. You can draw a region manually.");
 794:     } catch (cause) {
 795:       setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 796:     } finally {
 797:       setDetecting(false);
 798:     }
 799:   }

 801:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {
 802:     const box = canvasRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
 803:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;
 804:   }

 806:   function startCropEdit(
 807:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
 808:     candidate: Candidate,
 809:     handle: CropHandle,
 810:   ) {
 811:     event.stopPropagation();
 812:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 813:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;
 814:     if (!point || !stage) return;
 815:     cropEditStartRef.current = { candidate, handle, point };
 816:     stage.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 817:   }
 818: 
 819:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 820:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 821:     if (!manualMode) return;
 822: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 823: if (!canvas) return;
 824: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 825: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 826: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 827: if (
 828:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 829:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 830:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 831:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 832: ) return;
 833:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 834:     if (!point) return;
 835:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 836:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 837:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 838:     setDragSelection(selection);
 839:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 840:   }
 841: 
 842:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 843:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 844:     if (edit) {
 845:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 846:       if (!point || !session) return;
 847:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 848:       patchSession((current) => {
 849:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 850:         return {
 851:           ...current,
 852:           candidatesByPage: {
 853:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 854:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 855:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 856:           },
 857:         };
 858:       });
 859:       return;
 860:     }
 861:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
 862:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 863:     if (point) {
 864:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 865:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 866:       setDragSelection(selection);
 867:     }
 868:   }
 869: 
 870:   function finishRegion() {
 871:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
 872:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 873:       return;
 874:     }
 875:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
 876:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
 877:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
 878:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
 879:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
 880:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
 881:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 882:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 883:     setDragSelection(null);
 884:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
 885:     const candidate: Candidate = {
 886:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
 887:       x, y, width, height,
 888:       relativeScore: 1,
 889:       source: "manual",
 890:     };
 891:     patchSession((current) => ({
 892:       ...current,
 893:       candidatesByPage: {
 894:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 895:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
 896:       },
 897:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
 898:     }));
 899:     setManualMode(false);
 900:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
 901:   }
 902: 
 903:   function cancelRegion() {
 904:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 905:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 906:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 907:     setDragSelection(null);
 908:   }

 910:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
 911:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
 912:     try {
 913:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
 914:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
 915:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
 916:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
 917:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
 918:       const scale = mode === "width"
 919:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
 920:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
 921:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
 922:     } catch (cause) {
 923:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 924:     }
 925:   }

 325:   function toggleEngine() {
 326:     if (engineEnabled) {
 327:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 328:       engineRef.current = null;
 329:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 330:       setEngineStatus("off");
 331:       setEngineScore(null);
 332:       setEngineMessage("");
 333:       return;
 334:     }
 335:     try {
 336:       setEngineScore(null);
 337:       setEngineMessage("");
 338:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 339:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 340:         (status, message) => {
 341:           setEngineStatus(status);
 342:           if (status === "error") {
 343:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 344:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 345:             setEngineScore(null);
 346:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 347:             engineRef.current = null;
 348:           }
 349:         },
 350:         setEngineScore,
 351:       );
 352:       engineRef.current = client;
 353:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 354:     } catch (cause) {
 355:       setEngineStatus("error");
 356:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 357:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 358:     }
 359:   }

 361:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 362:     setSession((current) => {
 363:       if (!current) return current;
 364:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 365:     });
 366:   }

 368:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 369:     try {
 370:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 371:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 372:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 373:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 374:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 375:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 376:       setBook(opened);
 377:       setSession(nextSession);
 378:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 379:       setError("");
 380:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 381:     } catch (cause) {
 382:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 383:     }
 384:   }

 386:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 387:     if (!file) return;
 388:     try {
 389:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 390:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 391:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 392:       const now = Date.now();
 393:       const created: BookRecord = {
 394:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 395:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 396:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 397:         byteLength: file.size,
 398:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 399:         addedAt: now,
 400:       };
 401:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 402:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 403:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 404:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 405:       setBook(created);
 406:       setSession(blank);
 407:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 408:       setError("");
 409:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 410:     } catch (cause) {
 411:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 412:     }
 413:   }

 415:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 416:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 417: 
 418:     try {
 419:       await removeBook(item.id);
 420:       await removeSession(item.id);
 421: 
 422:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 423:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 424:         const next = { ...current };
 425:         delete next[item.id];
 426:         return next;
 427:       });
 428: 
 429:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 430:         setBook(null);
 431:         setSession(null);
 432:         setPdf(null);
 433:       }
 434: 
 435:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 436:       setError("");
 437:     } catch (cause) {
 438:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 439:     }
 440:   }
 441:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 442:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 443:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 444:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 445:     try {
 446:       await putBook(renamed);
 447:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 448:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 449:     } catch (cause) {
 450:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 451:     }
 452:   }

 464:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 465:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 466:     try {
 467:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 468:       setSession({
 469:         ...activeSession,
 470:         originalFen: fen,
 471:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 472:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 473:         moves: [],
 474:         moveIndex: 0,
 475:       });
 476:       setLastMove(null);
 477:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 478:       setUserArrows([]);
 479:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 480:       return true;
 481:     } catch (cause) {
 482:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 483:       return false;
 484:     }
 485:   }

 550:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 551:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 552:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 553:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 554:       return;
 555:     }
 556:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 557:     try {
 558:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 559:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 560:       preview.width = crop.width;
 561:       preview.height = crop.height;
 562:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 563:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 564:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 565:     } catch (cause) {
 566:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 567:       return;
 568:     }
 569:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 570:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 571:     setTransferFen("");
 572:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 573:         setRecognitionError("");
 574:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 575:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 576:     try {
 577:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 578:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 579:       });
 580:       const form = new FormData();
 581:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 582:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 583:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 584:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 585:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 586:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 587:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 588:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 589:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 590:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 591:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 592:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 593:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 594:       }
 595:     } catch (cause) {
 596:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 597:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 598:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 599:     }
 600:   }
 601: 
 602:   function closeTransfer() {
 603:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 604:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 605:     setTransferPreview("");
 606:     setTransferFen("");
 607:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 608:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 609:     setRecognitionError("");
 610:       }

 613:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 614:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 615:       setGameEndOverlay({
 616:         title: "Checkmate",
 617:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 618:       });
 619:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 620:       setGameEndOverlay({
 621:         title: "Stalemate",
 622:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 623:       });
 624:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 625:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 626:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 627:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 628:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 629:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 630:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 631:     } else {
 632:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 633:     }
 634:   }
 635: 
 636:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 637:     if (!promotionRequest || !session) return;
 638:     try {
 639:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 640:       const result = currentGame.move({
 641:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 642:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 643:         promotion: piece,
 644:       });
 645:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 646:       patchSession({
 647:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 648:         moves: nextMoves,
 649:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 650:       });
 651:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 652:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 653:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 654:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 655:       setError("");
 656:     } catch {
 657:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 658:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 659:     }
 660:   }
 661: 
 662:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 663:     if (!session) return;
 664:     try {
 665:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 666:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 667:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 668:       if (promote) {
 669:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 670:         return;
 671:       }
 672:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 673:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 674:       patchSession({
 675:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 676:         moves: nextMoves,
 677:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 678:       });
 679:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 680:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 681:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 682:       setError("");
 683:     } catch {
 684:       const piece = game.get(to);
 685:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 686:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 687:     }
 688:   }

 690:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 691:     
 692:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 693:       setUserArrows([]);
 694:       setArrowStart(null);
 695:       setArrowHover(null);
 696:       return;
 697:     }
 698: if (!session) return;
 699:     if (annotationMode) {
 700:       if (!arrowStart) {
 701:         setArrowStart(square);
 702:         return;
 703:       }
 704:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 705:       setArrowStart(null);
 706:       setArrowHover(null);
 707:       return;
 708:     }
 709:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 710:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 711:       return;
 712:     }
 713:     const piece = game.get(square);
 714:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 715:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 716:   }

 853:   async function detectBoards() {
 854:     if (detecting) {
 855:       stopBoardScan();
 856:       return;
 857:     }
 858: 
 859:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 860:     if (!API_BASE) {
 861:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 862:       return;
 863:     }
 864: 
 865:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 866:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 867:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 868:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 869: 
 870:     setDetecting(true);
 871:     setError("");
 872:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 873:     patchSession((current) => ({
 874:       ...current,
 875:       candidatesByPage: {
 876:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 877:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 878:       },
 879:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 880:     }));
 881: 
 882:     try {
 883:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 884:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 885:           (blob) => blob
 886:             ? resolve(blob)
 887:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 888:           "image/png",
 889:         );
 890:       });
 891: 
 892:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 893: 
 894:       const form = new FormData();
 895:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 896: 
 897:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 898:         method: "POST",
 899:         body: form,
 900:         signal: abortController.signal,
 901:       });
 902: 
 903:       if (!response.ok) {
 904:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 905:       }
 906: 
 907:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 908:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 909:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 910:       );
 911: 
 912:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 913: 
 914:       patchSession((current) => ({
 915:         ...current,
 916:         candidatesByPage: {
 917:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 918:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 919:         },
 920:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 921:       }));
 922: 
 923:       setNotice(
 924:         candidates.length
 925:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 926:           : "No board candidates found.",
 927:       );
 928:     } catch (cause) {
 929:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 930: 
 931:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 932:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 933:       } else {
 934:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 935:       }
 936:     } finally {
 937:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 938:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 939:         setDetecting(false);
 940:       }
 941:     }
 942:   }

 961:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 962:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 963:     if (!manualMode) return;
 964: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 965: if (!canvas) return;
 966: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;

 968: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 969: if (
 970:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 971:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 972:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 973:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 974: ) return;

 976:     if (!point) return;

 978:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };

 984:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 985:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 986:     if (edit) {
 987:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 988:       if (!point || !session) return;
 989:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 990:       patchSession((current) => {
 991:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 992:         return {
 993:           ...current,
 994:           candidatesByPage: {
 995:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 996:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 997:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 998:           },
 999:         };
1000:       });
1001:       return;
1002:     }
1003:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1004:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1005:     if (point) {
1006:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1007:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1008:       setDragSelection(selection);
1009:     }

1012:   function finishRegion() {
1013:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1014:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1015:       return;
1016:     }
1017:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1018:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1019:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1020:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1021:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1022:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1023:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1024:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1025:     setDragSelection(null);
1026:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1027:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1028:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1029:       x, y, width, height,
1030:       relativeScore: 1,
1031:       source: "manual",
1032:     };
1033:     patchSession((current) => ({
1034:       ...current,
1035:       candidatesByPage: {
1036:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1037:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1038:       },
1039:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1040:     }));
1041:     setManualMode(false);
1042:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1043:   }

1052:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1053:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1054:     try {
1055:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1056:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1057:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1058:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1059:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1060:       const scale = mode === "width"
1061:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1062:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1063:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1064:     } catch (cause) {
1065:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1066:     }
1067:   }

 435:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 436:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 437:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 438:       setBook(created);
 439:       setSession(blank);
 440:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 441:       setError("");
 442:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 443:     } catch (cause) {
 444:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 445:     }
 446:   }
 447: 
 448:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 449:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 450: 
 451:     try {
 452:       await removeBook(item.id);
 453:       await removeSession(item.id);
 454: 
 455:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 456:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 457:         const next = { ...current };
 458:         delete next[item.id];
 459:         return next;
 460:       });
 461: 
 462:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 463:         setBook(null);
 464:         setSession(null);
 465:         setPdf(null);
 466:       }
 467: 
 468:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 469:       setError("");
 470:     } catch (cause) {
 471:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 472:     }
 473:   }
 474:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 475:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 476:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 477:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 478:     try {
 479:       await putBook(renamed);
 480:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 481:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 482:     } catch (cause) {
 483:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 484:     }
 485:   }

 487:   function changePage(delta: number) {
 488:     if (!session) return;
 489:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });
 490:   }

 492:   function goToPage(value: number) {
 493:     if (!session || !Number.isFinite(value)) return;
 494:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });
 495:   }

 497:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 498:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 499:     try {
 500:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 501:       setSession({
 502:         ...activeSession,
 503:         originalFen: fen,
 504:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 505:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 506:         moves: [],
 507:         moveIndex: 0,
 508:       });
 509:       setLastMove(null);
 510:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 511:       setUserArrows([]);
 512:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 513:       return true;
 514:     } catch (cause) {
 515:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 516:       return false;
 517:     }
 518:   }

 526:       toggleEngine();
 527:     } else {
 528:       engineRef.current?.analyze(fen, engineDepth);
 529:     }
 530:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 531:     return true;
 532:   }

 583:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 584:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 585:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 586:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 587:       return;
 588:     }
 589:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 590:     try {
 591:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 592:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 593:       preview.width = crop.width;
 594:       preview.height = crop.height;
 595:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 596:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 597:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 598:     } catch (cause) {
 599:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 600:       return;
 601:     }
 602:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 603:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 604:     setTransferFen("");
 605:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 606:         setRecognitionError("");
 607:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 608:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 609:     try {
 610:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 611:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 612:       });
 613:       const form = new FormData();
 614:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 615:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 616:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 617:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 618:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 619:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 620:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 621:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 622:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 623:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 624:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 625:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 626:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 627:       }
 628:     } catch (cause) {
 629:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 630:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 631:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 632:     }
 633:   }
 634: 
 635:   function closeTransfer() {
 636:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 637:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 638:     setTransferPreview("");
 639:     setTransferFen("");
 640:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 641:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 642:     setRecognitionError("");
 643:       }

 646:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 647:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 648:       setGameEndOverlay({
 649:         title: "Checkmate",
 650:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 651:       });
 652:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 653:       setGameEndOverlay({
 654:         title: "Stalemate",
 655:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 656:       });
 657:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 658:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 659:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 660:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 661:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 662:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 663:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 664:     } else {
 665:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 666:     }
 667:   }
 668: 
 669:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 670:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 671:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 672:     try {
 673:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 674:       const result = currentGame.move({
 675:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 676:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 677:         promotion: piece,
 678:       });
 679:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 680:       patchBoardSession({
 681:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 682:         moves: nextMoves,
 683:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 684:       });
 685:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 686:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 687:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 688:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 689:       setError("");
 690:     } catch {
 691:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 692:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 693:     }
 694:   }
 695: 
 696:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 697:     if (!boardSession) return;
 698:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 699:     try {
 700:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 701:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 702:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 703:       if (promote) {
 704:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 705:         return;
 706:       }
 707:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 708:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 709:       patchBoardSession({
 710:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 711:         moves: nextMoves,
 712:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 713:       });
 714:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 715:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 716:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 717:       setError("");
 718:     } catch {
 719:       const piece = game.get(to);
 720:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 721:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 722:     }
 723:   }
 724: 
 725:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 726:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 727:     setRedSquares([]);
 728: 
 729:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 730:       setUserArrows([]);
 731:       setArrowStart(null);
 732:       setArrowHover(null);
 733:       return;
 734:     }
 735: if (!boardSession) return;
 736:     if (annotationMode) {
 737:       if (!arrowStart) {
 738:         setArrowStart(square);
 739:         return;
 740:       }
 741:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 742:       setArrowStart(null);
 743:       setArrowHover(null);
 744:       return;
 745:     }
 746:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 747:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 748:       return;
 749:     }
 750:     const piece = game.get(square);
 751:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 752:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 753:   }

 755:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 756:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 757: 
 758:   event.preventDefault();
 759: 
 760:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 761:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 762:     event.clientX,
 763:     event.clientY,
 764:     bounds,
 765:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 766:   );
 767: 
 768:   if (!square) return;
 769: 
 770:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 771:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 772:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 773:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 774:   setArrowStart(square);
 775:   setArrowHover(square);
 776: 
 777:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 778: }

 780:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 781:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 782:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 783:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
 784:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 785:     setArrowHover(square);
 786:   }

 788:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 789:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 790: 
 791:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 792: 
 793:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 794:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 795:     event.clientX,
 796:     event.clientY,
 797:     bounds,
 798:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 799:   );
 800: 
 801:   if (to && to !== from) {
 802:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 803:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 804:   } else {
 805:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 806:   }
 807: 
 808:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 809:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 810:   setArrowStart(null);
 811:   setArrowHover(null);
 812: }

 864:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
 865:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 866: 
 867:     const controller = scanAbortControllerRef.current;
 868:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;

 874:     setCropEditingId(null);

 876:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 877:

 879:       ...current,
 880:       candidatesByPage: {
 881:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 882:         [String(current.page)]: [],
