 390:       });
 391:       setStudyMode(true);
 392:     } else {
 393:       setStudyMode(false);
 394:     }
 395:     setLastMove(null);
 396:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 397:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 398:   }
 399: 
 400:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 401:     try {
 402:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 403:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 404:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 405:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 406:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 407:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 408:       setBook(opened);
 409:       setSession(nextSession);
 410:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 411:       setError("");
 412:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 413:     } catch (cause) {
 414:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 415:     }
 416:   }
 417: 
 418:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 419:     if (!file) return;
 420:     try {
 421:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 422:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 423:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 424:       const now = Date.now();
 425:       const created: BookRecord = {
 426:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 427:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 428:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 429:         byteLength: file.size,
 430:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 431:         addedAt: now,
 432:       };
 433:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 434:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 435:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 436:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 437:       setBook(created);
 438:       setSession(blank);
 439:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 440:       setError("");
 441:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 442:     } catch (cause) {
 443:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 444:     }
 445:   }
 446: 
 447:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 448:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 449: 
 450:     try {
 451:       await removeBook(item.id);
 452:       await removeSession(item.id);
 453: 
 454:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 455:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 456:         const next = { ...current };
 457:         delete next[item.id];
 458:         return next;
 459:       });
 460: 
 461:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 462:         setBook(null);
 463:         setSession(null);
 464:         setPdf(null);
 465:       }
 466: 
 467:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 468:       setError("");
 469:     } catch (cause) {
 470:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 471:     }
 472:   }
 473:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 474:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 475:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 476:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 477:     try {
 478:       await putBook(renamed);
 479:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 480:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 481:     } catch (cause) {
 482:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 483:     }
 484:   }

 496:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 497:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 498:     try {
 499:       const next = new Chess(fen);

 501:         ...activeSession,
 502:         originalFen: fen,
 503:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 504:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 505:         moves: [],
 506:         moveIndex: 0,
 507:       });
 508:       setLastMove(null);
 509:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 510:       setUserArrows([]);
 511:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 512:       return true;
 513:     } catch (cause) {
 514:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 515:       return false;
 516:     }
 517:   }

 582:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 583:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 584:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 585:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 586:       return;
 587:     }
 588:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 589:     try {
 590:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 591:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 592:       preview.width = crop.width;
 593:       preview.height = crop.height;
 594:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 595:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 596:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 597:     } catch (cause) {
 598:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 599:       return;
 600:     }
 601:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 602:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 603:     setTransferFen("");
 604:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 605:         setRecognitionError("");
 606:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 607:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 608:     try {
 609:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 610:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 611:       });
 612:       const form = new FormData();
 613:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 614:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 615:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 616:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 617:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 618:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 619:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 620:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 621:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 622:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 623:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 624:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 625:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 626:       }
 627:     } catch (cause) {
 628:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 629:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 630:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 631:     }
 632:   }
 633: 
 634:   function closeTransfer() {
 635:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 636:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 637:     setTransferPreview("");
 638:     setTransferFen("");
 639:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 640:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 641:     setRecognitionError("");
 642:       }

 645:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 646:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 647:       setGameEndOverlay({
 648:         title: "Checkmate",
 649:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 650:       });
 651:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 652:       setGameEndOverlay({
 653:         title: "Stalemate",
 654:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 655:       });
 656:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 657:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 658:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 659:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 660:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 661:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 662:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 663:     } else {
 664:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 665:     }
 666:   }

 668:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 669:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 670:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 671:     try {
 672:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 673:       const result = currentGame.move({
 674:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 675:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 676:         promotion: piece,
 677:       });
 678:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 679:       patchBoardSession({
 680:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 681:         moves: nextMoves,
 682:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 683:       });
 684:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 685:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 686:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 687:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 688:       setError("");
 689:     } catch {
 690:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 691:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 692:     }
 693:   }
 694: 
 695:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 696:     if (!boardSession) return;
 697:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 698:     try {
 699:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 700:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 701:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 702:       if (promote) {
 703:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 704:         return;
 705:       }
 706:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 707:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 708:       patchBoardSession({
 709:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 710:         moves: nextMoves,
 711:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 712:       });
 713:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 714:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 715:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 716:       setError("");
 717:     } catch {
 718:       const piece = game.get(to);
 719:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 720:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 721:     }
 722:   }

 724:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 725:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 726:     setRedSquares([]);
 727: 
 728:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 729:       setUserArrows([]);
 730:       setArrowStart(null);
 731:       setArrowHover(null);
 732:       return;
 733:     }
 734: if (!session) return;
 735:     if (annotationMode) {
 736:       if (!arrowStart) {
 737:         setArrowStart(square);
 738:         return;
 739:       }
 740:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 741:       setArrowStart(null);
 742:       setArrowHover(null);
 743:       return;
 744:     }
 745:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 746:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 747:       return;
 748:     }
 749:     const piece = game.get(square);
 750:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 751:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 752:   }

 754:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 755:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;

 764:     Boolean(session?.flipped),
 765:   );

 768:

 772:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 773:   setArrowStart(square);
 774:   setArrowHover(square);
 775: 
 776:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 777: }

 779:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 780:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;

 787:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 788:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 789: 
 790:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 791: 
 792:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 793:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 794:     event.clientX,
 795:     event.clientY,
 796:     bounds,
 797:     Boolean(session?.flipped),
 798:   );
 799: 
 800:   if (to && to !== from) {
 801:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 802:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 803:   } else {
 804:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 805:   }
 806: 
 807:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 808:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 809:   setArrowStart(null);
 810:   setArrowHover(null);
 811: }

 889:   async function detectBoards() {
 890:     if (detecting) {
 891:       stopBoardScan();
 892:       return;
 893:     }
 894: 
 895:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 896:     if (!API_BASE) {
 897:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 898:       return;
 899:     }
 900: 
 901:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 902:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 903:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 904:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 905: 
 906:     setDetecting(true);
 907:     setError("");
 908:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 909:     patchSession((current) => ({
 910:       ...current,
 911:       candidatesByPage: {
 912:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 913:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 914:       },
 915:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 916:     }));
 917: 
 918:     try {
 919:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 920:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 921:           (blob) => blob
 922:             ? resolve(blob)
 923:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 924:           "image/png",
 925:         );
 926:       });
 927: 
 928:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 929: 
 930:       const form = new FormData();
 931:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 932: 
 933:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 934:         method: "POST",
 935:         body: form,
 936:         signal: abortController.signal,
 937:       });
 938: 
 939:       if (!response.ok) {
 940:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 941:       }
 942: 
 943:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 944:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 945:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 946:       );
 947: 
 948:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 949: 
 950:       patchSession((current) => ({
 951:         ...current,
 952:         candidatesByPage: {
 953:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 954:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 955:         },
 956:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 957:       }));
 958: 
 959:       setNotice(
 960:         candidates.length
 961:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 962:           : "No board candidates found.",
 963:       );
 964:     } catch (cause) {
 965:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 966: 
 967:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 968:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 969:       } else {
 970:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 971:       }
 972:     } finally {
 973:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 974:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 975:         setDetecting(false);
 976:       }
 977:     }
 978:   }

 981:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;

 997:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 998:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 999:     if (!manualMode) return;
1000: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1001: if (!canvas) return;
1002: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1003: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1004: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1005: if (
1006:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||

1008:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||

1020:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1021:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1022:     if (edit) {
1023:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1024:       if (!point || !session) return;
1025:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1026:       patchSession((current) => {
1027:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1028:         return {
1029:           ...current,
1030:           candidatesByPage: {
1031:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1032:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1033:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1034:           },
1035:         };
1036:       });
1037:       return;
1038:     }
1039:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1040:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1041:     if (point) {
1042:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1043:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1044:       setDragSelection(selection);
1045:     }
1046:   }

1048:   function finishRegion() {
1049:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1050:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1051:       return;
1052:     }
1053:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1054:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1055:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1056:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1057:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1058:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1059:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1060:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1061:     setDragSelection(null);
1062:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1063:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1064:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1065:       x, y, width, height,
1066:       relativeScore: 1,
1067:       source: "manual",
1068:     };
1069:     patchSession((current) => ({
1070:       ...current,
1071:       candidatesByPage: {
1072:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1073:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1074:       },
1075:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1076:     }));
1077:     setManualMode(false);
1078:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1079:   }

1083:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1084:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1085:     setDragSelection(null);

1088:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1089:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1090:     try {
1091:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1092:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1093:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1094:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1095:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1096:       const scale = mode === "width"
1097:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1098:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1099:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1100:     } catch (cause) {
1101:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1102:     }
1103:   }

 157:         if (!cancelled) setError(`Could not restore the local library: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 158:       } finally {
 159:         if (!cancelled) setReady(true);
 160:       }
 161:     }
 162:     void initialize();
 163:     return () => { cancelled = true; };
 164:   }, []);
 165: 
 166:   useEffect(() => {
 167:     if (!ready || !book || !session) return;
 168:     const snapshot = session;
 169:     void Promise.all([putSession(snapshot), setActiveBookId(book.id)])
 170:       .then(() => setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [snapshot.bookId]: snapshot })))
 171:       .catch((cause: unknown) => setError(`Could not save reading session: ${messageOf(cause)}`));
 172:   }, [ready, book, session]);
 173: 
 174:   useEffect(() => {
 175:     pdfRef.current?.cleanup();
 176:     void loadingTaskRef.current?.destroy();
 177:     setPdf(null);
 178:     if (!book) {
 179:       pdfRef.current = null;
 180:       loadingTaskRef.current = null;
 181:       return;
 182:     }
 183:     let cancelled = false;
 184:     let loadingTask: PDFDocumentLoadingTask | null = null;
 185:     setPdfLoading(true);
 186:     setError("");
 187:     book.file.slice(0).arrayBuffer().then((data) => {
 188:       if (cancelled) return;
 189:       loadingTask = getDocument({ data });
 190:       loadingTaskRef.current = loadingTask;
 191:       return loadingTask.promise;
 192:     }).then((document) => {
 193:       if (!document) return;
 194:       if (cancelled) {
 195:         void document.cleanup();
 196:         return;
 197:       }
 198:       pdfRef.current = document;
 199:       setPdf(document);
 200:       setPdfLoading(false);
 201:       setSession((current) => current ? { ...current, pageCount: document.numPages } : current);
 202:     }).catch((cause: unknown) => {
 203:       if (!cancelled) {
 204:         setPdfLoading(false);
 205:         setError(`Could not open this PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 206:       }
 207:     });
 208:     return () => {
 209:       cancelled = true;
 210:       if (loadingTask) void loadingTask.destroy();
 211:     };
 212:   }, [book]);
 213: 
 214:   useEffect(() => {
 215:     if (!pdf || !session || !canvasRef.current) return;
 216:     let cancelled = false;
 217:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 218:     setRendering(true);
 219:     pdf.getPage(session.page).then((page) => {
 220:       if (cancelled) return;
 221:       const viewport = page.getViewport({ scale: session.zoom * Math.min(1.4, 1100 / page.getViewport({ scale: 1 }).width) });
 222:       const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
 223:       if (!context) throw new Error("Canvas rendering is unavailable in this browser.");
 224:       canvas.width = Math.floor(viewport.width);
 225:       canvas.height = Math.floor(viewport.height);
 226:       const task = page.render({ canvas, canvasContext: context, viewport });
 227:       renderTaskRef.current = task;
 228:       return task.promise;
 229:     }).then(() => {
 230:       if (!cancelled) setRendering(false);
 231:     }).catch((cause: unknown) => {
 232:       if (!cancelled && !(cause instanceof Error && cause.name === "RenderingCancelledException")) {
 233:         setRendering(false);
 234:         setError(`Could not render page ${session.page}: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 235:       }
 236:     });
 237:     return () => {
 238:       cancelled = true;
 239:       renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();
 240:     };
 241:   }, [pdf, session?.page, session?.zoom]);
 242: 
 243:   useEffect(() => {
 244:     function onKey(event: KeyboardEvent) {
 245:       if (!session || !book || isTypingTarget(event.target)) return;
 246:       if (cropEditingId && ["ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", "ArrowUp", "ArrowDown"].includes(event.key)) {
 247:         const candidate = (session.candidatesByPage[String(session.page)] ?? []).find((item) => item.id === cropEditingId);
 248:         if (!candidate) return;
 249:         const step = event.shiftKey ? 0.01 : 0.002;
 250:         const x = event.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowRight" ? step : 0;
 251:         const y = event.key === "ArrowUp" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowDown" ? step : 0;
 252:         const next = editCrop(candidate, "move", x, y);
 253:         patchSession((current) => {
 254:           const pageKey = String(current.page);
 255:           return {
 256:             ...current,
 257:             candidatesByPage: {
 258:               ...current.candidatesByPage,
 259:               [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((item) =>
 260:                 item.id === candidate.id ? { ...item, ...next } : item),
 261:             },
 262:           };
 263:         });
 264:         event.preventDefault();
 265:         return;
 266:       }
 267:       if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") changePage(-1);
 268:       if (event.key === "ArrowRight") changePage(1);
 269:     }
 270:     window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 271:     return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 272:   });
 273: 
 274:   useEffect(() => () => {
 275:     engineRef.current?.dispose();
 276:     engineRef.current = null;
 277:   }, []);

 279:   const sortedBooks = useMemo(() => [...books].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt), [books]);
 280:   const visibleBooks = useMemo(() => {
 281:     const needle = bookSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
 282:     return sortedBooks.filter((item) => {
 283:       const matchesTab = libraryTab === "all" || libraryTab === "recent";
 284:       return matchesTab && item.title.toLowerCase().includes(needle);
 285:     });

 291:     try {
 292:       return makePosition(boardSession.lineBaseFen, boardSession.moves, boardSession.moveIndex);
 293:     } catch {

 295:     }

 300:   }, [game, selectedSquare]);

 303:     try { return makePosition(boardSession?.lineBaseFen ?? START_FEN, boardSession?.moves ?? [], boardSession?.moveIndex ?? 0).history({ verbose: true }); }
 304:     catch { return []; }
 305:   }, [boardSession]);
 306:   const highlightedMove = lastMove ?? (moveHistory.length
 307:     ? { from: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].from, to: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].to }
 308:     : null);
 309:   const engineArrow = useMemo(
 310:     () => engineEnabled ? parseBestMove(engineScore?.bestMove) : null,

 318:     setAnnotationMode(false);

 325:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 326:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 327:   }

 329:   function toggleEngine() {
 330:     if (engineEnabled) {
 331:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 332:       engineRef.current = null;
 333:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 334:       setEngineStatus("off");
 335:       setEngineScore(null);
 336:       setEngineMessage("");
 337:       return;
 338:     }
 339:     try {
 340:       setEngineScore(null);
 341:       setEngineMessage("");
 342:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 343:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 344:         (status, message) => {
 345:           setEngineStatus(status);
 346:           if (status === "error") {
 347:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 348:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 349:             setEngineScore(null);
 350:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 351:             engineRef.current = null;
 352:           }
 353:         },
 354:         setEngineScore,
 355:       );
 356:       engineRef.current = client;
 357:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 358:     } catch (cause) {
 359:       setEngineStatus("error");
 360:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 361:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 362:     }
 363:   }

 365:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 366:     setSession((current) => {
 367:       if (!current) return current;
 368:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 369:     });
 370:   }

 373:     if (studyMode) setStudyBoard((current) => current ? { ...current, ...change } : current);
 374:     else patchSession(change);

 400:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 401:     try {
 402:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 403:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 404:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 405:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 406:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 407:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 408:       setBook(opened);
 409:       setSession(nextSession);
 410:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 411:       setError("");
 412:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 413:     } catch (cause) {
 414:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 415:     }
 416:   }

 418:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 419:     if (!file) return;
 420:     try {
 421:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 422:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 423:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 424:       const now = Date.now();
 425:       const created: BookRecord = {
 426:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 427:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 428:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 429:         byteLength: file.size,
 430:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 431:         addedAt: now,
 432:       };
 433:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 434:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 435:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 436:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 437:       setBook(created);
 438:       setSession(blank);
 439:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 440:       setError("");
 441:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 442:     } catch (cause) {
 443:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 444:     }
 445:   }

 447:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 448:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 449: 
 450:     try {
 451:       await removeBook(item.id);
 452:       await removeSession(item.id);
 453: 
 454:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 455:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 456:         const next = { ...current };
 457:         delete next[item.id];
 458:         return next;
 459:       });
 460: 
 461:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 462:         setBook(null);
 463:         setSession(null);
 464:         setPdf(null);
 465:       }
 466: 
 467:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 468:       setError("");
 469:     } catch (cause) {
 470:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 471:     }
 472:   }
 473:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 474:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 475:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 476:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 477:     try {
 478:       await putBook(renamed);
 479:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 480:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 481:     } catch (cause) {
 482:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 483:     }
 484:   }

 487:     if (!session) return;
 488:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });
 489:   }

 492:     if (!session || !Number.isFinite(value)) return;
 493:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });
 494:   }

 496:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 497:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 498:     try {
 499:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 500:       setSession({
 501:         ...activeSession,
 502:         originalFen: fen,
 503:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 504:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 505:         moves: [],
 506:         moveIndex: 0,
 507:       });
 508:       setLastMove(null);
 509:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 510:       setUserArrows([]);
 511:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 512:       return true;
 513:     } catch (cause) {
 514:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 515:       return false;
 516:     }
 517:   }

 526:     } else {

 528:     }
 529:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 530:     return true;
 531:   }

 582:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 583:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 584:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 585:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 586:       return;
 587:     }
 588:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 589:     try {
 590:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 591:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 592:       preview.width = crop.width;
 593:       preview.height = crop.height;
 594:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 595:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 596:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 597:     } catch (cause) {
 598:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 599:       return;
 600:     }
 601:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 602:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 603:     setTransferFen("");
 604:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 605:         setRecognitionError("");
 606:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 607:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 608:     try {
 609:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 610:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 611:       });
 612:       const form = new FormData();
 613:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 614:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 615:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 616:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 617:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 618:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 619:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 620:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 621:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 622:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 623:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 624:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 625:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 626:       }
 627:     } catch (cause) {
 628:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 629:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 630:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 631:     }
 632:   }
 633: 
 634:   function closeTransfer() {
 635:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 636:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 637:     setTransferPreview("");
 638:     setTransferFen("");
 639:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 640:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 641:     setRecognitionError("");
 642:       }

 645:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 646:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 647:       setGameEndOverlay({
 648:         title: "Checkmate",
 649:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 650:       });
 651:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 652:       setGameEndOverlay({
 653:         title: "Stalemate",
 654:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 655:       });
 656:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 657:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 658:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 659:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 660:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 661:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 662:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 663:     } else {
 664:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 665:     }
 666:   }
 667: 
 668:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 669:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 670:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 671:     try {
 672:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 673:       const result = currentGame.move({
 674:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 675:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 676:         promotion: piece,
 677:       });
 678:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 679:       patchBoardSession({
 680:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 681:         moves: nextMoves,
 682:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 683:       });
 684:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 685:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 686:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 687:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 688:       setError("");
 689:     } catch {
 690:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 691:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 692:     }
 693:   }
 694: 
 695:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 696:     if (!boardSession) return;
 697:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 698:     try {
 699:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 700:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 701:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 702:       if (promote) {
 703:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 704:         return;
 705:       }
 706:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 707:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 708:       patchBoardSession({
 709:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 710:         moves: nextMoves,
 711:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 712:       });
 713:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 714:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 715:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 716:       setError("");
 717:     } catch {
 718:       const piece = game.get(to);
 719:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 720:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 721:     }
 722:   }
 723: 
 724:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 725:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 726:     setRedSquares([]);
 727: 
 728:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 729:       setUserArrows([]);
 730:       setArrowStart(null);
 731:       setArrowHover(null);
 732:       return;
 733:     }
 734: if (!boardSession) return;
 735:     if (annotationMode) {
 736:       if (!arrowStart) {
 737:         setArrowStart(square);
 738:         return;
 739:       }
 740:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 741:       setArrowStart(null);
 742:       setArrowHover(null);
 743:       return;
 744:     }
 745:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 746:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 747:       return;
 748:     }
 749:     const piece = game.get(square);
 750:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 751:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 752:   }
 753:

 763:     bounds,
 764:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 765:   );

 768:

 773:   setArrowStart(square);

 779:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 780:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 781:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 782:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));

 787:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 788:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 789: 
 790:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 791: 
 792:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 793:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 794:     event.clientX,
 795:     event.clientY,
 796:     bounds,
 797:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 798:   );
 799: 
 800:   if (to && to !== from) {
 801:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 802:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 803:   } else {
 804:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 805:   }
 806: 
 807:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 808:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 809:   setArrowStart(null);
 810:   setArrowHover(null);

 863:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.

 880:         ...current.candidatesByPage,

 889:   async function detectBoards() {
 890:     if (detecting) {
 891:       stopBoardScan();
 892:       return;
 893:     }
 894: 
 895:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 896:     if (!API_BASE) {
 897:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 898:       return;
 899:     }
 900: 
 901:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 902:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 903:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 904:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 905: 
 906:     setDetecting(true);
 907:     setError("");
 908:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 909:     patchSession((current) => ({
 910:       ...current,
 911:       candidatesByPage: {
 912:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 913:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 914:       },
 915:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 916:     }));
 917: 
 918:     try {
 919:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 920:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 921:           (blob) => blob
 922:             ? resolve(blob)
 923:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 924:           "image/png",
 925:         );
 926:       });
 927: 
 928:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 929: 
 930:       const form = new FormData();
 931:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 932: 
 933:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 934:         method: "POST",
 935:         body: form,
 936:         signal: abortController.signal,
 937:       });
 938: 
 939:       if (!response.ok) {
 940:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 941:       }
 942: 
 943:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 944:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 945:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 946:       );
 947: 
 948:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 949: 
 950:       patchSession((current) => ({
 951:         ...current,
 952:         candidatesByPage: {
 953:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 954:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 955:         },
 956:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 957:       }));
 958: 
 959:       setNotice(
 960:         candidates.length
 961:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 962:           : "No board candidates found.",
 963:       );
 964:     } catch (cause) {
 965:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 966: 
 967:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 968:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 969:       } else {
 970:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 971:       }
 972:     } finally {
 973:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 974:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 975:         setDetecting(false);
 976:       }
 977:     }
 978:   }
 979:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {

 997:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 998:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 999:     if (!manualMode) return;
1000: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1001: if (!canvas) return;
1002: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1003: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1004: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1005: if (
1006:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1007:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1008:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1009:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1010: ) return;
1011:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1012:     if (!point) return;
1013:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1014:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1015:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1016:     setDragSelection(selection);

1020:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1021:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1022:     if (edit) {
1023:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1024:       if (!point || !session) return;
1025:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1026:       patchSession((current) => {
1027:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1028:         return {
1029:           ...current,
1030:           candidatesByPage: {
1031:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1032:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1033:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1034:           },
1035:         };
1036:       });
1037:       return;
1038:     }
1039:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1040:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1041:     if (point) {
1042:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1043:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1044:       setDragSelection(selection);
1045:     }
1046:   }

1048:   function finishRegion() {
1049:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1050:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1051:       return;
1052:     }
1053:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1054:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1055:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1056:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1057:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1058:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1059:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1060:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1061:     setDragSelection(null);
1062:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1063:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1064:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1065:       x, y, width, height,
1066:       relativeScore: 1,
1067:       source: "manual",
1068:     };
1069:     patchSession((current) => ({
1070:       ...current,
1071:       candidatesByPage: {
1072:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1073:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1074:       },
1075:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1076:     }));
1077:     setManualMode(false);
1078:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1079:   }

1084:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1085:     setDragSelection(null);

1088:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1089:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1090:     try {
1091:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1092:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1093:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1094:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1095:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1096:       const scale = mode === "width"
1097:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1098:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1099:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1100:     } catch (cause) {
1101:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1102:     }
1103:   }

1629: function formatSize(bytes: number): string {
1630:   if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${Math.max(1, Math.round(bytes / 1024))} KB`;
1631:   return `${(bytes / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)} MB`;

  27: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  28:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  29:   if (!match) return uci;
  30:   try {
  31:     const position = new Chess(fen);
  32:     const move = position.move({
  33:       from: match[1] as Square,
  34:       to: match[2] as Square,
  35:       ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  36:     });
  37:     return move.san;
  38:   } catch {
  39:     return uci;
  40:   }
  41: }

  43: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {
  44:   const position = new Chess(fen);
  45:   const san: string[] = [];
  46:   for (const uci of pv) {
  47:     const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  48:     if (!match) break;
  49:     try {
  50:       const move = position.move({
  51:         from: match[1] as Square,
  52:         to: match[2] as Square,
  53:         ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  54:       });
  55:       san.push(move.san);
  56:     } catch {
  57:       break;
  58:     }
  59:   }
  60:   return san.join(" ");
  61: }

  83: function readableDate(timestamp: number): string {
  84:   if (!timestamp) return "Not opened";
  85:   const elapsed = Date.now() - timestamp;
  86:   if (elapsed < 60_000) return "Just now";
  87:   if (elapsed < 3_600_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 60_000)}m ago`;
  88:   if (elapsed < 86_400_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 3_600_000)}h ago`;
  89:   return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString();

 520:     try {
 521:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 522:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 523:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 524:       const now = Date.now();
 525:       const created: BookRecord = {
 526:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 527:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 528:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 529:         byteLength: file.size,
 530:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 531:         addedAt: now,
 532:       };
 533:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 534:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 535:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 536:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 537:       setBook(created);
 538:       setSession(blank);
 539:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 540:       setError("");
 541:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 542:     } catch (cause) {
 543:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 544:     }
 545:   }
 546: 
 547:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 548:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 549: 
 550:     try {
 551:       await removeBook(item.id);
 552:       await removeSession(item.id);
 553: 
 554:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 555:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 556:         const next = { ...current };
 557:         delete next[item.id];
 558:         return next;
 559:       });
 560: 
 561:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 562:         setBook(null);
 563:         setSession(null);
 564:         setPdf(null);
 565:       }
 566: 
 567:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 568:       setError("");
 569:     } catch (cause) {
 570:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 571:     }
 572:   }
 573:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 574:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 575:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 576:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 577:     try {
 578:       await putBook(renamed);
 579:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 580:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 581:     } catch (cause) {
 582:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 583:     }
 584:   }

 603:         lineBaseFen: fen,

 606:         moveIndex: 0,
 607:       });
 608:       setLastMove(null);
 609:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 610:       setUserArrows([]);
 611:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 612:       return true;
 613:     } catch (cause) {
 614:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 615:       return false;
 616:     }

 682:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 683:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 684:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 685:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 686:       return;
 687:     }
 688:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 689:     try {
 690:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 691:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 692:       preview.width = crop.width;
 693:       preview.height = crop.height;
 694:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 695:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 696:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 697:     } catch (cause) {
 698:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 699:       return;
 700:     }
 701:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 702:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 703:     setTransferFen("");
 704:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 705:         setRecognitionError("");
 706:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 707:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 708:     try {
 709:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 710:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 711:       });
 712:       const form = new FormData();
 713:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 714:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 715:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 716:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 717:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 718:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 719:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 720:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 721:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 722:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 723:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 724:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 725:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 726:       }
 727:     } catch (cause) {
 728:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 729:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 730:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 731:     }
 732:   }
 733: 
 734:   function closeTransfer() {
 735:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 736:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 737:     setTransferPreview("");
 738:     setTransferFen("");
 739:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 740:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 741:     setRecognitionError("");
 742:       }

 745:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 746:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 747:       setGameEndOverlay({
 748:         title: "Checkmate",
 749:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 750:       });
 751:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 752:       setGameEndOverlay({
 753:         title: "Stalemate",
 754:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 755:       });
 756:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 757:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 758:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 759:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 760:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 761:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 762:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 763:     } else {
 764:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 765:     }
 766:   }

 768:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 769:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 770:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 771:     try {
 772:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 773:       const result = currentGame.move({
 774:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 775:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 776:         promotion: piece,
 777:       });
 778:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 779:       patchBoardSession({
 780:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 781:         moves: nextMoves,
 782:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 783:       });
 784:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 785:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 786:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 787:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 788:       setError("");
 789:     } catch {
 790:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 791:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 792:     }
 793:   }
 794: 
 795:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 796:     if (!boardSession) return;
 797:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 798:     try {
 799:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 800:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 801:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 802:       if (promote) {
 803:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 804:         return;
 805:       }
 806:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 807:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 808:       patchBoardSession({
 809:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 810:         moves: nextMoves,
 811:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 812:       });
 813:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 814:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 815:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 816:       setError("");
 817:     } catch {
 818:       const piece = game.get(to);
 819:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 820:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 821:     }
 822:   }

 824:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 825:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 826:     setRedSquares([]);
 827: 
 828:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 829:       setUserArrows([]);
 830:       setArrowStart(null);
 831:       setArrowHover(null);
 832:       return;
 833:     }
 834: if (!boardSession) return;
 835:     if (annotationMode) {
 836:       if (!arrowStart) {
 837:         setArrowStart(square);
 838:         return;
 839:       }
 840:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 841:       setArrowStart(null);
 842:       setArrowHover(null);
 843:       return;
 844:     }
 845:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 846:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 847:       return;
 848:     }
 849:     const piece = game.get(square);
 850:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 851:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 852:   }

 854:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {

 864:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),

 873:   setArrowStart(square);

 875:

 877: }

 887:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 888:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 889: 
 890:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 891: 
 892:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 893:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 894:     event.clientX,
 895:     event.clientY,
 896:     bounds,
 897:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 898:   );
 899: 
 900:   if (to && to !== from) {
 901:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 902:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 903:   } else {
 904:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 905:   }
 906: 
 907:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 908:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 909:   setArrowStart(null);
 910:   setArrowHover(null);
 911: }

 989:   async function detectBoards() {
 990:     if (detecting) {
 991:       stopBoardScan();
 992:       return;
 993:     }
 994: 
 995:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 996:     if (!API_BASE) {
 997:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 998:       return;
 999:     }
1000: 
1001:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
1002:     const abortController = new AbortController();
1003:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
1004:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
1005: 
1006:     setDetecting(true);
1007:     setError("");
1008:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
1009:     patchSession((current) => ({
1010:       ...current,
1011:       candidatesByPage: {
1012:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1013:         [String(current.page)]: [],
1014:       },
1015:       selectedDiagramId: null,
1016:     }));
1017: 
1018:     try {
1019:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
1020:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
1021:           (blob) => blob
1022:             ? resolve(blob)
1023:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
1024:           "image/png",
1025:         );
1026:       });
1027: 
1028:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1029: 
1030:       const form = new FormData();
1031:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
1032: 
1033:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
1034:         method: "POST",
1035:         body: form,
1036:         signal: abortController.signal,
1037:       });
1038: 
1039:       if (!response.ok) {
1040:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
1041:       }
1042: 
1043:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
1044:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
1045:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
1046:       );
1047: 
1048:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1049: 
1050:       patchSession((current) => ({
1051:         ...current,
1052:         candidatesByPage: {
1053:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
1054:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
1055:         },
1056:         selectedDiagramId: null,
1057:       }));
1058: 
1059:       setNotice(
1060:         candidates.length
1061:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
1062:           : "No board candidates found.",
1063:       );
1064:     } catch (cause) {
1065:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1066: 
1067:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
1068:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
1069:       } else {
1070:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1071:       }
1072:     } finally {
1073:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
1074:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1075:         setDetecting(false);
1076:       }
1077:     }
1078:   }

1097:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1098:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1099:     if (!manualMode) return;
1100: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1101: if (!canvas) return;
1102: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1103: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1104: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1105: if (
1106:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1107:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1108:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1109:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1110: ) return;
1111:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1112:     if (!point) return;
1113:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1114:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1115:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1116:     setDragSelection(selection);
1117:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);

1120:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1121:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1122:     if (edit) {
1123:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1124:       if (!point || !session) return;
1125:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1126:       patchSession((current) => {
1127:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1128:         return {
1129:           ...current,
1130:           candidatesByPage: {
1131:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1132:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1133:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1134:           },
1135:         };
1136:       });
1137:       return;
1138:     }
1139:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1140:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1141:     if (point) {
1142:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1143:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1144:       setDragSelection(selection);
1145:     }

1148:   function finishRegion() {
1149:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1150:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1151:       return;
1152:     }
1153:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1154:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1155:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1156:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1157:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1158:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1159:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1160:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1161:     setDragSelection(null);
1162:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1163:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1164:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1165:       x, y, width, height,
1166:       relativeScore: 1,
1167:       source: "manual",
1168:     };
1169:     patchSession((current) => ({
1170:       ...current,
1171:       candidatesByPage: {
1172:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1173:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1174:       },
1175:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1176:     }));
1177:     setManualMode(false);
1178:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1179:   }

1188:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1189:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1190:     try {
1191:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1192:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1193:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1194:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1195:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1196:       const scale = mode === "width"
1197:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1198:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1199:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1200:     } catch (cause) {
1201:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1202:     }
1203:   }

 333:   function toggleEngine() {
 334:     if (engineEnabled) {
 335:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 336:       engineRef.current = null;
 337:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 338:       setEngineStatus("off");
 339:       setEngineScore(null);
 340:       setEngineMessage("");
 341:       return;
 342:     }
 343:     try {
 344:       setEngineScore(null);
 345:       setEngineMessage("");
 346:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 347:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 348:         (status, message) => {
 349:           setEngineStatus(status);
 350:           if (status === "error") {
 351:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 352:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 353:             setEngineScore(null);
 354:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 355:             engineRef.current = null;
 356:           }
 357:         },
 358:         setEngineScore,
 359:       );
 360:       engineRef.current = client;
 361:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 362:     } catch (cause) {
 363:       setEngineStatus("error");
 364:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 365:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 366:     }
 367:   }

 369:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 370:     setSession((current) => {
 371:       if (!current) return current;
 372:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 373:     });
 374:   }

 376:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 377:     try {
 378:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 379:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 380:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 381:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 382:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 383:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 384:       setBook(opened);
 385:       setSession(nextSession);
 386:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 387:       setError("");
 388:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 389:     } catch (cause) {
 390:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 391:     }
 392:   }

 394:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 395:     if (!file) return;
 396:     try {
 397:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 398:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 399:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 400:       const now = Date.now();
 401:       const created: BookRecord = {
 402:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 403:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 404:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 405:         byteLength: file.size,
 406:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 407:         addedAt: now,
 408:       };
 409:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 410:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 411:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 412:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 413:       setBook(created);
 414:       setSession(blank);
 415:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 416:       setError("");
 417:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 418:     } catch (cause) {
 419:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 420:     }
 421:   }

 423:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 424:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 425: 
 426:     try {
 427:       await removeBook(item.id);
 428:       await removeSession(item.id);
 429: 
 430:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 431:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 432:         const next = { ...current };
 433:         delete next[item.id];
 434:         return next;
 435:       });
 436: 
 437:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 438:         setBook(null);
 439:         setSession(null);
 440:         setPdf(null);
 441:       }
 442: 
 443:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 444:       setError("");
 445:     } catch (cause) {
 446:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 447:     }
 448:   }
 449:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 450:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 451:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 452:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 453:     try {
 454:       await putBook(renamed);
 455:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 456:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 457:     } catch (cause) {
 458:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 459:     }
 460:   }

 478:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 479:         currentFen: next.fen(),

 481:         moveIndex: 0,
 482:       });
 483:       setLastMove(null);
 484:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 485:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 486:       return true;
 487:     } catch (cause) {
 488:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 489:       return false;
 490:     }
 491:   }
