 868:   async function detectBoards() {
 869:     if (detecting) {
 870:       stopBoardScan();
 871:       return;
 872:     }
 873: 
 874:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 875:     if (!API_BASE) {
 876:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 877:       return;
 878:     }
 879: 
 880:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 881:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 882:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 883:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 884: 
 885:     setDetecting(true);
 886:     setError("");
 887:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 888:     patchSession((current) => ({
 889:       ...current,
 890:       candidatesByPage: {
 891:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 892:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 893:       },
 894:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 895:     }));
 896: 
 897:     try {
 898:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 899:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 900:           (blob) => blob
 901:             ? resolve(blob)
 902:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 903:           "image/png",
 904:         );
 905:       });
 906: 
 907:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 908: 
 909:       const form = new FormData();
 910:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 911: 
 912:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 913:         method: "POST",
 914:         body: form,
 915:         signal: abortController.signal,
 916:       });
 917: 
 918:       if (!response.ok) {
 919:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 920:       }
 921: 
 922:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 923:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 924:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 925:       );
 926: 
 927:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 928: 
 929:       patchSession((current) => ({
 930:         ...current,
 931:         candidatesByPage: {
 932:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 933:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 934:         },
 935:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 936:       }));
 937: 
 938:       setNotice(
 939:         candidates.length
 940:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 941:           : "No board candidates found.",
 942:       );
 943:     } catch (cause) {
 944:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 945: 
 946:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 947:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 948:       } else {
 949:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 950:       }
 951:     } finally {
 952:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 953:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 954:         setDetecting(false);
 955:       }
 956:     }
 957:   }

 976:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 977:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 978:     if (!manualMode) return;
 979: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 980: if (!canvas) return;
 981: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 982: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 983: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 984: if (
 985:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 986:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 987:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 988:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 989: ) return;
 990:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 991:     if (!point) return;
 992:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 993:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 994:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 995:     setDragSelection(selection);
 996:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);

 999:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1000:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1001:     if (edit) {
1002:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1003:       if (!point || !session) return;
1004:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1005:       patchSession((current) => {
1006:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1007:         return {
1008:           ...current,
1009:           candidatesByPage: {
1010:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1011:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1012:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1013:           },
1014:         };
1015:       });
1016:       return;
1017:     }
1018:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1019:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1020:     if (point) {
1021:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1022:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1023:       setDragSelection(selection);
1024:     }
1025:   }

1027:   function finishRegion() {
1028:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1029:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1030:       return;
1031:     }
1032:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1033:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1034:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1035:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1036:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1037:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1038:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1039:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1040:     setDragSelection(null);
1041:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1042:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1043:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1044:       x, y, width, height,
1045:       relativeScore: 1,
1046:       source: "manual",
1047:     };
1048:     patchSession((current) => ({
1049:       ...current,
1050:       candidatesByPage: {
1051:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1052:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1053:       },
1054:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1055:     }));
1056:     setManualMode(false);
1057:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1058:   }

1061:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1062:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1063:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1064:     setDragSelection(null);
1065:   }

1067:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1068:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1069:     try {
1070:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1071:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1072:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1073:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1074:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1075:       const scale = mode === "width"
1076:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1077:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1078:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1079:     } catch (cause) {
1080:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1081:     }
1082:   }

  35: type RecognitionResult = {
  36:   fen: string;
  37:   orientation: "normal" | "flipped" | "unknown";
  38:   board_confidence: number;
  39:   mean_piece_confidence: number | null;

  45: function readableDate(timestamp: number): string {
  46:   if (!timestamp) return "Not opened";
  47:   const elapsed = Date.now() - timestamp;
  48:   if (elapsed < 60_000) return "Just now";
  49:   if (elapsed < 3_600_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 60_000)}m ago`;
  50:   if (elapsed < 86_400_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 3_600_000)}h ago`;
  51:   return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString();
  52: }
  53: 
  54: function squareName(fileIndex: number, rankIndex: number): Square {
  55:   return `${"abcdefgh"[fileIndex]}${rankIndex + 1}` as Square;
  56: }
  57: 
  58: function normalizedCandidate(value: CandidateInput, index: number): Candidate {
  59:   const { relative_score, confidence, ...candidate } = value;
  60:   return {
  61:     ...candidate,
  62:     id: candidate.id || `candidate-${index + 1}`,
  63:     source: candidate.source ?? "automatic",
  64:     relativeScore: candidate.relativeScore ?? relative_score ?? confidence ?? 0,
  65:   };
  66: }

 321:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {

 325:   function toggleEngine() {
 326:     if (engineEnabled) {
 327:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 328:       engineRef.current = null;
 329:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 330:       setEngineStatus("off");
 331:       setEngineScore(null);
 332:       setEngineMessage("");
 333:       return;
 334:     }
 335:     try {
 336:       setEngineScore(null);
 337:       setEngineMessage("");
 338:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 339:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 340:         (status, message) => {
 341:           setEngineStatus(status);
 342:           if (status === "error") {
 343:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 344:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 345:             setEngineScore(null);
 346:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 347:             engineRef.current = null;
 348:           }
 349:         },
 350:         setEngineScore,
 351:       );
 352:       engineRef.current = client;
 353:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 354:     } catch (cause) {
 355:       setEngineStatus("error");
 356:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 357:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 358:     }
 359:   }

 361:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 362:     setSession((current) => {
 363:       if (!current) return current;
 364:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 365:     });
 366:   }

 368:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 369:     try {
 370:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 371:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 372:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 373:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 374:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 375:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 376:       setBook(opened);
 377:       setSession(nextSession);
 378:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 379:       setError("");
 380:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 381:     } catch (cause) {
 382:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 383:     }
 384:   }

 386:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 387:     if (!file) return;
 388:     try {
 389:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 390:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 391:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 392:       const now = Date.now();
 393:       const created: BookRecord = {
 394:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 395:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 396:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 397:         byteLength: file.size,
 398:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 399:         addedAt: now,
 400:       };
 401:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 402:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 403:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 404:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 405:       setBook(created);
 406:       setSession(blank);
 407:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 408:       setError("");
 409:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 410:     } catch (cause) {
 411:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 412:     }
 413:   }

 415:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 416:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 417: 
 418:     try {
 419:       await removeBook(item.id);
 420:       await removeSession(item.id);
 421: 
 422:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 423:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 424:         const next = { ...current };
 425:         delete next[item.id];
 426:         return next;
 427:       });
 428: 
 429:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 430:         setBook(null);
 431:         setSession(null);
 432:         setPdf(null);
 433:       }
 434: 
 435:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 436:       setError("");
 437:     } catch (cause) {
 438:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 439:     }
 440:   }
 441:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 442:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 443:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 444:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 445:     try {
 446:       await putBook(renamed);
 447:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 448:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 449:     } catch (cause) {
 450:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 451:     }
 452:   }

 454:   function changePage(delta: number) {
 455:     if (!session) return;
 456:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });
 457:   }

 459:   function goToPage(value: number) {
 460:     if (!session || !Number.isFinite(value)) return;
 461:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });
 462:   }

 464:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 465:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 466:     try {
 467:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 468:       setSession({
 469:         ...activeSession,
 470:         originalFen: fen,
 471:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 472:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 473:         moves: [],
 474:         moveIndex: 0,
 475:       });
 476:       setLastMove(null);
 477:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 478:       setUserArrows([]);
 479:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 480:       return true;
 481:     } catch (cause) {
 482:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 483:       return false;
 484:     }
 485:   }

 487:   function analyzeManualPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 488:     const loaded = moveToPosition(fen);
 489:     if (!loaded) return false;
 490:     setEngineScore(null);
 491:     setEngineMessage("");
 492:     if (!engineEnabled) {
 493:       toggleEngine();
 494:     } else {
 495:       engineRef.current?.analyze(fen, engineDepth);
 496:     }
 497:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 498:     return true;
 499:   }

 548:   }

 550:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 551:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 552:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 553:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 554:       return;
 555:     }
 556:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 557:     try {
 558:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 559:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 560:       preview.width = crop.width;
 561:       preview.height = crop.height;
 562:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 563:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 564:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 565:     } catch (cause) {
 566:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 567:       return;
 568:     }
 569:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 570:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 571:     setTransferFen("");
 572:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 573:         setRecognitionError("");
 574:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 575:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 576:     try {
 577:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 578:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 579:       });
 580:       const form = new FormData();
 581:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 582:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 583:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 584:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 585:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 586:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 587:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 588:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 589:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 590:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 591:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 592:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 593:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 594:       }
 595:     } catch (cause) {
 596:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 597:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 598:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 599:     }
 600:   }
 601: 
 602:   function closeTransfer() {
 603:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 604:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 605:     setTransferPreview("");
 606:     setTransferFen("");
 607:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 608:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 609:     setRecognitionError("");
 610:       }

 613:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 614:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 615:       setGameEndOverlay({
 616:         title: "Checkmate",
 617:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 618:       });
 619:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 620:       setGameEndOverlay({
 621:         title: "Stalemate",
 622:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 623:       });
 624:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 625:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 626:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 627:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 628:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 629:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 630:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 631:     } else {
 632:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 633:     }
 634:   }
 635: 
 636:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 637:     if (!promotionRequest || !session) return;
 638:     try {
 639:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 640:       const result = currentGame.move({
 641:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 642:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 643:         promotion: piece,
 644:       });
 645:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 646:       patchSession({
 647:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 648:         moves: nextMoves,
 649:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 650:       });
 651:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 652:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 653:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 654:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 655:       setError("");
 656:     } catch {
 657:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 658:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 659:     }
 660:   }
 661: 
 662:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 663:     if (!session) return;
 664:     try {
 665:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 666:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 667:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 668:       if (promote) {
 669:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 670:         return;
 671:       }
 672:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 673:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 674:       patchSession({
 675:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 676:         moves: nextMoves,
 677:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 678:       });
 679:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 680:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 681:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 682:       setError("");
 683:     } catch {
 684:       const piece = game.get(to);
 685:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 686:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 687:     }
 688:   }

 690:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 691:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 692:     setRedSquares([]);
 693: 
 694:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 695:       setUserArrows([]);
 696:       setArrowStart(null);
 697:       setArrowHover(null);
 698:       return;
 699:     }
 700: if (!session) return;
 701:     if (annotationMode) {
 702:       if (!arrowStart) {
 703:         setArrowStart(square);
 704:         return;
 705:       }
 706:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 707:       setArrowStart(null);
 708:       setArrowHover(null);
 709:       return;
 710:     }
 711:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 712:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 713:       return;
 714:     }
 715:     const piece = game.get(square);
 716:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 717:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 718:   }

 757:

 768:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;

 770:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 771:   }
 772:

 855:   async function detectBoards() {
 856:     if (detecting) {
 857:       stopBoardScan();
 858:       return;
 859:     }
 860: 
 861:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 862:     if (!API_BASE) {
 863:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 864:       return;
 865:     }
 866: 
 867:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 868:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 869:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 870:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 871: 
 872:     setDetecting(true);
 873:     setError("");
 874:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 875:     patchSession((current) => ({
 876:       ...current,
 877:       candidatesByPage: {
 878:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 879:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 880:       },
 881:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 882:     }));
 883: 
 884:     try {
 885:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 886:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 887:           (blob) => blob
 888:             ? resolve(blob)
 889:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 890:           "image/png",
 891:         );
 892:       });
 893: 
 894:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 895: 
 896:       const form = new FormData();
 897:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 898: 
 899:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 900:         method: "POST",
 901:         body: form,
 902:         signal: abortController.signal,
 903:       });
 904: 
 905:       if (!response.ok) {
 906:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 907:       }
 908: 
 909:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 910:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 911:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 912:       );
 913: 
 914:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 915: 
 916:       patchSession((current) => ({
 917:         ...current,
 918:         candidatesByPage: {
 919:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 920:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 921:         },
 922:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 923:       }));
 924: 
 925:       setNotice(
 926:         candidates.length
 927:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 928:           : "No board candidates found.",
 929:       );
 930:     } catch (cause) {
 931:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 932: 
 933:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 934:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 935:       } else {
 936:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 937:       }
 938:     } finally {
 939:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 940:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 941:         setDetecting(false);
 942:       }
 943:     }
 944:   }

 963:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 964:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 965:     if (!manualMode) return;
 966: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 967: if (!canvas) return;
 968: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 969: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 970: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 971: if (
 972:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 973:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 974:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 975:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 976: ) return;
 977:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 978:     if (!point) return;
 979:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 980:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 981:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;

 986:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 987:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 988:     if (edit) {
 989:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 990:       if (!point || !session) return;
 991:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 992:       patchSession((current) => {
 993:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 994:         return {
 995:           ...current,
 996:           candidatesByPage: {
 997:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 998:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 999:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1000:           },
1001:         };
1002:       });
1003:       return;
1004:     }
1005:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1006:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1007:     if (point) {
1008:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1009:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1010:       setDragSelection(selection);
1011:     }
1012:   }

1014:   function finishRegion() {
1015:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1016:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1017:       return;
1018:     }
1019:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1020:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1021:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1022:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1023:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1024:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1025:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1026:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1027:     setDragSelection(null);
1028:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1029:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1030:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1031:       x, y, width, height,
1032:       relativeScore: 1,
1033:       source: "manual",
1034:     };
1035:     patchSession((current) => ({
1036:       ...current,
1037:       candidatesByPage: {
1038:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1039:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1040:       },
1041:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1042:     }));
1043:     setManualMode(false);
1044:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1045:   }

1054:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1055:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1056:     try {
1057:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1058:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1059:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1060:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1061:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1062:       const scale = mode === "width"
1063:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1064:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1065:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1066:     } catch (cause) {
1067:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1068:     }
1069:   }

 353:       engineRef.current = client;
 354:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 355:     } catch (cause) {
 356:       setEngineStatus("error");
 357:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 358:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 359:     }
 360:   }
 361: 
 362:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 363:     setSession((current) => {
 364:       if (!current) return current;
 365:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 366:     });
 367:   }
 368: 
 369:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 370:     try {
 371:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 372:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 373:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 374:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 375:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 376:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 377:       setBook(opened);
 378:       setSession(nextSession);
 379:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 380:       setError("");
 381:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 382:     } catch (cause) {
 383:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 384:     }
 385:   }
 386: 
 387:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 388:     if (!file) return;
 389:     try {
 390:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 391:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 392:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 393:       const now = Date.now();
 394:       const created: BookRecord = {
 395:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 396:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 397:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 398:         byteLength: file.size,
 399:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 400:         addedAt: now,
 401:       };
 402:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 403:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 404:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 405:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 406:       setBook(created);
 407:       setSession(blank);
 408:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 409:       setError("");
 410:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 411:     } catch (cause) {
 412:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 413:     }
 414:   }
 415: 
 416:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 417:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 418: 
 419:     try {
 420:       await removeBook(item.id);
 421:       await removeSession(item.id);
 422: 
 423:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 424:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 425:         const next = { ...current };
 426:         delete next[item.id];
 427:         return next;
 428:       });
 429: 
 430:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 431:         setBook(null);
 432:         setSession(null);
 433:         setPdf(null);
 434:       }
 435: 
 436:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 437:       setError("");
 438:     } catch (cause) {
 439:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 440:     }
 441:   }
 442:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 443:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 444:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 445:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 446:     try {
 447:       await putBook(renamed);
 448:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 449:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 450:     } catch (cause) {
 451:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 452:     }
 453:   }

 456:     if (!session) return;
 457:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });
 458:   }

 462:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });
 463:   }

 465:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 466:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 467:     try {
 468:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 469:       setSession({
 470:         ...activeSession,
 471:         originalFen: fen,
 472:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 473:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 474:         moves: [],
 475:         moveIndex: 0,
 476:       });
 477:       setLastMove(null);
 478:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 479:       setUserArrows([]);
 480:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 481:       return true;
 482:     } catch (cause) {
 483:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 484:       return false;
 485:     }
 486:   }

 495:     } else {

 497:     }
 498:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 499:     return true;

 551:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 552:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 553:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 554:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 555:       return;
 556:     }
 557:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 558:     try {
 559:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 560:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 561:       preview.width = crop.width;
 562:       preview.height = crop.height;
 563:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 564:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 565:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 566:     } catch (cause) {
 567:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 568:       return;
 569:     }
 570:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 571:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 572:     setTransferFen("");
 573:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 574:         setRecognitionError("");
 575:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 576:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 577:     try {
 578:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 579:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 580:       });
 581:       const form = new FormData();
 582:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 583:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 584:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 585:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 586:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 587:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 588:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 589:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 590:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 591:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 592:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 593:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 594:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 595:       }
 596:     } catch (cause) {
 597:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 598:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 599:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 600:     }
 601:   }
 602: 
 603:   function closeTransfer() {
 604:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 605:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 606:     setTransferPreview("");
 607:     setTransferFen("");
 608:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 609:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 610:     setRecognitionError("");
 611:       }

 614:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 615:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 616:       setGameEndOverlay({
 617:         title: "Checkmate",
 618:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 619:       });
 620:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 621:       setGameEndOverlay({
 622:         title: "Stalemate",
 623:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 624:       });
 625:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 626:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 627:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 628:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 629:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 630:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 631:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 632:     } else {
 633:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 634:     }
 635:   }

 637:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 638:     if (!promotionRequest || !session) return;
 639:     try {
 640:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 641:       const result = currentGame.move({
 642:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 643:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 644:         promotion: piece,
 645:       });
 646:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 647:       patchSession({
 648:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 649:         moves: nextMoves,
 650:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 651:       });
 652:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 653:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 654:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 655:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 656:       setError("");
 657:     } catch {
 658:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 659:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 660:     }
 661:   }
 662: 
 663:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 664:     if (!session) return;
 665:     try {
 666:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 667:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 668:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 669:       if (promote) {
 670:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 671:         return;
 672:       }
 673:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 674:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 675:       patchSession({
 676:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 677:         moves: nextMoves,
 678:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 679:       });
 680:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 681:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 682:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 683:       setError("");
 684:     } catch {
 685:       const piece = game.get(to);
 686:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 687:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 688:     }
 689:   }
 690: 
 691:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 692:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 693:     setRedSquares([]);
 694:     
 695:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 696:       setUserArrows([]);
 697:       setArrowStart(null);
 698:       setArrowHover(null);
 699:       return;
 700:     }
 701: if (!session) return;
 702:     if (annotationMode) {
 703:       if (!arrowStart) {
 704:         setArrowStart(square);
 705:         return;
 706:       }
 707:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 708:       setArrowStart(null);
 709:       setArrowHover(null);
 710:       return;
 711:     }
 712:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 713:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 714:       return;
 715:     }
 716:     const piece = game.get(square);
 717:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 718:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 719:   }

 721:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 722:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 723: 
 724:   event.preventDefault();
 725: 
 726:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 727:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 728:     event.clientX,
 729:     event.clientY,
 730:     bounds,
 731:     Boolean(session?.flipped),
 732:   );
 733: 
 734:   if (!square) return;
 735: 
 736:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 737:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 738:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 739:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 740:   setArrowStart(square);
 741:   setArrowHover(square);
 742: 
 743:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 744: }

 746:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 747:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 748:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 749:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(session?.flipped));
 750:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 751:     setArrowHover(square);

 754:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 755:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 756: 
 757:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 758: 
 759:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 760:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 761:     event.clientX,
 762:     event.clientY,
 763:     bounds,
 764:     Boolean(session?.flipped),
 765:   );
 766: 
 767:   if (to && to !== from) {
 768:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 769:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 770:   } else {
 771:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 772:   }
 773: 
 774:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 775:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 776:   setArrowStart(null);
 777:   setArrowHover(null);
 778: }

 830:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
 831:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 832:

 834:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;

 843:

 845:       ...current,

 856:   async function detectBoards() {
 857:     if (detecting) {
 858:       stopBoardScan();
 859:       return;
 860:     }
 861: 
 862:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 863:     if (!API_BASE) {
 864:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 865:       return;
 866:     }
 867: 
 868:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 869:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 870:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 871:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 872: 
 873:     setDetecting(true);
 874:     setError("");
 875:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 876:     patchSession((current) => ({
 877:       ...current,
 878:       candidatesByPage: {
 879:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 880:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 881:       },
 882:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 883:     }));
 884: 
 885:     try {
 886:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 887:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 888:           (blob) => blob
 889:             ? resolve(blob)
 890:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 891:           "image/png",
 892:         );
 893:       });
 894: 
 895:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 896: 
 897:       const form = new FormData();
 898:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 899: 
 900:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 901:         method: "POST",
 902:         body: form,
 903:         signal: abortController.signal,
 904:       });
 905: 
 906:       if (!response.ok) {
 907:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 908:       }
 909: 
 910:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 911:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 912:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 913:       );
 914: 
 915:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 916: 
 917:       patchSession((current) => ({
 918:         ...current,
 919:         candidatesByPage: {
 920:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 921:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 922:         },
 923:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 924:       }));
 925: 
 926:       setNotice(
 927:         candidates.length
 928:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 929:           : "No board candidates found.",
 930:       );
 931:     } catch (cause) {
 932:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 933: 
 934:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 935:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 936:       } else {
 937:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 938:       }
 939:     } finally {
 940:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 941:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 942:         setDetecting(false);
 943:       }
 944:     }
 945:   }
 946:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {

 948:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;
 949:   }

 964:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 965:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 966:     if (!manualMode) return;
 967: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 968: if (!canvas) return;
 969: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 970: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 971: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 972: if (
 973:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 974:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 975:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 976:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 977: ) return;
 978:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 979:     if (!point) return;
 980:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 981:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 982:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 983:     setDragSelection(selection);
 984:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 985:   }

 987:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 988:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 989:     if (edit) {
 990:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 991:       if (!point || !session) return;
 992:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 993:       patchSession((current) => {
 994:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 995:         return {
 996:           ...current,
 997:           candidatesByPage: {
 998:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 999:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1000:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1001:           },
1002:         };
1003:       });
1004:       return;
1005:     }
1006:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1007:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1008:     if (point) {
1009:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1010:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1011:       setDragSelection(selection);
1012:     }
1013:   }
1014: 
1015:   function finishRegion() {
1016:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1017:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1018:       return;
1019:     }
1020:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1021:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1022:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1023:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1024:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1025:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1026:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1027:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1028:     setDragSelection(null);
1029:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1030:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1031:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1032:       x, y, width, height,
1033:       relativeScore: 1,
1034:       source: "manual",
1035:     };
1036:     patchSession((current) => ({
1037:       ...current,
1038:       candidatesByPage: {
1039:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1040:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1041:       },
1042:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1043:     }));
1044:     setManualMode(false);
1045:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1046:   }

1050:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1051:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1052:     setDragSelection(null);
1053:   }

1055:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1056:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1057:     try {
1058:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1059:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1060:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1061:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1062:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1063:       const scale = mode === "width"
1064:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1065:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1066:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1067:     } catch (cause) {
1068:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1069:     }
1070:   }

  34: export function boardSquareAtPoint(
  35:   clientX: number,
  36:   clientY: number,
  37:   rect: Pick<DOMRect, "left" | "top" | "width" | "height">,
  38:   flipped = false,
  39: ): Square | null {
  40:   if (rect.width <= 0 || rect.height <= 0) return null;
  41:   const x = clientX - rect.left;
  42:   const y = clientY - rect.top;

  45:   const row = Math.floor((y / rect.height) * 8);
  46:   const file = flipped ? 7 - column : column;
  47:   const rank = flipped ? row + 1 : 8 - row;
  48:   return ("abcdefgh"[file] + rank) as Square;
  49: }

  51: export function squareCenter(square: Square, flipped = false): { x: number; y: number } {
  52:   const file = square.charCodeAt(0) - 97;
  53:   const rank = Number(square[1]) - 1;
  54:   return {
  55:     x: (flipped ? 7 - file : file) + 0.5,
  56:     y: (flipped ? rank : 7 - rank) + 0.5,
  57:   };
  58: }

  62:   return match ? { from: match[1] as Square, to: match[2] as Square, color: ANNOTATION_COLORS.engine } : null;

  65: export function toggleArrow(arrows: BoardArrow[], next: BoardArrow): BoardArrow[] {
  66:   const existing = arrows.findIndex((arrow) => arrow.from === next.from && arrow.to === next.to);
  67:   if (existing < 0) return [...arrows, next];
  68:   if (next.color && arrows[existing].color !== next.color) {
  69:     return arrows.map((arrow, index) => (index === existing ? next : arrow));
  70:   }
  71:   return arrows.filter((_, index) => index !== existing);
  72: }

  74: export function toggleSquareHighlight(
  75:   highlights: SquareHighlight[],
  76:   square: Square,
  77:   color: string = ANNOTATION_COLORS.red,
  78: ): SquareHighlight[] {
  79:   const existing = highlights.findIndex((h) => h.square === square);
  80:   if (existing < 0) return [...highlights, { square, color }];
  81:   if (highlights[existing].color !== color) {
  82:     return highlights.map((h, index) => (index === existing ? { square, color } : h));
  83:   }
  84:   return highlights.filter((_, index) => index !== existing);

  87: export function getArrowPath(
  88:   fromSquare: Square,
  89:   toSquare: Square,
  90:   flipped = false,
  91:   shaftWidth = 0.22,
  92:   headLength = 0.36,
  93:   headWidth = 0.50,
  94: ): string {
  95:   const from = squareCenter(fromSquare, flipped);
  96:   const to = squareCenter(toSquare, flipped);
  97:   const dx = to.x - from.x;
  98:   const dy = to.y - from.y;
  99:   const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
 100:   if (len < 0.2) return "";
 101: 
 102:   const ux = dx / len;
 103:   const uy = dy / len;
 104:   const nx = -uy;
 105:   const ny = ux;
 106: 
 107:   const actualHeadLen = len < 0.7 ? len * 0.48 : headLength;
 108:   const actualHeadWidth = len < 0.7 ? len * 0.65 : headWidth;
 109:   const actualShaftWidth = len < 0.7 ? len * 0.28 : shaftWidth;
 110: 
 111:   const hs = actualShaftWidth / 2;
 112:   const hw = actualHeadWidth / 2;
 113: 
 114:   const bx = to.x - actualHeadLen * ux;
 115:   const by = to.y - actualHeadLen * uy;
 116: 
 117:   const tipX = to.x;
 118:   const tipY = to.y;
 119: 
 120:   const headLeftX = bx + hw * nx;
 121:   const headLeftY = by + hw * ny;
 122:   const headRightX = bx - hw * nx;
 123:   const headRightY = by - hw * ny;
 124: 
 125:   const shaftEndLeftX = bx + hs * nx;
 126:   const shaftEndLeftY = by + hs * ny;
 127:   const shaftEndRightX = bx - hs * nx;
 128:   const shaftEndRightY = by - hs * ny;
 129: 
 130:   const shaftStartLeftX = from.x + hs * nx;
 131:   const shaftStartLeftY = from.y + hs * ny;
 132:   const shaftStartRightX = from.x - hs * nx;
 133:   const shaftStartRightY = from.y - hs * ny;
 134: 
 135:   return [
 136:     "M " + shaftStartLeftX.toFixed(4) + " " + shaftStartLeftY.toFixed(4),
 137:     "L " + shaftEndLeftX.toFixed(4) + " " + shaftEndLeftY.toFixed(4),
 138:     "L " + headLeftX.toFixed(4) + " " + headLeftY.toFixed(4),
 139:     "L " + tipX.toFixed(4) + " " + tipY.toFixed(4),
 140:     "L " + headRightX.toFixed(4) + " " + headRightY.toFixed(4),
 141:     "L " + shaftEndRightX.toFixed(4) + " " + shaftEndRightY.toFixed(4),
 142:     "L " + shaftStartRightX.toFixed(4) + " " + shaftStartRightY.toFixed(4),
 143:     "A " + hs.toFixed(4) + " " + hs.toFixed(4) + " 0 0 0 " + shaftStartLeftX.toFixed(4) + " " + shaftStartLeftY.toFixed(4),
 144:     "Z",
 145:   ].join(" ");
 146: }

  65: export function toggleArrow(arrows: BoardArrow[], next: BoardArrow): BoardArrow[] {
  66:   const existing = arrows.findIndex((arrow) => arrow.from === next.from && arrow.to === next.to);
  67:   if (existing < 0) return [...arrows, next];
  68:   if (next.color && arrows[existing].color !== next.color) {
  69:     return arrows.map((arrow, index) => (index === existing ? next : arrow));
  70:   }
  71:   return arrows.filter((_, index) => index !== existing);
  72: }
  73: 
  74: export function toggleSquareHighlight(
  75:   highlights: SquareHighlight[],
  76:   square: Square,
  77:   color = ANNOTATION_COLORS.red,
  78: ): SquareHighlight[] {
  79:   const existing = highlights.findIndex((h) => h.square === square);
  80:   if (existing < 0) return [...highlights, { square, color }];
  81:   if (highlights[existing].color !== color) {
  82:     return highlights.map((h, index) => (index === existing ? { square, color } : h));
  83:   }
  84:   return highlights.filter((_, index) => index !== existing);
  85: }
  86: 
  87: export function getArrowPath(
  88:   fromSquare: Square,
  89:   toSquare: Square,
  90:   flipped = false,
  91:   shaftWidth = 0.22,
  92:   headLength = 0.36,
  93:   headWidth = 0.50,
  94: ): string {
  95:   const from = squareCenter(fromSquare, flipped);
  96:   const to = squareCenter(toSquare, flipped);
  97:   const dx = to.x - from.x;
  98:   const dy = to.y - from.y;
  99:   const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
 100:   if (len < 0.2) return "";
 101: 
 102:   const ux = dx / len;
 103:   const uy = dy / len;
 104:   const nx = -uy;
 105:   const ny = ux;
 106: 
 107:   const actualHeadLen = len < 0.7 ? len * 0.48 : headLength;
 108:   const actualHeadWidth = len < 0.7 ? len * 0.65 : headWidth;
 109:   const actualShaftWidth = len < 0.7 ? len * 0.28 : shaftWidth;
 110: 
 111:   const hs = actualShaftWidth / 2;
 112:   const hw = actualHeadWidth / 2;
 113: 
 114:   const bx = to.x - actualHeadLen * ux;
 115:   const by = to.y - actualHeadLen * uy;
 116: 
 117:   const tipX = to.x;
 118:   const tipY = to.y;
 119: 
 120:   const headLeftX = bx + hw * nx;
 121:   const headLeftY = by + hw * ny;
 122:   const headRightX = bx - hw * nx;
 123:   const headRightY = by - hw * ny;
 124: 
 125:   const shaftEndLeftX = bx + hs * nx;
 126:   const shaftEndLeftY = by + hs * ny;
 127:   const shaftEndRightX = bx - hs * nx;
 128:   const shaftEndRightY = by - hs * ny;
 129: 
 130:   const shaftStartLeftX = from.x + hs * nx;
 131:   const shaftStartLeftY = from.y + hs * ny;
 132:   const shaftStartRightX = from.x - hs * nx;
 133:   const shaftStartRightY = from.y - hs * ny;
 134: 
 135:   return [
 136:     "M " + shaftStartLeftX.toFixed(4) + " " + shaftStartLeftY.toFixed(4),
 137:     "L " + shaftEndLeftX.toFixed(4) + " " + shaftEndLeftY.toFixed(4),
 138:     "L " + headLeftX.toFixed(4) + " " + headLeftY.toFixed(4),
 139:     "L " + tipX.toFixed(4) + " " + tipY.toFixed(4),
 140:     "L " + headRightX.toFixed(4) + " " + headRightY.toFixed(4),
 141:     "L " + shaftEndRightX.toFixed(4) + " " + shaftEndRightY.toFixed(4),
 142:     "L " + shaftStartRightX.toFixed(4) + " " + shaftStartRightY.toFixed(4),
 143:     "A " + hs.toFixed(4) + " " + hs.toFixed(4) + " 0 0 0 " + shaftStartLeftX.toFixed(4) + " " + shaftStartLeftY.toFixed(4),
 144:     "Z",
 145:   ].join(" ");
 146: }

   1: import { Chess } from "chess.js";
   2: 
   3: export function makePosition(baseFen: string, moves: string[], moveIndex: number): Chess {
   4:   const game = new Chess(baseFen);
   5:   for (const san of moves.slice(0, moveIndex)) {
   6:     const result = game.move(san);
   7:     if (!result) throw new Error(`Saved move could not be replayed: ${san}`);
   8:   }
   9:   return game;
  10: }
  11: 
  12: export function fenWithTurn(fen: string, turn: "w" | "b"): string {
  13:   const fields = fen.split(/\s+/);
  14:   if (fields.length !== 6) throw new Error("FEN must contain six fields.");
  15:   fields[1] = turn;
  16:   fields[3] = "-";
  17:   fields[4] = "0";
  18:   return fields.join(" ");
  19: }

   4: type Orientation = "white" | "black";
   5: type Mode = "timed" | "untimed" | "streak";
   6: type SessionResult = { date: string; score: number; accuracy: number; duration: number };
   7: 
   8: const FILES = "abcdefgh";
   9: const RANKS = "12345678";
  10: const randomSquare = (avoid?: string) => {
  11:   let next = `${FILES[Math.floor(Math.random() * 8)]}${RANKS[Math.floor(Math.random() * 8)]}`;
  12:   while (next === avoid) next = `${FILES[Math.floor(Math.random() * 8)]}${RANKS[Math.floor(Math.random() * 8)]}`;
  13:   return next;
  14: };

  17: export default function CoordinateTraining() {

  19:   const [mode, setMode] = useState<Mode>("timed");

  23:   const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  24:   const [correct, setCorrect] = useState(0);
  25:   const [wrong, setWrong] = useState(0);

   1: export type CropBounds = { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number };
   2: export type CropHandle = "move" | "n" | "s" | "e" | "w" | "ne" | "nw" | "se" | "sw";
   3: 
   4: export function pointOnCanvas(
   5:   clientX: number,
   6:   clientY: number,
   7:   rect: Pick<DOMRect, "left" | "top" | "width" | "height">,
   8: ): { x: number; y: number } | null {
   9:   if (rect.width <= 0 || rect.height <= 0) return null;
  10:   return {
  11:     x: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (clientX - rect.left) / rect.width)),
  12:     y: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (clientY - rect.top) / rect.height)),
  13:   };
  14: }
  15: 
  16: export function editCrop(
  17:   start: CropBounds,
  18:   handle: CropHandle,
  19:   deltaX: number,
  20:   deltaY: number,
  21:   minimum = 0.04,
  22: ): CropBounds {
  23:   if (handle === "move") {
  24:     const x = Math.max(0, Math.min(1 - start.width, start.x + deltaX));
  25:     const y = Math.max(0, Math.min(1 - start.height, start.y + deltaY));
  26:     return { ...start, x, y };
  27:   }
  28:   let left = start.x;
  29:   let top = start.y;
  30:   let right = start.x + start.width;
  31:   let bottom = start.y + start.height;
  32:   if (handle.includes("w")) left = Math.max(0, Math.min(right - minimum, left + deltaX));
  33:   if (handle.includes("e")) right = Math.min(1, Math.max(left + minimum, right + deltaX));
  34:   if (handle.includes("n")) top = Math.max(0, Math.min(bottom - minimum, top + deltaY));
  35:   if (handle.includes("s")) bottom = Math.min(1, Math.max(top + minimum, bottom + deltaY));
  36:   return { x: left, y: top, width: right - left, height: bottom - top };
  37: }
  38: 
  39: export function cropToPixels(bounds: CropBounds, sourceWidth: number, sourceHeight: number) {
  40:   const x = Math.max(0, Math.min(sourceWidth - 1, Math.floor(bounds.x * sourceWidth)));
  41:   const y = Math.max(0, Math.min(sourceHeight - 1, Math.floor(bounds.y * sourceHeight)));
  42:   const right = Math.max(x + 1, Math.min(sourceWidth, Math.ceil((bounds.x + bounds.width) * sourceWidth - 1e-7)));
  43:   const bottom = Math.max(y + 1, Math.min(sourceHeight, Math.ceil((bounds.y + bounds.height) * sourceHeight - 1e-7)));
  44:   return { x, y, width: right - x, height: bottom - y };
  45: }

 265: function parseFen(fen: string): (string | null)[][] {
 266:   const boardPart = fen.split(" ")[0];
 267:   return boardPart.split("/").map((row) => {
 268:     const out: (string | null)[] = [];
 269:     for (const ch of row) {
 270:       if (ch >= "1" && ch <= "8") {
 271:         for (let i = 0; i < parseInt(ch, 10); i++) out.push(null);
 272:       } else {
 273:         out.push(ch);
 274:       }
 275:     }
 276:     return out;
 277:   });
 278: }

 280: function squareCoords(sq: string, flipped: boolean): { x: number; y: number } {
 281:   const file = sq.charCodeAt(0) - 97;
 282:   const rank = 8 - parseInt(sq[1], 10);
 283:   const col = flipped ? 7 - file : file;
 284:   const row = flipped ? 7 - rank : rank;
 285:   return { x: col * 12.5 + 6.25, y: row * 12.5 + 6.25 };
 286: }

1054: export function LichessCoordinateTrainer() {
1055:   const [running, setRunning] = useState(false);
1056:   const [mode, setMode] = useState<"30s" | "unlimited">("30s");
1057:   const [perspective, setPerspective] = useState<"white" | "random" | "black">("white");
1058:   const [showCoords, setShowCoords] = useState(true);
1059:   const [showPieces, setShowPieces] = useState(true);
1060:   const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
1061:   const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState(30);
1062:   const [currentTarget, setCurrentTarget] = useState("e4");
1063:   const [nextTarget, setNextTarget] = useState("f6");
1064:   const [flashSquare, setFlashSquare] = useState<{ sq: string; ok: boolean } | null>(null);
1065: 
1066:   const initialBoard = useMemo(
1067:     () => parseFen("rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1"),
1068:     []
1069:   );
1070: 
1071:   const isFlipped = perspective === "black";
1072:   const displayRows = isFlipped ? [...initialBoard].reverse() : initialBoard;
1073: 
1074:   useEffect(() => {
1075:     if (!running || mode === "unlimited") return;
1076:     const timer = setInterval(() => {
1077:       setTimeLeft((t) => {
1078:         if (t <= 1) {
1079:           setRunning(false);
1080:           return 0;
1081:         }
1082:         return t - 1;
1083:       });
1084:     }, 1000);
1085:     return () => clearInterval(timer);
1086:   }, [running, mode]);
1087: 
1088:   const startSession = () => {
1089:     setScore(0);
1090:     setTimeLeft(30);
1091:     setCurrentTarget(ALL_SQUARES[Math.floor(Math.random() * 64)]);
1092:     setNextTarget(ALL_SQUARES[Math.floor(Math.random() * 64)]);
1093:     setRunning(true);
1094:   };
1095: 
1096:   const handleSquareClick = (sq: string) => {
1097:     if (!running) {
1098:       startSession();
1099:       return;
1100:     }
1101:     const ok = sq === currentTarget;
1102:     setFlashSquare({ sq, ok });
1103:     setTimeout(() => setFlashSquare(null), 260);
1104:     if (ok) {
1105:       setScore((s) => s + 1);
1106:       setCurrentTarget(nextTarget);
1107:       setNextTarget(ALL_SQUARES[Math.floor(Math.random() * 64)]);
1108:     }
1109:   };
1110: 
1111:   return (
1112:     <div className="li-coord-shell">
1113:       <div className="li-coord-board-wrap">
1114:         <div className="li-coord-board">
1115:           {displayRows.map((row, rIdx) => {
1116:             const actualRankIdx = isFlipped ? 7 - rIdx : rIdx;
1117:             const cols = isFlipped ? [...row].reverse() : row;
1118: 
1119:             return cols.map((piece, cIdx) => {
1120:               const actualFileIdx = isFlipped ? 7 - cIdx : cIdx;
1121:               const sq = `${["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h"][actualFileIdx]}${
1122:                 8 - actualRankIdx
1123:               }`;
1124:               const isLight = (actualRankIdx + actualFileIdx) % 2 === 0;
1125:               const flash =
1126:                 flashSquare?.sq === sq
1127:                   ? flashSquare.ok
1128:                     ? "li-coord-flash-ok"
1129:                     : "li-coord-flash-err"
1130:                   : "";
1131: 
1132:               return (
1133:                 <div
1134:                   key={sq}
1135:                   onClick={() => handleSquareClick(sq)}
1136:                   className={`li-coord-sq ${
1137:                     isLight ? "li-brown-light" : "li-brown-dark"
1138:                   } ${flash}`}
1139:                 >
1140:                   {showCoords && cIdx === 7 && <span className="li-coord-rank">{8 - actualRankIdx}</span>}
1141:                   {showCoords && rIdx === 7 && (

1143:                       {["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h"][actualFileIdx]}
1144:                     </span>
1145:                   )}

1147:                 </div>
1148:               );
1149:             });
1150:           })}
1151: 
1152:           <div className="li-coord-giant-overlay">
1153:             <span className="li-coord-current-target">{currentTarget}</span>
1154:             <span className="li-coord-next-target">{nextTarget}</span>
1155:           </div>
1156:         </div>
1157: 
1158:         <div className="li-coord-timer-track">
1159:           <div
1160:             className="li-coord-timer-fill"

1162:           />
1163:         </div>

  29: 
  30: export function isChessNotationText(text: string): { isNotation: boolean; kind: NotationHighlightKind } {
  31:   const trimmed = text.trim();
  32:   if (!trimmed || trimmed.length < 2) return { isNotation: false, kind: "continuous" };
  33: 
  34:   const hasMoveNum = MOVE_NUMBER_REGEX.test(trimmed);
  35:   const hasSan = SAN_MOVE_REGEX.test(trimmed);
  36:   const hasFigurine = FIGURINE_REGEX.test(trimmed) || FIGURINE_MOVE_REGEX.test(trimmed);
  37:   const hasSymbol = CHESS_SYMBOL_REGEX.test(trimmed);
  38:   const hasProse = CHESS_PROSE_REGEX.test(trimmed);
  39: 
  40:   if (trimmed.startsWith("(") || (trimmed.includes("(") && (hasSan || hasFigurine))) {
  41:     return { isNotation: true, kind: "variation" };
  42:   }
  43: 
  44:   if (hasMoveNum && (hasSan || hasFigurine)) {
  45:     return { isNotation: true, kind: "continuous" };
  46:   }
  47: 
  48:   if (hasSan && (hasFigurine || hasSymbol || trimmed.split(/\s+/).length >= 2)) {
  49:     return { isNotation: true, kind: "continuous" };
  50:   }
  51: 
  52:   if (hasFigurine && (hasSan || hasSymbol || hasMoveNum)) {
  53:     return { isNotation: true, kind: "continuous" };
  54:   }
  55: 
  56:   if (hasProse && (hasMoveNum || hasSan || hasFigurine || trimmed.toLowerCase().includes("diagram"))) {
  57:     return { isNotation: true, kind: "prose" };
  58:   }
  59: 
  60:   return { isNotation: false, kind: "continuous" };
  61: }

  63: type NormalizedTextLine = {
  64:   text: string;
  65:   x: number;
  66:   y: number;
  67:   width: number;
  68:   height: number;
  69:   kind: NotationHighlightKind;
  70: };

  72: export function extractNotationHighlights(
  73:   items: PDFTextItemInput[],
  74:   viewport: { width: number; height: number; convertToViewportPoint?: (x: number, y: number) => [number, number] },
  75:   candidates: Candidate[],
  76: ): NotationHighlight[] {
  77:   if (!items.length || !candidates.length || viewport.width <= 0 || viewport.height <= 0) {
  78:     return [];
  79:   }
  80: 
  81:   const textItems: { text: string; x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number }[] = [];
  82: 
  83:   for (const item of items) {
  84:     if (!item.str || !item.str.trim()) continue;
  85:     const tx = item.transform[4];
  86:     const ty = item.transform[5];
  87:     const w = item.width || Math.abs(item.transform[0]) || 8;
  88:     const h = item.height || Math.abs(item.transform[3]) || 10;
  89: 
  90:     let x1: number, y1: number, x2: number, y2: number;
  91:     if (typeof viewport.convertToViewportPoint === "function") {
  92:       [x1, y1] = viewport.convertToViewportPoint(tx, ty + h);
  93:       [x2, y2] = viewport.convertToViewportPoint(tx + w, ty);
  94:     } else {
  95:       x1 = tx;
  96:       y1 = viewport.height - (ty + h);
  97:       x2 = tx + w;
  98:       y2 = viewport.height - ty;
  99:     }
 100: 
 101:     const normX = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Math.min(x1, x2) / viewport.width));
 102:     const normY = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Math.min(y1, y2) / viewport.height));
 103:     const normW = Math.max(0.005, Math.min(1 - normX, Math.abs(x2 - x1) / viewport.width));
 104:     const normH = Math.max(0.005, Math.min(1 - normY, Math.abs(y2 - y1) / viewport.height));
 105: 
 106:     textItems.push({
 107:       text: item.str,
 108:       x: normX,
 109:       y: normY,
 110:       width: normW,
 111:       height: normH,
 112:     });
 113:   }
 114: 
 115:   if (!textItems.length) return [];
 116: 
 117:   textItems.sort((a, b) => (Math.abs(a.y - b.y) < 0.008 ? a.x - b.x : a.y - b.y));
 118: 
 119:   const lines: NormalizedTextLine[] = [];
 120:   let currentGroup: typeof textItems = [];
 121: 
 122:   function flushGroup() {
 123:     if (!currentGroup.length) return;
 124:     const text = currentGroup.map((i) => i.text).join(" ").trim();
 125:     const { isNotation, kind } = isChessNotationText(text);
 126: 
 127:     if (isNotation) {
 128:       const minX = Math.min(...currentGroup.map((i) => i.x));
 129:       const minY = Math.min(...currentGroup.map((i) => i.y));
 130:       const maxX = Math.max(...currentGroup.map((i) => i.x + i.width));
 131:       const maxY = Math.max(...currentGroup.map((i) => i.y + i.height));
 132:       lines.push({
 133:         text,
 134:         x: Math.max(0, minX - 0.003),
 135:         y: Math.max(0, minY - 0.002),
 136:         width: Math.min(1 - minX, (maxX - minX) + 0.006),
 137:         height: Math.min(1 - minY, (maxY - minY) + 0.004),
 138:         kind,
 139:       });
 140:     }
 141:     currentGroup = [];
 142:   }
 143: 
 144:   for (const item of textItems) {
 145:     if (!currentGroup.length) {
 146:       currentGroup.push(item);
 147:     } else {
 148:       const last = currentGroup[currentGroup.length - 1];
 149:       const sameLine = Math.abs(item.y - last.y) < 0.01;
 150:       const nearbyX = item.x - (last.x + last.width) < 0.08;
 151:       if (sameLine && nearbyX) {
 152:         currentGroup.push(item);
 153:       } else {
 154:         flushGroup();
 155:         currentGroup.push(item);
 156:       }
 157:     }
 158:   }
 159:   flushGroup();
 160: 
 161:   if (!lines.length) return [];
 162: 
 163:   const result: NotationHighlight[] = [];
 164: 
 165:   for (let index = 0; index < lines.length; index++) {
 166:     const line = lines[index];
 167:     let bestCandidate = candidates[0];
 168:     let bestDistance = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
 169: 
 170:     for (const candidate of candidates) {
 171:       const candBottom = candidate.y + candidate.height;
 172:       const candTop = candidate.y;
 173:       const candCenterX = candidate.x + candidate.width / 2;
 174:       const lineCenterX = line.x + line.width / 2;
 175: 
 176:       const isBelow = line.y >= candTop - 0.02 && line.y <= candBottom + 0.35;
 177:       const xDist = Math.abs(lineCenterX - candCenterX);
 178:       const yDist = line.y >= candBottom ? (line.y - candBottom) : Math.abs(line.y - candTop);
 179: 
 180:       const score = (isBelow ? 0 : 10) + yDist * 2 + xDist * 1.5;
 181: 
 182:       if (score < bestDistance) {
 183:         bestDistance = score;
 184:         bestCandidate = candidate;
 185:       }
 186:     }
 187: 
 188:     result.push({
 189:       id: "highlight-" + bestCandidate.id + "-" + (index + 1),
 190:       candidateId: bestCandidate.id,
 191:       kind: line.kind,
 192:       text: line.text,
 193:       x: line.x,
 194:       y: line.y,
 195:       width: line.width,
 196:       height: line.height,
 197:     });
 198:   }
 199: 
 200:   return result;
 201: }

   1: import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
   2: import { Chess, type Square } from "chess.js";
   3: import { ChevronFirst, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, ChevronLast, RotateCw, BookOpen, GraduationCap } from "lucide-react";
   4: import "./notation-learner.css";
   5: 
   6: const FILES = "abcdefgh";
   7: const PIECES: Record<string, string> = {
   8:   wk:"♔", wq:"♕", wr:"♖", wb:"♗", wn:"♘", wp:"♙",
   9:   bk:"♚", bq:"♛", br:"♜", bb:"♝", bn:"♞", bp:"♟"
  10: };
  11: 
  12: function parseLine(input: string) {
  13:   const chess = new Chess();
  14:   const cleaned = input
  15:     .replace(/\{[^}]*\}/g, " ")
  16:     .replace(/\([^)]*\)/g, " ")
  17:     .replace(/^\s*\[.*\]\s*$/gm, " ")
  18:     .replace(/\d+\.(\.\.)?/g, " ")
  19:     .replace(/\$\d+/g, " ")
  20:     .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
  21:     .trim();
  22: 
  23:   const tokens = cleaned.split(" ").filter(Boolean)
  24:     .filter((x) => !["1-0", "0-1", "1/2-1/2", "*"].includes(x));
  25: 
  26:   const moves: string[] = [];
  27:   for (const token of tokens) {
  28:     try {
  29:       const move = chess.move(token);
  30:       moves.push(move.san);
  31:     } catch {
  32:       throw new Error(`Invalid or illegal move: ${token}`);
  33:     }
  34:   }
  35:   return moves;
  36: }
  37: 
  38: export default function NotationLearner() {
  39:   const [input, setInput] = useState("1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 a6");
  40:   const [moves, setMoves] = useState<string[]>(() => parseLine("1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 a6"));
