  35: export async function fetchOpeningExplorerStats(
  36:   uciMoves: string[],
  37:   signal?: AbortSignal,
  38: ): Promise<OpeningExplorerStats> {
  39:   const query = new URLSearchParams();
  40:   query.set("variant", "standard");
  41:   query.set("moves", "8");
  42:   if (uciMoves.length) query.set("play", uciMoves.join(","));
  43: 
  44:   const response = await fetch(
  45:     `/api/lichess/opening-explorer?${query.toString()}`,
  46:     {
  47:       method: "GET",
  48:       credentials: "same-origin",
  49:       headers: { Accept: "application/json" },
  50:       signal,
  51:     },
  52:   );
  53: 
  54:   if (!response.ok) {
  55:     throw new Error(`Opening Explorer request failed (${response.status}).`);
  56:   }
  57: 
  58:   const raw: unknown = await response.json();
  59:   if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object") {
  60:     throw new Error("Opening Explorer returned an invalid response.");
  61:   }
  62: 
  63:   const data = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
  64:   const white = count(data.white);
  65:   const draws = count(data.draws);
  66:   const black = count(data.black);
  67: 
  68:   const moves: OpeningExplorerMove[] = Array.isArray(data.moves)
  69:     ? data.moves.flatMap((entry): OpeningExplorerMove[] => {
  70:         if (!entry || typeof entry !== "object") return [];
  71:         const item = entry as Record<string, unknown>;
  72:         if (typeof item.uci !== "string" || typeof item.san !== "string") return [];
  73:         return [{
  74:           uci: item.uci,
  75:           san: item.san,
  76:           white: count(item.white),
  77:           draws: count(item.draws),
  78:           black: count(item.black),
  79:           opening: opening(item.opening),
  80:         }];
  81:       })
  82:     : [];
  83: 
  84:   return {
  85:     white,
  86:     draws,
  87:     black,

  90:     opening: opening(data.opening),
  91:   };
  92: }

 103:     method: "GET",
 104:     credentials: "same-origin",
 105:     headers: { Accept: "application/json" },
 106:     cache: "no-store",
 107:     signal,

 114:     throw new Error("Invalid connection status response.");

   1: import { Chess, type Square } from "chess.js";
   2: 
   3: export type OpeningLineResult = {
   4:   fen: string;
   5:   sanMoves: string[];
   6:   uciMoves: string[];
   7:   error: string | null;
   8: };
   9: 
  10: export function parseOpeningLine(input: string): OpeningLineResult {
  11:   const chess = new Chess();
  12:   const sanMoves: string[] = [];
  13:   const uciMoves: string[] = [];
  14: 
  15:   const tokens = input
  16:     .replace(/\{[^}]*\}/g, " ")
  17:     .replace(/\([^)]*\)/g, " ")
  18:     .replace(/\d+\.(\.\.)?/g, " ")
  19:     .replace(/\$\d+/g, " ")
  20:     .split(/\s+/)
  21:     .filter(Boolean)
  22:     .filter((token) => !["1-0", "0-1", "1/2-1/2", "*"].includes(token));
  23: 
  24:   for (const token of tokens) {
  25:     try {
  26:       const uci = token.match(/^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/i);
  27:       const move = uci
  28:         ? chess.move({
  29:             from: uci[1].toLowerCase() as Square,
  30:             to: uci[2].toLowerCase() as Square,
  31:             promotion: uci[3]?.toLowerCase(),
  32:           })
  33:         : chess.move(token);
  34: 
  35:       sanMoves.push(move.san);
  36:       uciMoves.push(`${move.from}${move.to}${move.promotion ?? ""}`);
  37:     } catch {
  38:       return {
  39:         fen: chess.fen(),
  40:         sanMoves,
  41:         uciMoves,
  42:         error: `Invalid or illegal move: ${token}`,
  43:       };
  44:     }
  45:   }
  46: 
  47:   return { fen: chess.fen(), sanMoves, uciMoves, error: null };
  48: }
  49: 
  50: export function openingPositionAt(input: string, ply: number): OpeningLineResult {
  51:   const parsed = parseOpeningLine(input);
  52:   if (parsed.error) return parsed;
  53: 
  54:   const limit = Math.max(0, Math.min(parsed.sanMoves.length, Math.floor(ply)));
  55:   const chess = new Chess();
  56:   const sanMoves: string[] = [];
  57:   const uciMoves: string[] = [];
  58: 
  59:   for (let i = 0; i < limit; i++) {
  60:     const move = chess.move(parsed.sanMoves[i]);
  61:     sanMoves.push(move.san);
  62:     uciMoves.push(`${move.from}${move.to}${move.promotion ?? ""}`);
  63:   }
  64: 
  65:   return { fen: chess.fen(), sanMoves, uciMoves, error: null };

  11: export function parsePgn(pgn: string): ImportedPgn {

  15:     throw new Error("Paste or select a PGN game first.");
  16:   }
  17: 
  18:   const parsed = new Chess();
  19: 
  20:   try {
  21:     parsed.loadPgn(source);
  22:   } catch (cause) {
  23:     const detail = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Unknown PGN error";
  24:     throw new Error(`Invalid PGN: ${detail}`);
  25:   }
  26: 
  27:   const headers = parsed.getHeaders();
  28:   const customFen = headers.FEN?.trim();
  29:   const lineBaseFen = customFen || START_FEN;
  30: 
  31:   let replay: Chess;
  32: 
  33:   try {
  34:     replay = new Chess(lineBaseFen);
  35:   } catch {
  36:     throw new Error("The PGN contains an invalid starting FEN.");
  37:   }
  38: 
  39:   const moves = parsed.history();
  40: 
  41:   if (moves.length === 0) {
  42:     throw new Error("The PGN contains no moves.");
  43:   }
  44: 
  45:   try {
  46:     for (const san of moves) {
  47:       replay.move(san);
  48:     }
  49:   } catch (cause) {
  50:     const detail = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Unknown move error";
  51:     throw new Error(`Could not replay the imported game: ${detail}`);
  52:   }
  53: 
  54:   if (replay.fen() !== parsed.fen()) {
  55:     throw new Error("The imported PGN could not be reproduced from its starting position.");
  56:   }
  57: 
  58:   return {
  59:     headers,
  60:     lineBaseFen,
  61:     moves,
  62:     finalFen: replay.fen(),

  24: export function parseFenPlacement(placement: string): string[][] | null {
  25:   const ranks = placement.split("/");
  26:   if (ranks.length !== 8) return null;
  27:   const board: string[][] = [];
  28:   for (const rank of ranks) {
  29:     const squares: string[] = [];
  30:     for (const token of rank) {
  31:       if (/^[1-8]$/.test(token)) squares.push(...Array(Number(token)).fill(""));
  32:       else if (PIECE_CODES.test(token)) squares.push(token);
  33:       else return null;
  34:     }
  35:     if (squares.length !== 8) return null;
  36:     board.push(squares);
  37:   }
  38:   return board;
  39: }

  41: export function serializeFenPlacement(board: string[][]): string {
  42:   if (board.length !== 8 || board.some((rank) => rank.length !== 8)) {
  43:     throw new Error("A chess position must contain exactly 64 squares.");
  44:   }
  45:   return board.map((rank) => {
  46:     let result = "";
  47:     let empty = 0;
  48:     for (const piece of rank) {
  49:       if (!piece) {
  50:         empty += 1;
  51:       } else {
  52:         if (!PIECE_CODES.test(piece)) throw new Error(`Invalid chess piece code: ${piece}`);
  53:         if (empty) result += empty;
  54:         empty = 0;
  55:         result += piece;
  56:       }
  57:     }
  58:     if (empty) result += empty;
  59:     return result;

  73: export function moveFenPiece(placement: string, fromRow: number, fromCol: number, toRow: number, toCol: number): string {

  75:   if (!board || fromRow < 0 || fromRow > 7 || fromCol < 0 || fromCol > 7 || toRow < 0 || toRow > 7 || toCol < 0 || toCol > 7) {

 116: export function sanitizeCastlingRights(board: string[][], currentCastling: string): string {
 117:   if (!currentCastling || currentCastling === "-") return "-";
 118:   let result = "";
 119:   // White king must be on e1 (row 7, col 4)
 120:   const whiteKingOnE1 = board[7]?.[4] === "K";
 121:   if (whiteKingOnE1) {
 122:     if (currentCastling.includes("K") && board[7]?.[7] === "R") result += "K";
 123:     if (currentCastling.includes("Q") && board[7]?.[0] === "R") result += "Q";
 124:   }
 125:   // Black king must be on e8 (row 0, col 4)
 126:   const blackKingOnE8 = board[0]?.[4] === "k";
 127:   if (blackKingOnE8) {
 128:     if (currentCastling.includes("k") && board[0]?.[7] === "r") result += "k";
 129:     if (currentCastling.includes("q") && board[0]?.[0] === "r") result += "q";
 130:   }
 131:   return result || "-";
 132: }

 134: export function buildFullFen(
 135:   placement: string,
 136:   turn: "w" | "b" = "w",
 137:   castling?: string,
 138:   enPassant: string = "-",
 139:   halfmove: number = 0,
 140:   fullmove: number = 1

 142:   const board = parseFenPlacement(placement);
 143:   if (!board) throw new Error("Invalid piece placement for FEN generation.");
 144:   let effectiveCastling = castling;
 145:   if (!effectiveCastling) {
 146:     effectiveCastling = placement === START_PLACEMENT ? "KQkq" : "-";
 147:   } else {
 148:     effectiveCastling = sanitizeCastlingRights(board, effectiveCastling);
 149:   }
 150:   return `${placement} ${turn} ${effectiveCastling} ${enPassant} ${halfmove} ${fullmove}`;

 153: export function validatePositionFen(fen: string): { isValid: boolean; error?: string } {
 154:   const trimmed = fen.trim();
 155:   if (!trimmed) {
 156:     return { isValid: false, error: "Position FEN cannot be empty." };
 157:   }
 158:   const fields = trimmed.split(/\s+/);
 159:   if (fields.length !== 6) {
 160:     return { isValid: false, error: "FEN must contain exactly 6 space-separated fields." };
 161:   }
 162:   const [placement, turn] = fields;
 163:   const board = parseFenPlacement(placement);
 164:   if (!board) {
 165:     return { isValid: false, error: "Invalid board piece placement." };
 166:   }
 167: 
 168:   let whiteKings = 0;
 169:   let blackKings = 0;
 170:   let invalidPawns = 0;
 171:   for (let r = 0; r < 8; r++) {
 172:     for (let c = 0; c < 8; c++) {
 173:       const piece = board[r][c];
 174:       if (piece === "K") whiteKings += 1;
 175:       if (piece === "k") blackKings += 1;
 176:       if ((r === 0 || r === 7) && (piece === "P" || piece === "p")) {
 177:         invalidPawns += 1;
 178:       }
 179:     }
 180:   }
 181: 
 182:   if (whiteKings === 0) {
 183:     return { isValid: false, error: "Position is missing a White king (K)." };
 184:   }
 185:   if (whiteKings > 1) {
 186:     return { isValid: false, error: `Position has ${whiteKings} White kings. Exactly one is required.` };
 187:   }
 188:   if (blackKings === 0) {
 189:     return { isValid: false, error: "Position is missing a Black king (k)." };
 190:   }
 191:   if (blackKings > 1) {
 192:     return { isValid: false, error: `Position has ${blackKings} Black kings. Exactly one is required.` };
 193:   }
 194:   if (invalidPawns > 0) {
 195:     return { isValid: false, error: "Pawns cannot be placed on the first or eighth rank." };
 196:   }
 197:   if (turn !== "w" && turn !== "b") {
 198:     return { isValid: false, error: "Side to move must be 'w' (White) or 'b' (Black)." };
 199:   }
 200: 
 201:   const result = validateFen(trimmed);
 202:   if (!result.ok) {
 203:     return { isValid: false, error: result.error || "Invalid chess position." };
 204:   }
 205: 
 206:   try {
 207:     new Chess(trimmed);
 208:   } catch (err: unknown) {
 209:     return { isValid: false, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) };
 210:   }
 211: 
 212:   return { isValid: true };
 213: }

SOURCE FILE: src\stockfish.ts (4682 bytes)

   1: export type EngineStatus = "off" | "loading" | "ready" | "analyzing" | "error";
   2: export type EngineScore = { kind: "cp" | "mate"; value: number; depth: number; bestMove?: string; pv?: string[] };
   3: 
   4: type UciRequest = { fen: string; depth: number };
   5: 
   6: export function parseUciInfo(line: string, sideToMove: "w" | "b"): Omit<EngineScore, "bestMove"> | null {
   7:   if (!line.startsWith("info ")) return null;
   8:   const depth = Number(line.match(/\bdepth (\d+)/)?.[1]);
   9:   const score = line.match(/\bscore (cp|mate) (-?\d+)/);
  10:   if (!score || !Number.isFinite(depth)) return null;
  11:   const value = Number(score[2]);
  12:   const whiteValue = sideToMove === "w" ? value : -value;
  13:   const kind = score[1] as "cp" | "mate";
  14:   const orientedValue = kind === "mate" && value === 0
  15:     ? (sideToMove === "w" ? -1 : 1)
  16:     : whiteValue;
  17:   const pv = line.match(/\bpv (.+)$/)?.[1]?.trim().split(/\s+/);
  18:   return {
  19:     kind,
  20:     value: orientedValue,
  21:     depth,
  22:     ...(pv?.length ? { pv } : {}),
  23:   };
  24: }
  25: 
  26: export function formatEvaluation(score: EngineScore): string {
  27:   if (score.kind === "mate") return `#${score.value > 0 ? "+" : ""}${score.value}`;
  28:   const pawns = score.value / 100;
  29:   return `${pawns > 0 ? "+" : ""}${pawns.toFixed(2)}`;
  30: }
  31: 
  32: export function whiteScoreShare(score: EngineScore): number {
  33:   if (score.kind === "mate") return score.value > 0 ? 0.96 : 0.04;
  34:   const bounded = Math.max(-1000, Math.min(1000, score.value));
  35:   return Math.max(0.04, Math.min(0.96, 1 / (1 + 10 ** (-bounded / 400))));
  36: }
  37: 
  38: export class StockfishEngine {
  39:   private readonly worker: Worker;
  40:   private ready = false;
  41:   private searching = false;
  42:   private awaitingStop = false;
  43:   private queued: UciRequest | null = null;
  44:   private currentSide: "w" | "b" = "w";
  45:   private latestScore: EngineScore | null = null;
  46: 
  47:   constructor(
  48:     workerUrl: string,
  49:     private readonly onStatus: (status: EngineStatus, message?: string) => void,
  50:     private readonly onScore: (score: EngineScore | null) => void,
  51:   ) {
  52:     this.worker = new Worker(workerUrl);
  53:     this.worker.onmessage = (event: MessageEvent<string>) => this.handleLine(String(event.data));
  54:     this.worker.onerror = (event) => {
  55:       this.onStatus("error", event.message || "The Stockfish worker failed to load.");
  56:       this.dispose();
  57:     };
  58:     this.onStatus("loading");
  59:     this.worker.postMessage("uci");
  60:   }
  61: 
  62:   analyze(fen: string, depth: number): void {
  63:     this.queued = { fen, depth: Math.max(1, Math.min(24, Math.floor(depth))) };
  64:     this.latestScore = null;
  65:     this.onScore(null);
  66:     if (!this.ready) return;
  67:     if (this.searching) {
  68:       if (!this.awaitingStop) {
  69:         this.awaitingStop = true;
  70:         this.worker.postMessage("stop");
  71:       }
  72:       return;
  73:     }
  74:     this.startQueuedAnalysis();
  75:   }
  76: 
  77:   dispose(): void {
  78:     this.worker.terminate();
  79:     this.ready = false;
  80:     this.searching = false;
  81:     this.queued = null;
  82:   }
  83: 
  84:   private handleLine(line: string): void {
  85:     if (/^Error:/i.test(line)) {
  86:       this.onStatus("error", line);
  87:       this.dispose();
  88:       return;
  89:     }
  90:     if (line === "uciok") {
  91:       this.worker.postMessage("isready");
  92:       return;
  93:     }
  94:     if (line === "readyok") {
  95:       this.ready = true;
  96:       this.onStatus("ready");
  97:       this.startQueuedAnalysis();
  98:       return;
  99:     }
 100:     if (line.startsWith("info ")) {
 101:       if (this.awaitingStop) return;
 102:       const score = parseUciInfo(line, this.currentSide);
 103:       if (score) {
 104:         // Use the current principal variation's first move for a live arrow.
 105:         // Stockfish's final "bestmove" will replace this provisional move.
 106:         const provisionalMove = score.pv?.[0];
 107:         this.latestScore = {
 108:           ...score,
 109:           ...(provisionalMove ? { bestMove: provisionalMove } : {}),
 110:         };
 111:         this.onScore(this.latestScore);
 112:       }
 113:       return;
 114:     }
 115:     const bestMove = line.match(/^bestmove (\S+)/)?.[1];
 116:     if (!bestMove) return;
 117:     this.searching = false;
 118:     if (this.awaitingStop) {
 119:       this.awaitingStop = false;
 120:       this.startQueuedAnalysis();
 121:       return;
 122:     }
 123:     if (this.latestScore) {
 124:       this.latestScore = { ...this.latestScore, bestMove: bestMove === "(none)" ? undefined : bestMove };
 125:       this.onScore(this.latestScore);
 126:     }
 127:     this.onStatus("ready");
 128:   }
 129: 
 130:   private startQueuedAnalysis(): void {
 131:     if (!this.ready || this.searching || !this.queued) return;
 132:     const request = this.queued;
 133:     this.queued = null;
 134:     this.currentSide = request.fen.split(/\s+/)[1] === "b" ? "b" : "w";
 135:     this.searching = true;
 136:     this.latestScore = null;
 137:     this.onStatus("analyzing");
 138:     this.worker.postMessage(`position fen ${request.fen}`);
 139:     this.worker.postMessage(`go depth ${request.depth}`);
 140:   }

   1: export type EngineStatus = "off" | "loading" | "ready" | "analyzing" | "error";
   2: export type EngineScore = { kind: "cp" | "mate"; value: number; depth: number; bestMove?: string; pv?: string[] };
   3: 
   4: type UciRequest = { fen: string; depth: number };
   5: 
   6: export function parseUciInfo(line: string, sideToMove: "w" | "b"): Omit<EngineScore, "bestMove"> | null {
   7:   if (!line.startsWith("info ")) return null;
   8:   const depth = Number(line.match(/\bdepth (\d+)/)?.[1]);
   9:   const score = line.match(/\bscore (cp|mate) (-?\d+)/);
  10:   if (!score || !Number.isFinite(depth)) return null;
  11:   const value = Number(score[2]);
  12:   const whiteValue = sideToMove === "w" ? value : -value;
  13:   const kind = score[1] as "cp" | "mate";
  14:   const orientedValue = kind === "mate" && value === 0
  15:     ? (sideToMove === "w" ? -1 : 1)
  16:     : whiteValue;
  17:   const pv = line.match(/\bpv (.+)$/)?.[1]?.trim().split(/\s+/);
  18:   return {
  19:     kind,
  20:     value: orientedValue,
  21:     depth,
  22:     ...(pv?.length ? { pv } : {}),
  23:   };
  24: }
  25: 
  26: export function formatEvaluation(score: EngineScore): string {
  27:   if (score.kind === "mate") return `#${score.value > 0 ? "+" : ""}${score.value}`;
  28:   const pawns = score.value / 100;
  29:   return `${pawns > 0 ? "+" : ""}${pawns.toFixed(2)}`;
  30: }
  31: 
  32: export function whiteScoreShare(score: EngineScore): number {
  33:   if (score.kind === "mate") return score.value > 0 ? 0.96 : 0.04;
  34:   const bounded = Math.max(-1000, Math.min(1000, score.value));
  35:   return Math.max(0.04, Math.min(0.96, 1 / (1 + 10 ** (-bounded / 400))));
  36: }

  38: export class StockfishEngine {
  39:   private readonly worker: Worker;
  40:   private ready = false;
  41:   private searching = false;
  42:   private awaitingStop = false;
  43:   private queued: UciRequest | null = null;
  44:   private currentSide: "w" | "b" = "w";
  45:   private latestScore: EngineScore | null = null;
  46: 
  47:   constructor(
  48:     workerUrl: string,
  49:     private readonly onStatus: (status: EngineStatus, message?: string) => void,
  50:     private readonly onScore: (score: EngineScore | null) => void,
  51:   ) {
  52:     this.worker = new Worker(workerUrl);
  53:     this.worker.onmessage = (event: MessageEvent<string>) => this.handleLine(String(event.data));
  54:     this.worker.onerror = (event) => {
  55:       this.onStatus("error", event.message || "The Stockfish worker failed to load.");
  56:       this.dispose();
  57:     };
  58:     this.onStatus("loading");
  59:     this.worker.postMessage("uci");
  60:   }
  61: 
  62:   analyze(fen: string, depth: number): void {
  63:     this.queued = { fen, depth: Math.max(1, Math.min(24, Math.floor(depth))) };
  64:     this.latestScore = null;
  65:     this.onScore(null);
  66:     if (!this.ready) return;
  67:     if (this.searching) {
  68:       if (!this.awaitingStop) {
  69:         this.awaitingStop = true;
  70:         this.worker.postMessage("stop");
  71:       }
  72:       return;
  73:     }
  74:     this.startQueuedAnalysis();
  75:   }
  76: 
  77:   dispose(): void {
  78:     this.worker.terminate();
  79:     this.ready = false;
  80:     this.searching = false;
  81:     this.queued = null;
  82:   }
  83: 
  84:   private handleLine(line: string): void {
  85:     if (/^Error:/i.test(line)) {
  86:       this.onStatus("error", line);
  87:       this.dispose();
  88:       return;
  89:     }
  90:     if (line === "uciok") {
  91:       this.worker.postMessage("isready");
  92:       return;
  93:     }
  94:     if (line === "readyok") {
  95:       this.ready = true;
  96:       this.onStatus("ready");
  97:       this.startQueuedAnalysis();
  98:       return;
  99:     }
 100:     if (line.startsWith("info ")) {
 101:       if (this.awaitingStop) return;
 102:       const score = parseUciInfo(line, this.currentSide);
 103:       if (score) {
 104:         this.latestScore = score;
 105:         this.onScore(score);
 106:       }
 107:       return;
 108:     }
 109:     const bestMove = line.match(/^bestmove (\S+)/)?.[1];
 110:     if (!bestMove) return;
 111:     this.searching = false;
 112:     if (this.awaitingStop) {
 113:       this.awaitingStop = false;
 114:       this.startQueuedAnalysis();
 115:       return;
 116:     }
 117:     if (this.latestScore) {
 118:       this.latestScore = { ...this.latestScore, bestMove: bestMove === "(none)" ? undefined : bestMove };
 119:       this.onScore(this.latestScore);
 120:     }
 121:     this.onStatus("ready");
 122:   }
 123: 
 124:   private startQueuedAnalysis(): void {
 125:     if (!this.ready || this.searching || !this.queued) return;
 126:     const request = this.queued;
 127:     this.queued = null;
 128:     this.currentSide = request.fen.split(/\s+/)[1] === "b" ? "b" : "w";
 129:     this.searching = true;
 130:     this.latestScore = null;
 131:     this.onStatus("analyzing");
 132:     this.worker.postMessage(`position fen ${request.fen}`);
 133:     this.worker.postMessage(`go depth ${request.depth}`);
 134:   }

   7: function openDatabase(): Promise<IDBDatabase> {
   8:   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
   9:     const request = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION);
  10:     request.onupgradeneeded = () => {
  11:       const db = request.result;
  12:       if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains("books")) {
  13:         db.createObjectStore("books", { keyPath: "id" });
  14:       }
  15:       if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains("sessions")) {
  16:         db.createObjectStore("sessions", { keyPath: "bookId" });
  17:       }
  18:       if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains("settings")) {
  19:         db.createObjectStore("settings", { keyPath: "key" });
  20:       }
  21:     };
  22:     request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
  23:     request.onerror = () => reject(request.error ?? new Error("Could not open local library."));
  24:   });
  25: }
  26: 
  27: async function transact<T>(
  28:   storeName: string,
  29:   mode: IDBTransactionMode,
  30:   run: (store: IDBObjectStore) => IDBRequest<T>,
  31: ): Promise<T> {
  32:   const db = await openDatabase();
  33:   try {
  34:     return await new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
  35:       const transaction = db.transaction(storeName, mode);
  36:       let outcome: { value: T } | null = null;
  37:       transaction.oncomplete = () => {
  38:         if (outcome) resolve(outcome.value);
  39:         else reject(new Error("Local library transaction completed without a result."));
  40:       };
  41:       transaction.onerror = () => reject(transaction.error ?? new Error("Local library transaction failed."));
  42:       transaction.onabort = () => reject(transaction.error ?? new Error("Local library transaction aborted."));
  43:       const request = run(transaction.objectStore(storeName));
  44:       request.onsuccess = () => { outcome = { value: request.result }; };
  45:       request.onerror = () => reject(request.error ?? new Error("Local library operation failed."));
  46:     });
  47:   } finally {
  48:     db.close();
  49:   }
  50: }

  32: function openStudyDb(): Promise<IDBDatabase> {
  33:   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  34:     const request = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, 1);
  35:     request.onupgradeneeded = () => {
  36:       const db = request.result;
  37:       if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE)) {
  38:         db.createObjectStore(STORE, { keyPath: "id" });
  39:       }
  40:     };
  41:     request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
  42:     request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
  43:   });
  44: }

  46: async function readItems(): Promise<StudyItem[]> {

 267: 
 268:       <div className="study-breadcrumb">
 269:         <button onClick={() => setFolderId(null)}><Home size={13} /> Studies</button>
 270:         {folderId && (
 271:           <>
 272:             <ChevronRight size={13} />
 273:             <span>{items.find(item => item.id === folderId)?.name ?? "Folder"}</span>
 274:             <button className="study-up-button" onClick={() => setFolderId(items.find(item => item.id === folderId)?.parentId ?? null)}>Up</button>
 275:           </>
 276:         )}
 277:       </div>
 278: 
 279:       {loading ? <div className="study-empty">Loading studies…</div> : (
 280:         <div className="study-item-list">
 281:           {visibleItems.map(item => (
 282:             <div className={`study-item ${selectedId === item.id ? "study-item-active" : ""}`} key={item.id}>
 283:               <button className="study-item-open" onClick={() => item.kind === "folder" ? setFolderId(item.id) : openText(item)}>
 284:                 {item.kind === "folder" ? <Folder size={16} /> : <FileText size={16} />}
 285:                 <span>{item.name}</span>
 286:               </button>
 287:               <details className="study-item-menu">
 288:                 <summary aria-label={`Options for ${item.name}`}>⋯</summary>
 289:                 <div>
 290:                   {item.kind === "text" && <button onClick={() => exportText(item)}>Export .txt</button>}
 291:                   <button onClick={() => void renameItem(item)}><Pencil size={13} /> Rename</button>
 292:                   <button className="study-delete-action" onClick={() => void removeItem(item)}><Trash2 size={13} /> Delete</button>
 293:                 </div>
 294:               </details>
 295:             </div>
 296:           ))}
 297:           {!visibleItems.length && <div className="study-empty">No items here yet. Use + to create a document or folder.</div>}
 298:         </div>
 299:       )}
 300: 
 301:       {selected && (
 302:         <div className="study-editor">
 303:           <div className="study-editor-heading">
 304:             <FileText size={15} />
 305:             <strong>{selected.name}</strong>
 306:             <span>{saving ? "Saving…" : <><Check size={12} /> Saved</>}</span>
 307:           </div>
 308:           <textarea
 309:             aria-label="Study document content"
 310:             value={draft}
 311:             onChange={event => setDraft(event.target.value)}
 312:             placeholder="Write your ideas, opening traps, endgame plans…"
 313:             spellCheck
 314:           />
 315:           {error && <div className="study-error" role="alert">{error}</div>}
 316:         </div>
 317:       )}
 318:       {error && !selected && <div className="study-error" role="alert">{error}</div>}
 319:       <div className="study-library-footer">Stored locally in this browser · Export documents to keep a separate .txt copy.</div>
 320:     </div>
 321:   );
 322: }

 165: def count_repeated_peaks(values: np.ndarray) -> int:
 166:     if len(values) < 12:
 167:         return 0
 168:     smooth = np.convolve(values, np.ones(3, dtype=np.float32) / 3, mode="same")
 169:     threshold = float(np.mean(smooth) + np.std(smooth) * 0.45)
 170:     peak_indices = np.where((smooth[1:-1] > smooth[:-2]) & (smooth[1:-1] >= smooth[2:]) & (smooth[1:-1] > threshold))[0] + 1
 171:     count = 0
 172:     last = -4
 173:     for index in peak_indices:
 174:         if index - last >= max(2, len(values) // 15):
 175:             count += 1
 176:             last = int(index)
 177:     return count

 180: @lru_cache(maxsize=256)
 181: def cell_sample_offsets(size: int) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, int]:
 182:     patch = max(1, size // 16)
 183:     starts_x = np.arange(8) * size // 8 + (size // 8 - patch) // 2
 184:     starts_y = np.arange(8) * size // 8 + (size // 8 - patch) // 2
 185:     return starts_x, starts_y, starts_x + patch, starts_y + patch, patch

 188: def checker_score(integral: np.ndarray, x: int, y: int, size: int) -> tuple[float, float]:
 189:     """Score all 64 cells together; a partial grid cannot pass on line count alone."""
 190:     starts_x, starts_y, ends_x, ends_y, patch = cell_sample_offsets(size)
 191:     sums = (
 192:         integral[y + ends_y[:, None], x + ends_x]
 193:         - integral[y + starts_y[:, None], x + ends_x]
 194:         - integral[y + ends_y[:, None], x + starts_x]
 195:         + integral[y + starts_y[:, None], x + starts_x]
 196:     )
 197:     cells = (sums / (patch * patch)).astype(np.float32)
 198:     centered = cells - cells.mean()
 199:     variation = float(np.sqrt(np.sum(centered * centered)))
 200:     if variation < 1:
 201:         return 0.0, 0.0
 202:     correlation = abs(float(np.sum(centered * _PARITY))) / (variation * 8)
 203:     contrast = abs(float(cells[_EVEN_CELLS].mean() - cells[_ODD_CELLS].mean())) / max(variation / 8, 12.0)
 204:     return correlation, contrast
 205: 
 206: 
 207: def continuation_score(gray: np.ndarray, x: int, y: int, size: int, contrast: float) -> float:
 208:     """Penalize a box when the alternating cells visibly continue outside its edge."""
 209:     height, width = gray.shape[:2]
 210:     band = max(2, size // 24)
 211:     scores: list[float] = []
 212:     for side, start, end in (
 213:         ("left", x - band, x),
 214:         ("right", x + size, x + size + band),
 215:         ("top", y - band, y),
 216:         ("bottom", y + size, y + size + band),
 217:     ):
 218:         if side in {"left", "right"}:
 219:             start, end = max(0, start), min(width, end)
 220:             if end - start < band:
 221:                 continue
 222:             strip = gray[y : y + size, start:end]
 223:             values = cv2.resize(strip, (1, 8), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA).reshape(8)
 224:             expected = np.array([(-1.0) ** (row + (8 if side == "right" else -1)) for row in range(8)])
 225:             board_mean = cv2.resize(gray[y : y + size, x : x + size], (8, 8), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA).mean()
 226:         else:
 227:             start, end = max(0, start), min(height, end)
 228:             if end - start < band:
 229:                 continue
 230:             strip = gray[start:end, x : x + size]
 231:             values = cv2.resize(strip, (8, 1), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA).reshape(8)
 232:             expected = np.array([(-1.0) ** ((0 if side == "top" else 8) + col) for col in range(8)])
 233:             board_mean = cv2.resize(gray[y : y + size, x : x + size], (8, 8), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA).mean()
 234:         correlation = abs(float(np.dot(values - board_mean, expected) / (np.linalg.norm(values - board_mean) * np.sqrt(8) + 1e-6)))
 235:         scores.append(correlation)
 236:     if not scores:
 237:         return 0.0
 238:     return max(scores) * min(1.0, contrast / 0.8)
 239: 
 240: 
 241: def find_grid_candidates(image: np.ndarray) -> list[Candidate]:
 242:     height, width = image.shape[:2]
 243:     gray = cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
 244:     integral = cv2.integral(gray, sdepth=cv2.CV_64F)
 245:     smallest = 40
 246:     largest = min(width, height)
 247:     if largest < smallest:
 248:         return []
 249: 
 250:     # A coarse, multiscale square-window scan finds borderless diagrams too.
 251:     sizes: list[int] = []
 252:     size = smallest
 253:     while size <= largest:
 254:         sizes.append(size)
 255:         next_size = max(size + 1, round(size * 1.1))
 256:         if next_size == size:
 257:             break
 258:         size = next_size
 259:     if sizes[-1] != largest:
 260:         sizes.append(largest)
 261: 
 262:     found: list[tuple[int, int, int, int, float]] = []
 263:     for size in sizes:
 264:         step = max(4, size // 4)
 265:         xs = list(range(0, width - size + 1, step))
 266:         ys = list(range(0, height - size + 1, step))
 267:         if not xs or xs[-1] != width - size:
 268:             xs.append(width - size)
 269:         if not ys or ys[-1] != height - size:
 270:             ys.append(height - size)
 271:         for y in ys:
 272:             for x in xs:
 273:                 correlation, contrast = checker_score(integral, x, y, size)
 274:                 if correlation < 0.3 or contrast < 0.5:
 275:                     continue
 276:                 score = 0.72 * correlation + 0.28 * min(1.0, contrast / 1.2)
 277:                 if score >= 0.38:
 278:                     found.append((x, y, size, size, score))
 279: 
 280:     # Contours add precise outer-frame seeds that a coarse texture scan can miss.
 281:     edges = cv2.Canny(cv2.GaussianBlur(gray, (3, 3), 0), 40, 130)
 282:     contours, _ = cv2.findContours(edges, cv2.RETR_LIST, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
 283:     for contour in contours:
 284:         x, y, box_width, box_height = cv2.boundingRect(contour)
 285:         if box_width < smallest or box_height < smallest:
 286:             continue
 287:         ratio = box_width / box_height
 288:         if not 0.78 <= ratio <= 1.28:
 289:             continue
 290:         size = round((box_width + box_height) / 2)
 291:         if size > largest:
 292:             continue
 293:         x = min(x, width - size)
 294:         y = min(y, height - size)
 295:         correlation, contrast = checker_score(integral, x, y, size)
 296:         score = 0.72 * correlation + 0.28 * min(1.0, contrast / 1.2)
 297:         if correlation >= 0.3 and contrast >= 0.5 and score >= 0.38:
 298:             found.append((x, y, size, size, score))
 299: 
 300:     found.sort(key=lambda item: item[4], reverse=True)
 301:     seeds: list[tuple[int, int, int, int, float]] = []
 302:     for proposal in found:
 303:         if any(intersection_over_union(proposal, existing) > 0.42 for existing in seeds):
 304:             continue
 305:         seeds.append(proposal)
 306:         if len(seeds) == 32:
 307:             break
 308: 
 309:     refined: list[tuple[int, int, int, int, float]] = []
 310:     for seed_x, seed_y, seed_size, _, _ in seeds:
 311:         position_step = max(2, seed_size // 32)
 312:         size_step = max(2, seed_size // 32)
 313:         minimum_size = max(smallest, seed_size - seed_size // 10)
 314:         maximum_size = min(largest, seed_size + seed_size // 10)
 315:         refine_sizes = list(range(minimum_size, maximum_size + 1, size_step))
 316:         if not refine_sizes or refine_sizes[-1] != maximum_size:
 317:             refine_sizes.append(maximum_size)
 318:         for candidate_size in refine_sizes:
 319:             for candidate_y in range(max(0, seed_y - seed_size // 4), min(height - candidate_size, seed_y + seed_size // 4) + 1, position_step):
 320:                 for candidate_x in range(max(0, seed_x - seed_size // 4), min(width - candidate_size, seed_x + seed_size // 4) + 1, position_step):
 321:                     correlation, contrast = checker_score(integral, candidate_x, candidate_y, candidate_size)
 322:                     if correlation < 0.3 or contrast < 0.5:
 323:                         continue
 324:                     score = 0.72 * correlation + 0.28 * min(1.0, contrast / 1.2)
 325:                     refined.append((candidate_x, candidate_y, candidate_size, candidate_size, score))
 326: 
 327:     refined.sort(key=lambda item: item[4], reverse=True)
 328:     proposals: list[tuple[int, int, int, int, float]] = []
 329:     for proposal in refined:
 330:         if any(intersection_over_union(proposal, existing) > 0.82 for existing in proposals):
 331:             continue
 332:         proposals.append(proposal)
 333:         if len(proposals) == 384:
 334:             break
 335: 
 336:     kept: list[tuple[int, int, int, int, float]] = []
 337:     for candidate in proposals:
 338:         if any(intersection_over_union(candidate, existing) > 0.42 for existing in kept):
 339:             continue
 340:         _, y, size, _, score = candidate
 341:         contrast = checker_score(integral, candidate[0], y, size)[1]
 342:         clipped = continuation_score(gray, candidate[0], y, size, contrast)
 343:         if clipped > 0.82:
 344:             continue
 345:         candidate = (*candidate[:4], score - 0.28 * clipped)
 346:         if candidate[4] < 0.70:
 347:             continue
 348:         kept.append(candidate)
 349:         if len(kept) == 32:
 350:             break
 351: 
 352:     return [
 353:         Candidate(
 354:             id=f"page-candidate-{index + 1}",
 355:             x=working_x / width,
 356:             y=working_y / height,
 357:             width=working_width / width,
 358:             height=working_height / height,
 359:             relative_score=score,
 360:         )
 361:         for index, (working_x, working_y, working_width, working_height, score) in enumerate(
 362:             sorted(kept, key=lambda item: (item[1], item[0]))
 363:         )
 364:     ]
 365: 
 366: 
 367: def intersection_over_union(a: tuple[int, int, int, int, float], b: tuple[int, int, int, int, float]) -> float:
 368:     ax, ay, aw, ah, _ = a
 369:     bx, by, bw, bh, _ = b
 370:     overlap_width = max(0, min(ax + aw, bx + bw) - max(ax, bx))
 371:     overlap_height = max(0, min(ay + ah, by + bh) - max(ay, by))
 372:     intersection = overlap_width * overlap_height
 373:     union = aw * ah + bw * bh - intersection
 374:     return intersection / union if union else 0.0

  47: def _prepare_image(image: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, float, float, float]:
  48:     height, width = image.shape[:2]
  49:     scale = min(MODEL_SIZE / width, MODEL_SIZE / height)
  50:     resized_width = round(width * scale)
  51:     resized_height = round(height * scale)
  52:     resized = cv2.resize(image, (resized_width, resized_height), interpolation=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)
  53:     pad_x = (MODEL_SIZE - resized_width) / 2
  54:     pad_y = (MODEL_SIZE - resized_height) / 2
  55:     left, top = round(pad_x - 0.1), round(pad_y - 0.1)
  56:     right, bottom = MODEL_SIZE - resized_width - left, MODEL_SIZE - resized_height - top
  57:     padded = cv2.copyMakeBorder(
  58:         resized, top, bottom, left, right, cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT, value=(114, 114, 114)
  59:     )
  60:     tensor = np.ascontiguousarray(
  61:         padded[:, :, ::-1].transpose(2, 0, 1)[None].astype(np.float32) / 255.0
  62:     )
  63:     return tensor, scale, float(left), float(top)

  66: def _decode_rows(
  67:     rows: np.ndarray,
  68:     image_width: int,
  69:     image_height: int,
  70:     scale: float,
  71:     pad_x: float,

  84:             max(0.0, min(float(image_height), (y2 - pad_y) / scale)),
  85:         )
  86:         if box[2] > box[0] and box[3] > box[1]:
  87:             detections.append(Detection(class_id, confidence, box))

  91: def _fen_placement(

  93: ) -> tuple[str, dict[str, float], int]:
  94:     ranks: list[str] = []
  95:     confidences: dict[str, float] = {}
  96:     collisions = 0
  97:     for row in range(8):
  98:         rank_text = ""
  99:         empty_count = 0
 100:         for col in range(8):
 101:             visual_row = 7 - row if flipped else row

 103:             piece = pieces.get((visual_row, visual_col))
 104:             if piece is None:
 105:                 empty_count += 1
 106:                 continue
 107:             if empty_count:
 108:                 rank_text += str(empty_count)
 109:                 empty_count = 0
 110:             rank_text += piece[0]
 111:             file_name = chr(ord("a") + col)
 112:             rank_name = str(8 - row)
 113:             confidences[file_name + rank_name] = piece[1]
 114:         if empty_count:
 115:             rank_text += str(empty_count)
 116:         ranks.append(rank_text)
 117:     return "/".join(ranks), confidences, collisions

 120: def assemble_position(detections: list[Detection], image_width: int, image_height: int) -> dict:
 121:     boards = [item for item in detections if item.class_id == 0]
 122:     if not boards:
 123:         raise ValueError("The OCR model did not localize a complete chessboard in this crop.")
 124:     board = max(boards, key=lambda item: item.confidence)
 125:     x1, y1, x2, y2 = board.box
 126:     if x2 - x1 < 8 or y2 - y1 < 8:
 127:         raise ValueError("The recognized board crop is too small. Adjust the crop and retry.")
 128: 
 129:     pieces: dict[tuple[int, int], tuple[str, float]] = {}
 130:     unmatched_count = 0
 131:     collisions = 0
 132:     for item in detections:
 133:         if item.class_id not in PIECE_TO_FEN:
 134:             continue
 135:         center_x = (item.box[0] + item.box[2]) / 2
 136:         center_y = (item.box[1] + item.box[3]) / 2
 137:         if not (x1 <= center_x < x2 and y1 <= center_y < y2):
 138:             unmatched_count += 1
 139:             continue
 140:         col = min(7, int((center_x - x1) / ((x2 - x1) / 8)))
 141:         row = min(7, int((center_y - y1) / ((y2 - y1) / 8)))
 142:         previous = pieces.get((row, col))
 143:         if previous is None or item.confidence > previous[1]:
 144:             if previous is not None:
 145:                 collisions += 1
 146:             pieces[(row, col)] = (PIECE_TO_FEN[item.class_id], item.confidence)
 147:         else:
 148:             collisions += 1
 149: 
 150:     orientation_marker = [item for item in detections if item.class_id == 13]
 151:     orientation_detection = max(orientation_marker, key=lambda item: item.confidence) if orientation_marker else None
 152:     flipped = bool(orientation_detection and (orientation_detection.box[1] + orientation_detection.box[3]) / 2 < (y1 + y2) / 2)
 153:     orientation = "flipped" if flipped else "normal" if orientation_detection else "unknown"
 154: 
 155:     placement, piece_confidences, _ = _fen_placement(pieces, flipped)
 156:     end_markers = [item for item in detections if item.class_id == 15]
 157:     turn = "w"
 158:     turn_inferred = False
 159:     if end_markers:
 160:         marker = max(end_markers, key=lambda item: item.confidence)
 161:         marker_center = ((marker.box[0] + marker.box[2]) / 2, (marker.box[1] + marker.box[3]) / 2)
 162:         for item in detections:
 163:             if item.class_id in PIECE_TO_FEN and (
 164:                 item.box[0] <= marker_center[0] <= item.box[2]
 165:                 and item.box[1] <= marker_center[1] <= item.box[3]
 166:             ):
 167:                 turn = "w" if item.class_id <= 6 else "b"
 168:                 turn_inferred = True
 169:                 break
 170: 
 171:     piece_scores = [score for _, score in pieces.values()]
 172:     return {
 173:         "fen": f"{placement} {turn} - - 0 1",
 174:         "placement": placement,
 175:         "orientation": orientation,
 176:         "orientation_confidence": orientation_detection.confidence if orientation_detection else None,
 177:         "turn_inferred": turn_inferred,
 178:         "board_confidence": board.confidence,
 179:         "mean_piece_confidence": sum(piece_scores) / len(piece_scores) if piece_scores else None,
 180:         "piece_confidences": piece_confidences,
 181:         "piece_count": len(pieces),
 182:         "unmatched_piece_count": unmatched_count,
 183:         "collision_count": collisions,
 184:         "warnings": [
 185:             *([] if orientation_detection else ["Board orientation was not detected; normal orientation is assumed."]),
 186:             *([] if turn_inferred else ["Side to move is not visible; White is assumed."]),
 187:             *(["No chess pieces were recognized. Do not trust this position; adjust the crop and retry."] if not pieces else []),
 188:             *([f"{collisions} overlapping piece detections shared a square; the highest-confidence detection was kept."] if collisions else []),
 189:             *([f"{unmatched_count} piece detections fell outside the detected board and were ignored."] if unmatched_count else []),
 190:             "Castling rights and en-passant state cannot be determined from a static diagram; FEN defaults are used.",
 191:         ],
 192:     }

 195: def _normalize_model_rows(output: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
 196:     """Normalize supported batched/unbatched [N, 6] detection outputs."""
 197:     raw = np.asarray(output)
 198:     original_shape = raw.shape
 199:     if raw.ndim >= 3 and raw.shape[0] == 1:
 200:         raw = raw[0]
 201:     if raw.ndim == 1 and raw.size % 6 == 0:
 202:         raw = raw.reshape(-1, 6)
 203:     if raw.ndim != 2 or raw.shape[-1] != 6:
 204:         raise ValueError(
 205:             f"Unsupported OCR model output shape {original_shape}; expected detection rows [N, 6]."
 206:         )
 207:     return raw

 210: def recognize_image(image: np.ndarray) -> dict:
 211:     tensor, scale, pad_x, pad_y = _prepare_image(image)
 212:     session = _model_session()
 213:     outputs = session.run(None, {session.get_inputs()[0].name: tensor})
 214:     if not outputs:
 215:         raise ValueError("The OCR model returned no outputs. Verify that the installed model is compatible.")
 216:     rows = _normalize_model_rows(outputs[0])
 217:     detections = _decode_rows(
 218:         rows, image.shape[1], image.shape[0], scale, pad_x, pad_y
 219:     )
 220:     result = assemble_position(detections, image.shape[1], image.shape[0])
 221:     result["model"] = "2d-chess-ocr/yolo26m-finetuned"
 222:     return result

 224: def detect_board_candidates(
 225:     image: np.ndarray,
 226:     tile_size: int = 640,
 227:     overlap: float = 0.25,
 228:     max_candidates: int = 32,
 229:     min_board_side: int = 32,
 230:     nms_iou: float = 0.35,
 231: ) -> list[dict]:
 232:     """
 233:     Detect multiple chessboards across a page using overlapping tiles.
 234: 
 235:     Returns normalized page coordinates:
 236:     x, y, width, height, relative_score.
 237: 
 238:     relative_score is the model's board confidence, not a calibrated
 239:     probability that the entire position/FEN is correct.
 240:     """
 241:     if image is None or image.ndim != 3 or image.shape[2] != 3:
 242:         raise ValueError("Expected a decoded BGR image.")
 243: 
 244:     if tile_size < 64:
 245:         raise ValueError("tile_size must be at least 64.")
 246:     if not 0 <= overlap < 1:
 247:         raise ValueError("overlap must be in the range [0, 1).")
 248: 
 249:     page_height, page_width = image.shape[:2]
 250:     if page_width == 0 or page_height == 0:
 251:         return []
 252: 
 253:     session = _model_session()
 254:     input_name = session.get_inputs()[0].name
 255: 
 256:     stride = max(1, round(tile_size * (1.0 - overlap)))
 257: 
 258:     def tile_starts(length: int) -> list[int]:
 259:         if length <= tile_size:
 260:             return [0]
 261:         starts = list(range(0, length - tile_size + 1, stride))
 262:         last = length - tile_size
 263:         if starts[-1] != last:
 264:             starts.append(last)
 265:         return starts
 266: 
 267:     # Each entry is (x1, y1, x2, y2, confidence) in page pixels.
 268:     boxes: list[tuple[float, float, float, float, float]] = []
 269: 
 270:     for top in tile_starts(page_height):
 271:         for left in tile_starts(page_width):
 272:             right = min(left + tile_size, page_width)
 273:             bottom = min(top + tile_size, page_height)
 274:             tile = image[top:bottom, left:right]
 275: 
 276:             tensor, scale, pad_x, pad_y = _prepare_image(tile)
 277:             outputs = session.run(None, {input_name: tensor})
 278: 
 279:             if not outputs:
 280:                 raise ValueError("The OCR model returned no outputs.")
 281: 
 282:             rows = _normalize_model_rows(outputs[0])
 283:             detections = _decode_rows(
 284:                 rows,
 285:                 tile.shape[1],
 286:                 tile.shape[0],
 287:                 scale,
 288:                 pad_x,
 289:                 pad_y,
 290:             )
 291: 
 292:             for detection in detections:
 293:                 if detection.class_id != 0:
 294:                     continue
 295: 
 296:                 x1, y1, x2, y2 = detection.box
 297:                 if x2 <= x1 or y2 <= y1:
 298:                     continue
 299:                 if min(x2 - x1, y2 - y1) < min_board_side:
 300:                     continue
 301: 
 302:                 # Translate tile coordinates to original page coordinates.
 303:                 x1 += left
 304:                 x2 += left
 305:                 y1 += top
 306:                 y2 += top
 307: 
 308:                 x1 = max(0.0, min(float(page_width), x1))
 309:                 x2 = max(0.0, min(float(page_width), x2))
 310:                 y1 = max(0.0, min(float(page_height), y1))
 311:                 y2 = max(0.0, min(float(page_height), y2))
 312: 
 313:                 if x2 > x1 and y2 > y1:
 314:                     boxes.append(
 315:                         (x1, y1, x2, y2, detection.confidence)
 316:                     )
 317: 
 318:     # Greedy non-maximum suppression removes duplicate boards from
 319:     # overlapping tiles while keeping distinct nearby diagrams.
 320:     boxes.sort(key=lambda box: box[4], reverse=True)
 321:     kept: list[tuple[float, float, float, float, float]] = []
 322: 
 323:     for candidate in boxes:
 324:         ax1, ay1, ax2, ay2, _ = candidate
 325:         area_a = (ax2 - ax1) * (ay2 - ay1)
 326:         duplicate = False
 327: 
 328:         for existing in kept:
 329:             bx1, by1, bx2, by2, _ = existing
 330:             ix1, iy1 = max(ax1, bx1), max(ay1, by1)
 331:             ix2, iy2 = min(ax2, bx2), min(ay2, by2)
 332:             intersection = max(0.0, ix2 - ix1) * max(0.0, iy2 - iy1)
 333:             area_b = (bx2 - bx1) * (by2 - by1)
 334:             union = area_a + area_b - intersection
 335: 
 336:             smaller_area = min(area_a, area_b)
 337:             containment = intersection / smaller_area if smaller_area > 0 else 0.0
 338: 
 339:             # Remove partial detections contained within a stronger,
 340:             # larger board candidate, even when ordinary IoU is low.
 341:             if (
 342:                 (union > 0 and intersection / union > nms_iou)
 343:                 or containment > 0.80
 344:             ):
 345:                 duplicate = True
 346:                 break
 347: 
 348:         if not duplicate:
 349:             kept.append(candidate)
 350:             if len(kept) >= max_candidates:
 351:                 break
 352: 
 353:     # The frontend expects normalized coordinates, independent of page size.
 354:     kept.sort(key=lambda box: (box[1], box[0]))
 355: 
 356:     return [
 357:         {
 358:             "x": x1 / page_width,
 359:             "y": y1 / page_height,
 360:             "width": (x2 - x1) / page_width,
 361:             "height": (y2 - y1) / page_height,
 362:             "relative_score": confidence,
 363:         }
 364:         for x1, y1, x2, y2, confidence in kept
 365:     ]

================================================================================
BACKEND FILE: backend\app\__init__.py (0 bytes)

7. PROBLEMS IDENTIFIED & FEATURE GAP AUDIT SUMMARY
--------------------------------------------------
- PROBLEM 1 (Book Reader Overwritten): Recent patch replaced src/App.tsx with a simplified 220-line shell, disconnecting PDF.js book rendering, diagram cropping, Stockfish engine hook, PGN import modal, Opening Explorer, and Notation Learner.
- PROBLEM 2 (UI Reference Mode Toolbar): ReferenceSwitcher toolbar ('Chess.com Analysis (Ref #5)', etc.) is still rendered inside GameReview.tsx and must be completely removed.
- PROBLEM 3 (Coach / AI Move Reasoning in GameReview): Coach portrait, speech bubble, and natural-language explanations must be removed and replaced with purely data-driven Chess.com Premium statistics, accuracy, evaluation graph, key moments, and engine PV lines.
- PROBLEM 4 (Inconsistent Chessboards & Blue Theme): App.tsx and CoordinateTraining/AnalysisBoard use different square colors (#b59cd9 purple, #7c8d9e slate, #0f172a blue background) instead of the unified Chess.com dark charcoal theme (#312e2b / #262421) and unified tan/brown chessboard (#e6cfa7 / #b48764) with identical Neo-Staunton vector pieces from image_a898f9.png.
- PROBLEM 5 (Screen Space & Viewport Utilization): Fixed narrow max-widths leave large empty margins around Analysis Board, Game Review, and Coordinate Training.
- PROBLEM 6 (Direct Lichess & Chess.com Game Import): Game Review needs an IMPORT GAMES modal supporting Lichess API (/api/games/user/{username}), Chess.com PubAPI (/pub/player/{username}/games/{YYYY}/{MM}/pgn), PGN file upload, and Paste PGN with local library deduplication.
